kogmaw__ahri.notes:
- threat: Ahri's Charm locks you down; Spirit Rush lets her kite and reposition freely after.
- early: Dangerous. Stay back from minions. Dodge Orb of Deception on return; it deals true damage.
- trading: Never trade into her range. Bait Charm by moving unpredictably; use W range to farm safely.
- post6: Matchup worsens significantly. Spirit Rush gives her three escape routes; you cannot chase or all-in.
- spike: First item (Luden's Tempest or similar AP spike) is dangerous. You lack sustained damage early.
- window: Mid-game after two items when your attack range and on-hit damage outscale her burst window.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Ahri wants to roam; denying her quick push forces her mid.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale her long fights; she wins short skirmishes with charm and mobility early.
- item: Void Staff to shred her AP scaling defenses after first major item completion.

kogmaw__akali.notes:
- Akali's W Twilight Shroud makes her untargetable; your R Living Artillery cannot confirm kills through it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Akali's all-in with E Shuriken Flip and Q Five Point Strike hurts hard.
- Never chase Akali into fog; bait her W, then unload Q Caustic Spittle and W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6, her R Perfect Execution gap-closes fast; position near walls or teammates to limit her dash angles.
- Akali's first item spike (around Nashor's Tooth or Lich Bane) is dangerous; stay back and farm safely.
- Your window is when Akali wastes W Twilight Shroud; immediately land R Living Artillery or all-in with range.
- Hold wave near your tower; force Akali to dive through minions or gank, reducing her all-in threat.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Akali hard with attack speed and W Bio-Arcane Barrage on-hit damage later.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to survive her R Perfect Execution burst and extend teamfight presence safely.

kogmaw__akshan.notes:
- Akshan's Heroic Swing mobility lets him chase, dodge your skillshots, and threaten all-ins relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Akshan's double-attack pressure and sustained DPS win short trades early.
- Bait Avengerang with sidestep, then unload—his boomerang is his only guaranteed poke tool.
- Post-6, Comeuppance forces you into awkward positioning; never fight when low health near him.
- Akshan's first-item spike (likely Manamune or Essence Reaver) is dangerous; farm safely and scale.
- Power window: mid-game teamfights when you have Kraken Slayer and range to kite his engage.
- Hold wave near tower; let Akshan push in so Heroic Swing is less effective defensively.
- Use Scaling; your late-game W and Artillery outscale his early mobility and all-in threat.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stall Comeuppance channel or survive Heroic Swing all-in attempts.

kogmaw__alistar.notes:
- Alistar's Q Pulverize and W Headbutt lock you down; follow-up E stun kills immobilized targets.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; stay maximum range, use Q to corrode and kite backward safely.
- Never trade close range; bait Q Pulverize by repositioning, then punish with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6 Alistar's R Unbreakable Will negates your kiting; play further back and respect engage windows.
- Alistar's first item spike (typically Sunfire) is a danger window; maintain distance and avoid grouped play.
- Your punish window is mid-game when he's on cooldown; unload W and R Living Artillery freely.
- Hold wave near your tower; Alistar's engage tools are shorter range, forcing him to overextend.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Alistar and need defensive stats to survive his all-in attempts safely.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass as a counter-item; it dodges his engage combo and saves immobilized self.

kogmaw__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns you at close range; you die in follow-up burst.
- Play safe behind minions; Bandage Toss is a skillshot—dodge sideways when you see it coming.
- Never trade into Amumu directly; kite backward and use Caustic Spittle to slow his approach.
- Post-6, respect his ultimate range; position far back and use Living Artillery to poke safely.
- Amumu's first item is a danger window; stay near tower and spam Q to harass.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Amumu is on cooldown post-teamfight; unleash Bio-Arcane Barrage trades then.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Amumu wants close fights—deny him by staying safe.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Amumu's engage threat hard in extended teamfights with items.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Curse of the Sad Mummy's stun and burst chain.

kogmaw__anivia.notes:
- Crystallize walls trap you; Flash Frost stun + Frostbite double damage combo kills.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid pushing up; respect her all-in threat.
- Dodge Flash Frost with movement; never trade into her post-stun; use W range advantage.
- Glacial Storm zoning forces you back; her egg makes fights harder; play safer.
- Anivia first item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) increases kill pressure; farm safely, don't force.
- Post-Berserker's Greaves and attack speed, you outrange and kite her; punish overextension.
- Hold wave near tower; her wall blocks escape routes; deny gank setups for her.
- Scaling; you scale harder into late game; survive early, spike with items.
- Void Staff; her magic resist itemization becomes real threat; shred it for team.

kogmaw__annie.notes:
- threat: Annie's Pyromania stun locks you down; Summon: Tibbers burst combo deletes immobile Kog'Maw instantly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range farming; never let Annie land Disintegrate or Incinerate; dodge toward tower.
- trading: Never trade into her spell cooldowns; bait Disintegrate by moving unpredictably, then attack with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- post6: Summon: Tibbers range forces you further back; reposition before her fourth spell stacks Pyromania.
- spike: First item (Luden's-type) around level 9 increases burst; farm safely and respect her all-in window.
- window: Mid-game when Annie lacks cooldown reduction; abuse Bio-Arcane Barrage range advantage and kite backward constantly.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Annie needs to push forward to threaten; punish overextension with R.
- rune: Standard (default) — Kog'Maw needs consistent scaling and kiting tools; hard engage runes waste your range.
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass stops Summon: Tibbers burst and gives you time for cooldown resets and safety.

kogmaw__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's Public Execution suppresses you, guarantees follow-up damage and stun; you cannot kite or escape.
- Stay behind minions levels 1–3; her Cunning Sweep and Lacerate gap-close and chunk hard.
- Never trade into her Repudiation window; bait her W shield-tank, then kite backward with Q.
- Public Execution reaches across the map; position near walls or jungle; use Living Artillery to scout danger.
- Her first item spike (likely Kaenic Rookern or Black Cleaver) increases survivability; punish her before completion.
- Mid-game when you have two items and she is still one; kite and spam Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; minimize her all-in engagement range and bait her ult while safety exists.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her late-game with range, attack speed, and percent health damage output.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to delay and survive Public Execution suppression and follow-up slam-stun chain.

kogmaw__aphelios.notes:
- Aphelios' long-range poke and weapon flexibility overwhelm Kog'Maw's shorter effective range early.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at maximum distance and avoid extended trades near minions.
- Dodge his Calibrum marks by repositioning; never fight when marked as follow-up damages hard.
- Post-6, Moonlight Vigil applies his main weapon effect at massive range; respect it heavily.
- His first item spike (likely Manamune or crit item) creates a major damage threat window.
- Spike advantage arrives mid-game when Kog'Maw reaches two crit items and Aphelios runs low ammo.
- Hold wave near your tower; Aphelios outranges you, so deny him free poke opportunities safely.
- Pick Scaling; you scale harder into late game and need time to itemize safely.
- Add Wit's End to block his magic damage and steal attack speed when trading.

kogmaw__ashe.notes:
- Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns from range; you cannot dodge it, only respect distance.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; Volley applies Frost Shot slow, enabling her all-in with Ranger's Focus.
- Never trade into her slowed attacks; wait for her to miss Volley, then Bio-Arcane Barrage safely.
- Post-6, Enchanted Crystal Arrow is a hard engage tool—play further back and use Void Ooze to kite.
- Ashe first-item spike (Kraken Slayer or Runaan's Hurricane) increases her Volley pressure; farm safely under tower then.
- Your window opens when Ashe burns Enchanted Crystal Arrow; Living Artillery harass forces her to respect your range.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Ashe Volley shove forces you forward into Enchanted Crystal Arrow engagement range.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder than Ashe into lategame team fights with Bio-Arcane Barrage and artillery poke.
- Add Void Staff if Ashe stacks MR; otherwise, prioritize Kraken Slayer for sustained damage through her armor.

kogmaw__aurelionsol.notes:
- Astral Flight + Breath of Light combo at range deals unavoidable damage; you can't dodge channeled breath while he flies.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Aurelion Sol outranges you early, so farm from distance with Q and avoid extended trades.
- Never chase Aurelion Sol or walk into Singularity; bait his W cooldown before committing trades with your attack range.
- Post-6, Falling Star stun into Breath of Light is lethal; respect the range and play behind minions for cover.
- Aurelion Sol's first item spike (typically Luden's or Rylai's) is dangerous; don't fight clustered; spread and kite backward.
- Your window comes mid-game when he's immobile without W; force fights when his Astral Flight is on cooldown.
- Hold wave near your tower; Aurelion Sol has superior roaming, so deny him free pressure and punish his return.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack-speed scaling and percent-health damage from Bio-Arcane Barrage into late game.
- Add Wit's End to nerf his magic damage and gain magic resist without sacrificing your damage or attack speed.

kogmaw__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's Across the Veil invisibility and mobility let her reposition freely, dodging your skillshots and kiting you down.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Aurora out-trades you early. Farm at range with Caustic Spittle, avoid extended fights near her.
- Never chase Aurora into fog of war. Bait Across the Veil with a Caustic Spittle; she must reposition predictably.
- Post-6, Between Worlds gives Aurora a slow zone and teleport escape. Your Living Artillery range helps maintain distance; abuse it.
- Aurora's first item spike is manageable; you still scale harder. Abuse your range advantage before she gets defensive items.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed and on-hit items. Punish when she lacks cooldown reduction or mobility options.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Aurora's mobility punishes overextension; safer positioning lets you kite and reposition with Living Artillery.
- Scaling (default). You outscale Aurora significantly; buying time and surviving early lets your late-game damage and range win fights.
- Add Phantom Dancer; its damage reduction and mobility help you survive her burst and reposition against her slows and gaps.

kogmaw__azir.notes:
- Azir's Conquering Sands and Emperor's Divide kite and knock you back; stay out of soldier range.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Azir out-ranges and out-damages you early. Farm from max distance with Q.
- Never walk into soldier range for trades. Bait Shifting Sands by repositioning; punish his dash cooldown.
- Emperor's Divide knocks you back and damages; position away from walls. Use R to chunk him safely.
- Azir's first item (Nashor's Tooth or Liandry's Torment) spikes his sustained damage; respect soldier poke range.
- Mid-game teamfights when Azir wastes Shifting Sands or Emperor's Divide; then advance with Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it push to you. Azir controls space; don't give him initiative.
- Scaling (default); you scale better into late game and need mana to sustain poking from distance.
- Build Void Staff if Azir rushes magic resist; amplify your percent health damage through his defenses.

kogmaw__bard.notes:
- threat: Cosmic Binding stun chains you; Tempered Fate locks you down helpless during teamfights
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Bard lacks kill threat but poke hurts—stay max range, dodge Cosmic Binding
- trading: Never trade into Cosmic Binding range; bait it toward walls then all-in with Caustic Spittle
- post6: Tempered Fate stasis negates your damage and kiting; position spread so ult catches fewer allies
- spike: Bard first item (support item upgrade) isn't a threat window; you spike harder with Kraken Slayer
- window: After Bard wastes Cosmic Binding or Tempered Fate is down, use Living Artillery to pressure heavily
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; lets you kite away from Cosmic Binding and abuse range advantage safely
- rune: Scaling; you outscale Bard's utility as a hypercarry with attack speed and on-hit damage ramping
- item: Void Staff into heavy AP Bard builds; adds magic pen to Living Artillery and Bio-Arcane Barrage

kogmaw__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's dash (Q) and knockup (W) close the gap; you have no escape, so she will kill you.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm at max range with Caustic Spittle (Q), stay near tower, do not fight her.
- Never trade into her engage pattern; bait her Q or W before committing, then kite backward with Bio-Arcane Barrage (W).
- Post-6, Endless Banquet increases her range and attack speed dramatically; respect her damage and stay further back always.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; she gains raw AD and attack speed, so play safer until you scale.
- Your window is mid-game when you have two items and she has one; Living Artillery (R) reveals and damages her.
- Hold the wave near your tower; let it bounce toward you so Bel'Veth must dive through minions to reach you.
- Pick Scaling; you outscale her in teamfights with Runaan's Hurricane and percent damage, so survive early patiently.
- Add Randuin's Omen into your build to reduce her attack damage and slow her attack speed in fights.

kogmaw__blitzcrank.notes:
- threat: Rocket Grab into point-blank Power Fist and Static Field kills you before you kite away safely
- early: Dangerous; stay behind minions to block Rocket Grab, never walk up to trade short range
- trading: Never engage trades; bait Rocket Grab by positioning behind wave, then kite with Bio-Arcane Barrage range
- post6: Living Artillery outranges Blitzcrank massively; spam it from fog of war to poke and reveal him
- spike: Blitzcrank's first item (likely Protobelt or tank item) is your punish window; he lacks sustained damage yet
- window: Mid-game teamfights when you have Kraken Slayer or Lord Dominik's; kite and burst him from range
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; let Blitzcrank push into you so Rocket Grab can't catch sidelane escapees
- rune: Scaling; you outscale his engage tools and need survivability mana items more than early aggression
- item: Phantom Dancer; the movement speed and ghosting deny Blitzcrank's grab followup engage chains entirely

kogmaw__brand.notes:
- Threat: Brand stuns you with Q after Blaze stacks; Pyroclasm bounces lock you down permanently.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Brand out-ranges you. Farm from max distance, avoid clustered minions.
- Trading: Never trade into stacked Blaze. Bait Q by moving unpredictably; dodge it before committing.
- Post6: Pyroclasm bounces chain on you in teamfights. Position away from teammates; kite backwards always.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) spikes Brand hard. Farm safer; don't fight in narrow areas.
- Window: Post-first-item when you spike attack speed and range. Kite from max W range; Brand can't reach.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Forces Brand to overextend for poke; punish with R artillery.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale Brand's burst; survive early, scale into unstoppable on-hit DPS machine.
- Item: Build Wit's End third or fourth. Stacks with W on-hits, blocks Brand's magic damage and mana drain threat.

kogmaw__braum.notes:
- Braum's Unbreakable blocks all your projectiles; you cannot trade effectively into his shield.
- Levels 1-3: Play safe behind minions. Avoid Q trades; Braum stacks Concussive Blows easily with allies.
- Never trade into Unbreakable. Wait for shield cooldown, then W-auto harass. Do not get stunned.
- Post-6: Glacial Fissure's knockup locks you down hard. Position further back; use range advantage only.
- Braum first item (typically armor): Your damage drops sharply. This is his window, not yours.
- Your window: mid-game when you spike Kraken Slayer or Runaan's Hurricane; kite around his cooldowns.
- Hold wave near your tower. Braum wants to all-in close; denying engage setup keeps you safe.
- Use Scaling. You outrange and outlast Braum; scaling runes maximize your late-game W-auto dominance.
- Add Void Staff if Braum stacks Kaenic Rookern or heavy resistances early to break his defense.

kogmaw__caitlyn.notes:
- threat: Caitlyn's Headshot and Piltover Peacemaker burst from range before you can retaliate effectively.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Piltover Peacemaker pierces through. Avoid walking into Yordle Snap Trap zones.
- trading: Never walk up for autos into trap range. Bait Piltover Peacemaker by moving unpredictably sideways.
- post6: Ace in the Hole forces you to position behind walls or teammates; living Artillery outranges it.
- spike: First Kraken Slayer spike is dangerous—dodge aggressively. Punish her immobility window when trap cooldown expires.
- window: Mid-game when you have Runaan's Hurricane; sustained damage overwhelms her if she's caught without traps.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Caitlyn controls long-range poke; deny her ability to trap you forward.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale her damage and attack speed; survive early poke, win late teamfights.
- item: Phantom Dancer. Dodge her Headshots and Piltover Peacemaker shots more effectively; block a crit.

kogmaw__cassiopeia.notes:
- Cassiopeia's W grounds you, disabling your mobility and trapping you for her E spam and R.
- Stay max range with W. Farm safely from distance; avoid trading into her Q poke.
- Never walk into Miasma. Bait her W with fake repositioning, then kite backward when she commits.
- Petrifying Gaze stuns you frontally and slows backside. Play off-angle; never face her directly in teamfights.
- Her first item (likely Liandry's or Rylai's) accelerates poison damage. Play safer; farm and scale instead.
- Post-two-items you outdamage and outrange her if you avoid Miasma. Group and teamfight from distance.
- Hold wave near your tower. She roams and scales hard; denying her lane priority limits her map pressure.
- Scaling. Your range and on-hit scaling outscale her early pressure; survive laning phase and hypercarry late.
- Wit's End. Blocks her magic damage and poison application; survives her all-in burst attempts more reliably.

kogmaw__corki.notes:
- Corki's Missile Barrage deals high burst magic damage; dodge or space it carefully always.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Corki out-ranges you early. Farm behind minions, avoid Phosphorus Bomb.
- Never walk into Valkyrie's fire trail. Trade only after Corki wastes Gatling Gun cooldown.
- Missile Barrage becomes a constant threat; use W Bio-Arcane Barrage range to keep distance safely.
- Corki's first item (Manamune or Liandry's) spike is dangerous; respect damage and play back.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items; use W range to kite and farm safely.
- Hold wave near your tower; Corki's mobility lets him roam. Punish him when he leaves lane.
- Standard (default) rune page fits; you need sustain and scaling into this poke-heavy matchup.
- Add Wit's End to reduce Corki's magic damage and gain magic resist without sacrificing damage.

kogmaw__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Rupture and Feral Scream combo locks you down; Feast deletes you if caught.
- Play safe; avoid center lane. Farm at range with Caustic Spittle; respect Rupture knockup range.
- Never trade into Rupture's knockup zone. Bait Feral Scream by moving unpredictably; it's his only silence.
- Post-6, Feast true damage scales hard on you. Maximize distance; never let him get close.
- His first item spike (usually Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) reduces your damage; farm safely outside.
- Your window opens when he uses Rupture or Feral Scream. Punish with Bio-Arcane Barrage spam.
- Hold wave near your tower. Cho'Gath wants close fights; denying him lane control starves his power.
- Run Scaling; you outrange and scale harder than Cho'Gath late. Early safety matters more than pressure.
- Buy Void Staff early if he stacks magic resist; otherwise prioritize Kraken Slayer for sustained damage.

kogmaw__darius.notes:
- Darius Hemorrhage stacks + Noxian Guillotine true damage execute kills you instantly if caught.
- Stay 550+ range away; use W Bio-Arcane Barrage to kite safely; never walk up for Q.
- Dodge E Apprehend hook at all costs; if he pulls you, you die to ult.
- Noxian Guillotine at six gives him kill pressure; stay full range and position near allies.
- His first item spike (Plated Steelcaps or Kaenic Rookern) reduces your damage; delay your damage spike.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have two items and he cannot one-shot you.
- Hold wave near your tower; force him to walk up and get ganked by your jungler.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed and range in fights.
- Add Phantom Dancer for movespeed to kite his E Apprehend pull attempts more safely.

kogmaw__drmundo.notes:
- Mundo's Q Infected Bonesaw slows and deals current health damage; kite backward relentlessly.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Mundo has no gap close yet, farm freely with spacing.
- Never stand still when Mundo throws Q; sidestep it constantly, it's a skillshot.
- Maximum Dosage heals and grants movespeed; he becomes harder to kite, play safer.
- First item spike around Sunfire or Hollow Radiance isn't dangerous; you outrange him still.
- Your window opens when Mundo ult is down; spam R Living Artillery for poke.
- Hold wave near your tower; Mundo has no siege tool and ganks worse here.
- Use Scaling rune page; you scale better into late game than tankier Mundo.
- Add Void Staff if Mundo builds heavy magic resist; shred his defenses harder.

kogmaw__diana.notes:
- threat: Diana's Lunar Rush dashes through your kite; Moonfall locks you down for followup burst.
- early: Dangerous—Diana out-trades you. Stay behind minions, use Caustic Spittle to kite her approach.
- trading: Never bait Crescent Strike; she gains free Moonlight resets. Trade only when she's on cooldown.
- post6: Moonfall range forces you further back. Position near tower; Void Ooze trail blocks her dash paths.
- spike: Diana's first item spike hurts—she deals more burst. Play safer; don't overextend for CS.
- window: After Diana wastes Lunar Rush without Moonlight, punish with full Auto-Attack harass and Caustic Spittle.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Diana's all-in threat forces defensive positioning; prevent her dive setup.
- rune: Scaling—you outscale her late. Extend the game; your range and % health damage wins fights.
- item: Build Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Moonfall engage and burst—gives time for team followup.

kogmaw__draven.notes:
- Draven's all-in with Spinning Axe and Blood Rush chunks you before you kite away safely.
- Play safe near tower; his early damage and all-in threat outweighs your farm value.
- Never trade when he has axe stacks; bait Spinning Axe misses, then kite backward hard.
- Whirling Death forces you to reposition; use E Void Ooze to slow his approach.
- First-item Kraken Slayer spike (around 10 min) is dangerous; play further back and safer.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Draven lacks mobility; focus kiting and landing Q debuffs.
- Hold wave near your tower; denies Draven roam pressure and lets you farm safely.
- Use Scaling; you outscale his raw damage and need survivability to reach late-game advantage.
- Add Phantom Dancer early if Draven snowows; the movement speed and shield block his burst.

kogmaw__ekko.notes:
- Ekko Phase Dive lets him gap-close, burst, and teleport out before you kite him properly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-trades early. Farm with Q when possible, avoid close range.
- Never chase Ekko into fog or walls. Bait Q rewind, then kite back hard.
- Chronobreak heals him and resets fights; don't commit burst when his ult is up.
- His first item spike (Lich Bane or Nashor's Tooth) hurts; farm safely, don't contest.
- After Ekko burns Chronobreak and Phase Dive, unleash W attacks and R artillery for kills.
- Hold wave near tower; Ekko roams and dives easier with side pressure, you need safety.
- Use Scaling; you scale better than Ekko into mid-late and need ramp time.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early for ghosting against his slows and extra kite insurance.

kogmaw__elise.notes:
- Threat: Elise Cocoon stun locks you; Spider Form Rappel closes distance for guaranteed burst damage.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Cocoon by predicting her angle.
- Trading: Never trade into her melee range. Bait Cocoon with lateral movement, then Q Caustic Spittle.
- Post6: Much worse. Spider Form Rappel guarantees engagement. Play further back; use R Living Artillery to poke.
- Spike: First item spike is dangerous for you. Elise gains burst; respect her all-in range significantly.
- Window: Mid-game when you have Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane; kite her Spider Form swarm easily.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Elise excels at dive; deny her gank setup by staying safe.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale her damage and utility; scaling runes compound your late-game kiting advantage.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stops Rappel burst and lets you survive Spider Form all-in attempts cleanly.

kogmaw__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's W Allure charm locks you down; her R Last Caress gap-closes and decimates before warping away.
- early: Dangerous. Stay near tower; Evelynn roams. Farm safely with Q Caustic Spittle from distance when possible.
- trading: Avoid trading into her W Allure charm window. Bait her E Whiplash, then kite backward while attacking.
- post6: Extremely dangerous. Evelynn's R Last Caress makes her untargetable, gaps close, and warps away. Play further back.
- spike: First item spike (likely Hextech Rocketbelt or Nashor's Tooth) threatens you heavily. Play passive and hug tower.
- window: After Evelynn wastes R Last Caress, push waves and farm freely for thirty seconds before she re-engages.
- wave: Shove waves hard into tower. Deny her roam opportunities and give yourself space to kite her engage safely.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale Evelynn hard; survive early with passive play, then dominate mid-to-late with range and W damage.
- item: Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to survive R Last Caress; triggers after her untargetable ends, negating follow-up burst damage.

kogmaw__ezreal.notes:
- Ezreal's Mystic Shot and Arcane Shift kite you endlessly; you cannot close gap or trade back.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; Mystic Shot reduces cooldowns, enabling relentless poke you cannot match.
- Never chase Ezreal or commit to trading; bait Arcane Shift then reposition; dodge Mystic Shot angles.
- Trueshot Barrage reaches you anywhere; position behind minions or structures; your Living Artillery outranges it slightly.
- Ezreal's first item (Manamune or Trinity) powerspikes around 1000 gold; respect his damage and kite pressure then.
- Post-15 minutes, your range and attack speed scale harder; group and use wave pressure to force fights.
- Hold wave near your tower; Ezreal is mobile and can roam; deny him picks on side lanes.
- Run Scaling; you need survivability and damage items to outscale his early harass and kiting threat.
- Add Wit's End after core attack speed; magic resist and on-hit sustain counter his repeated Mystic Shot spam.

kogmaw__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Crowstorm channeling unseen near you; fear and silence chain you into his team.
- Safe farm at range; Fiddlesticks weak early. Ward river, watch for roams constantly.
- Never chase into fog. Bait Terrify by staying visible; abuse range with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Crowstorm creates kill zone; position farther back and use Void Ooze to kite away.
- First item spike minimal threat; exploit early by positioning aggressively with Living Artillery poke.
- Post-first-item when Fiddlesticks itemizes AP; Kog'Maw outranges and out-dps him if positioned safely.
- Hold wave near tower; Fiddlesticks roams often. Farming safely under tower denies his gank setup.
- Scaling; Kog'Maw scales harder into late teamfights where range and dps dominate fear engage.
- Zhonya's Hourglass lets you survive Crowstorm initiation; buy it if dying repeatedly to ult.

kogmaw__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Lunge closes gaps and applies on-hits; her Vitals heal her while you kite helplessly backward.
- Play safe near tower; her early all-in with Lunge beats your short range and immobility.
- Never walk into Vital range; bait her Riposte with Q before committing W attacks; stay max range.
- Grand Challenge reveals all Vitals; she heals massively if she hits them; respect her damage spike hard.
- Blade of the Ruined King first lets her lifesteal off your W; kite harder and consider tabis.
- You spike when she burns Riposte; unload full W damage and Living Artillery from safe distance after.
- Hold wave near your tower; force her to engage you under turret where her mobility loses value.
- Scaling; you scale harder into teamfights with range and poke; Fiora is a duelist, not a threat.
- Randuin's Omen slows her attack speed and move speed; cripples her Lunge gap close and Vital procs.

kogmaw__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage slows and damages you; kite away from its center always.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Gangplank lacks burst. Farm freely with Caustic Spittle range.
- Never trade into Trial by Fire procs. Bait Parrrley by moving unpredictably, then attack.
- Post-6, Cannon Barrage zoning forces you to reposition constantly. Respect its range and slow.
- Gangplank's first item spike is moderate. Punish him when Cannon Barrage is on cooldown.
- Your spike comes mid-game when Bio-Arcane Barrage shreds his health pool relentlessly with range.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Gangplank's Powder Keg and ult punish pushed positions.
- Run Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed, range, and true damage scaling.
- Buy Void Staff to shred Gangplank's magic resist and amplify your Bio-Arcane Barrage damage.

kogmaw__garen.notes:
- Garen's Decisive Strike silences you, preventing Caustic Spittle and Living Artillery counterplay.
- Stay at maximum range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid trading early—Garen wins short fights.
- Never trade into Garen's Judgment spin; kite backward and use Living Artillery from distance instead.
- Demacian Justice executes low-health targets; stay above 25% health or play safer near tower.
- Garen's Stridebreaker or Black Cleaver first item is dangerous; respect his gap-close and damage spike.
- Win window is mid-game teamfights where range and poke with Living Artillery outvalue his melee range.
- Hold wave near your tower; Garen excels in extended side-lane fights, so deny him positioning.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale Garen hard with items and sustained ranged damage output.
- Add Void Staff if Garen builds magic resist; otherwise prioritize Kraken Slayer for execute threat.

kogmaw__heimerdinger.notes:
- Heimerdinger's turrets zone you and deny farm while his E stun locks you down hard.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid walking into turret range. Let wave come to you naturally.
- Never walk straight at turrets. Bait E grenade, then trade with Q and W attacks.
- UPGRADE!!! amplifies turret damage and E stun duration—play further back, use R from range.
- Heimerdinger first item spike is real; respect turret zone and farm safely with R poke.
- You spike when Heimerdinger runs out of mana or wastes E; punish immediately with aggression.
- Hold wave near your tower so turrets don't zone you further; farm safely under protection.
- Scaling: Kog'Maw scales better into late game; survive lane and outscale his early pressure.
- Build Void Staff early if his turrets chunk you; cuts magic damage and pen needs.

kogmaw__hecarim.notes:
- Hecarim's E and R close the gap and lock you down before you kite away safely.
- Levels 1–3 are safe; Hecarim has no gap close yet. Farm freely and position near tower.
- Never trade into his Q spam. Bait E with positioning; kite backward when he commits to charge.
- Post-6, Onslaught of Shadows is a hard engage that fears and locks you. Play safer, closer to tower.
- His first item spike (typically Hollow Radiance or Black Cleaver) is moderate. Your kiting and range still control trades.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have Kraken Slayer and range boots; out-DPS and kite his engages.
- Hold the wave closer to your tower so his E engage has less distance to travel and less damage.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him if you avoid early kills and reach two items with kiting items online.
- Add Randuin's Omen to reduce his physical burst from E and Q, and lower his attack speed from Warpath.

kogmaw__gwen.notes:
- threat: Gwen's W Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable; your R Living Artillery and autos cannot reach her inside.
- early: Dangerous. Gwen wins short trades with Q Snip Snip! true damage. Stay max range, farm with Q Caustic Spittle safely.
- trading: Avoid trading into her. Bait her W Hallowed Mist down, then abuse her cooldown with R Living Artillery poke.
- post6: Gwen's R Needlework applies her passive repeatedly; she heals significantly and deals scaling damage. Respect her all-in potential immediately.
- spike: First item (likely Nashor's Tooth or Lich Bane) is dangerous. She gains sustained damage and healing; maintain distance and poke.
- window: Mid-game when her W cooldown is long and you stack Runaan's Hurricane or Guinsoo's Rageblade attack speed for poke.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. She wants to dive into you; let her overextend, then punish with R and support.
- rune: Scaling. You outrange and out-scale her; survive early, spike harder with items, then kite her down from distance.
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass against her all-in burst and R Needlework spam; gives you time to W Bio-Arcane Barrage kite safely.

kogmaw__hwei.notes:
- Hwei's Q into E combo primes and stuns you; you can't kite out before taking burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hwei out-ranges you early. Farm from distance, dodge his Q skillshot, don't trade.
- Bait Hwei's E (Crushing Maw) by repositioning; it's the only cc threat. Never walk into Q range willingly.
- Post-6, Spiraling Despair expands and slows; stay outside its radius or kite perpendicular. Your W range lets you escape.
- Hwei's first item (typically Luden's or Shadowflame) is dangerous. Play safer; punish him when his cooldowns are down.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed and on-hit items. Kite around terrain, abuse W range advantage then.
- Hold wave near your tower. Hwei has cc lockdown; let him push into you so your supports engage safely.
- Use Scaling. You scale much better than Hwei; survive early, outrange him late with W and Runaan's stacking.
- Add Wit's End into your build for magic resist and attack speed; it shuts down his burst safely.

kogmaw__illaoi.notes:
- Illaoi's W Harsh Lesson leaps on you; tentacles swing and deal massive damage.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid positioning where tentacles can reach you both.
- Never contest short trades; bait W cooldown before trading with Q and autos.
- Illaoi R Leap of Faith spawns tentacles per champion hit; avoid grouped fights.
- Her first item spike (likely Sheen into tank) is a danger window; respect it.
- Kog'Maw punishes Illaoi when she wastes W or R; kite and spam Q.
- Hold wave near your tower; deny her close-range W engage and tentacle swings.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her late with range, attack speed, and percent damage.
- Build Void Staff early to amplify your magic damage through her resistances and items.

kogmaw__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller roots you from range, then Daisy or allies collapse and burst you down.
- Farm safely at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range; Ivern cannot punish you at distance early.
- Never walk into brush where Brushmaker bonus damage applies; bait Rootcaller with lateral movement.
- Daisy provides sustained damage and peel; kite away and use Void Ooze to slow her.
- Ivern's first item spike (usually support items) is not dangerous; you outscale him hard.
- Mid-game teamfights when Kog'Maw has two items and Ivern has minimal damage output.
- Shove waves into tower; prevent Ivern from grouping and setting up root-engage from brush.
- Scaling; Kog'Maw scales infinitely better into late game than Ivern's utility kit.
- Add Void Staff if Ivern builds early magic resist; amplifies your percentage health damage.

kogmaw__irelia.notes:
- threat: Irelia's Bladesurge dashes through you; if marked, cooldown refreshes and she hunts relentlessly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Flawless Duet by positioning sideways.
- trading: Never trade without W active. Bait Flawless Duet, then punish with Q Caustic Spittle.
- post6: Vanguard's Edge marks multiple targets and creates a wall; stay behind minions, kite backward always.
- spike: First item (Blade of the Ruined King) is her danger window; respect her burst.
- window: Post-teamfight when Irelia cooldowns are down, or when she overextends without Marked allies nearby.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Irelia needs the wave to dash reset; deny her positioning.
- rune: Scaling. You outrange and outdamage late; survive early with safer keystones and scaling stats.
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stops Bladesurge all-in and lets you survive burst before kiting out.

kogmaw__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow lock you down; his poke outdamages your sustained damage early.
- Play safe at max range; avoid pushing toward Jayce because Shock Blast catches immobile targets easily.
- Never trade when Jayce is in Cannon Stance; wait for his Hammer transformation, then use W range advantage.
- Your Living Artillery outranges Shock Blast significantly; use it to pressure and reveal him before all-ins.
- First item (likely Manamune or Trinity Force) makes Jayce extremely dangerous; respect his burst window hard.
- Mid-game with two items and W maxed, you out-duel him at extended range with on-hit damage.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Jayce's mobility lets him roam easily if you push forward.
- Use Scaling because you outscale him and need survivability to reach your item power spikes safely.
- Build Phantom Dancer early for movement speed to kite his engage and dodge Shock Blast patterns.

kogmaw__jax.notes:
- Threat: Jax Counter Strike dodges your projectiles and stuns, then all-ins with Leap Strike and Relentless Assault.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid Q Caustic Spittle as it telegraphs your position.
- Trading: Never trade into his all-in window. Kite backward when he Q's; bait Counter Strike with E Void Ooze.
- Post6: Living Artillery becomes your poke tool and disengage. Jax Grandmaster-at-Arms adds burst; respect his third-attack magic damage.
- Spike: First item Jax spike (Trinity Force or similar) is dangerous. Play safer; your W scaling is slower early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Jax is isolated or caught. R Living Artillery reveals and damages him before engagement.
- Wave: Push the wave hard and farm safety; deny him all-in opportunities and force him toward your tower.
- Rune: Scaling. You outrange and outdamage him late; stall the game and scale into W and artillery dominance.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stopwatch the Counter Strike stun window and deny his follow-up burst damage.

kogmaw__jinx.notes:
- Jinx's Super Mega Death Rocket deals massive execute damage; respect its range and reveal.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jinx out-ranges you early. Farm with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Dodge Zap! as it slows and reveals you. Don't trade into Pow-Pow minigun bursts.
- Post-6, Super Mega Death Rocket becomes lethal. Respect map pressure; stay healthy and grouped.
- Jinx first-item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) is dangerous. Avoid extended fights; farm safely mid-game.
- Your window opens when Jinx uses Switcheroo! cooldown or when you complete Nashor's Tooth.
- Hold wave near your tower. You outrange her at range; force her to overextend for cs.
- Use Scaling rune page; your scaling and range advantage win late-game teamfights decisively.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass as a sixth item to survive Super Mega Death Rocket bursts.

kogmaw__jhin.notes:
- Jhin's Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call pierce and stop on you; kite sideways to dodge skillshots.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jhin outranges you early. Farm with Q when he's on cooldown.
- Never walk into Jhin's attack cone predictably. Bait Deadly Flourish by moving sideways; dodge with W range.
- Curtain Call is four piercing shots at extreme range. Stay behind minions and use terrain to block.
- Jhin's first item spike (Essence Reaver or Lord Dominik's) increases his damage window. Farm safely; don't duel.
- Post-6 when Jhin uses Curtain Call, punish with W Bio-Arcane Barrage extended range on immobilized targets.
- Hold wave near your tower. Jhin wants distance; denying space limits his Deadly Flourish and Curtain Call.
- Use Scaling; Kog'Maw scales harder into late game with W on-hit and attack speed ramping.
- Build Phantom Dancer for movement speed to kite Jhin's skillshots and survive Curtain Call barrages.

kogmaw__ksante.notes:
- K'Sante's All Out transformation closes gap, deals burst, and reduces your kiting window severely.
- Play safe early; Ntofo Strikes outranges your autos, so farm with Q from distance.
- Never chase K'Sante or let him stack Ntofo Strikes freely; bait W knockback then disengage.
- All Out ult threatens your life instantly; kite backward and spam R to reveal him.
- First item spike is moderate danger; your W range and R poke keep you safe.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when K'Sante wastes All Out cooldown; punish with sustained damage.
- Hold wave near tower; force K'Sante to engage in your minion advantage and turret range.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder into late game and outrange his transformed combo window.
- Buy Randuin's Omen early if he builds AD; reduces his burst and attack speed threat.

kogmaw__kalista.notes:
- Kalista's Pierce and Rend spears stack and burst you down before you kite away safely.
- Stay behind minions levels 1–3; Kalista out-trades you early with spear poke and mobility.
- Never stand still when she winds up Pierce; move unpredictably to bait it past you.
- Fate's Call lets her reposition her Oathsworn for gank setup; play safer when she ults.
- Kalista's first item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) is dangerous; respect her all-in burst potential then.
- Post-three items you kite and duel better; use range and W On-Hit to wear her down.
- Hold wave near tower to minimize Rend damage and Oathsworn gank setup from river angles.
- Scaling; Kog'Maw scales harder into teamfights where Kalista cannot close gap against your R and W.
- Add Randuin's Omen to reduce her attack speed and critical strike damage from Kraken Slayer.

kogmaw__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct dash closes gap instantly; you cannot kite away once she engages.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kai'Sa outtraces you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid close trades.
- Never trade into her close range. Bait her Killer Instinct dash, then kite backward with W.
- Post-6 Kai'Sa threatens all-in dives. Play further back; use R Living Artillery to poke and reveal.
- Kai'Sa first-item spike (around Nashro's Tooth timing) is dangerous. Stay safe, scale toward your own items.
- Kog'Maw scales faster than Kai'Sa late-game. Win teamfights by positioning max range with W, kiting.
- Hold wave near your tower. Kai'Sa's dash range forces you safer; control when she can engage.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale her and need survival tools more than early aggression.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stopwatch her dive attempts and reset her burst window temporarily.

kogmaw__karma.notes:
- Karma's Focused Resolve tether roots you in place; you cannot kite or reposition mid-root.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Inner Flame outranges your auto-attacks, abuse minions for cover.
- Never stand still for long; bait her Focused Resolve by moving unpredictably, then counter-trade.
- Post-6, Mantra-empowered abilities hit harder and root faster; respect her range and disengage further back.
- First-item spike is real; she gains cooldown reduction and shield strength—farm safer, avoid extended fights.
- Your window comes mid-game when you complete two items and W Bio-Arcane Barrage outranges her spells.
- Hold wave near your tower; her root range forces you to play defensively if she roams.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her into late game where your range and DPS dominate teamfights.
- Add Wit's End to block her magic damage and gain attack speed against her harass.

kogmaw__karthus.notes:
- Requiem deals unavoidable damage to all champions; respect its channeling window and play safer.
- Play safe early; Karthus Q damages from range. Farm with Q when possible, avoid clumping.
- Dodge Lay Waste by spacing; it has delayed blast. Trade only when Karthus misses Q.
- Post-6, Requiem forces you to respect channel time. Back off or position behind units pre-channel.
- Karthus first item (Liandry's or Void Staff) increases Q damage; farm safer until you spike Kraken.
- After your Kraken Slayer, out-trade Karthus with W range and sustained damage; he falls off.
- Hold wave near tower; limits Karthus roaming for kills and forces him closer to your range.
- Standard (default); you need reliable farming against a poke-heavy matchup with constant threat pressure.
- Add Void Staff early if Karthus stacks magic resist; cuts his survivability against your W.

kogmaw__katarina.notes:
- Shunpo onto you into Death Lotus channels massive magic damage while you're immobile.
- Play safe behind minions; Bouncing Blade is a skillshot—dodge sidestep. Farm with Q at range.
- Never trade directly; Katarina wants close fights. Use W range to kite away from her.
- Post-6, Death Lotus forces you to position far back or face instant deletion if caught.
- Her first item spike (roughly 1100g) is manageable; abuse range before she completes Nashor's Tooth.
- You outrange and out-kite her once you have two items; abuse W range advantage then.
- Hold wave near your tower; force her to overextend for Shunpo engage or miss farm safely.
- Scaling (default); you scale harder into mid-game and need time to reach item power spikes.
- Zhonya's Hourglass gives you invulnerability to stop Death Lotus channel and survive Shunpo all-in attempts.

kogmaw__kayle.notes:
- threat: Divine Judgment invulnerability negates your burst; Kayle outranges and outkites you late.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Radiant Blast slows and reduces resistances. Avoid extended trades.
- trading: Never trade into Kayle's attack range. Bait Radiant Blast with positioning, then Caustic Spittle.
- post6: Kayle becomes unkillable during Divine Judgment. Focus on farming; avoid all-ins on her.
- spike: First item is dangerous. Kayle gains range and sustained damage; play safer, scale.
- window: Mid-game before Kayle caps out defensively. Poke with Living Artillery; don't let her engage.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Kayle wants to roam and scale; denying kills is priority.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale Kayle's midgame if you survive; standard doesn't justify early risk.
- item: Void Staff. Kayle builds heavy resistances; pen cuts through her defensive layers cleanly.

kogmaw__kassadin.notes:
- Threat: Riftwalk closes gap instantly; Kassadin all-ins and kills you before you kite away safely.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; avoid Null Sphere poke.
- Trading: Bait Null Sphere with Q Caustic Spittle, then attack. Never trade when Kassadin has Force Pulse charged.
- Post6: Kassadin becomes lethal. Riftwalk gap-close means instant death if caught; play near tower, never extend.
- Spike: First item spike (Catalyst into Tear stacking) is a danger window. Kassadin gains tankiness and mana sustain; avoid fighting.
- Window: When Riftwalk is on cooldown after a failed engage, unload Living Artillery and auto-attacks for short burst.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Pushing out lets Kassadin roam and Riftwalk-dive you; safety is priority.
- Rune: Scaling. Kog'Maw outscales Kassadin hard late-game; survive early, hypercarry teamfights with attack range and artillery.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stops Kassadin Riftwalk burst mid-fight; gives you time for teammates or cooldown reset.

kogmaw__kayn.notes:
- Threat: Kayn's Umbral Trespass isolates and oneshots you before you can kite or react.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay near tower, farm safely with Caustic Spittle, never extend into river alone.
- Trading: Avoid trading when Kayn closes gap with Reaping Slash; bait his Blade's Reach instead.
- Post6: Massive threat spike. Umbral Trespass makes you vulnerable; position deeper and group with teammates always.
- Spike: First item (Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer) is danger window; stay safe.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you have peel and Kayn is isolated; then punish with range.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Shoved waves force Kayn to dive through minions; tower prevents burst.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale Kayn hard; survive early and dominate with range and health damage.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stopwatch delays Umbral Trespass burst and lets allies collapse on Kayn trapped.

kogmaw__kennen.notes:
- Kennen stuns you with Mark of the Storm after three ability hits; you die immobilized.
- Play safe; Kennen's Thundering Shuriken outranges your Caustic Spittle early. Farm under tower.
- Never walk into Electrical Surge range; dodge Thundering Shuriken and trade only after his cooldowns.
- Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom in teamfights stuns and kills you. Position far back or Zhonya's.
- His first Nashor's Tooth or Lich Bane spike is dangerous; respect his damage burst.
- After Kennen wastes Slicing Maelstrom, position forward and poke with Living Artillery before next teamfight.
- Hold wave near your tower; Kennen's gank setup is strong. Deny him roam pressure.
- Pick Scaling; you scale harder and outrange him late. Survive early safely.
- Build Zhonya's Hourglass early to survive Slicing Maelstrom stun during teamfights safely.

kogmaw__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix all-ins you after Leap lands; you have no escape and die instantly when Isolated.
- Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; stay near minions to deny Unseen Threat mark.
- Never chase or extend alone; Kha'Zix Leaps in, Taste Their Fear one-shots you if Isolated.
- Post-6 he becomes invisible, triggers Unseen Threat, and can evolve Leap for resets—stay grouped always.
- First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk into Manamune) is dangerous; avoid side lane farming entirely then.
- You spike harder mid-game with Runaan's Hurricane and Guinsoo's Rageblade; group and leverage team numbers.
- Hold wave near your tower; never push out alone or rotate without vision of Kha'Zix.
- Use Scaling to scale safely into late-game where your artillery and on-hit damage overwhelm him.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early; the movespeed and ghosting help you kite and survive his all-in.

kogmaw__kindred.notes:
- Mounting Dread's third-attack Wolf pounce deals massive damage; you cannot kite infinitely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kindred out-duels you early. Farm passively, avoid extended trades.
- Never fight Kindred near her marks. Dodge Dance of Arrows; bait Q cooldown before trading.
- Lamb's Respite denies your burst and resets fights. Play around her ult timing; disengage early.
- Kindred's first-item spike (likely Kraken Slayer or Navori) is dangerous. Farm safely; don't force fights.
- Your window comes mid-game when you've stacked attack speed items; kite from max Bio-Arcane range.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Kindred hunts for picks; denying extended lane fights protects you.
- Use Scaling. You outscale Kindred if you survive her mid-game hunt windows and reach late teamfights.
- Add Phantom Dancer for movement speed and damage reduction against her Wolf pounce damage spike.

kogmaw__leblanc.notes:
- Ethereal Chains root locks you down; Sigil + Mimic burst deletes immobile targets instantly.
- Stay max range with W active; abuse superior range to farm safely from distance.
- Never chase her W dash; bait it out, then kite backward with Q attack-speed.
- Mimic doubles her burst threat; respect all-in range and position near tower after six.
- First item spike (Lich Bane or Hextech Rocketbelt) forces you to respect her damage.
- Post-teamfight or when she wastes W; punish with Living Artillery spam from safe distance.
- Hold wave near tower; her gank setup is too strong, safety trumps cs pressure.
- Scaling; extra range and attack speed let you kite her chains and out-duel later.
- Zhonya's Hourglass negates burst and lets you survive Ethereal Chains root duration safely.

kogmaw__kled.notes:
- Kled's Jousting gap-close and Bear Trap lock-down chain you for all-in burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kled wins short trades. Farm at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Never walk into Bear Trap on a Rope range. Bait his Jousting, then Caustic Spittle.
- Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants Kled a shield and speed; respect the engage. Keep distance post-six.
- Kled first-item spike (likely Brutalizer components) is dangerous. Respect all-in windows; play back.
- Kog'Maw scales harder mid-game. Poke with Living Artillery from fog; farm safely for items.
- Hold wave near your tower. Kled excels in extended skirmishes; deny him roam tempo.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale him and need survivability against his all-in pattern.
- Add Phantom Dancer for movement speed to kite Jousting and improve Living Artillery safety.

kogmaw__leona.notes:
- Leona's E Zenith Blade immobilizes you; her Q Shield of Daybreak stuns follow-up, trapping you for guaranteed R Solar Flare hit.
- Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; kite backward when Leona moves forward; never let her close the gap to E range.
- Don't trade into her W Eclipse; wait for it to end, then unleash Q Caustic Spittle and auto-attacks; dodge E Zenith Blade by moving perpendicular.
- Post-6, R Solar Flare's stun zone becomes a massive engagement tool; avoid grouping tight; position so her R catches only one or two.
- Leona's first item spike (typically armor/magic resist item) reduces your poke damage significantly; this is her safest window—farm passively and scale instead.
- After Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane, you duel and kite her harder; use this window to trade when her cooldowns are down.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it slow-push toward you so you can kite backward into tower safety when she engages.
- vs Hard Engage; Leona commits to closing distance—you need mobility and survivability runes to kite and escape her all-in.
- Add Wit's End; the magic resist and attack speed help you kite faster and reduce her burst damage while farming safely.

kogmaw__lissandra.notes:
- Frozen Tomb stuns you instantly; you cannot dodge point-and-click CC. You die immobilized.
- Stay max range with W. Dodge Ice Shard with lateral movement. Do not trade.
- Never walk into Ring of Frost range. Bait her Q, sidestep it, then farm safely.
- Frozen Tomb range extends post-6. Play further back; use R to kite from distance.
- Her first item (typically Liandry's or Zhonya's) doesn't spike damage enough to one-tap you yet.
- You spike harder at two items with attack speed and range; Lissandra falls off relative to you.
- Hold wave near your tower. Lissandra lacks waveclear; she must walk up to CS, exposing herself.
- Scaling: you scale harder into late; she needs to abuse early and mid to punish.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass last-slot to survive Frozen Tomb engage and reposition safely post-stasis.

kogmaw__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's Lilting Lullaby sleep chains into burst; you cannot kite while asleep or drowsy.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; Lillia's Q and W have deceptive range and speed.
- Never trade into her; dodge Swirlseed and kite away from Blooming Blows activation range instead.
- Post-6, assume Lilting Lullaby lands if you're marked with Dream Dust; reposition proactively always.
- First item spike (Cosmic Drive) is dangerous; she gains MS and AP to all-in you.
- Punish window: when Lillia's R is down (120s+ cooldown); abuse range with Caustic Spittle trades.
- Hold wave near tower; let her push into you so Bio-Arcane Barrage and E punish her dives.
- Use Scaling; you scale better into teamfights and need time to stack items safely.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Lilting Lullaby chain and burst before she closes distance.

kogmaw__locke.notes:
- Locke's Ashen Pursuit gaps you instantly; dodge it or you die to follow-up burst.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Locke's Q marks you for Silver Stake bonus damage—farm range.
- Never trade into marked enemies; bait his E teleport then kite backward with W.
- Post-6, Purgatory execute threatens you hard; stay above 40% HP and respect range.
- First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk) is dangerous; play back until you complete Kraken Slayer.
- You spike harder at two items; kite and abuse W range when his cooldowns are down.
- Hold wave near tower; Locke lacks waveclear, so deny his roam and keep gank threat minimal.
- Standard (default) page works; you need raw damage and attack speed to outduel him safely.
- Buy Wit's End early; the MR and on-hit resist his mark damage and execution pressure.

kogmaw__lucian.notes:
- Lucian's Lightslinger procs and Piercing Light burst you before W range lets you trade back safely.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Lucian wins short trades. Farm with Q from distance, avoid walking up.
- Never trade into his ability cooldowns. Bait Relentless Pursuit with positioning, then E Void Ooze to punish.
- The Culling at range threatens you hard. Stay behind minions or use Zhonya's Hourglass to negate damage.
- Lucian's first-item spike (Serrated Dirk into Manamune) is dangerous. Farm safely; don't fight until you have two items.
- Post-two items, W Bio-Arcane Barrage out-ranges his dash and lets you kite him if he overcommits.
- Hold wave near your tower. Lucian has kill pressure; safety matters more than tempo here.
- Scaling. You scale better into late; survive early and abuse range advantage when items complete.
- Zhonya's Hourglass stops The Culling and lets you survive his all-in attempts mid-game reliably.

kogmaw__lulu.notes:
- Lulu's W Whimsy turns you into a critter; you cannot attack or cast for the duration.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Pix damage trades favorably. Farm at range with Q Caustic Spittle.
- Never walk into Glitterlance range. Bait W Whimsy before committing to extended trades with autos.
- Post-6, Wild Growth shields and slows; kite away from Lulu's team after she ults her carry.
- Lulu's first item spike is moderate. Kog'Maw spikes harder with Kraken Slayer; punish her then.
- Once you have two items, kite and auto from max W Bio-Arcane Barrage range safely.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Lulu lacks wave clear; deny her roam pressure safely.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Lulu hard in teamfights with range and sustained magic damage output.
- Build Void Staff to shred Lulu's shields and Magic Resist from E Help, Pix.

kogmaw__lux.notes:
- Threat: Light Binding roots you in place; Final Spark follows for guaranteed Illumination proc damage.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay beyond Q range. Farm safely with W; never walk into Q path predictably.
- Trading: Avoid her Q at all costs—it locks you down. Bait Q with sidestep, then trade with W.
- Post6: Final Spark becomes massive threat. Play behind minions; use E to create distance and obscure beam.
- Spike: First item spike (Luden's or Shadowflame) hurts. Punish by staying max W range, avoiding close fights.
- Window: Post-first-item when you have Kraken Slayer or Runaan's Hurricane; outdamage her from safe range.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Forces Lux to overextend for engage; maximizes your W range advantage safely.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale Lux hard; survive early, stack advantages, then dominate with attack-speed and range.
- Item: Void Staff. Lux builds heavy AP; penetration lets your W percent damage and spells cut through.

kogmaw__malphite.notes:
- Malphite's Unstoppable Force gaps you and locks you down; you die if caught.
- Play safe near tower; his Q steals speed and sets up ganks easily.
- Never walk into Q range; bait Unstoppable Force by spreading, then kite with W.
- Post-6, Unstoppable Force is a kill threat; stay grouped or hug tower defensively.
- His first armor item (Thornmail, Kaenic, Randuin's) spikes his E and Q damage hard.
- You spike when he wastes Unstoppable Force; unload W and R while he's on cooldown.
- Hold wave near your tower; Malphite gains armor scaling, so let him overextend for ganks.
- Use Scaling; you outrange and out-dps him late, and he needs to engage first.
- Buy Void Staff early to shred his armor stacking and reduce E's high damage.

kogmaw__malzahar.notes:
- Malzahar's R Nether Grasp suppresses you—you cannot attack, move, or cast while channeled.
- Play safe near tower; E Void Ooze slows and Q silences are poke threats early.
- Never face-check bushes; bait Q Call of the Void by repositioning, then trade back.
- Post-6, respect R range massively; position where he cannot channel you into his team.
- Malzahar's first item spike (typically AP) threatens your health pool—play around minions and map.
- Your power window is when his R is down; punish aggressively with W autos.
- Hold wave near your tower; escape R Nether Grasp by staying close to base.
- Pick Scaling; you outscale Malzahar's damage and need time to itemize for teamfights.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stasis during R Nether Grasp and survive channel attempts.

kogmaw__maokai.notes:
- Maokai's Twisted Advance roots you point-blank; you cannot kite or escape afterward.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Caustic Spittle, avoid short trades.
- Never fight when Maokai closes gap; bait Twisted Advance, then kite with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Nature's Grasp wall roots you from long range; respect it and reposition early.
- Maokai first item spike is moderate; your Kraken Slayer or Runaan's Hurricane outscales him.
- Post-9 minutes when Maokai cooldowns extend; punish with Living Artillery poke and range advantage.
- Shove wave into tower; deny Maokai brush access and reduce his all-in engagement range.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Maokai hard with attack speed and percent-health damage ramping.
- Add Phantom Dancer for movement speed and dueling survivability against his root combo.

kogmaw__mel.notes:
- Mel's Overwhelm stacks synergize with Golden Eclipse to burst you from range; dodge Solar Snare root.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Radiant Barrage poke forces you to respect her range early.
- Bait Rebuttal by spacing; it destroys your projectiles so hold Caustic Spittle and Q when she commits.
- Golden Eclipse at 6 becomes a global execution threat; stay spread and reduce Overwhelm stacks before teamfights.
- Her first item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) is dangerous; farm safely and avoid extended trades then.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Mel burns cooldowns; punish her cooldown windows with Bio-Arcane Barrage and Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; Mel's range and Overwhelm stack on poke so minimize exposure safely.
- Use Scaling; you outscale Mel in sustained damage and itemization once you complete two items.
- Add Void Staff early if Mel builds early magic resist; otherwise prioritize Kraken Slayer for consistent damage.

kogmaw__masteryi.notes:
- threat: Master Yi's Alpha Strike makes him untargetable; Living Artillery is your only reliable damage tool on him.
- early: Dangerous. Master Yi will all-in you at level 2 if you're overextended; farm safely near tower and kite backward.
- trading: Never trade into Master Yi directly; bait his Alpha Strike with positioning, then punish with Living Artillery when he lands.
- post6: Highlander makes him immune to slows and vastly faster; you cannot kite him effectively—prioritize range and poke damage instead.
- spike: First item (likely Blade of the Ruined King) is extremely dangerous; play behind minions and avoid all-in fights during his spike window.
- window: Mid-game when Highlander is on cooldown or when Master Yi is low health for Living Artillery bonus damage execution.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; pushing out lets Master Yi flank and engage you; safety scales better than wave pressure here.
- rune: Scaling. Master Yi needs time to come online; you outscale him in teamfights with range and artillery damage over the game.
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stops his all-in burst during Highlander; lets you survive engages and output Living Artillery safely from stasis.

kogmaw__mordekaiser.notes:
- Mordekaiser's Realm of Death isolates you; you cannot kite or escape his stat-steal ult.
- Levels 1–3 are safe; Mordekaiser has no gap close yet. Farm freely and poke with Q.
- Never let him land E Death's Grasp; kite backward and use range advantage to trade safely.
- At level 6, Realm of Death becomes lethal isolation tool. Stay grouped; never fight alone.
- His first item spike (typically Rylai's or Liandry's) is your punish window; burst him before ult.
- Mid-game when you have Kraken Slayer and attack speed; he lacks sustained damage without ult.
- Hold wave near your tower; force him to push into you where allies can collapse easily.
- Scaling; you outscale him significantly with range, attack speed, and sustained magic damage scaling.
- Phantom Dancer gives you movement speed to kite and dodge E; buy it if he pops ult frequently.

kogmaw__missfortune.notes:
- Threat: Miss Fortune's Bullet Time channels massive cone damage; you can't kite or dodge it easily.
- Early: Dangerous. Miss Fortune out-trades you levels 1-3 with Love Tap bonus damage on Q Double Up.
- Trading: Avoid trading into her when she's attacking new targets; bait Q Double Up, then retaliate with W.
- Post6: Extremely dangerous. Bullet Time forces you to position far back or risk channeled burst; respect the range.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Collector) spikes her Q and R damage; respect her and farm safely.
- Window: Mid-game when you finish Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane; your W outranges her and applies on-hit efficiently.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Miss Fortune's E Make It Rain controls space; let her push, then trade.
- Rune: Scaling. You scale harder into teamfights; early skirmishes favor Miss Fortune, so prioritize farming safely and scaling.
- Item: Phantom Dancer. Dodge her Q and reduce Bullet Time's damage via the movement speed and damage reduction passive.

kogmaw__naafiri.notes:
- Naafiri's pack dashes close and bleeds you down before you kite; her W untargetability dodges your burst.
- Play safe behind minions; Naafiri wins short trades with packmate damage. Farm at max range with Q.
- Bait her Q by positioning near minions she'll dash to, then kite backward. Never let pack close.
- Her R gap-closes and resets on takedowns; position deeper and use E Void Ooze to slow her approach.
- First item (Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer) lets her stick and lifesteal; farm safely under tower.
- After Naafiri uses W, she has no escape; unload with W Bio-Arcane Barrage and R Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; her pack excels at collapsing from fog. Deny deep CS and stay safe.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her at two items and need survivability early to reach teamfight phase.
- Buy Randuin's Omen early if she snowballs; it cripples her repeated dash resets and pack engage.

kogmaw__nami.notes:
- threat: Aqua Prison stuns you; Tidal Wave knocks up and slows, preventing kite and escape.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W active; avoid short trades where Q bubble lands.
- trading: Dodge Aqua Prison with movement; never trade when bubble is off cooldown or close.
- post6: Tidal Wave zone control forces you further back; retreat to safety when she positions ult.
- spike: First item (likely Mandate or Shard) minimal threat; your R and W scale better early.
- window: When Nami Q is down and you land R from distance; all-in if isolated.
- wave: Hold near tower. Nami lacks waveclear; let her waste mana on Ebb and Flow.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale her and need durability against poke; hard engage wastes your range.
- item: Phantom Dancer. Blocks her slow effects and lets you escape Tidal Wave knockup chains.

kogmaw__nasus.notes:
- threat: Nasus Wither cripples your attack speed and move speed; you die if caught.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Bio-Arcane Barrage; never walk up to trade.
- trading: Bait Wither by kiting backward, then trade with Caustic Spittle from range only.
- post6: Fury of the Sands makes Nasus tanky and deals persistent damage; respect his engage.
- spike: His first armor item is dangerous; Caustic Spittle and Living Artillery still scale through it.
- window: After Nasus ult expires or before he reaches full stacks, pressure with range advantage.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; let it slow-push into you so Nasus must overextend.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale him hard; avoid early all-ins and prioritize farm and poke safely.
- item: Randuin's Omen reduces his crit threat and slows his approach during Fury of the Sands.

kogmaw__neeko.notes:
- Threat: Tangle-Barbs roots you from range; Pop Blossom stun locks you with no escape.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay beyond Blooming Burst range; dodge Tangle-Barbs by positioning behind minions.
- Trading: Bait Tangle-Barbs by shifting sideways, then Caustic Spittle her. Never chase her clone.
- Post6: Critical danger. Pop Blossom preparation hidden by disguise; respect massive teamfight engage threat.
- Spike: First item (Kraken Slayer or Blade) strengthens her; farm safely, avoid all-ins.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete two items and Runaan's Hurricane applies attack speed shred.
- Wave: Hold near tower. Neeko's roots punish overextension; minimize exposure, farm safely under turret.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale her; survive laning phase and leverage late-game range advantage.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Cleanse Pop Blossom stun and Tangle-Barbs root threats in teamfights.

kogmaw__nidalee.notes:
- Threat: Nidalee's Javelin Toss / Takedown spear from fog of war one-shots you before teamfights start.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; dodge her Javelin Toss / Takedown by positioning unpredictably in lane.
- Trading: Never trade into her. She gaps close with Bushwhack / Pounce; kite backward and use Caustic Spittle.
- Post6: Aspect Of The Cougar transforms her into an all-in threat; respect Pounce / Takedown burst range always.
- Spike: First item spike punishes you hard. Farm safely under tower; avoid extended trades near brush.
- Window: Post-first-item, your range and poke with Living Artillery outscale her. Group and use range advantage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Prevents Nidalee from flanking and forces her to commit to dives.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale her hard; survive early safely and scale into teamfight powerhouse.
- Item: Build Zhonya's Hourglass to survive her all-in burst and Pounce / Takedown combo attempt.

kogmaw__nilah.notes:
- threat: Nilah's dash and ult pull you into melee range where you die instantly to her team
- early: Dangerous; stay max range, respect Formless Blade poke, never face-check bush or get caught alone
- trading: Never trade short; bait Jubilant Veil with Caustic Spittle, then kite back; dodge Slipstream with positioning
- post6: Apotheosis ult pull is lethal; position further back, use Living Artillery to zone and reveal her
- spike: Nilah's first item spike (likely Blade of the Ruined King) is a danger window; play safer
- window: After Nilah ults on your team, punish her cooldown with Living Artillery spam and kite freely
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; let it push to you so Slipstream engagement costs her more distance
- rune: Scaling; you outscale her damage and utility with items, so survive early with safety focus
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass; freeze her Apotheosis chain damage and gives you time for teammates to counter-engage

kogmaw__nunuwillump.notes:
- Biggest Snowball Ever! and Absolute Zero lock you down; you die immobilized without kite tools.
- Play safe; Nunu ganks early with W. Farm near tower, dodge his E snowballs.
- Never trade into his engage; bait E root then kite backward with W active.
- Absolute Zero becomes your hardest problem; position far back and use Zhonya's Hourglass timing.
- First item Kraken Slayer is not a threat window; respect his level 6 power spike.
- Win window is mid-game when you outrange and out-dps him; abuse W max range.
- Hold wave near tower; Nunu's engage tools force ganks, and tower defense keeps you safe.
- Pick Scaling; you scale harder and survive early safety required to reach your win condition.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass into build to survive Absolute Zero and maintain DPS through his ult.

kogmaw__olaf.notes:
- Olaf closes gap with Q Undertow armor shred, then E Reckless Swing true damage bursts you down.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; dodge Q by positioning sideways; farm safely with W Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- Never trade into Olaf directly; bait his Q then reposition; kite backward when he approaches you.
- Olaf R Ragnarok immunity to disables makes him unkitable; focus on range and positioning away from him.
- Olaf first item spike (likely damage) is dangerous; stay at maximum W range and avoid all-ins.
- Kog'Maw punish window is when Olaf Q is down and cooldown not reset; farm safely then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Olaf excels at extended fights so deny him close-range engage angles.
- Use Scaling rune page; your late-game R Living Artillery and W scaling outpace Olaf's mid-game threat.
- Build Phantom Dancer early for movement speed and passive shield to survive Olaf E true damage.

kogmaw__orianna.notes:
- Threat: Command: Shockwave launches you toward her Ball; avoid close-range teamfights where she controls positioning.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Command: Attack with positioning, never trade close.
- Trading: Bait Command: Attack by repositioning sideways, then trade back with Q Caustic Spittle from distance safely.
- Post6: Lethal threat. Living Artillery reveals her; Command: Shockwave guarantees a knockup if you're grouped. Play split or kite.
- Spike: First item (Archangel's Staff or Luden's Echo) spikes her burst; stay unpredictable and avoid predictable positioning patterns.
- Window: Mid-game when you stack attack speed (Runaan's Hurricane + Guinsoo's Rageblade); kite her in extended fights safely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces her to overextend for poke with Command: Attack, then punish with range.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale her damage; prioritize survival and late-game teamfight positioning over early trading pressure.
- Item: Phantom Dancer—dodge her Command: Shockwave knockup window with the MS boost and ghosting passive effect.

kogmaw__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, amplifying his burst damage and setting up Call of the Forge God.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ornn's terrain collision with E Searing Charge creates kill pressure near walls.
- Dodge Volcanic Rupture's fissure and avoid the magma pillar; don't trade into his Bellows Breath Brittle status.
- Post-6, Call of the Forge God is a major engagement tool; position away from terrain to avoid knockup chains.
- First item spike (Kaenic Rookern or similar tank item) reduces your poke threat; punish before he completes it.
- When Ornn is on cooldown after E Searing Charge or R, kite and deal max health damage with W.
- Hold wave near your tower; Ornn can chain terrain-based knockups if you're extended, and his upgrades scale harder.
- Use Scaling; this matchup requires late-game hypercarry damage to overcome his tankiness and utility stacking.
- Build Void Staff to cut through his massive magic resist gains from Living Forge and defensive items.

kogmaw__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns you; follow with Q or E combo kills immobile Kog'Maw.
- Levels 1-3 play safe behind minions; dodge W by positioning near allies or tower.
- Never trade into Pantheon's Mortal Will empowered spell; bait it out with positioning, then retaliate.
- Grand Starfall covers huge area; play toward side lane or use Zhonya's Hourglass reactively.
- First item spike (likely Manamune or Serrated Dirk) dangerous; respect all-in; farm safely with Q.
- Power window: mid-game when you complete Runaan's Hurricane or Kraken Slayer; he falls off.
- Hold wave near tower; Pantheon roams better than you; deny him priority and gank setup.
- Use Scaling (default); Kog'Maw scales harder than Pantheon; survive early, scale into teamfight dominance.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass early if Pantheon snowballs; stopwatch negates Grand Starfall and W combo timing.

kogmaw__reksai.notes:
- Rek'Sai Void Rush gap-closes and one-shots you before you kite; she's fastest threat.
- Play safe behind minions; Rek'Sai Burrow ganks are real. Farm with Q range.
- Never trade into her melee range; bait Unburrow knock-up then kite with W.
- Post-6 Void Rush marks you instantly; respect her all-in after any damage taken.
- First item Blade of the Ruined King spike is dangerous; farm safely, don't duel.
- Your window comes mid-game when you have two items and Runaan's Hurricane AoE.
- Hold wave near tower; Rek'Sai's tunnel gank relies on you being overextended.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outrange and out-damage her in extended teamfights later.
- Buy Randuin's Omen to reduce her burst and True Damage from Furious Bite.

kogmaw__quinn.notes:
- Vault dashes through you, interrupts, slows, and positions Quinn for free kiting with Harrier procs.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; stay behind minions, avoid Blinding Assault range, farm safely with Q at distance.
- Never trade into her Harrier mark; dodge Blinding Assault by positioning behind wave, bait her Vault cooldown.
- Post-6, Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines gives her repositioning and Skystrike marks—play further back, use R to threaten.
- First-item spike (Kraken Slayer or Blade) is a danger window; respect her all-in, farm safer until you scale.
- Mid-game (2+ items) Kog'Maw outranges and out-damages; group with team, let her overextend into R artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; avoid pushing into Vault range, force her to commit before teamfights.
- Scaling (defensive runes preferred); you scale harder, so patience and not dying early is the win condition.
- Add Phantom Dancer after core; the movement speed helps you kite Vault and Harrier-empowered chase attempts.

kogmaw__rammus.notes:
- Rammus E taunt locks you down; W reflects your damage back while he tanks with armor.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q. Never let Rammus close the gap.
