- Avoid trading into his W when active. Bait Q Powerball, then kite backward and spam attacks.
- Rammus R Soaring Slam adds engage threat and knockup; play further back, use range advantage.
- First item armor spike (Thornmail or similar) hurts you; farm safely, don't force extended trades.
- Post-Defensive Ball Curl cooldown window: unload W Bio-Arcane Barrage damage before he can re-engage.
- Push wave into his tower; denies him engage range and forces him to overextend for resets.
- Scaling rune page; you outscale his engage and armor-stacking falls off against your percentage damage.
- Add Void Staff to shred his stacking resistances and ensure your damage applies through his defenses.

kogmaw__rakan.notes:
- Threat: Rakan's Grand Entrance and The Quickness dash into you, knock you up, charm you, leaving you defenseless.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Gleaming Quill has short range. Ward river; Rakan roams fast with Battle Dance.
- Trading: Never trade when Rakan closes gap. Bait Grand Entrance by positioning far back, then Caustic Spittle and kite.
- Post6: The Quickness makes Rakan nearly untouchable—he runs you down, charms you, and you die. Play farther back.
- Spike: Rakan's first item (likely support item upgrade) is low danger. Your Kraken Slayer spike hurts him harder.
- Window: Post-first-item, when Rakan's cooldowns are down. Unload Bio-Arcane Barrage and Living Artillery; he cannot chase fast enough.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Rakan excels roaming; denying side pressure and staying safe under tower limits his impact.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale Rakan hard; survive early, scale into unkillable team fighter with range and percent health damage.
- Item: Phantom Dancer. Dodge his charm proc and The Quickness engage; the movement speed and tenacity help you kite.

kogmaw__rell.notes:
- Threat: Magnet Storm pulls you into Rell's team; you have no escape and die instantly.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Shattering Strike stuns through anything. Avoid her engage attempts.
- Trading: Never trade when Rell is mounted. Wait for her Ferromancy: Crash Down, then kite backward hard.
- Post6: Magnet Storm is a guaranteed teamfight win for Rell if you're in range. Play further back.
- Spike: Rell's first item (armor/resist) is your punish window. Kite and stack Bio-Arcane Barrage damage.
- Window: Mid-game when Rell lacks cooldown reduction; her Magnet Storm downtime lets you position safely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Rell's engage range is shorter; this forces her to commit.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale Rell hard in teamfights; survive early and scale your range advantage.
- Item: Phantom Dancer. The movespeed and ghosting help you kite Magnet Storm's pull and drag.

kogmaw__renataglasc.notes:
- threat: Renata's Hostile Takeover forces you berserk; Handshake roots you in place defenseless
- early: Safe farm; dodge Handshake with positioning, never fight in minion wave early
- trading: Avoid trading when Handshake is up; bait it before using Caustic Spittle
- post6: Living Artillery reveals you; Hostile Takeover turn forces you away or dies fighting
- spike: First item spike (likely Chemtech item) empowers Bailout saves; play respectfully then
- window: Mid-game when Renata lacks ult cooldown; poke with Living Artillery safely from range
- wave: Hold wave near tower; Renata's close-range combo threatens extended positioning away from safety
- rune: Scaling; you outscale hard once you buy lifesteal and range items like Runaan's
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass stops Hostile Takeover berserk duration and lets you survive Handshake root

kogmaw__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's Flamespitter and The Equalizer deal sustained magic damage in wide areas; dodge or kite out.
- Stay max range with W active; farm safely at distance; avoid Rumble's Q cone trade pattern entirely.
- Never trade into Flamespitter's cone; bait Q by moving sideways; use E Void Ooze to create distance and slow.
- The Equalizer wall is unavoidable at close range; respect its massive damage and kite perpendicular to its path.
- Rumble's first item spike (typically magic pen) increases Q and E damage; stay further back during this window.
- Kog'Maw spikes harder mid-game with attack speed and on-hit items; abuse W range advantage and R poke then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Rumble's close-range pattern forces him to commit into your tower range or lose CS.
- Use Scaling (default); Kog'Maw scales better than Rumble into teamfights with sustained W damage and R utility.
- Build Void Staff early if Rumble itemizes magic resist; otherwise prioritize Kraken Slayer for consistent on-hit damage output.

kogmaw__samira.notes:
- Samira closes gaps with Wild Rush, melee range Daredevil Impulse burst, and Inferno Trigger—stay out of range.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Samira out-trades at close range. Farm from distance with Caustic Spittle, avoid extended fights.
- Never let her dash onto you. Bait Wild Rush with positioning, then kite backward; dodge nothing—she'll close anyway.
- Living Artillery range advantage continues post-6, but Inferno Trigger forces you further back. Respect her all-in potential with ult up.
- Her first Kraken Slayer spike (if she builds it) is dangerous around 10–12 minutes. Respect damage and increase kiting distance.
- Kog'Maw spikes hardest with Runaan's Hurricane and Kraken Slayer complete. Play around team fights where Samira cannot dash safely.
- Hold wave near your tower. Samira excels in skirmishes on open map; deny her roam opportunities and farm safely.
- Scaling—Kog'Maw outscales Samira hard in teamfights with range and artillery. Survive early, scale into dominance.
- Add Phantom Dancer to your itemization for movement speed and damage reduction against her burst when she reaches you.

kogmaw__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's Q Arctic Assault and R Glacial Prison lock you down; you die immobilized.
- Farm safely at range with Q Caustic Spittle; avoid walking into her Q charge range.
- Don't trade into her W Winter's Wrath; bait her Q, then kite backward with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Her R Glacial Prison is a point-and-click engage tool; you must position deeper or group with teammates.
- Sejuani's first armor item spike is moderate danger; your Kraken Slayer or Void Staff punishes her.
- You spike when she runs out of mana or cooldowns; unload R Living Artillery then.
- Hold the wave near your tower; her Q Arctic Assault is deadlier when you're pushed forward.
- Use Scaling; you scale faster than her and outrange her entire kit.
- Buy Phantom Dancer to dodge her Q Arctic Assault and R Glacial Prison lock attempts.

kogmaw__sett.notes:
- Sett's Haymaker and Show Stopper lock you down; you die before kiting out.
- Play safe early; Sett out-trades you levels 1-3. Farm with Q from range.
- Never let Sett close gap. Dodge Facebreaker by positioning on only one side of him.
- Show Stopper at six gives Sett a guaranteed all-in. Respect the threat; position deeper.
- His first Sheen or Titanic spike is dangerous. Play further back; farm with artillery.
- After Sett uses cooldowns or ult, unload damage. Your range advantage wins long trades.
- Hold the wave near tower. Sett wants you extended; denying him setup keeps you alive.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed and range items stacked.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early for the movespeed and shield; kiting matters more than raw damage.

kogmaw__seraphine.notes:
- Seraphine's Encore charm locks you in place; you cannot kite or reposition during it.
- Levels 1–3: Play safe at range. Her Q damage stacks; avoid clustering with minions.
- Trading: Bait Beat Drop with positioning; dodge the line skillshot, then trade back with Q.
- Post6: Encore is a hard engage tool. Back off when she positions to ult; maintain distance.
- Spike: First item (Luden's Echo or similar) is her spike. Farm safely; don't face-check.
- Window: After she wastes Encore on allies or terrain, you have 40 seconds to pressure.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Seraphine wants to engage; denying space limits her ult range.
- Rune: Standard (default). You need steady DPS and kiting tools; scaling won't save you from charm.
- Item: Phantom Dancer. The movement speed and ghosting help you reposition after charm hit you.

kogmaw__shen.notes:
- Shen's Shadow Dash taunts you into his team; kite backward and position away from his dash line.
- Stay behind minions; Shen will look to Shadow Dash when you trade, so respect his engagement threat.
- Bait his Shadow Dash by positioning aggressively, then kite away; never trade when his cooldown is up.
- Post-6, Shen's Stand United shields an ally and teleports; watch for roam patterns and play safer when it's available.
- Shen's first item spike (Kaenic Rookern or similar) reduces your damage; abuse him before he completes it.
- Once you hit two items with attack speed, kite him down with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; he cannot all-in you.
- Push the wave into his tower; it limits his roam timing and forces him to decide between farming and helping allies.
- Standard (default) — you need consistent DPS and kiting tools to outrange and wear Shen down over time.
- Add Runaan's Hurricane to stack your W on-hits faster and deny Shen's ability to isolate you one-versus-one.

kogmaw__shyvana.notes:
- Shyvana's Dragon Form empowers all abilities and makes her a sustained threat you cannot kite effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Emberstrike range and W Inferno Aegis shield make early trades bad for you.
- Never walk into her Q range. Bait her W Inferno Aegis shield, then kite backward with R Living Artillery.
- Post-6, Dragon's Descent closes gaps fast. Stay max range, spam R Living Artillery, position near walls to block her leap.
- Her first item spike (typically Bork or Sunfire) empowers her sustained damage; respect her all-in but punish if she wastes W.
- Your window is when her R Dragon's Descent is down and you have Kraken Slayer or Nashor's Tooth online.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Her sustained damage and gap closers punish extended fights; farming safely scales your range advantage.
- vs Hard Engage. Shyvana's threat demands defensive runes to survive her Dragon Form engagement and stay mobile.
- Buy Phantom Dancer second or third. Its movement speed and damage reduction help you kite and survive her upfront burst.

kogmaw__sivir.notes:
- Sivir's Spell Shield blocks your Caustic Spittle and Living Artillery, denying key tools.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Boomerang Blade outranges your autos, poke with Caustic Spittle.
- Bait Spell Shield with Caustic Spittle before committing to Living Artillery or all-in.
- Post-6, Sivir's On The Hunt lets her chase or disengage; respect her mobility spike.
- Her first-item Kraken Slayer is dangerous; play safer until you complete Blade of the Ruined King.
- Push advantage when Spell Shield is down; Living Artillery becomes your primary threat tool again.
- Hold wave near your tower; Sivir's Ricochet punishes grouped minions and her dash Spell Shield escape.
- Take Scaling; you outscale her and need time to itemize armor-shred and attack-speed layers.
- Add Void Staff if she builds magic resist; otherwise stay true to core for DPS.

kogmaw__sion.notes:
- Decimating Smash charged knock-up stun locks you; Unstoppable Onslaught rams you into his team.
- Play safe behind minions; his Q is a skillshot so bait it wide, then trade with Caustic Spittle.
- Never stand still; dodge his Q charge by moving perpendicular. Trade only when his Q is on cooldown.
- Unstoppable Onslaught has massive range and speed; respect it and position near your tower or kite backwards hard.
- His first item spike (typically Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) reduces your damage; farm safely and scale instead.
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items and attack speed, kite him endlessly with Bio-Arcane Barrage and Runaan's.
- Hold wave near your tower; his engage tools force you back, so deny him easy roams and picks.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard in extended teamfights and need survivability to kite his charges.
- Add Void Staff early if he stacks magic resist; otherwise add Phantom Dancer for kiting and survivability.

kogmaw__singed.notes:
- Singed's E Fling into W Mega Adhesive root traps you immobile, followed by poison damage and Grievous Wounds.
- Play safe near tower; Singed's early poison damage is minor but E Fling range is deceptively far. Farm passively.
- Never position where Singed can E Fling you backward into his W. Bait his W, then kite around it.
- Singed R Insanity Potion grants him tankiness and Grievous Wounds on Q Poison Trail, severely limiting your sustain and dueling.
- His first item spike (Rylai's or similar) isn't immediately lethal, but it makes kiting harder. Punish with R Living Artillery range.
- Kog'Maw power window: after you complete Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane. Your range and on-hit damage outscale his engage.
- Hold wave near your tower; Singed wants to bait you into extended fights near his side. Deny him ground advantage.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale massively and don't need early pressure. Survive laning phase, let teamfights be your victory.
- Add Randuin's Omen if Singed builds Rylai's; the armor and slow-resist counter his kite-and-chase fantasy significantly.

kogmaw__skarner.notes:
- Skarner's Impale suppresses you—you can't kite, attack, or use abilities while dragged.
- Levels 1-3: Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; avoid letting him close distance.
- Dodge Ixtal's Impact charge by repositioning sideways; don't trade into his Seismic Bastion shield.
- Post-6: Impale is point-and-click and unavoidable once in range—prioritize staying 700+ units away always.
- Skarner's first item spike (Hollow Radiance or tank item) increases his tankiness; maintain range advantage.
- Your window: land Void Ooze to slow his approach, then kite backward with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Hold wave near your tower so Skarner must overextend to engage; this limits his suppression threat.
- Use Scaling (default) to stack range and damage for mid-to-late teamfights where you dominate.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass as a one-item addition to stasis-dodge Impale if Skarner lands on you.

kogmaw__sona.notes:
- Crescendo stuns you instantly at range with no dodge window; play around cooldown.
- Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; avoid walking into Sona's close range.
- Never trade into her Hymn of Valor bolts; bait her to use abilities first.
- Crescendo locks you down for a guaranteed follow-up; respect the ultimate and position back.
- Her first item spike (usually Tear-based or support item) is not a danger window.
- You spike harder when you hit two items; Sona lacks burst to match your damage then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Crescendo's range means overextending gets you caught and stunned.
- Scaling; you scale infinitely harder and Sona becomes irrelevant by midgame teamfights.
- Zhonya's Hourglass freezes you during Crescendo stun duration, negating the follow-up damage window.

kogmaw__smolder.notes:
- Threat: Smolder's E Flap, Flap, Flap dives you and chains with MMOOOMMMM! before you kite away safely.
- Early: Dangerous—Smolder's Q Super Scorcher Breath out-trades your short-range autos; play safe behind minions, use Caustic Spittle to kite.
- Trading: Never walk into his Q range predictably; bait E by repositioning, then Caustic Spittle + Bio-Arcane Barrage when he lands.
- Post6: MMOOOMMMM! slows and amplifies his burst; respect the zone and maintain max Void Ooze trail distance from him always.
- Spike: First item (likely Nashor's Tooth or Kraken Slayer) spikes his Q damage hard—stay far back, do not challenge early.
- Window: Level 2-3 before his E stacks, and mid-game when Kog'Maw's range items (Runaan's Hurricane, Guinsoo's Rageblade) outscale his burst.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower—Smolder's E ganks you easily when pushed up; punish his E cooldown by shoving only then.
- Rune: Scaling—you outrange and out-dps him late; buy time with safe farming and poke with Living Artillery from distance.
- Item: Add Zhonya's Hourglass to counter MMOOOMMMM! burst and survive his all-in when caught in his ultimate's slow.

kogmaw__soraka.notes:
- Threat: Soraka's Equinox silence locks you down; her Wish sustain negates your poke and siege pressure.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Soraka has no kill threat but denies trades with Astral Infusion healing.
- Trading: Bait Equinox with positioning, then trade when zone is down. Dodge Starcall; it slows and heals her.
- Post6: Wish makes her unkillable and enables her team. Your siege becomes harder; focus objective pressure instead.
- Spike: First item (likely Chemtech Purifier alternative or heal-reduction item) hurts you. Play around cooldowns, not direct trades.
- Window: Mid-game when Soraka's mana depletes or cooldowns are staggered. Chain objectives before her team regroups.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Soraka wants to roam; denying safe positioning forces her to choose lane.
- Rune: Scaling. Extended game favors your range and damage scaling over early skirmishing pressure she avoids.
- Item: Void Staff pierces her magic resist; pair with W On-Hit damage to shred her and allies alike.

kogmaw__swain.notes:
- Swain's E root chains you; his R drains and you cannot kite freely under it.
- Play safe; Swain out-trades you early. Farm at range with Q; avoid walking up needlessly.
- Bait his E forward, then sidestep root. Never trade into Q when multiple bolts connect.
- Demonic Ascension makes him unkillable in close fights. Keep maximum distance; use R to poke.
- Swain's first item spike (typically Liandry's Torment) strengthens his sustained damage; farm safely, don't duel.
- Post-first-item when Swain lacks full build; kite and poke with R from fog of war safely.
- Hold wave near your tower; Swain wants to engage close. Punish overextension with R harassment.
- Scaling; you scale harder into teamfights with range and percent health damage on W attacks.
- Kaenic Rookern blocks his R drain healing; grab it after core if Swain snowballs hard.

kogmaw__sylas.notes:
- Sylas W Kingslayer closes gaps, deals damage, and heals him—your immobility makes you vulnerable prey.
- Play safe behind minions; Sylas Q Chain Lash is a skillshot you can dodge by positioning.
- Never trade when his Petricite Burst is charged; dodge his Q and punish with Living Artillery.
- His ult steals Living Artillery—he gains your long-range poke and execute threat; play further back.
- First Hextech Rocketbelt spike (around 2 items) lets him gap-close faster; kite harder and use E.
- After Sylas burns W Kingslayer cooldown, he's vulnerable; unleash Q Caustic Spittle and full Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; force him to all-in under tower or farm safely with E Void Ooze.
- Standard (default) page fits—you need consistent DPS and kiting tools, not scaling or hard engage.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to survive his W Kingslayer burst and stolen ult burst windows safely.

kogmaw__tahmkench.notes:
- Devour traps you for seconds with no counterplay; stay outside three-stack range always.
- Play safe near tower; Tahm Q applies stacks and his W knockup zones you hard.
- Never trade into his Q—dodge it or back off; he heals and stacks you.
- Devour locks you down; position far back and use R to kite away post-six.
- His first item (likely Kaenic Rookern) isn't a spike; abuse your range before he scales.
- Post-three items, Kog'Maw outdamages him; maximize distance and poke with R from safety.
- Hold wave near your tower; let him overextend chasing cs, then R poke from safety.
- Scaling; you outscale hard and need time to reach item power spikes safely.
- Buy Void Staff early if he builds magic resist; pure damage ignores his tankiness.

kogmaw__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's E Scatter the Weak stuns you with Dark Spheres; her R Unleashed Power one-shots low-health targets instantly.
- Play safe levels 1–3; her Q Dark Sphere outranges your attacks. Farm under tower, avoid her projectile path.
- Never walk into her E Scatter the Weak range. Bait Q Dark Sphere placement, then trade with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6, R Unleashed Power deals massive damage at range. Stay healthy; one R combo kills you if low enough.
- Her first item spike (Luden's Tempest or Shadowflame) increases burst significantly. Play further back; punish her mana usage instead.
- You spike at three items with attack speed and on-hit damage. Kite sideways; use range advantage to stay safe.
- Hold wave near your tower. Her E knockback punishes forward positioning; farming defensively lets you scale into hypercarry status.
- Use Scaling rune page. You outscale her hard; survive early, spike mid-game, and dominate with attack speed and range.
- Add Phantom Dancer or Wit's End. Phantom Dancer blocks burst and gives mobility; Wit's End steals her AP and gives magic resist.

kogmaw__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Seismic Shove and Unraveled Earth trap you; you lack mobility to escape.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Threaded Volley chunks you. Farm safely at range.
- Trading: Never trade into her zone. Bait Seismic Shove before committing with Caustic Spittle.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall cuts the map; Living Artillery outranges her. Play safer, farm sideways.
- Spike: First item spike is her danger window. Farm safely until you scale.
- Window: Mid-game with two items; Living Artillery range and damage outscale her mobility then.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Taliyah roams easily; denying push limits her map pressure.
- Rune: Scaling. You outscale her hard; survive early, dominate mid-game teamfights with range.
- Item: Void Staff. Taliyah builds AP; shred her magic resist to amplify all damage.

kogmaw__taric.notes:
- threat: Taric's Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your sustained damage; Dazzle stun locks you down.
- early: Dangerous. Stay back from Dazzle range; farm safely with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- trading: Never trade into his Bravado empowerment window. Bait Dazzle before committing to damage.
- post6: Cosmic Radiance makes Taric unkillable during teamfights; focus on avoiding his engage entirely.
- spike: First item spike dangerous—Taric gains tankiness and healing. Play safer, respect his peel.
- window: Mid-game when Taric lacks cooldown reduction; punish gaps between Cosmic Radiance casts aggressively.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Taric wants close range fights; deny him engagement angles safely.
- rune: Scaling. Kog'Maw outscales Taric's utility; avoid early all-ins and scale into item advantages.
- item: Void Staff. Taric builds armor naturally; magic pen cuts through his defensive layers efficiently.

kogmaw__teemo.notes:
- Teemo's Blinding Dart negates your W damage window; his traps zone you from positioning safely.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Teemo outranges you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid brush.
- Never chase Teemo into brush where he goes invisible. Bait his Blinding Dart, then trade with W.
- Post-6, Noxious Trap creates a minefield; respect trap placement and use Q to scout brushes safely.
- Teemo's first item spike (Nashor's Tooth or Statikk Shiv) is dangerous; respect his burst and slow.
- Your spike arrives when you complete Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane; extended teamfights favor your range.
- Hold wave near your tower; Teemo's traps control side lanes. Safe farming denies his roam pressure.
- Pick Scaling; you scale much harder than Teemo into mid-game teamfights with proper positioning.
- Add Phantom Dancer to block Teemo's on-hit poison and gain extra durability against his poke.

kogmaw__tristana.notes:
- Tristana's Rocket Jump and Buster Shot knock you away; you cannot kite or reposition safely.
- Play safe behind minions; Tristana Rocket Jump trades poorly into your Q Caustic Spittle armor shred.
- Never walk into her E Explosive Charge range; bait her Rocket Jump before trading damage.
- Buster Shot knockback denies your W Bio-Arcane Barrage range advantage; stay at max distance always.
- Her first item spike (Kraken Slayer or Infinity Edge) is dangerous; farm safely under tower.
- After Tristana wastes Rocket Jump, punish with max-range W Bio-Arcane Barrage and R Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; her all-in threat from Rocket Jump is too high to space forward.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder into late game with percent damage and artillery range advantage.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive her Buster Shot knockback and burst; delays her kill window.

kogmaw__thresh.notes:
- Thresh Q Death Sentence chains and pulls you; follow-up E Flay knocks you into danger or his team.
- Stay beyond hook range levels 1–3; farm safely at max W Bio-Arcane Barrage range, never walk up to CS.
- Never trade after Thresh lands Q; bait his hook by faking walks toward him, then reposition hard away.
- Living Artillery reveals Thresh through fog; stay healthy so he cannot all-in post-6; kite away from R The Box.
- Thresh first item spike (typically Plated Steelcaps or Kaenic Rookern) is moderate threat; abuse your range advantage at this window.
- Your power window is mid-game when W Bio-Arcane Barrage shreds his armor; he cannot close gap if hook misses.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Thresh push; his Q Death Sentence is easier to dodge when he overextends.
- Pick Scaling; you outscale Thresh hard once you itemize; his engage window closes as you gain resistances and damage.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass as fifth or sixth item; dodge his R The Box walls and deny follow-up burst damage.

kogmaw__trundle.notes:
- Trundle's Subjugate steals your resistances, making you fragile and vulnerable to his burst.
- Play safe behind minions; Trundle's Chomp saps your attack damage—avoid close trades early.
- Never trade into Trundle when Pillar of Ice is up; dodge it or kite backward.
- Subjugate doubles stolen stats over 4 seconds, making you extremely vulnerable post-6; maintain distance.
- Trundle's first item spike (usually Frozen Heart or Kaenic Rookern) is dangerous; farm safely.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Kraken Slayer completes; kite and use Living Artillery to poke from range.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Trundle's Frozen Domain gives him dueling advantage in extended fights.
- Use Scaling; you outrange and out-damage him late game if you survive the mid-game.
- Add Void Staff to shred his magic resistance and maintain damage after his Subjugate theft.

kogmaw__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's Spinning Slash closes gap; his Undying Rage makes you vulnerable during teamfights.
- Play safe early; farm with Caustic Spittle from distance. Avoid close range trades.
- Never trade into his spin; kite backward and use Void Ooze to slow his approach.
- Post-6, Undying Rage negates burst damage. Kite around terrain and rely on Living Artillery poke.
- First item spike (likely Blade of the Ruined King) lets him lifesteal and duel harder.
- Spike comes mid-game when Tryndamere loses crit chance; abuse this window with team rotations.
- Hold wave near your tower; force him to overextend into your range for safe farming.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed and percent health damage scaling.
- Add Randuin's Omen; its armor and crit reduction directly counter his crit-based damage pattern.

kogmaw__twistedfate.notes:
- Twisted Fate's Pick a Card stun locks you down; Destiny reveals and enables gank setup.
- Play safe; Wild Cards is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Dodge Wild Cards; never trade into his Stacked Deck bonus damage windows every 4 attacks.
- Post-6 Destiny reveals you globally; respect gank timing and play closer to your tower.
- First item spike (likely Lich Bane or similar) increases his burst; farm safely, don't overextend.
- You spike harder mid-game with two items; punish his cooldowns when Destiny is down.
- Hold wave near tower; Twisted Fate lacks waveclear early, and ganks are safer for you there.
- Standard rune page; you need reliable laning survivability and scaling into teamfights without all-in pressure.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early; the movement speed and dodge passive help you kite and evade stuns.

kogmaw__twitch.notes:
- Twitch's Spray and Pray pierces through you at range, dealing massive true damage via Deadly Venom stacks.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Twitch out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid close trades entirely.
- Never trade into Twitch directly—his venom stacks faster than your damage output. Bait his W, then kite backward hard.
- Post-6, Spray and Pray outranges your W significantly. Stay behind minions or retreat to tower when he ults.
- His first item (likely Kraken Slayer) is a major spike. Punish him during his build completion window before powerspike.
- You spike harder mid-game with W range and attack speed items. All-in when he lacks defensive items or positioning.
- Shove the wave hard to deny his roam threat and force him into tower, limiting his map pressure significantly.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him late with sustained dps and W range advantage over his burst window.
- Build Wit's End early for magic resist and attack speed, reducing his venom damage significantly while powering your W.

kogmaw__vayne.notes:
- Vayne's W Silver Bolts true damage on third hit shreds your health despite resistances.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; farm safely at range with Q, avoid close trades.
- Never trade when Vayne has two bolt stacks; bait her Condemn into missing.
- Post-6 Final Hour makes her invisible during Tumble; play around your team, not solo.
- Vayne's first item spike (Kraken Slayer or Blade) is lethal; respect her all-in.
- Kog'Maw spikes when he completes two items and can kite from max W range.
- Hold wave near your tower; Vayne's close-range kit punishes you when pushed forward.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her damage profile and need late-game survivability.
- Add Randuin's Omen to reduce her attack speed and crit threat significantly.

kogmaw__veigar.notes:
- Veigar's Event Horizon cage stuns you if you walk through it; follow with Primordial Burst for massive damage.
- Play safe; Veigar outranges you early. Farm with Q Caustic Spittle from distance, avoid pushing past river.
- Never walk into Event Horizon. Bait it by faking sidestep, then reposition. Trade only after cage is down.
- Primordial Burst scales with your missing health; stay healthy or respect massive ult damage. W Bio-Arcane Barrage range helps kite.
- Veigar's first Rabadon's Deathcap spike is lethal around 15-18 minutes. Play safer, position further back during this window.
- After Veigar wastes Event Horizon cooldown, you have 16+ seconds to position aggressively and threaten with W attacks.
- Hold wave near your tower; Veigar's cage threatens all-ins if you push. Farm safely under turret until mid-game.
- Scaling rune page; you scale harder into late game than Veigar and need survivability for his burst threats.
- Build Void Staff early if Veigar rushes Magic Resist itemization; otherwise add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Primordial Burst.

kogmaw__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's Q Plasma Fission and W Void Rift combo chunks you before you can kite safely back.
- Play safe level 1-3; Vel'Koz out-ranges your autos. Farm with Q Caustic Spittle when possible.
- Never walk into E Tectonic Disruption knock-up range. Bait Q splits by positioning unpredictably side-to-side.
- Post-6, R Life Form Disintegration Ray chains true damage through your health pool; respect beam range.
- Vel'Koz first item (Liandry's or Shadowflame) is danger window; you lack resistances and lifesteal early.
- You spike when W Bio-Arcane Barrage plus attack speed items let you out-range and kite his abilities.
- Hold wave near tower; Vel'Koz out-ranges your W early and punishes overextension. Play for ganks.
- Scaling (default); you outscale his utility and need defensive stats and resist scaling into late game.
- Add Void Staff after core if Vel'Koz builds heavy resistances, or Shadowflame to counter his shields.

kogmaw__vex.notes:
- Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your dash patterns and Shadow Surge marks you for all-in.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Vex out-ranges you early. Farm under tower, avoid her Q poke.
- Never dash toward Vex when Doom 'n Gloom is active; bait her fear, then reposition.
- Post-6 Shadow Surge is a hard engage tool. Stay positioned deep; don't let her mark you.
- Vex's first item spike (Shadowflame or Liandry's) is dangerous around minute 11-13. Play safer, farm.
- You spike harder mid-game with Kraken Slayer and attack speed; kite her in teamfights then.
- Hold wave near your tower. Use W Bio-Arcane Barrage range to farm safely without pushing.
- Use Scaling rune page; Vex is a mid-game threat but you outscale her hard.
- Add Void Staff if Vex builds heavy AP; otherwise prioritize core Kraken into Runaan's.

kogmaw__viego.notes:
- Heartbreaker execution on low-health Kog'Maw; Viego teleports in and one-shots you instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; Spectral Maw stun range is dangerous, don't get caught extended.
- Never trade into Viego's Blade of the Ruined King On-Hits; kite backward with W range.
- Post-6, Heartbreaker turns him into a guaranteed kill threat; respect massive range and execution damage.
- First item Kraken Slayer spike is real danger; your range advantage and poke pressure punish him hard before then.
- Kog'Maw dominates mid-game when Viego lacks items; spam Caustic Spittle and Living Artillery before his core finishes.
- Hold wave near your tower; Heartbreaker threatens overextended positioning, so deny him execution setups on you.
- Use Scaling; you scale into late-game carry; Viego falls off compared to your sustained DPS and poke.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to deny Heartbreaker execution window and buy time for teammates to collapse.

kogmaw__vi.notes:
- threat: Vi's Cease and Desist locks you down; she closes gaps faster than you kite backward safely
- early: Dangerous—Vi gaps you easily. Farm safely behind minions; use Caustic Spittle for attack speed and spacing
- trading: Never trade short. Bait Vault Breaker into terrain or minions, then punish with Bio-Arcane Barrage trades
- post6: Critical danger window. Cease and Desist reaches across the map; position deeper and play around cooldown timers
- spike: Vi's first item (Trinity Force or Black Cleaver) is a danger window; respect her damage spike hard
- window: Mid-game when Vi lacks cooldowns or you position near walls to escape Vault Breaker into terrain
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Shove only when Vi shows elsewhere; you need tower safety from her
- rune: Scaling. You outscale Vi hard; survive early with range and kiting, then dominate teamfights with poke
- item: Zhonya's Hourglass. Stasis dodges Cease and Desist follow-up damage and resets her engagement window entirely

kogmaw__viktor.notes:
- threat: Viktor's Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm deal sustained magic damage; stay out of beam lines.
- early: Dangerous. Viktor outranges you early; farm safely at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range, avoid his Siphon Power.
- trading: Trade only when Viktor misses Hextech Ray. Bait his Siphon Power cooldown, then reposition before his next spell.
- post6: Arcane Storm becomes a zoning nightmare. Keep distance, use Void Ooze to create space and slow his repositioning.
- spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts. This is a punish window—respect range, stack Runaan's Hurricane faster.
- window: Mid-game (items 2-3): Runaan's Hurricane and Blade of the Ruined King let you out-duel him safely from distance.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Force Viktor to overextend into your range or miss farm; avoid his Gravity Field traps.
- rune: Scaling. You outscale Viktor's damage profile hard with attack speed and on-hit; survive early, dominate late.
- item: Void Staff. Negates his magic resist stacking and amplifies your Bio-Arcane Barrage magic damage against him significantly.

kogmaw__vladimir.notes:
- threat: Vladimir's Hemoplague amplifies damage; Sanguine Pool dodges your skillshots and heals him continuously.
- early: Dangerous. Vladimir out-trades you level 1-2; stay max range, avoid extended fights, farm safely.
- trading: Never commit to Caustic Spittle if Vladimir holds Sanguine Pool; bait it first, then trade.
- post6: Hemoplague turns Vladimir into a burst threat; Kog'Maw must kite and use range advantage strictly.
- spike: Vladimir's first completed item (typically Protobelt or Zhonyas) spikes his damage; maintain distance during this window.
- window: Mid-game, after Kraken Slayer completes; Vladimir falls off if you stay at max Bio-Arcane Barrage range.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Vladimir needs to engage close to deal damage, deny that angle.
- rune: Scaling. You outrange and out-scale Vladimir; survive early, punish his immobility in extended fights.
- item: Void Staff; Vladimir builds health-AP items, so magic penetration shreds his tankiness and damage conversion.

kogmaw__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's Thundering Smash stun into all-in combo kills you before you kite away safely.
- Play safe; farm at range with Caustic Spittle. Never let him close the gap freely.
- Bait Thundering Smash by repositioning sideways, then trade back with Caustic Spittle and autos.
- Stormbringer closes distance instantly and disables towers; kite harder and respect the engage window.
- First item spike (likely Sunfire Aegis or tank item) reduces your burst; farm safely, scale harder.
- After Volibear uses Thundering Smash cooldown, Living Artillery from distance punishes his immobility window.
- Hold wave near tower; Volibear excels at diving and tower-disabling, so deny him that advantage.
- Scaling; you outrange and outscale him, so survive early lane and let items carry you.
- Randuin's Omen reduces his attack speed and crit threat while providing armor and health.

kogmaw__warwick.notes:
- Warwick's Infinite Duress suppression leaves you helpless; he kills you in one combo while locked.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1–3; his all-in with Q and E chunks you hard.
- Never fight close range; kite backward and use E Void Ooze to slow his approach angle.
- After level 6, Infinite Duress range scales with his bonus Move Speed; respect his engage threat.
- His Blade of the Ruined King first spike hurts; farm safely until you have Kraken Slayer.
- Your power window is mid-game with two items when you kite and poke with R Living Artillery safely.
- Hold wave near your tower; force him to engage into your tower or lose CS safely.
- Use Scaling (default) to scale into late-game teamfights where range and poke dominance matter most.
- Build Zhonya's Hourglass to survive and dodge Infinite Duress suppression window damage during teamfights.

kogmaw__xayah.notes:
- Xayah's Bladecaller roots you in place; you cannot kite or reposition during the root window.
- Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; stay near tower and avoid pushing into her feathers.
- Never walk through her feather trail from Void Ooze; bait Bladecaller by positioning away from clustered feathers.
- Featherstorm makes Xayah untargetable; use this window to position backwards and prepare Bio-Arcane Barrage for her landing.
- First item Kraken Slayer spike is dangerous; Xayah gains burst and attack speed—respect her all-in range at this timing.
- You spike harder mid-game with Runaan's Hurricane or Guinsoo's Rageblade; kite her with W range and punish root misses.
- Hold wave near your tower; her feathers control space and roots punish overextension—wait for ganks or let her push into you.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her in extended fights with sustained damage while she needs quick burst windows.
- Add Phantom Dancer if rooted repeatedly; the movement speed and untargetability help you survive Bladecaller and reposition after root ends.

kogmaw__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's long-range skillshots (Q, W, R) delete you before you can threaten him back.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; stay behind minions, dodge his Q Arcanopulse beam, farm passively.
- Never trade into his range. Bait his Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in only post-6.
- Post-6, your R Living Artillery matches his range; use it to duel and zone him.
- His first-item spike (around 2-3 items) is dangerous; respect it, farm safely, scale into lategame.
- Your power window is mid-to-late game once you have 2+ items and R maxed; duel then.
- Hold the wave near your tower; let it push to you so Xerath must overextend to poke.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed, on-hit, and range advantage lategame.
- Buy Wit's End early if you eat too much magic damage; resists and attack speed help.

kogmaw__xinzhao.notes:
- Xin Zhao all-ins with Audacious Charge; you die if caught without kiting space or peel.
- Play safe level 1–3; farm at max range with Caustic Spittle, never walk up alone.
- Bait Audacious Charge by positioning near minions, then kite backward; dodge Wind Becomes Lightning's slow.
- Post-6, Crescent Guard passive challenges you after any Xin Zhao damage—keep distance and use poke.
- Xin Zhao spikes hard at Brutalizer or Black Cleaver; play back and rely on Living Artillery.
- You spike when you finish Kraken Slayer or Runaan's Hurricane; kite and output from safety then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Xin Zhao will dive if lane pushes; deny him all-in angle.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale and need mana, CDR, and survivability for extended fights.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early for passive ghost effect; dodge Audacious Charge's engage and create untargetable windows.

kogmaw__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo closes gap with E Sweeping Blade dashes, then Last Breath knocks you airborne for his team.
- Play safe behind minions; Yasuo's Q Steel Tempest is a skillshot—dodge sideways. Do not trade yet.
- Never walk toward Yasuo; bait his E dash, then kite away and punish with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Post-6, Last Breath converts any knockup into a lethal combo. Stay spread and never clump with allies.
- Yasuo's first item (likely Shieldbow or crit) strengthens his all-in; respect it and play further back.
- Mid-game when Kog'Maw has two items, kite from max range with W; Yasuo cannot gap close infinitely.
- Hold wave near your tower; Yasuo wants to dive. Deny him space to dash through minions freely.
- Use Scaling; Kog'Maw scales harder into late game when Yasuo falls off and kiting becomes your win.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass if Yasuo snowballs; it delays his Last Breath combo and protects your positioning.

kogmaw__yone.notes:
- Yone's Fate Sealed blinks behind you, pulls you in, and chains you for his team's follow-up.
- Play safe; Yone out-trades you early. Farm at max W range, respect his Q dash threat.
- Never let Yone stack Gathering Storm freely. Bait his Q, then punish with E slow into W.
- Post-6, Fate Sealed range makes you vulnerable. Maintain distance; use E preemptively to deny his engage.
- Yone's first-item spike (Infinity Edge or Kraken Slayer) is dangerous. Play behind tower until you spike.
- You outrange and outdamage him once you hit two items. Force fights when he's on cooldown.
- Hold wave near your tower. Yone excels in side lane skirmishes; denying him kills limits his snowball.
- Take Scaling. You scale harder than Yone; surviving early lets you dominate mid-game teamfights.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Fate Sealed engages and protect yourself during Spirit form windows.

kogmaw__yunara.notes:
- Yunara's Cultivation of Spirit attack spread and Transcendent upgrades let her kite and burst you down.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q spreads damage. Farm with W range, avoid close trading patterns.
- Never chase her E; she becomes Ghosted or dashes away. Bait her W before committing.
- Post-6 Yunara gains sustained damage pressure. Your Living Artillery range advantage lets you poke safely back.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage. Stay back, use W range to farm safely.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items. Kite away, use Caustic Spittle armor shred to duel.
- Hold wave near tower. Her spread damage punishes grouped minions; deny her close-range attack angles there.
- Standard; you need baseline defenses and sustained damage to outrange and outlast her kite attempts.
- Build Wit's End early to resist her magic damage and gain attack speed for W scaling.

kogmaw__yorick.notes:
- Yorick's Mist Walkers and Maiden swarm you; kite backward and use range to maintain distance.
- Play safe. Yorick's Q Last Rites heal + bonus damage threatens all-ins. Farm at max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Never trade into his minion wave. Bait his W Dark Procession to block nothing, then reposition freely.
- Post-6, Eulogy of the Isles amplifies his sustained damage via Maiden. Stay max range; use E Void Ooze to slow her advance.
- Yorick's first Sheen item (Lich Bane or Trinity Force equivalent) spikes his burst. Respect it; farm safely and don't face-check.
- After Yorick uses W Dark Procession, he has no CC. Punish with Q Caustic Spittle + W spam to kite away.
- Hold wave near your tower. Yorick's summons struggle to dive you under turret; force him to overextend or lose CS.
- Standard (default) — you need poke pressure and sustained DPS to kite his melee-reliant engage pattern effectively.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early. Its movement speed boost and ghosting help you kite Mist Walkers and avoid Maiden lockdowns.

kogmaw__zaahen.notes:
- Zaahen's gap-close and knock-up lock you down; his healing negates poke damage.
- Play safe; farm at range with Q. Avoid pushing; let wave come to you.
- Dodge W Dreaded Return by spacing back; never trade into his Q healing window.
- Living Artillery reveals him post-6; use it to kite and punish his approach attempts.
- His first item spike is dangerous; respect his all-in threat and stay healthy.
- You spike when he's low on Determination stacks; punish before he resets on minions.
- Hold wave near tower; force him to extend into your range advantage with W.
- Use Scaling; you outscale his mid-game and need survival runes to reach it.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early to dodge his E and W engage attempts safely.

kogmaw__zac.notes:
- Zac's E Elastic Slingshot engages you; his R Let's Bounce! locks you down for the kill.
- Stay near tower; Zac's early ganks with E are lethal. Farm safely with Q Caustic Spittle.
- Never face Zac directly. Bait his Q Stretching Strikes, then kite backward. Trade only at range.
- Post-6, R Let's Bounce! into your team forces a teamfight you cannot escape. Position deeper.
- Zac's first item spike (Hollow Radiance or Abyssal Mask) increases tankiness; this is your punish window.
- Mid-game when Zac lacks cooldown reduction: force teamfights where W Bio-Arcane Barrage burns his health fastest.
- Hold wave near your tower. Zac needs to engage close; pushing out exposes you to E ganks.
- Scaling (default). You outscale Zac's engage if you farm safely and farm safely and let teamfights happen.
- Buy Randuin's Omen to reduce Zac's R Let's Bounce! knockup duration and his burst threat significantly.

kogmaw__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark all-in with R dash gap-closes and amplifies burst through marked damage window.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Zed out-trades early. Farm with Q range, stay away from minions.
- Never walk into E range. Dodge his Q Razor Shuriken skillshots; bait shadow repositioning with W.
- Death Mark forces you immobile. Use Zhonya's Hourglass active or reposition behind turret immediately post-mark.
- Zed's Serrated Dirk spike (first lethality item) is dangerous. Respect all-in windows; play further back.
- After Zed uses R, he's vulnerable for 3+ seconds. Unload W Bio-Arcane Barrage and R Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near tower. Zed's all-in threat is strongest when you're overextended; force him to dive.
- Use Scaling rune page; this matchup rewards patience, late-game teamfight positioning, and artillery range advantage.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass early (before Lord Dominik's Regards or Void Staff) to negate Death Mark burst.

kogmaw__zeri.notes:
- Zeri closes gaps with E Spark Surge and R Lightning Crash; kite or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zeri's all-in with E is fast, you lack range.
- Never trade into her E dash; bait it out, then use Q Caustic Spittle.
- Post-6, R Lightning Crash gives her Move Speed stacking—kite backwards, spam W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Her first item spike is moderate danger; abuse range advantage before she buys defenses.
- After Zeri burns E, you have a 6-second window to trade with Q and auto-attacks.
- Let the wave push toward you slightly; Zeri excels in extended short-range fights.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her hard with attack range and W percent health damage.
- Buy Phantom Dancer early; its Movement Speed and ghost passive counter her E dashes.

kogmaw__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs' Mega Inferno Bomb deals massive poke from extreme range; you cannot retaliate.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; Bouncing Bomb and Short Fuse poke hurt early.
- Never chase Ziggs into lane brush; dodge Bouncing Bomb, let Satchel Charge push him away.
- Living Artillery outranges Ziggs' combo at level 6; use it to zone him safely.
- Ziggs' first item spike (Liandry's or Shadowflame) forces you back; farm safer, stay healthy.
- After Ziggs uses Satchel Charge to escape, he's vulnerable; punish with Living Artillery pressure.
- Hold wave near your tower; Ziggs excels at collapsing on overextended targets with jungler.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder into late game with attack speed and range items.
- Build Void Staff early if Ziggs builds heavy magic resist; cuts his defensive value.

kogmaw__zoe.notes:
- Sleepy Trouble Bubble locks you down; follow-up burst from Paddle Star! while defenseless kills you.
- Play safe behind minions; Paddle Star! outranges your early damage. Farm with Caustic Spittle from distance.
- Never walk into Zoe's Q line. Bait Portal Jump before committing to extended trades with W.
- Post-6, Portal Jump gives Zoe repositioning to land Sleepy Trouble Bubble from unexpected angles. Stay mobile.
- Zoe's first item spike (Luden's Tempest or Shadowflame) threatens your health pool; play further back temporarily.
- Win window: when Zoe wastes Spell Thief or Portal Jump on non-threat targets. Punish with Living Artillery.
- Hold wave near your tower; forces Zoe to overextend for Paddle Star! poke and risks Portal Jump ganks.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her raw damage and survive her burst with itemization and stat growth.
- Add Wit's End to block her magic damage spikes and reduce Sleepy Trouble Bubble's burst follow-up threat.

kogmaw__zyra.notes:
- Grasping Roots root locks you in place; Stranglethorns knocks you airborne and enrages plants.
- Play safe behind minions; her seeds spawn slowly early. Don't get rooted near tower.
- Bait Grasping Roots by repositioning, then trade with W attacks. Never face-check brush.
- Stranglethorns plants enrage and deal heavy damage. Stay max range; use R to poke safely.
- Her first item spike (typically Liandry's or Zhonyas) is dangerous. Punish her before completion.
- Post-first-item when she lacks CDR. Shove wave, retreat, and poke with R from safety.
- Hold wave near your tower; her plants force close fights. Avoid letting her freeze it.
- Scaling works; sustain and outrange her. Standard also works if you respect root threat.
- Buy Wit's End to block magic damage and resist her plant trades early-mid game.

drmundo__aatrox.notes:
- Threat: Aatrox's Q chains and E dash enable all-ins that burst you before you can kite or heal back.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are safe; farm with Q from distance, avoid walking into his Q swing patterns.
- Trading: Dodge his Q slams, trade back with your Q when he E dashes forward aggressively.
- Post6: World Ender grants him massive AD and healing; respect the all-in threat and play safer spacing.
- Spike: His first item (likely Serrated Dirk or Manamune) is a danger window; don't fight him then.
- Window: After Heartsteel + Warmog's you outscale hard; at that point threaten all-ins and play confidently.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces him to chase you into your range and wastes his mobility.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; slows lock you down and his E dash sticks, so you need the escape tool.
- Item: Thornmail after Heartsteel + Warmog's; grievous wounds cripple his passive and World Ender healing in extended fights.

drmundo__ahri.notes:
- Charm stops your movement and forces you toward her; dodge it or she controls the fight entirely.
- Farm safely; her early damage is low. Stay healthy and don't chase; wait for level 6 advantage.
- She has no point-and-click CC before Charm. Bait Charm by moving predictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Post-6, she can kite and escape with Spirit Rush. Stop chasing when she ults; wait for cooldown.
- Her first item (typically Luden's or Protobelt) is not a danger window; your MR soon trivializes her damage.
- After your first MR item, she deals negligible damage. Abuse this by splitpushing side lanes or grouping aggressively.
- Shove the wave hard. Force her to farm under tower or roam; either way, you gain map pressure.
- Conditioning variant; you scale harder into mid-game and her poke becomes irrelevant with natural MR stacking.
- Mercury's Treads or Abyssal Mask first; both reduce Charm's threat and give you early MR to nullify her.

drmundo__akali.notes:
- threat: Akali's R2 execute dash and E2 mark-dash combo burst you down if you're isolated or low.
- early: Safe farm with Q poke; Doran's Shield + Second Wind blunt her early damage significantly.
- trading: Land Q, then walk away; don't chase into her W shroud or get marked by E.
- post6: Respect all-in when pushed up low; her level 6 spike is lethal—play safer and hold W.
- spike: First item (Hextech Protobelt or similar) is dangerous; she gains burst range—stay healthy and respect distance.
- window: Mid-game extended trades win if you avoid her shroud; W activation during her R2 or E2 negates burst.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; limits her all-in angle and lets you disengage into safety easily.
- rune: Conditioning variant; stacking armor and health scales better into her burst than early aggression runes.
- item: Mercury's Treads; her slow and burst chain reduce, improving your survival odds in extended fights.

drmundo__alistar.notes:
- threat: Alistar Headbutt knockback disrupts your engage; Pulverize stun chains disable you before fights start.
- early: Safely farm; respect his all-in at level 2 when both Q and W are ready.
- trading: Bait his Pulverize by positioning near minions, then Infected Bonesaw him repeatedly while he recovers.
- post6: Unbreakable Will removes crowd control and reduces damage—he becomes harder to kill; ignore and dive ADC.
- spike: First item (Abyssal Mask or Heartsteel) is not dangerous; you spike harder with HP stacking.
- window: Levels 4-5 before Alistar ult; spam Bonesaw, run at him, force cooldown burns before teamfight.
- wave: Push wave into tower; denies him roam and forces him to defend or sacrifice farm.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; he sticks you with Headbutt and slows, so you need the movespeed burst.
- item: Mercury's Treads; reduces Pulverize stun duration so you engage faster and stick to his backline.

drmundo__akshan.notes:
- Threat: Akshan's E (Heroic Swing) lets him kite and dodge your Q while out-trading you with repeated auto-attacks and Dirty Fighting procs.
- Early: Play safe levels 1–3. Stay behind minions, avoid pushing, and let Akshan push toward you so you can farm under tower safety.
- Trading: Never commit to all-ins early; Akshan kites backwards. Bait his E swing, then Q when he lands. Avoid chasing into his grapple range.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage gives you sustain to outheal poke, but Comeuppance punishes low-health fights. Don't let him stack bullets on you repeatedly.
- Spike: First Manamune or BotRK (around 1100–1400 gold) hurts. If he rushes BotRK, grab Bramble Armor early to reduce his healing and damage.
- Window: Mid-to-late game teamfights are your win condition. Akshan is a ranged duelist; grouped 5v5 forces him into bad angles or death.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Ranged tops scale worse in grouped fights; stalling lets your team scale and forces Akshan to roam or die.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. You need the movement speed and slow resist to stick to Akshan when he tries to kite away with E.
- Item: Randuin's Omen if Akshan builds crit (Infinity Edge, Phantom Dancer). Armor and active slow lock him down in teamfights.

drmundo__ambessa.notes:
- Threat: Her Q slows and pokes safely; her R suppresses and stuns, negating your tankiness and trading tools completely.
- Early: Dangerous. Respect her Q range and damage. Stay behind minions, avoid extended trades, farm safely at range with Q.
- Trading: Dodge her Q by standing near minions or moving unpredictably. Only all-in when W is up; she outkites you otherwise.
- Post6: Massive threat spike. Her R suppresses you, cancels W, and locks you down. Respect cooldown; play safer and grouper.
- Spike: First item (likely Stride Breaker or Black Cleaver) strengthens her kiting and chase. Do not force extended trades; survive and scale.
- Window: Mid-game when you stack Health and she lacks repeated R uses. Punish cooldown windows; group and leverage your tankiness advantage.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Her slows and mobility let her roam or dive if pushed; deny her angle into you safely.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. Handles her Q and E slows; lets you kite back or stick if she dives; safer than Grasp.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean. Stacks with her slows and repeated damage; boosts your survivability against her repeated engagement pattern significantly.

drmundo__annie.notes:
- threat: Summon: Tibbers stun plus burst combo kills you if caught without cooldowns available
- early: Dangerous; Annie outranges you heavily—farm safely at distance, avoid her Incinerate cone
- trading: Bait her Pyromania stun by playing around her spell count; dodge Disintegrate with movement
- post6: Matchup becomes harder—Summon: Tibbers forces you to respect her all-in range or use ult defensively
- spike: First item spike (Luden's or similar) is a danger window; stay healthy and respect burst range
- window: After she wastes Pyromania stun or ult, immediately all-in with Blunt Force Trauma and Heart Zapper
- wave: Shove lane to deny her cs safely; her short range makes her vulnerable under tower
- rune: Conditioning variant—you scale harder than her and tank her burst better as the game goes on
- item: Mercury's Treads—reduce Summon: Tibbers stun duration and her overall burst combo effectiveness significantly

drmundo__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Flash Frost stun plus Crystallize wall trap you; slows prevent escape and kiting through her.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid pushing into river where Flash Frost range catches you easily.
- Trading: Don't chase through Crystallize; bait Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Post6: Glacial Storm slows you hard during all-ins; Rebirth means she survives your burst—disengage if ulted.
- Spike: First item (Archangel's or Liandry's) isn't a danger spike; use early levels 1-5 to dominate.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before her ult; all-in when Flash Frost is down and Crystallize on cooldown.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; pushing out lets her land free Q's and trap you with wall.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; extra movespeed helps stick through slows and escape Crystallize zones faster.
- Item: Mercury's Treads for Flash Frost stun duration reduction and Glacial Storm slow resistance early.

drmundo__amumu.notes:
- Threat: Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns you and applies Curse, letting Amumu and team burst you with magic damage.
- Early: Safe farm. Amumu Q is a skillshot—space properly and you out-duel him; dodge Bandage Toss and punish his miss.
- Trading: Never trade into his Despair aura. Bait his Q, dodge it, then all-in with E and Q; he has no escape.
- Post6: Extremely dangerous. His ult stuns and Curses your whole team. Play around vision; never let him flank or catch you grouped.
- Spike: First Liandry's does chip damage but you kill him faster. Ignore him, run at backline, and force his team to help.
- Window: Levels 1–5 before his ult. Amumu has no defensive tools; abuse his immobility and all-in whenever Q misses or is down.
- Wave: Shove and roam. Amumu needs gold and levels to scale; starving him by rotating wins you the macro game.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. His Despair slows and sticks; you need movespeed to kite and roam faster than he can catch.
- Item: Unending Despair. Reduce his Despair aura damage by 15% and chill his healing; makes his teamfight pressure negligible.

drmundo__aphelios.notes:
- threat: Red gun and white gun burst you down before you can close or heal enough.
- early: Safer early. Farm at range with Q, avoid his poke. Don't chase into his range.
- trading: Trade when he's swapping guns or out of ammo. Dodge his red gun shots, bait Q.
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you reengage after his burst, but Moonlight Vigil applies red/white effects—still dangerous.
- spike: First item spike hurts. Play safer, use terrain. Your healing outscales his poke mid-game though.
- window: Mid-game onward you run him down. Late game ignore guns, force teamfights he can't kite from.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. You need him close to threaten; pushing lets him kite freely.
- rune: Conditioning variant. You need the extra resistances early to survive his poke and scale harder.
- item: Abyssal Mask first. Reduces his burst damage and makes your healing more efficient against his sustained poke.

drmundo__ashe.notes:
- Threat: Enchanted Crystal Arrow stun from fog of war; kite you endlessly with Frost Shot slows.
- Early: Safely farm; avoid pushing lane. Ashe outranges you heavily—stay behind minions, dodge Volley cones.
- Trading: Never trade into her. Wait for her to miss Volley, then all-in with Q+E+W.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage heal lets you tank Crystal Arrow stun, but respect fog of war positioning always.
- Spike: First Manamune spike hurts—she gains range and poke. Farm safely; don't fight extended trades yet.
- Window: Level 9+ with Heartsteel + Spirit Visage online; tank her damage, close gap, force all-in.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Forces her into gank range; prevents her from roaming free.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Stacking armor and magic resist scales your tankiness into her sustained poke damage.
- Item: Randuin's Omen. Reduces her critical damage threat and slows her attack speed in teamfights.

drmundo__aurora.notes:
- Threat: Aurora's E slows and pushes you away; her W invisibility lets her reposition and dodge your Q skillshot.
- Early: Safe farm. Aurora's poke is weak under tower; let her push and farm safely without trading into her burst.
- Trading: Dodge her E by moving sideways before she casts; bait her W to burn it, then all-in with Q and Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage healing plus her Between Worlds mobility makes her slipperier; she can kite you more effectively after ulting.
- Spike: First item (likely Spirit Visage or similar) is not a danger window; you still outtrade her in extended fights post-6.
- Window: After landing Q cleaver and she's not near full health, run her down immediately; she has no escape if Between Worlds is down.
- Wave: Shove the wave into tower to deny her safe poke range and force her to choose between farming or harassing under tower pressure.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge because the move speed helps you stick to her through her slows and catch her when Between Worlds is on cooldown.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early to reduce her spell damage and increase your tankiness against her E and Q poke during lane.

drmundo__belveth.notes:
- She roots you in place with Royal Maelstrom and drains your health as a sustained damage sponge
- Play safe; she out-damages you early. Farm at range with Q, avoid isolated trades near her
- Never trade in her E channel range; bait her dash with Q, then all-in when she commits
- Her ult transforms her into a raid boss with lifesteal; you cannot 1v1 her post-six alone
- Her first item spike (likely Kraken or Rageblade) is a danger window; avoid extended fights then
- You spike when you land Blunt Force Trauma on low-health Bel'Veth; she's immobile during E channel
- Shove the wave hard; denies her isolated 1v1 opportunities and forces grouped teamfighting where you shine
- Stormraider's Surge counters her slows and roots, letting you kite away from her E channel
- Thornmail denies her lifesteal and punishes her basic attacks; essential to neutralize her sustain threat

drmundo__bard.notes:
- Threat: Tempered Fate ult stasis stops your engage and ult healing; his roam leaves you weaksided against bullies.
- Early: Safe to farm; Bard has no kill pressure on you pre-6. Play for CS and poke with Q.
- Trading: His Q is a skillshot—dodge it or let him waste it. Trade back with Q when he misses or commits.
- Post6: Your passive eats Tempered Fate stasis; use ult to cleanse it and continue fighting. Win extended trades hard.
- Spike: First item is not a threat window. He builds tank; you outscale him and can ignore him.
- Window: Post-6 onward; your ult cleanses his only hard CC. Roaming Bard is your real threat, not the 1v1.
- Wave: Shove it in hard; this forces Bard to defend or lose tower pressure, limiting his roam impact.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—you scale into a unkillable tank; armor and magic resist growth abuse his low damage.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early if Bard has magic damage supports nearby; otherwise skip and rush Heartsteel into tank core.

drmundo__blitzcrank.notes:
- Rocket Grab hooks you into Blitzcrank's team; you die before cooldowns matter.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; don't give Blitzcrank a hook angle.
- Never trade back after dodging his hook; wait for his grab cooldown.
- Maximum Dosage lets you survive hooks and escape; use it proactively before fights.
- First item spike (Blitzcrank's first completed item) is dangerous; stay near tower.
- Dr. Mundo spikes when Maximum Dosage is off cooldown and you have Heartsteel.
- Let the wave push toward you so you're closer to tower and hook safety.
- Stormraider's Surge helps you stick with Blitzcrank after eating hooks for your team.
- Build Jak'Sho, The Protean early to reduce his grab damage and Static Field.

drmundo__brand.notes:
- Threat: Blaze stacking burns you down; Pyroclasm bounces chain stun you if you get close.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Brand out-ranges you hard. Stay back, avoid clumping for E spread.
- Trading: Never trade into stacked Blaze. Bait Q and E as skillshots, then all-in when he's on cooldown.
- Post6: Pyroclasm chains stuns and Blaze stacks fast. Maximum Dosage heal keeps you alive through burst; use it reactively.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's) hurts around 1100g. Not a danger window; you scale harder into tankiness.
- Window: Post-first-item you outduel him. Reach him with Q slow and E slam; he has no escape.
- Wave: Shove hard and roam side lanes. Brand lacks waveclear; punish his immobility while he manages wave.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge counters his slow from Rylai's and lets you stick once you close the gap.
- Item: Force of Nature reduces his magic damage and Blaze tick impact; add after core resistances lock in.

drmundo__braum.notes:
- Threat: Concussive Blows stun locks you; Unbreakable blocks your Q and negates poke attempts entirely.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay back, farm safely with Q from range, avoid short trades with Braum.
- Trading: Never trade into his shield. Bait Unbreakable by walking up, then all-in when it ends.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive his Glacial Fissure knockup and healing through his burst damage.
- Spike: First item Braum spike is dangerous; he gets tankier and your poke stops working harder.
- Window: Mid-game when your tankiness outscales his armor. Punish when Unbreakable is on cooldown for teamfights.
- Wave: Shove hard to crash into tower; forces Braum to tank minions or abandon his ADC support.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge for stick matchups; guarantees you run down his ADC through his heavy slows.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean for his mixed damage and repeated Concussive Blow stack applications.

drmundo__caitlyn.notes:
- threat: Her Headshot auto-attacks shred you even full tank; you lack lockdown to stop her damage.
- early: Dangerous; dodge Q Piltover Peacemaker and avoid her traps—stay outside Yordle Snap Trap range entirely.
- trading: Never trade autos into her Headshot resets; bait W Heart Zapper into her combo instead.
- post6: Ace in the Hole locks you down from range; can't dodge it, must use P or play around it.
- spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer or Infinity Edge) massively spikes her damage; you cannot trade with her then.
- window: Post-level 11 with tankiness items; she falls off relative to your scaling if you survive early.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; she zones you with range, so minimize her Headshot opportunities and gank setup.
- rune: Fleet Footwork; sustain and kite tools help you survive her poke and auto-attack damage pattern.
- item: Mercury's Treads or Plated Steelcaps early to reduce her auto and ability damage output significantly.

drmundo__cassiopeia.notes:
- threat: Miasma grounds you, stopping P and R move speed; Petrifying Gaze stuns if you face her.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; she has no kill threat yet. Farm Q max range, avoid her poison clouds.
- trading: Don't chase missed Noxious Blast; low cooldown means she'll reposition. Bait Miasma placement, then trade outside it.
- post6: Petrifying Gaze is dangerous if you're facing her directly. Play around vision; approach from flanks or angles.
- spike: First item (~10 min) isn't a major spike for her. You can still trade; watch for rotation threats.
- window: You outscale significantly after three items and in prolonged fights. Split push when she's grouped mid.
- wave: Shove hard into her tower; she can't match your split and cleanup pressure forces bad rotations.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge counters her slows and grounds, letting you stick and disengage her kite attempts.
- item: Unending Despair reduces her damage output and provides health scaling to multiply your defensive purchases.

drmundo__camille.notes:
- threat: Her E knockup into R lockdown prevents you from reaching backline; she locks you down while team kills you.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; her Q and autos outdamage your trades. Play for CS, avoid her all-in attempts.
- trading: Never trade into her repeated Q damage. Bait her E onto a wall far from teammates, then all-in.
- post6: Catastrophic for you. Her R traps you in place; you cannot escape or reach enemies. Play safer, shorter fights.
- spike: First item (likely Trinity Force or Kaenic Rookern) is a danger window. You still outscale but respect her burst.
- window: Late game (three items+) after R cooldown expires. Split hard, duel her 1v1 if she matches, or use teamfight to bypass her.
- wave: Shove every wave hard. Force her to defend or roam; if she roams, take plates and ping teammates constantly.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge (counter her E lockdown and slow trades; run past her R later with extra move speed).
- item: Randuin's Omen (blocks her Q bonus damage and move speed, reduces her burst during R lockdown windows).

drmundo__corki.notes:
- Threat: Missile Barrage true damage output and Gatling Gun armor shred overwhelm your resistances.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; farm safely with Q Infected Bonesaw, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Dodge Phosphorus Bomb skillshot; bait his W Valkyrie before committing E Blunt Force Trauma all-in.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage sustain keeps you relevant; his Missile Barrage becomes harder to duel into.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune/Trinity) is dangerous; respect his damage until you hit Heartsteel.
- Window: Past 6 with Heartsteel, land Q Infected Bonesaw and run him down relentlessly.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; his all-in leaves him gankable when overextended.
- Rune: Conditioning variant maximizes your scaling and defensive stats into his poke-heavy harassment.
- Item: Abyssal Mask first to reduce his magic damage and maximize your sustain pressure.

drmundo__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Feast true damage and silence from Feral Scream shut down your tankiness and healing potential.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Cho'Gath out-trades you early. Farm safely, avoid extended fights, respect his all-in.
- Dodge his Rupture skillshot; bait it before trading. Never fight into his Feral Scream cone silence.
- Post-6, Cho'Gath cheeses you with Feast true damage. Play safer, respect his kill pressure, avoid low health.
- His first item spike (likely Rylai's or Liandry's) is moderately threatening but not your main danger window.
- Your power edge is levels 11+ when Q max deals massive percent health damage and you scale harder.
- Perma shove the wave into his tower if you're ahead; deny him CS and Q-poke constantly from range.
- Use Stormraider's Surge to kite his engage and stick through his slows while maintaining escape pressure.
- Add Abyssal Mask early to reduce his magic damage burst and maximize your sustain into his poke.

drmundo__darius.notes:
- Threat: Darius' Hemorrhage stacks + Noxian Guillotine true damage executes you if passive is down.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are dangerous; farm Q from range, avoid letting him stack passive on you.
- Trading: Bait his Q by moving inside his axe range, then trade back hard with W + auto + E.
- Post6: Noxian Guillotine is a kill threat at 5 stacks; respect it and play around passive cooldown strictly.
- Spike: First item (likely Phage into Cleaver) is his major spike; you must have passive up or back off.
- Window: Post-first-item when your passive cooldown drops and his E cooldown matters; punish him if E is down.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower so you kite toward safety; shove only when his E is on cooldown.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge for guaranteed kite and escape when he commits; stick matchup demands the speed tool.
- Item: Add Bramble Vest early to reduce his Q healing and punish his all-in attempts with reflect damage.

drmundo__diana.notes:
- Threat: Diana's Lunar Rush dash with Moonlight applies resets; she kills you if you're isolated or low.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Diana outranges you. Stay near minions, dodge Crescent Strike, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait her Crescent Strike with positioning, then trade back with Q and E. Never all-in early.
- Post6: Moonfall locks you down before Lunar Rush; kite backward and spam Q. Ult when she commits.
- Spike: First item spike is minor danger. You scale harder into mid-game; farming safely buys time.
- Window: You outpace her at two items and full build. Extended teamfights favor your tankiness and sustain.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Forces Diana to dive or waste time; lets you scale safely.
- Rune: Conditioning variant; stacking armor and MR lets you survive her burst and scale into lane dominance.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early if she's AP; reduces her magic damage and strengthens your own tankiness significantly.

drmundo__draven.notes:
- Draven's raw damage output and axe catch mechanics enable him to kite and burst Dr. Mundo down.
- Play safe early; farm at range with Q. Avoid all-ins before level 3 when he outtrrades you.
- Let Stand Aside come out, then run him down. Bait his axe catches by positioning unpredictably.
- Maximum Dosage lets you tank his damage and chase him down; this is your turning point hard.
- His first item spike (usually Infinity Edge components) is dangerous; play safer until you complete Heartsteel.
- Post-6 with Heartsteel and armor items, you out-scale him massively; run him down relentlessly in side lanes.
- Shove the wave hard to deny his kiting space and force him into your range near tower.
- Conditioning variant to stack armor and health scaling, enabling you to absorb his combo and run him down.
- Randuin's Omen early to cripple his attack speed and critical strike damage output significantly.

drmundo__elise.notes:
- threat: Early tower dives with Cocoon stun; Rappel escape makes counterplay hard without jungler help.
- early: Dangerous. Stay near tower, avoid getting stunned near it. Farm safe; ask jungler to hover.
- trading: Never trade near your tower. Bait Cocoon by positioning unpredictably, then all-in her post-dodge with Q.
- post6: Rappel gives her free tower dive reset. Shove wave harder; force her to choose: farm or dive.
- spike: First Liandry's or Zhonyas (her first item window) heightens dive threat. Punish by shoving and stalling.
- window: Post-6, you scale harder. Win fights after level 11 when your R heals eclipse her burst damage.
- wave: Shove at all costs. Denies her dive window and forces her to choose between farming and roaming.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Extra armor and magic resist scale with your Health and neuter her early poke and burst.
- item: Jak'Sho, The Protean. Armor and magic resist scale with teamfights; reduces her burst and sustains your tankiness.

drmundo__evelynn.notes:
- Evelynn's burst combo with W charm into R decimation one-shots you if caught immobilized or mid-W.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid pushing wave early since Evelynn's pre-6 gank threat is real.
- Never W offensively into her; she'll charm you during duration and R burst kills you outright.
- Post-6 Evelynn gains untargetable R escape; dodge her charm by staying unpredictable; don't chase solo.
- Her first item spike (Lich Bane or Hextech Protobelt) is a danger window; play safer, group mid.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder at Heartsteel plus resistances; then you outduel and sustain through her burst.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it push naturally so Evelynn must overextend for ganks or roams.
- Standard rune page works best; Mundo's sustain-scaling benefits outweigh specialty runes into this burst matchup.
- Add Abyssal Mask early if Evelynn rushes AP damage; the magic resist and healing combo save you.

drmundo__ezreal.notes:
- Threat: Mystic Shot spam chunks you from range; you can't retaliate without closing gap.
- Early: Dangerous—dodge Q when possible, but farm safely; Ezreal outranges you heavily early.
- Trading: Don't chase Ezreal through minions; bait Arcane Shift before committing to all-in.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you sustain his poke, but Trueshot Barrage is another nuke threat.
- Spike: First Manamune spike hurts; play safer, stack tankiness, dodge Q more carefully then.
- Window: Once you land Infected Bonesaw slow, run him down; he's immobile and squishy.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; let him push in, then engage when he's overextended.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—extra resistances let you absorb Mystic Shot spam and scale tankier.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask early to reduce his ability damage and amplify your healing.

drmundo__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals and on-hit procs burst you down faster than you can out-trade her early.
- Play safe levels 1–3; farm at range with Q, avoid walking into her attack range unpunished.
- Bait her Q by stepping in and out of range, then trade Q + auto + E and walk away.
- Post-6, hug walls during her Grand Challenge ult to deny Vital hits and kite her safely.
- Fiora's first item (likely Sheen or Sunderer) is her spike; respect it, don't force extended fights.
- You outscale her heavily in teamfights once you complete Bramble Vest + resistances; avoid solo duels.
- Hold the wave near your tower; she wins skirmishes in open space, so deny roam and safety.
