- First Strike if farming safely; Grasp if you want aggressive short trades; Stormraider's if you split-push hard.
- Rush Bramble Vest into Cloth Armor; without grievous wounds, her healing and Vitals healing will overwhelm you.

drmundo__fizz.notes:
- threat: Chum the Waters shark knock-up locks you down; Playful / Trickster makes him untargetable when you trade back.
- early: Safe farm—Fizz outranges your Q and E. Stay back, let wave push to you, avoid Urchin Strike poke.
- trading: Never chase Fizz into fog or river. Bait Playful / Trickster before committing Q or E; dodge nothing.
- post6: Chum the Waters forces you to respect massive range. Play around minions and terrain to block shark pathing.
- spike: First Sheen item (Iceborn Gauntlet) makes him sticky; survive it passively, itemize armor and health, outscale him hard.
- window: Post-Heartsteel + Jak'Sho spike (mid-game) you're unkillable. Fizz can't burst or stick to you anymore; dominate.
- wave: Hold wave near tower—Fizz wants to roam and gank. Deny him roam pressure; scale safely and farm.
- rune: Conditioning variant—extra armor and magic resist stacking makes you survive his burst and outsustain his poke significantly.
- item: Iceborn Gauntlet first—armor, CDR, and sheen proc let you trade safely and kite his Urchin Strike all-ins.

drmundo__gangplank.notes:
- Threat: Cannon Barrage slow and poke damage forces you to engage or lose map pressure safely.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; eat Parrrley poke, dodge Powder Keg explosions, don't fight near barrels.
- Trading: Bait his barrel placement with E, break it with auto-E before detonation, then all-in.
- Post6: Cannon Barrage limits your engage windows; use R to heal through slow and close gap fast.
- Spike: First item spike minimal threat; you outscale him hard with health stacking and regen scaling.
- Window: Mid-game onward after first major item; you tank him and kill him in sidelanes easily.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces him to engage you or lose CS, plays into tankiness.
- Rune: Grasp if confident in early trades; Stormraider's Surge plus Resolve if you need safety and mobility.
- Item: Unending Despair reduces his kite potential and amplifies your tankiness into late-game domination window.

drmundo__garen.notes:
- Demacian Justice executes you at low health; respect its range and timing always.
- Level 1-3: Start W into his Q auto to win trades; shove wave level 2 onward relentlessly.
- Trading: Use Q poke under tower; dodge his Decisive Strike silence by backing off before he engages.
- Post6: Ult around 1/3 HP instead of 1/8 to survive Demacian Justice; never wait until execution range.
- Spike: His first item (Plated Steelcaps or Kaenic Rookern) reduces your poke; abuse him before it completes.
- Window: Levels 2-5 before his ult; shove and poke relentlessly to force his base or kill him.
- Wave: Shove hard every wave to deny him farm and force tower pressure; deny his scaling.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for early trading dominance and health scaling into late game.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean reduces his physical burst and Demacian Justice damage significantly.

drmundo__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you, forcing close-range fights where his burst and CC dominate you.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Galio outranges and outdamages early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait his W by backing off; when he charges, reposition sideways. Never face-check bushes; he'll E knockup.
- Post-6, Galio's ult gives his team shields and knockup engage. Respect the range; play safer when allies are grouped.
- First item (Hollow Radiance or Abyssal Mask) is not a major spike. This is your window to scale safely.
- After Heartsteel + two items, you outscale Galio hard. Abuse side lane pressure and force him to match you.
- Hold wave near your tower. Galio roams strong; pushing out invites his ult engages on your team.
- Use Conditioning to stack tankiness and reduce his burst damage relevance over time as you scale harder.
- Add Hollow Radiance if Galio went full AP; otherwise skip it. Force of Nature is better for mixed/AD comps.

drmundo__gragas.notes:
- E Body Slam stuns and bursts you; his R Explosive Cask knocks you away from fights.
- Play safe and farm. Dodge his Q Barrel Roll; respect his E all-in range.
- Bait his E Body Slam by repositioning, then all-in if his passive is down.
- Respect his R Explosive Cask near tower; it can chain-stun you under turret with setup.
- First item spike around Liandry's or Demonic is dangerous; abuse pre-first-item windows hard.
- Post-6 when his E is down and you land Q; all-in before he repositions.
- Hold wave near your tower. His E threatens you in open space; safer farming closer to base.
- Stormraider's Surge lets you kite his Body Slam and dodge follow-ups with move speed.
- Mercury's Treads or Abyssal Mask reduce his burst and E stun lockdown potential significantly.

drmundo__gnar.notes:
- Mini Gnar's Hyper lets him kite and burst you down; dodge Boomerang Throw to reset his damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar outranges you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his Boomerang Throw by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Infected Bonesaw and Blunt Force Trauma.
- Post-6, all-in immediately if you land Infected Bonesaw and Gnar has no rage; dodge Boomerang Throw carefully.
- Gnar's first item spike is minimal danger; you outscale him. Punish him when he's extending for CS.
- Your power window is mid-game when you're tanky enough to ignore his kiting; chase him relentlessly.
- Hold wave near your tower to bait him forward, then all-in with jungler when he commits to dive.
- Use Stormraider's Surge to stick to mini Gnar and prevent him from kiting away after you commit.
- Buy Randuin's Omen early to reduce his crit and burst damage from Hyper-enhanced attacks and combos.

drmundo__graves.notes:
- threat: Graves' End of the Line explosive shell deals heavy burst damage; dodge it or tank with armor.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Graves' bullets cannot pass through units, blocking his poke. Farm safely.
- trading: Bait End of the Line by moving unpredictably, then trade with Infected Bonesaw. Avoid extended fights early.
- post6: Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive his Collateral Damage burst better. Extended fights favor you now.
- spike: First item (likely Serpent's Fang or armor pen) is a danger window. Play safer, focus farming.
- window: Mid-game when you stack health items; you out-stat-check him unless he's significantly ahead in gold.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Graves' short range struggles to dive safely; let him overextend for kills.
- rune: Conditioning variant. You need extra tankiness early to survive poke and scale into your late-game stat advantage.
- item: Thornmail. Reflects his auto-attack damage back at him and applies grievous wounds to reduce any healing he attempts.

drmundo__heimerdinger.notes:
- Threat: His turrets deal relentless damage; you cannot duel him near them without dying.
- Early: Farm safely under tower. Use Q to destroy turrets from range before all-ins happen.
- Trading: Never chase him into turret nests. Bait his E stun then all-in with E.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage sustain counters his poke, but avoid grouped turrets or you still die fast.
- Spike: First item is danger; respect turret damage and farm from distance until you scale.
- Window: After level 9 with E max and two items, you outduel him one-on-one safely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Turrets punish overextension; cleaver them from distance, then freeze.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge counters his slows and heavy turret stacking near your tower engages.
- Item: Abyssal Mask first after boots reduces turret burn and his poke damage significantly.

drmundo__hecarim.notes:
- Devastating Charge + Onslaught of Shadows gap close and burst you down before you heal.
- Play safe; Hecarim Q spam outdamages your early sustain, so farm at range with Infected Bonesaw.
- Never chase Hecarim or get caught in Spirit Dread range; kite backward and land Q slowdowns.
- Onslaught terrifies you, making positioning critical; stay spread so he can't land multi-man ult charges.
- His first item spike (likely Kaenic Rookern) reduces your Q damage; this window favors him slightly.
- You spike harder at Heartsteel or Warmog's; force teamfights where his single-target Q can't carry.
- Shove wave hard into his tower; if he matches, teamfight erupts near your tower where you win.
- Conditioning variant because you need raw tankiness to survive his E-R burst and heal through W spam.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early to reduce his W and ult healing efficiency against your tankiness.

drmundo__hwei.notes:
- threat: Spiraling Despair slows and damages; his CC chains lock you down before you escape
- early: Safe farm—Hwei lacks early damage; CS freely but avoid grouping near lava pit center
- trading: Dodge Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw; run him down when abilities on cooldown
- post6: Spiraling Despair expands fast; stay mobile and pick up canisters to reset P and kite away
- spike: First item is danger window; his damage spikes hard—play safer, stack resistances early
- window: Post-Warmog's and when Hwei wastes CC; you outheal and run him down easily then
- wave: Shove into tower consistently; he struggles to wave clear and you roam with ult strength
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—stick through his slows and chase after he blows cooldowns defensively
- item: Abyssal Mask early second to stack MR, reduce his poke, and amplify your healing back

drmundo__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's A Thousand Cuts passive deals % max-HP magic damage and heals her off it—she punishes your tanking.
- Farm safely at range with Q; dodge her predictive E dashes by moving unpredictably; avoid all-ins level 1–3.
- Land Q on her predictive E movements; bait W by threatening all-in, then kite out; dodge nothing else (point-click).
- R reduces her burst window slightly, but she still out-duels you; use it to reset and disengage, not commit.
- Her first Kraken/Riftmaker spike (≈10 min) is dangerous; your Warmog's (Stormraider's page) spike (≈13 min) flips the matchup hard.
- Post-Warmog's, all-in her in sidelane, Stormraider's away, heal to full, repeat; she cannot stick or out-duel you then.
- Shove wave into her tower to deny her freeze and force her to farm under tower; limits her roam threat.
- Stormraider's Surge page: poke with Q + Scorch early, kite with speed proc, and unlock Warmog's spike to dominate mid-game.
- Thornmail into her healing if you go Grasp (MR stack build); Spirit Visage if Stormraider's to reduce % damage taken early.

drmundo__janna.notes:
- threat: Howling Gale and Monsoon CC lock you down; pick up canister immediately to break immobilize.
- early: Safe farm—Janna has no kill pressure early; focus cs and avoid Howling Gale skillshot poke.
- trading: Bait her Zephyr slow before engaging; dodge Howling Gale by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Q.
- post6: Monsoon throws you back and heals her team; use Maximum Dosage after her ult knockback resolves.
- spike: Janna's first item doesn't threaten you; continue scaling and farming safely until you spike.
- window: Post-first-item, you outduel her in extended trades; chase her down when she overextends for shield.
- wave: Shove hard—her cc has low cooldown, so minion advantage and pressure prevents her from rotating.
- rune: Conditioning variant; you scale harder than her and durability stacking turns her poke into nothing.
- item: Unending Despair for additional slow resistance, making her Zephyr less effective at kiting you.

drmundo__jarvaniv.notes:
- Threat: Cataclysm traps you in terrain arena; his team collapses while you're caged and immobilized.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Jarvan Q max hurts but stays ranged; abuse short trades with E.
- Trading: Dodge his Q skillshot when he commits to Dragon Strike; bait it before all-inning.
- Post6: Cataclysm is lethal if his team follows. Play around minimap; back off when team collapses.
- Spike: First item isn't a danger window. You outscale him; respect ult timing, farm safely.
- Window: Mid-game onward when you're tankier and he can't one-shot you; abuse his ult cooldown.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Forces Jarvan to commit Q aggressively or chase you under turret.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Stacking armor and MR scales better than raw damage into his physical threat.
- Item: Randuin's Omen if Jarvan gets ahead early; armor reduces his Martial Cadence and Q burst.

drmundo__jayce.notes:
- Threat: Conqueror Jayce all-in with Q-E combo knockback chains you into his team.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; respect his poke range, use minions as cover, don't chase.
- Trading: Dodge his Shock Blast skillshots; eat Thundering Blow knockback since you heal it back easily.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive his burst and run him down; he can't kite forever.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Manamune) is minor threat; you scale harder into mid-game tankiness.
- Window: Level 11+ with cleaver landed; his gank vulnerability and your healing make you dominant.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; he's gank-vulnerable there and you starve his roam pressure safely.
- Rune: Conditioning variant; scaling resistances matter more than early tempo against his poke-heavy lane.
- Item: Randuin's Omen; reduces his crit damage and slows his kite potential in fights.

drmundo__jhin.notes:
- Threat: Deadly Flourish's long-range piercing shot catches you immobile; his execute damage punishes low health.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions to dodge Deadly Flourish; respect his range and poke damage.
- Trading: Avoid walking into Deadly Flourish's line. Bait his shots by positioning unpredictably; dodge with movement.
- Post6: Curtain Call pins you down if caught; stay mobile and use terrain to block shots.
- Spike: First item spike (around 1100 gold) is dangerous; dodge more carefully and respect execute damage.
- Window: Post-six when you've built enough health; Maximum Dosage healing outpaces his damage, then run him down.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Jhin needs distance to deal damage; force him to overextend farming.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. Stick to him once engaged and close the gap before his shots connect.
- Item: Randuin's Omen. Crit damage reduction halves his fourth-shot execute threat and slows his attack speed.

drmundo__ksante.notes:
- threat: K'Sante's R all-out combo with reduced defenses kills you if you're low; dodge or run.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; K'Sante outduels you early, so avoid extended trades before level 6.
- trading: Dodge his Q3 shockwave pull at all costs; let him push, then trade when it's down.
- post6: Your R flips the matchup hard—instant heal and regen let you outheal his burst damage.
- spike: His first item spike is dangerous; play safer until you complete Heartsteel or Jak'Sho first.
- window: When his R is down, run him down and trade aggressively; he cannot duel you.
- wave: Hold wave near tower so his all-out combo whiffs on minions; deny him engage angles.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge in high elo to survive his R combo and kite away safely after.
- item: Rush Mercury's Treads or Abyssal Mask early if K'Sante lands consistent Q poke before teamfights.

drmundo__karma.notes:
- threat: Karma's poke with Inner Flame and Focused Resolve tether roots you, preventing escape and enabling repeated damage.
- early: Dangerous; respect Inner Flame range and avoid walking into Focused Resolve tether range—farm safely at distance.
- trading: Never trade into her; her poke outranges your engage tools and she kites backward infinitely.
- post6: Matchup barely shifts; Maximum Dosage doesn't help you catch or kill an enemy who just roots and backs away.
- spike: Karma's first item spike is minor—she gains mana and cooldown but doesn't suddenly threaten you more.
- window: You outscale hard after two items; leverage side lane pressure when she's grouped and can't duel you one-versus-one.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; freezing denies her poke range and forces her to overextend or roam.
- rune: Fleet Footwork—sustain her poke damage and reposition safely without committing to trades you cannot win.
- item: Abyssal Mask first or second—reduces her spell damage and punishes her for poking into your tank stats.

drmundo__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks and burst from her Living Weapon upgrades shred your Health before you can close gaps.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; her E max lets her kite you easily. Wait for jungle help or her mistakes.
- Dodge her W Void Seeker skillshot when possible; her Q is unavoidable. Don't chase her through kited positions.
- Post-6, Killer Instinct makes her untargetable and repositions her away from your engage. She becomes much harder to pin down.
- First item spike (Muramana or Manamune) gives her raw damage and poke. This is a punish window; play safer farming.
- Your window is mid-game when you finish Heartsteel or Jak'Sho and have high Health; run her down with allies present only.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her safe poke range and force her to choose between farming and repositioning.
- Stormraider's Surge: her E kite and ult repositioning are heavy stick problems; stick tool lets you close and trade back.
- Add Unending Despair early to reduce her kite window and lock her down when you do close the gap.

drmundo__karthus.notes:
- Lay Waste spam in teamfights; dodge Qs or die despite tankiness from poke damage
- Safe farm early; Karthus weak levels 1-3, avoid walking into predictable Lay Waste zones
- Dodge his Lay Waste with movement; bait it out before committing to all-ins
- Tank Requiem easily; your ult healing and resistances trivialize his ultimate damage output
- First item spike minimal threat; Karthus needs time to stack Mana and items
- Post-items when Dr. Mundo has healing stacked; Karthus can't outdamage your regeneration then
- Shove wave hard; force Karthus to farm under tower, limiting his Lay Waste angles
- Conditioning variant maximizes late tankiness; stacking resistances negates Karthus's sustained magic damage threat
- Spirit Visage adds healing amp for your R; accelerates outscaling Karthus's poke in extended fights

drmundo__kalista.notes:
- Threat: Kalista's Rend stacks and Execute damage shred your health; kite away from Eand avoid getting speared repeatedly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kalista out-ranges you. Farm at distance, dodge Pierce, wait for her to waste cooldowns.
- Trading: Do not chase her; she kites with Martial Poise. Let her use Rend, then all-in with Q and E.
- Post6: Fate's Call gives her escape and ally disengage. Play around Oathsworn position; do not overcommit when ally is near.
- Spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer or Manamune) is dangerous. Respect her damage spike; farm safely and scale instead.
- Window: Post-6 when you land Maximum Dosage heal and run her down. Mid-game teamfights favor you if she's isolated.
- Wave: Shove hard when safe. Force her to farm under tower; this denies Oathsworn synergy and limits her kiting space.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge counters her kite and slow tools; stick to her after landing abilities and run her down.
- Item: Buy Randuin's Omen to lower her attack speed and crit damage, reducing Rend execute threat significantly.

drmundo__katarina.notes:
- Death Lotus wipes your team if you can't kill her before channeling; you lack CC to stop it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid her all-in when Dagger lands near you.
- Dodge her Bouncing Blade with positioning; don't chase her into unwarded areas where she Shunpos away free.
- Post-6 she becomes a teamfight threat; Death Lotus kills your backline, so focus killing her before fights.
- Her first item spike (Nashor's Tooth or Void Staff) is your punish window—kill her before she scales.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where you out-tank her damage; sidelane is unwinnable for her.
- Shove the wave hard; she can't duel you in sidelane and must roam to impact game.
- Conditioning—you need raw tankiness to survive her burst and buy time for your team to focus her.
- Add Abyssal Mask early if she's fed; reduces her magic damage and gives you sustain against poke.

drmundo__kassadin.notes:
- Threat: Riftwalk mobility lets him kite and escape; Null Sphere interrupts your engage attempts and shields his magic damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kassadin is weak pre-6, so Q poke and farm freely without forcing all-ins.
- Trading: Avoid chasing after he Riftwalk away; bait his Q Null Sphere before committing to E Blunt Force Trauma trades.
- Post6: Riftwalk gives him infinite escape; he will never 1v1 you, so stop trying to catch and kill him.
- Spike: First item (Archangel's Staff/Seraph's Embrace) spike is a punish window; he's still squishy and immobile before stacking mana items.
- Window: Level 3-5 before his Riftwalk comes online; abuse this window to deal damage and deny his farm safely.
- Wave: Shove the wave and take tower pressure; he must hard respect your side-lane threat and cannot answer your split effectively.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; you need raw stick potential to threaten him before he escapes via Riftwalk kiting.
- Item: Force of Nature; magic damage reduction and movement speed help you stick and survive his burst-chain combo.

drmundo__kayle.notes:
- Kayle's Starfire Spellblade missing-health damage and Divine Judgment invulnerability wall your win conditions.
- Level 1 she outdamages you; farm safely at range with Q, avoid all-ins near her.
- Let her Radiant Blast miss by moving unpredictably; never chase her into her team.
- Divine Judgment makes you useless in fights; wait for her ult to end before committing.
- First item spike (likely Nashors or Lich) strengthens her dueling; play around her cooldowns.
- Level 16 with rank 3 R grants superior sustain and healing; duel her then decisively.
- Hold wave near tower; her range advantage punishes shoves, and you scale better late.
- Conditioning—lets you survive her early poke and scales into your late-game tank role.
- Mercury's Treads reduce her Radiant Blast slow and Divine Judgment counterplay windows significantly.

drmundo__kennen.notes:
- Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom ultimate stuns and melts you; avoid clustered teamfights early.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; his poke outdamages you pre-6, so respect range and position.
- Let his Thundering Shuriken and Electrical Surge whiff; dodge skillshots, tank unavoidable poke with E max.
- Post-6 his ult threatens you heavily; space carefully and use Maximum Dosage to survive burst.
- First item spike (Liandry's/Shadowflame) hurts; it's a punish window, so avoid extended trades then.
- Level 11+ you outscale; use late-game tankiness to run him down with Q spam.
- Hold wave near tower; don't extend into his Electrical Surge range and allow jungle ganks.
- Grasp if confident in extended trades and scaling; Stormraider's if you need escape and safety.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his damage and helps you survive his magic damage before teamfights.

drmundo__kayn.notes:
- Threat: Kayn's Umbral Trespass burst damage and guaranteed follow-up damage when he exits your body.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayn has no real threat yet, just CS and avoid unnecessary poke.
- Trading: Bait his Reaping Slash with positioning, then Q him while he's on cooldown; dodge nothing.
- Post6: Blue Kayn assassination threat is manageable with your tankiness; Red Kayn's sustained damage and healing hurt more.
- Spike: First item spike is minor threat; your early tankiness already handles his damage, farm safely and scale.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you; your R healing and tankiness outlast his burst, especially if Blue Kayn wastes ult.
- Wave: Shove the wave into his tower to limit his roam and force him to stay and defend.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge counters his mobility and slow follow-ups, letting you kite away after dodging his engage.
- Item: Add Jak'Sho, The Protean to tank his mixed damage and reduce his burst effectiveness against you.

drmundo__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolation burst on Q deals massive damage; avoid being alone away from minions and teammates.
- Play safe levels 1–3; stay near minions and farm defensively, don't extend into river without vision.
- Let Kha'Zix Q you near the wave so minions block isolation damage; trade with Q when grouped.
- Post-6, Kha'Zix gains Void Assault invisibility and evolves—expect all-ins; play grouped and use R preemptively.
- First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk or Manamune) is dangerous; stay near allies and farm safely.
- Post-first-item, you outscale hard; group with team and run him down with tankiness and sustained damage.
- Shove the wave into his tower so he can't isolate you; safety in numbers and minion density.
- Take Conditioning variant to scale faster into him and reduce his early cheese all-in threat window.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if he ganks repeatedly; otherwise build Abyssal Mask or Hollow Radiance if AP-heavy.

drmundo__kled.notes:
- Kled's all-in damage with mounted Q hook into W attack speed burst kills you if you're caught.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; respect his damage and farm at range with Q, never trade melee.
- Max Q; use it to keep him dismounted and farming rather than baiting all-ins you lose.
- Post-6 Chaaaaaaaarge!!! gives him a gap-closing engage tool; respect it and play even safer near lane edges.
- First item (likely Executioner's or bruiser item) is not a danger window; farm harder while he remounts.
- Your power edge comes at 2+ items when scaling and tankiness let you absorb his burst safely.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it bounce to you so you farm safely and he overextends.
- Fleet Footwork gives sustain and kiting tools to handle his sticky mounted engage patterns better.
- Add Randuin's Omen early to reduce his crit and attack speed burst damage significantly.

drmundo__leblanc.notes:
- threat: Ethereal Chains root locks you down; Sigil detonation burst punishes extended fights.
- early: Safe farm. Stay out of chain range; dodge E by positioning behind minions.
- trading: Never engage her directly. She wins all-ins. Farm and scale; ignore her.
- post6: Mimic doubles her burst and lockdown potential. Still don't engage; focus macro plays.
- spike: First item doesn't spike her threat meaningfully. Continue ignoring and farming safely.
- window: Mid-game teamfights when you're tanky. She can't stop your engage on others.
- wave: Shove hard and roam. Force her to choose between defending tower or grouping.
- rune: Conditioning variant. You need extra resistances to survive her burst if caught.
- item: Abyssal Mask first. Reduces her magic damage and healing she takes from you.

drmundo__kindred.notes:
- Mounting Dread into Wolf's Frenzy combo deals massive damage; dodge the slowing shot or lose half health.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; Kindred out-trades you early. Use Q to farm from range, avoid all-ins.
- Bait Mounting Dread's slow shot by moving unpredictably; dodge it or she chains Wolf pounce for huge burst.
- Post-6, ult after her Lamb's Respite ends, never before. Her ult negates your burst; wait for zone expiration.
- Kindred first item spike is dangerous; she gains Hunt empowerment and range. Play safe until you complete Heartsteel.
- You spike hardest mid-game with Heartsteel plus Warmog's Armor; your sustain outpaces her damage. Dominate teamfights then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Kindred hunts picks in river and jungle. Deny easy Hunt completion by staying grouped.
- Standard rune page; you need tankiness and sustain to weather her early pressure and Hunt-empowered scaling.
- Add Thornmail if Kindred builds on-hit attack speed; otherwise stick core. Force her to deal with your reflect damage.

drmundo__kogmaw.notes:
- Threat: Bio-Arcane Barrage on-hit shreds your max health; with enchanter support you die before closing gap.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kog'Maw outranges you badly, so avoid trading and focus CS only.
- Trading: Never trade into his W range; bait Q with movement then all-in with E+W combo.
- Post6: Living Artillery reveals you and chunks from range; play around fog of war and cover.
- Spike: First crit item is dangerous window; you cannot duel him, focus farming and roaming instead.
- Window: Level 6+ with R heal lets you survive his burst and threaten all-in; abuse it immediately.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; letting it push forces him to extend and risk ganks.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; his kite and slows are suffocating, you need the move speed to stick.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early; his magic damage is primary threat and it gives you tankiness and mana.

drmundo__lucian.notes:
- Threat: The Culling's sustained DPS and Lightslinger bonus magic damage burst; don't tank full ult.
- Early: Dangerous. Lucian's poke outdamages your sustain; farm safely at range, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Dodge Piercing Light skillshot; bait his dash with Q, then all-in with E+W combo.
- Post6: Catastrophic. The Culling forces you to either dodge or tank massive damage; play around cooldown.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Serrated Dirk) is a danger window; respect his burst.
- Window: Post-level 9 when you stack health; he struggles into tanky builds with no true pen.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; let it bounce to you so he can't abuse long-range poke.
- Rune: Conditioning variant; you need the scaling durability to outscale his early DPS advantage.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean; his magic damage from Lightslinger and ult scales with resistances.

drmundo__lillia.notes:
- threat: Lillia's Lilting Lullaby sleep chain locks you down; her Dream-Laden Bough true damage shreds your max Health.
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions to dodge Swirlseed; Q is dodgeable skillshot. Walk up only when her cooldowns are down.
- trading: Never chase her or walk into Blooming Blows range. Bait E Swirlseed by positioning near walls; dodge it, then all-in.
- post6: Lillia becomes lethal. Her ult forces you into teamfights where you're vulnerable. Respect sleep range; never group without escape.
- spike: First item spike (Liandry's or similar) hurts less than you'd think. Abuse wave before she buys; her poke still tickles.
- window: Levels 1-5 before her ult. Side lane split-push after 6; ignore her, take towers while she looks for teamfights.
- wave: Shove hard early to deny her roams and force her to respond. Hold mid-game if she groups; don't let her ult chain.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick to her and cut through her kite; she'll try to space you with Blooming Blows.
- item: Abyssal Mask first or early to tank her true damage and reduce her magic damage output significantly.

drmundo__lux.notes:
- threat: Light Binding roots you; Final Spark triggers Illumination for burst damage from range.
- early: Safe farm. Stay outside Q range; dodge toward minions when she angles for binding.
- trading: Bait her Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E when she misses.
- post6: Final Spark becomes kill threat; respect it but don't fear—your ult heals its damage.
- spike: First Liandry's is her spike; you survive it easily with early tankiness stacking.
- window: Level 6 onward you outduel her; run her down after baiting her root.
- wave: Shove hard and crash into tower; she can't stop your all-in safely under turret.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—stick to her after landing E, don't let her kite away.
- item: Abyssal Mask first—reduces her magic damage and she can't poke you down anymore.

drmundo__locke.notes:
- threat: Silver Stake's missing-health scaling and Purgatory execute potential; kite and burst you down.
- early: Dangerous. Locke out-damages you levels 1-3. Play safe, farm at range with Q, avoid all-ins.
- trading: Never trade into Locke's Attack Speed window (post-W). Bait his E dash, then all-in with E+W.
- post6: Locke gains execute threat with Purgatory. Stay healthy; use R proactively to deny execute range and heal.
- spike: First item (likely crit or Attack Speed) is a punish window. Respect his damage; play defensively.
- window: Post-Heartsteel or Warmog's when health-scaling stacks. Your tankiness outscales his missing-health damage; then you win.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Locke wants extended trades; deny space and safety for his E repositions.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Extra resistances and health scale into his missing-health damage and execute threat long-term.
- item: Unending Despair. Reduces healing he gains from W and forces him into longer fights where you tank better.

drmundo__malzahar.notes:
- Nether Grasp suppression locks you down while he damages you; stay mobile and respect range.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; abuse your tankiness but avoid extended trades near his minions.
- Never trade into Call of the Void silence window; bait his Q before committing.
- Post-6, Nether Grasp is a kill tool if you're caught alone; never face-check him without escape.
- First item (Liandry's or Rylai's) isn't a major spike; continue scaling and farm safely.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Maximum Dosage outscales his poke and sustains through pressure.
- Hold wave near your tower; avoid shoving into his minions with Malefic Visions active.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your durability spike timing and makes his poke less relevant.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his Magic Damage and Void Swarm harassment significantly.

drmundo__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Malphite's Unstoppable Force knock-up locks you down; his poke with Comet chunks you hard early.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; dodge his Seismic Shard when possible, auto-trade when he misses Q cooldown.
- Trading: Max Q and poke with Infected Bonesaw; bait his Seismic Shard by moving unpredictably, then all-in.
- Post6: Unstoppable Force is lethal; play near your tower and use Goes Where He Pleases to block it.
- Spike: His first item (Sundered Sky or Kaenic) around 10 min is dangerous; avoid extended trades then.
- Window: Mid-game onward you out-duel him if ahead; itemize tankiness faster and out-sustain his poke with Warmog's.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; this lets you dodge his ult safely and farm with Q.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge with Resolve; keeps you sticky against his slow and helps escape Unstoppable Force.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early to block his poke damage and neuter his Comet pressure significantly.

drmundo__maokai.notes:
- Threat: Twisted Advance roots you and enables Maokai's team to collapse; his ult zones you from fights.
- Early: Safe farm; respect Bramble Smash knockback range but abuse his long cooldowns—trade after he misses Q.
- Trading: Dodge nothing—all his damage is point-and-click or guaranteed. Use Q max to chunk him safely from range.
- Post6: Nature's Grasp forces you to respect positioning; don't fight in its path. Use it to identify teamfight location.
- Spike: First item (Abyssal Mask) is not a danger window; you already outscale. Farm uninterrupted and let him fall behind.
- Window: Levels 9-13 when Q maxes—you outdamage his sustain and can pressure towers while he lacks kill threat.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; deny his roams and force him to farm while you scale infinitely.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—you need tankiness scaling to match his durability and guarantee your lategame superiority.
- Item: Thornmail—converts his Sap Magic procs into damage reflection and amplifies your threat against his healing sustain.

drmundo__masteryi.notes:
- Threat: Master Yi's true damage from Wuju Style and attack speed from Highlander shred your tankiness in extended fights.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Master Yi has no kill pressure yet; stack your passive and play for late game scaling.
- Trading: Never trade into his attack range; bait Alpha Strike with positioning, then Q him as he lands; avoid chasing.
- Post6: Highlander makes him untargetable to slows and kites; you cannot stop him with Infected Bonesaw; focus on teamfight setup instead.
- Spike: His first Blade of the Ruined King spike is a danger window; you must have Bramble Vest or lose extended duels.
- Window: You spike when he is behind; gank your team early to starve him; he cannot duel you if underleveled and underfarmed.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Master Yi scales with items and levels; denying him farm matters more than shoving pressure.
- Rune: Conditioning variant to maximize survivability and itemization efficiency; you need defensive stats to weather his true damage spike.
- Item: Bramble Vest immediately after Abyssal Mask; its grievous wounds and thornmail reflect counter his on-hit builds and healing patterns.

drmundo__milio.notes:
- threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire zone heals allies and denies your all-in; his Breath of Life removes your CC.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Milio has no kill pressure but poke is annoying—stay healthy for all-ins later.
- trading: Avoid trading into his Cozy Campfire zone; bait him away from it, then Q-slow and all-in hard.
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive his Breath of Life healing; you outscale his support utility significantly.
- spike: His first item-spike (early Moonstone or Mikael's) doesn't threaten you; abuse this window before his team groups.
- window: Post-6 with ult and early tank items you duel him and his ADC; hunt before he reaches critical mass.
- wave: Shove the wave into his tower to deny Cozy Campfire value and force Milio to follow up weakly.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—stick to enemies in his zone, stick to his ADC, ignore his slows and kiting.
- item: Unending Despair early against his enchants; reduces their damage effectiveness and synergizes with your tankiness.

drmundo__missfortune.notes:
- Threat: Bullet Time channels massive damage in a cone; you cannot tank it, must dodge or position away entirely.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Miss Fortune has no real threat pre-6. Farm at range with Q, avoid unnecessary trades.
- Trading: Don't chase her down lane—she kites backward with Strut Move Speed. Trade only when she's committed to farming minions.
- Post6: Bullet Time forces you to respect positioning. Never clump near walls or terrain that traps you in her cone.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Serrated Dirk) is not a panic spike. You outscale her as a tank by mid-game.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where she has no ult cooldown. Run her down with Dead Man's Plate and E Blunt Force Trauma.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. She wants to kite backward; denying space limits her damage output and safety margin.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick through her Strut Move Speed and chase after she burns ult or repositions away.
- Item: Thornmail to punish her repeated auto-attacks and reduce her healing if she runs Bloodthirster; forces her to play safer.

drmundo__naafiri.notes:
- threat: Naafiri's packmates and bleeds shred you down; she has no escape, so she commits fully.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; she out-trades you early with packmate damage and bleed stacking.
- trading: Let her commit to you, then all-in; dodge Darkin Daggers skillshot to prevent bleed setup.
- post6: Hounds' Pursuit is a gap-closer and commit tool; you become the stat-check threat post-6.
- spike: First item is minor danger; you outscale her once you build bulk and healing.
- window: Once you hit Heartsteel or two items, you stat-check her hard; she cannot kite away.
- wave: Shove the wave to deny her roam angle and force her to choose: farm or fight.
- rune: Standard; you need durability and sustain against her consistent packmate and bleed damage output.
- item: Thornmail to reflect her attack damage and reduce her healing if she lifesteals off you.

drmundo__nasus.notes:
- Wither locks you down; Nasus stacks Q infinitely, outdueling you hard post-6 regardless of items.
- Levels 1-3 are slightly winning; abuse Q spam and poke him off CS, stay healthy.
- Dodge nothing; bait his Wither with movement prediction, then all-in with Q max and E active.
- Post-6 Fury of the Sands gives him stats, lifesteal scaling, and reduced Q cooldown; you lose 1v1s.
- His first item (usually Sheen or armor) doesn't spike dangerously; exploit him before two items arrive.
- Early game (levels 1-5) is your only real window; snowball with mid ganks or jungle help.
- Clear the wave before tower aggro unless he has Hullbreaker; force teamfights, never let him stack alone.
- Stormraider's Surge is safe for stick-and-kite pressure; Grasp works if you want early bully lane dominance.
- Force of Nature or Mercury's Treads helps against his scaling, but the matchup is fundamentally him outscaling.

drmundo__neeko.notes:
- threat: Pop Blossom stun-knockup combo from disguise deletes your teamfight presence and setup.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Q-W poke outdamages your early sustain, avoid trades.
- trading: Dodge her Tangle-Barbs root skillshot; bait it with positioning, then all-in with Q-E.
- post6: Pop Blossom hidden prep is lethal in teamfights; play around minimap awareness and vision.
- spike: First item (Liandry's/Rylai's) spike is moderate danger; your tankiness outscales her poke.
- window: Levels 9-11 when you spike tankier; abuse her immobility in sidelane splitpush.
- wave: Shove constantly into her tower; she cannot match your sidelane pressure or run you down.
- rune: Standard; you outscale and sustain her poke, need no special defensive runes here.
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces her burst and amplifies your Q damage back into her.

drmundo__nautilus.notes:
- Threat: Dredge Line roots you, allowing Nautilus to chain CC and burst you down with team follow-up damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Nautilus outtrrades you pre-6. Respect his Staggering Blow root and avoid extended fights.
- Trading: Never trade into his Staggering Blow root. Bait his Dredge Line skillshot by positioning unpredictably, then punish.
- Post6: Depth Charge adds unavoidable engage pressure. Play further back and position where his ult can't chain into team.
- Spike: First Sundered Sky spike is moderate danger. You spike harder at Heartsteel or Abyssal Mask; match his engage.
- Window: After your ult Maximum Dosage heals and grants MS, chase him down before Depth Charge resets. Punish heavily.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Nautilus wants to roam; denying him easy engage angles forces him to gank harder.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Reduces Nautilus' early burst and stacks into your tankiness for mid-game teamfights where he dominates.
- Item: Randuin's Omen. Reduces his Dredge Line damage and slows enemies around you, making his all-in less lethal.

drmundo__nilah.notes:
- threat: Nilah dodges your Q with Jubilant Veil; heals off your W damage; outsustains you in extended trades
- early: Dangerous; play safe and farm at range with Q; avoid all-ins before level 3 when she outtraces you
- trading: Never trade into her W; bait it with fake engages, then trade when it's down; dodge her E dash
- post6: Maximum Dosage sustain barely keeps you alive; Nilah's Apotheosis pull into her team means certain death for you alone
- spike: First item is dangerous; she gains survivability and damage simultaneously while your tankiness hasn't ramped yet; respect range
- window: Level 9+ when you're significantly tankier; coordinate with jungler; never fight her solo without massive lead
- wave: Shove hard into tower; deny her safe farming and force her to choose between CSing and roaming botlane
- rune: Conditioning variant; she's a sustained damage threat with no hard CC, so scaling defenses matter more than early combat
- item: Thornmail early; reflects her heals back into her face and reduces her self-healing effectiveness significantly

drmundo__nidalee.notes:
- Threat: Long-range Javelin Toss from fog of war chunks you; Takedown executes low-health targets instantly.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are safe if you avoid bushes; farm Infected Bonesaw from distance, don't trade.
- Trading: Never sit in lane brush—she traps it for vision and poke. Bait Javelin by moving unpredictably.
- Post6: Nidalee gains cougar form mobility and burst; you still outscale. Don't chase into fog of war.
- Spike: Her first item (Protobelt or Luden's) is a danger window; you're still scaling into tankiness safely.
- Window: After level 9-11 with Heartsteel + one MR item, you outheal her poke and duel her.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; her long-range poke forces you back, so safety farming XP matters most.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—you need the extra resistances to survive her early poke and scale into unkillable tank.
- Item: Add Mercury's Treads or Abyssal Mask early if she lands Javelins frequently; prioritize survivability over damage.

drmundo__nocturne.notes:
- Threat: Unspeakable Horror fear locks you down; Paranoia ult removes vision then he all-ins you.
- Early: Safe farm—his mana costs are high, so let him poke and bait missed Duskbringer.
- Trading: Dodge his Duskbringer skillshot to force mana waste; his poke does little since Passive heals.
- Post6: Paranoia is extremely dangerous—use P shield to tank the immobilize, then ult away for distance.
- Spike: His first item is a minor threat; you spike harder with Heartsteel or Warmog's Armor.
- Window: You dominate mid-game when tanky items complete; he falls off while your healing scales infinitely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower—he cannot dive you safely; let him waste mana on poke.
- Rune: Conditioning variant maximizes your defensive scaling into his poke-heavy, extended-trade playstyle perfectly.
- Item: Add Unending Despair early to reduce his healing output and cripple Umbra Blades sustain.

drmundo__nunuwillump.notes:
- Threat: Nunu's Biggest Snowball Ever! knockup chains with ganks; you can't dodge it or escape hard CC.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Nunu weak early, just CS and avoid overextending near river without vision.
- Trading: Don't trade into Willump's autos—his P gives him and allies attack speed. Q Infected Bonesaw poke is safe.
- Post6: Absolute Zero forces you away from teamfights. Use R Maximum Dosage to sustain through poke, then disengage.
- Spike: Nunu's first item (likely Liandry's or tank item) isn't a major danger window; you match him in durability.
- Window: You outscale and sustain better mid-game if you avoid ganks. Punish Nunu's roams by pushing and taking towers.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; pushing out gets you ganked by Nunu's roam potential and hard CC chains.
- Rune: Standard (default) or Conditioning variant; you need durability to survive ganks, not mobility or damage runes.
- Item: Plated Steelcaps early if ganks are frequent; reduces Willump's autos and gives you time to react to roams.

drmundo__orianna.notes:
- Threat: Command: Shockwave launches you away and deals massive magic damage; dodge by not grouping.
- Early: Safely farm; her Q is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably.
- Trading: Bait her Q to miss, then run her down with Q and E spam.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you tank her burst; use it reactively after Shockwave hits.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or Luden's) is dangerous; respect her damage but keep pressuring.
- Window: Levels 9-11 and after first item; you vastly outscale her into mid-game.
- Wave: Shove hard; deny her safe positioning and force her to respect your all-in threat.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; stick to her after landing Q, don't let her kite forever.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early; reduces her magic damage and strengthens your bulk against her poke.

drmundo__ornn.notes:
- threat: Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, letting Ornn all-in with guaranteed E knockup and ult follow-up.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; stay outside Bellows range and spam Q cleavers from distance.
- trading: Bait Bellows Breath by positioning at max range, then all-in when it's down; dodge nothing.
- post6: Call of the Forge God ult forces you to respect teamfights; he becomes a zone controller.
- spike: His first item-spike (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; dodge teamfights and abuse sidelane.
- window: Levels 4-5 before ult and after Bellows cooldown; abuse him in sidelane throughout mid-game.
- wave: Shove the wave hard; you outscale in sidelane and Ornn can't match your split pressure.
- rune: First Strike; cleavers wreck him and you farm gold while scaling into a carry threat.
- item: Plated Steelcaps to reduce his E and ult knockup impact if you're dying to all-ins.

drmundo__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's W Shield Vault stuns and combos into sustained damage; don't let it land or he snowballs.
- Play safe levels 1–3; dodge his Q Comet Spear skillshots and never trade into his empowered autos.
- Bait and dodge Q, then trade back with Infected Bonesaw or E Blunt Force Trauma; respect W range.
- Grand Starfall gives him kill pressure but you scale harder; play around cooldown and don't get caught isolated.
- His first item completes around 10–12 minutes; you outscale him—don't die, farm safely, scale into midgame.
- Levels 7–11 and post-first-item you outduel him if you've dodged ganks; his short trades lose to your sustain.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it bounce back so you farm safely away from his W all-in range.
- Grasp of the Undying to trade back when W lands, then heal off minions; Stormraider's Surge is wasted here.
- Add Unending Despair early if he lands free trades; it slows his burst and punishes his shorter range.

drmundo__pyke.notes:
- threat: Pyke's E stuns you and his R executes low-health targets; stay healthy to avoid execution range.
- early: Safe farm. Q and W have longer range than Pyke's Q; abuse range advantage freely.
- trading: Ignore Pyke unless he E's into you; his short range makes him useless without engage.
- post6: Lethal danger window. Stay above 25% health always or risk sudden R execution; play safer.
- spike: First item spike (~3k gold) is manageable; your tankiness scales better than his damage scaling.
- window: Post-first-item onwards; you're unkillable while he remains squishy and gold-starved without kills.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Forces Pyke into dangerous engage range; minimizes his E stun setup space.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Stacking armor and magic resist keeps you tanky enough to survive his burst.
- item: Jak'Sho, The Protean. Armor and magic resist reduce his burst and E stun damage significantly.

drmundo__qiyana.notes:
- Threat: Supreme Display of Talent stun locks you; dodge it or she bursts you down hard.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay out of grass; dodge Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal skillshots easily.
- Trading: Bait her Audacity dash in, then trade back with Infected Bonesaw slow and basic attacks.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive her ult stun; use healing to outlast her burst damage.
- Spike: Her first item isn't a danger window; you scale harder into mid-game tankiness than her.
- Window: Post-first-item you outduel her; maximize this window before her team groups and supports arrive.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard and take tower; ignore her if she grass-spams and roam pressure.
- Rune: Standard — you need tankiness and sustain; Conditioning scales your health pool better than alternatives.
- Item: Add Mercury's Treads to reduce Supreme Display of Talent stun duration and tenacity value.

drmundo__quinn.notes:
- Vault interrupts you mid-fight; E max negates her lethality and lets you trade back hard.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; her Vault cooldown is long early, so respect range but don't panic.
- Bait her Vault by positioning near your minions; punish her landing with E and W combo.
- Post-6 she gains kite and repositioning tools, but you outscale; respect her roam threat and shove.
- First item spike (Serrated Dirk into Collector) is moderate danger; your tankiness already crushes her damage.
- Levels 11+ and two items onward; you tank her burst and heal through her sustained damage.
- Instantly shove and take plates when Quinn roams; deny her map pressure and gold advantage hard.
- Standard rune page; you need tankiness and sustain to absorb her poke and fight back.
- Plated Steelcaps early if her Harrier procs are chunking you; her basic attacks scale poorly into armor.

drmundo__rammus.notes:
- Frenzying Taunt locks you down for his team to burst; avoid getting caught alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm under tower and avoid extended trades with him.
- Spam Q poke from range; don't auto-attack him during Defensive Ball Curl.
- Maximum Dosage sustain lets you out-duel him; all-in when his Frenzying Taunt is down.
- Thornmail spike is real but you still win; keep cleaver poking and farming safely.
- Post-Thornmail, you outscale him hard; use your sustained damage and cleaver range advantage.
- Farm under tower; proxy if their jungler is weak early or playing bot side.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your defensive scaling and lets you absorb his poke efficiently.
- Thornmail is his wincon into you; counter with Hollow Radiance only if full AP.

drmundo__rell.notes:
- Magnet Storm locks you down while Break the Mold steals resistances, making you vulnerable.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid extended trades since Rell's early damage is respectable.
- Dodge Shattering Strike's stun; bait her W crash-down before committing to all-ins with E.
- Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive Magnet Storm's lock-down and resistance theft together.
- Rell's first-item spike is moderate; punish her before she completes Hollow Radiance or similar.
- You spike harder mid-game with tank items; force fights when you have two items.
- Hold wave near your tower; her roam threat and gank setup demand safe positioning.
- Stormraider's Surge for the slow-resist and stick counter against Full Tilt's ramping speed.
- Buy Mercury's Treads early to reduce Shattering Strike stun and Magnet Storm lock-down duration.

drmundo__reksai.notes:
- Void Rush true damage and Unburrow knockup burst—both delete you if you're caught immobile or low.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Unburrow knockups by moving away from burrowed positions preemptively.
- Land Infected Bonesaw from range; she must Burrow to sustain, making her vulnerable to poke.
- Post-6 Void Rush marks you—stay healthy and position away from walls to avoid gap-close combos.
- Her first item spike is mild; you spike harder with Heartsteel—punish her level 11 powerdip.
- You dominate mid-game when she lacks burst tools; force fights around your Ultimate cooldown advantage.
- Shove and reset; she can't contest your clear safely without Unburrow, and you need item lead.
- Conditioning; you need raw tankiness to survive her true damage and mitigate early gank pressure.
- Jak'Sho, The Protean; armor and MR reduction per stack counter both her physical Q and true damage E.

drmundo__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's double-dash gap-close and W stun combo locks you down and bursts you.
- Play safe; farm at range with Q. Respect his all-in at level 2 dash.
- When he dashes in: throw Cleaver, auto, E, walk away immediately before his stun lands.
- His ult gives him HP and Fury generation; respect his damage and sustain spike.
- First item (Sundered Sky or Plated Steelcaps) is not a danger window; farm safely.
- Mid/late game you dominate: outsustain him, 2v1 his jungler with him, and teamfight win.
- Hold wave near your tower; his dash threat means shove = death or burnt ult.
- Grasp; you heal from every trade, outsustain his early poke, and scale better late.
- Jak'Sho, The Protean if he stacks AD/fury; otherwise stick to your standard defensive core.

drmundo__renataglasc.notes:
- Renata's W Bailout delays your burst damage and converts fights into extended teamfights where her team outscales you.
- Play safe early; her Q Handshake root stops you cold and E Loyalty Program shields allies while damaging you.
- Avoid trading into her shield cooldowns; bait Q Handshake by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Maximum Dosage lets you ignore her delayed damage, but her R Hostile Takeover turns teamfights chaotic and unpredictable.
- She spikes first item around 10-12 minutes; abuse her mana costs and spacing vulnerability before she completes it.
- You spike hard at Heartsteel or Warmog's Armor completion; she cannot burst through your raw health and regeneration.
- Shove the wave hard and roam; your sustained damage is wasted in prolonged lane trades against her shields.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your survivability and scales into her delayed burst pattern perfectly in the mid-to-late game.
- Add Unending Despair if teamfights cluster; its grievous wounds soft-counters her team's healing and extends your sustained pressure.

drmundo__rengar.notes:
- Rengar's Thrill of the Hunt camouflage lets him flank and burst you before you react or escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm Q from distance and avoid pushing lane near river brush.
- Dodge his Bola Strike E skillshot; if rooted by empowered E, you cannot activate P or R.
- Post-6, Rengar hunts you across the map; play defensively and group with team for safety.
- His first item spike (around 1000 gold) is dangerous; farm carefully and ask jungler for early gank.
- You outscale hard mid-late game; survive early, stack health, and out-duel him with full build and W.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it slow-push into you so you can farm safely away from brush.
- Use Conditioning variant to maximize survivability against his burst and scale into your tankier mid-game teamfight power.
- Build Thornmail early if Rengar rushes damage; the grievous wounds cripple his healing and burst window.

drmundo__rumble.notes:
- Threat: The Equalizer ult slows you hard; he runs you down and tower dives with impunity post-6.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are manageable; space out and eat his poke rather than fight for every CS.
- Trading: Don't chase his Electro Harpoon skillshots; bait them out, then all-in with Q max and E active.
- Post6: Respect The Equalizer completely; it denies space, enables dives, and turns fights into guaranteed losses for you.
- Spike: His first item is a danger window; you have no defense yet, so play safer and scale.
- Window: Post-Warmog's and when sidelaning, you outscale hard; use superior healing and tankiness to win extended trades.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize gank angles and bait his ult into the tower's safety.
- Rune: Conditioning variant maximizes your survivability scaling into midgame when you need to absorb poke and survive dives.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask early after null-magic mantle to reduce his magic damage and amplify your own healing.

drmundo__ryze.notes:
- Threat: Ryze's Rune Prison roots you if Flux is on you, then bursts with Overload and Spell Flux.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Ryze has no kill pressure. Stay healthy, avoid unnecessary trades, scale up.
- Trading: Dodge his Spell Flux orb with movement; bait Rune Prison by moving unpredictably before committing to trades.
- Post6: Realm Warp gives Ryze escape and repositioning; you still win extended all-ins if he takes Stormraider's.
- Spike: First item (Archangel's Staff) is not a danger window; abuse him before his mana scaling peaks.
- Window: Mid-game (levels 9-13) when your tankiness and healing outpace his burst; catch him without cooldowns.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; force Ryze to push, then all-in him when he overextends for damage.
- Rune: Conditioning variant maximizes your defensive scaling into his consistent poke and sustained damage output over time.
- Item: Mercury's Treads reduce Rune Prison's root duration, improving your all-in reliability against his main crowd control.

drmundo__sejuani.notes:
- threat: Sejuani's Q Arctic Assault knocks you airborne, leaving you vulnerable to follow-up CC chains.
- early: Safe farm. Stay out of charge range; her early damage is low. Farm passively.
- trading: Avoid her W Winter's Wrath slows and Frost stacks. Trade when she whiffs Q.
- post6: Her R Glacial Prison stuns you on impact. Play around cooldown; don't get caught alone.
- spike: First item poses no real danger. You outscale her tankiness with healing and regen.
- window: Mid-game onward. Your healing and Maximum Dosage outpace her damage. Duel her confidently then.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Sejuani wants to engage; denying her angle keeps you safe.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Extra armor and magic resist scale your tankiness against her mixed damage.
- item: Randuin's Omen. Reduces her Q knock-up impact and slows attackers, improving your survivability.

drmundo__senna.notes:
- Threat: Dawning Shadow shields her team globally while damaging you; Last Embrace roots you before you engage.
- Early: Relatively safe; Senna has no early all-in. Farm safely, avoid her Q beam, watch for W setup.
- Trading: Dodge Last Embrace by moving sideways; her W is the only skillshot that matters. Run her down when it's down.
- Post6: Dawning Shadow limits your all-in potential but doesn't stop you. Coordinate with your team to flank or engage simultaneously.
- Spike: First item isn't a danger spike for you. You outscale her in raw tankiness; punish her immobility early.
- Window: Mid-game when you're tanky enough to absorb her poke. Run her down relentlessly; she can't kite forever.
- Wave: Shove it into her tower to force her to respond. Denies her soul collection and limits her roaming pressure.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick to her after Last Embrace wears off; she has no defensive tools against sustained pressure.
- Item: Unending Despair to reduce her self-healing and make her even more vulnerable to your sustained damage output.

drmundo__shaco.notes:
- Shaco's Deceive + Backstab burst from stealth one-shots or chunks you early; respect it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm defensively near tower, don't chase or push forward alone.
- Let Shaco waste Deceive cooldown, then all-in him; dodge nothing—he has no skillshots.
- Maximum Dosage counters his burst; ult when he materializes, heal and run him down.
- Shaco's first item doesn't threaten you; you outscale him hard after level 11.
- Mid-game teamfights (levels 11-13) you become unkillable; run him down with Heart Zapper.
- Hold wave near tower early; push out only after he shows on map elsewhere.
- Use Conditioning for extra tankiness stacking with your health scalings throughout the game.
- Add Hollow Radiance only if Shaco built full AP (rare); otherwise skip it entirely.

drmundo__sett.notes:
- Threat: The Show Stopper ult carries your bonus HP into backline; position carefully or die instantly.
- Early: Levels 1–3 are dangerous; his Q Move Speed lets him bully aggressively, so farm safely with Q.
- Trading: Never trade when he has Grit stacked; bait Haymaker W shield and retaliate when it expires.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage sustains your health but Show Stopper ult threat forces you to play far back.
- Spike: First item spike is not dangerous; your tankiness and Q max outscale his early damage quickly.
- Window: Mid-game after first item, you outscale hard; he falls off unless fed; teamfight advantage yours.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; his MS steroid lets him roam and collapse on side lanes.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge with Inspiration or Resolve to match his MS steroid and escape Show Stopper.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean reduces his true damage burst from Haymaker and scales with armor stacking.

drmundo__singed.notes:
- threat: Singed proxies waves and forces you to choose between chasing him or losing farm to tower.
- early: Safe farm lane; use Grasp to bully him when he walks up for CS, max Q.
- trading: Dodge his W Mega Adhesive; bait it by walking toward him, then trade with Q or E.
- post6: Maximum Dosage sustain keeps you healthy through his Insanity Potion burst; you outscale his damage.
- spike: His first Rylai's or Liandry's is not a real threat; you scale harder into mid-game.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you frontline; his kite tools don't stop your engage or Maximum Dosage healing.
- wave: Perma-shove to deny his proxy; if he proxies anyway, freeze near your tower to deny him entirely.
- rune: Grasp to bully his attempts to walk up and farm; raw pressure wins early trading.
- item: Unending Despair reduces his Poison Trail and Insanity Potion Grievous Wounds effectiveness on your sustain.

drmundo__shyvana.notes:
- threat: On-hit Shyvana's sustained damage and repeated Emberstrike procs shred your tankiness without giving you time to disengage.
- early: Safe farm. Avoid extended trades; Shyvana outdamages you early. Farm safely and let her push into you.
- trading: Never chase or all-in. Trade only when she wastes Inferno Aegis; dodge nothing since her Q is point-and-click.
- post6: Dragon's Descent makes her a threat. She gaps close, fears you, and empowered abilities deal massive damage. Play safer.
- spike: First on-hit item (Runaan's or Nashor's) is a danger window. She'll duel you harder; avoid extended fights then.
- window: Post-first-item when you complete Heartsteel or Warmog's, you outscale her tankiness and healing. Force extended fights in sidelane.
- wave: Hold it near your tower. Shyvana rarely ganks top; let her push and farm safely under tower for HP scaling.
- rune: Conditioning variant. You need the extra defense scaling to survive her on-hit damage and win the durability race long-term.
- item: Thornmail. Reflects her on-hit damage back and applies grievous wounds, cutting her self-healing from Inferno Aegis while in Dragon Form.

drmundo__sion.notes:
- Threat: Sion's Q stun locks you down; his R charges through your slows and knocks you up.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stand behind minions, avoid predictable positions for his Q charge.
- Trading: Max Q and poke with Infected Bonesaw. Bait his Q by repositioning; dodge the knockup.
- Post6: Unstoppable Onslaught is a major threat. Play near walls and jungle entrances to limit his angle.
- Spike: Sion's first item is not a spike window. You outscale him; punish his early weakness.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and Warmog's healing online. Chase his proxying into jungle.
- Wave: Shove fast and hard. Deny him plates, force him to proxy, then collapse with jungle.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Scales your tankiness to outmuscle Sion's sustained damage in prolonged fights.
- Item: Randuin's Omen. Reduces his R damage and slows his charges; cuts his burst threat significantly.

drmundo__sivir.notes:
- threat: Sivir's Move Speed and Spell Shield let her kite and block your engage tools freely.
- early: Safe farm. Stay back; she out-trades you early. Q is a skillshot—dodge it easily.
- trading: Avoid fighting her when Spell Shield is up. Bait it with Q, then all-in.
- post6: On The Hunt makes her untouchable. Don't chase. Wait for her to come to you.
- spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer or Manamune) is dangerous. Play safer; you spike harder later.
- window: Post-Heartsteel or after teamfight build completion—your tankiness and healing outscale her sustained damage heavily.
- wave: Shove early to deny her safe farming and force her to use mana/cooldowns defending.
- rune: Conditioning variant. You need extra tankiness early to survive her poke before outscaling massively.
- item: Thornmail. Reflects her attack damage and applies Grievous Wounds if she heals; punishes her relentlessly.

drmundo__skarner.notes:
- Threat: Skarner's Impale suppresses you—dodge it or use P to waste it on cooldown.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Skarner has no pressure. Q-poke him freely and stack stacks.
- Trading: Max Q and spam it. His Shattered Earth is a skillshot—bait it, then all-in.
- Post6: Impale is his only threat. Play around P cooldown; waste his ult on you intentionally.
- Spike: His first item is not a spike. You outscale immediately; abuse this window hard.
- Window: Levels 6+ entire game. Every time his Impale is down, you're free to dominate.
- Wave: Shove it in constantly. Force him to farm under tower; deny him roam pressure.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge—his slows matter little; you need to stick and chase him down relentlessly.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean—stacks magic resist against his Quaking and reduces all his damage output.

drmundo__sona.notes:
- Crescendo stuns you for free while you're immobile; dodge it or die in teamfights.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; Sona has no kill threat early, just poke with Q Infected Bonesaw.
- Never chase her into fog; bait Crescendo with W Heart Zapper, then all-in her immobile body.
- Crescendo turns the matchup; respect it cooldown and never group without vision of her position.
- First item spike is minimal threat; punish her squishy frame before she scales into utility.
- Your powerspike is mid-game when you've stacked health; she's most vulnerable before teamfights matter.
- Shove the wave hard; deny her positioning in river and force her to choose between wave and roams.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your health scaling and reduces poke damage from her Q Hymn of Valor.
- Mercury's Treads cuts Crescendo stun duration; buy early if she lands ult repeatedly in lane.

drmundo__soraka.notes:
- Threat: Soraka's Wish instantly heals entire team; your burst cannot delete her allies fast enough.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. She outranges you heavily; avoid walking into Starcall poke spam.
- Trading: Dodge her Starcall skillshot, then all-in with Q + W + E. She cannot kite.
- Post6: Wish makes teamfights unwinnable for you solo. Play around her cooldown; force fights immediately after.
- Spike: First item spike (Moonstone/Mandate) makes her healing oppressive. Punish before she finishes; invade her jungle.
- Window: Level 9+ when you have two items and Wish cooldown is longer than your all-in.
- Wave: Shove hard into her tower. Forces her to choose between defending tower or roaming to help.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge—you need raw stick power to catch and kill her before Wish cooldown resets.
- Item: Abyssal Mask first. Reduces her healing output on Wish and Astral Infusion by twenty percent.

drmundo__smolder.notes:
- threat: Smolder's burn damage and Dragon Practice stacks make him increasingly lethal; you can't sustain through fed Smolder forever.
- early: Relatively safe. Farm cautiously—Super Scorcher Breath is a skillshot you can dodge. Don't get caught by Achooo! in minion wave.
- trading: Bait Super Scorcher Breath, then all-in with Infected Bonesaw into Blunt Force Trauma. Avoid walking into Achooo! combo range needlessly.
- post6: Smolder gains mobility and poke with MMOOOMMMM!—harder to lock down. Maximum Dosage lets you reengage after his ult slow.
- spike: First item (around 10–12 min) is a danger window. His damage ramps; respect Dragon Practice stacks and play safer, don't fight.
- window: Post-6, whenever you land Infected Bonesaw cleaver, run him down immediately. He has no defensive steroid; end the fight fast.
- wave: Let it push toward your tower. Smolder outranges you; farming near tower lets you use Maximum Dosage and sustain under safety.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Extended trades and Maximum Dosage synergize with Conditioning's tankiness scaling; you need raw durability to outlast his burn.
- item: Abyssal Mask early if Smolder is ahead. Reduces his burn damage and gives you mana sustain for repeated Infected Bonesaw spam.

drmundo__sylas.notes:
- threat: Sylas all-ins with W Kingslayer healing; if fed, he bursts you before your ult sustains back
- early: Safe farm; dodge Q Chain Lash skillshot, then trade back with Q Infected Bonesaw or E Blunt Force Trauma
- trading: Bait his E Abscond dash, then chunk him with Q or all-in with W Heart Zapper active phase
- post6: Sylas steals Maximum Dosage but wastes it; your healing scales better with health items than his burst does
- spike: First item spike (likely Zhonyas or Shadowflame) is dangerous; respect his burst window, play safer until you itemize
- window: Post-Heartsteel or Warmog's when health scaling peaks, you stat-check him hard; he cannot burst you down anymore
- wave: Shove and reset; denies Sylas roam windows and lets you back safely without losing pressure on tower
- rune: Conditioning variant; extra resistances scale infinitely with your health items and reduce his all-in burst damage significantly
- item: Abyssal Mask early if Sylas goes AP; reduces his W healing against you and amplifies your own sustain value

drmundo__syndra.notes:
- Threat: Syndra's Unleashed Power ult executes you when low; her E stuns even if passive blocks it.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; she has no kill threat but poke hurts—stay healthy for ult value.
- Trading: Dodge her E skillshot by moving sideways; your passive eats it but orb still stuns you.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage ult immediately when she ults you low or you die to execution damage.
- Spike: First item is danger window; stay healthy and farm safely, then all-in her post-level 9.
- Window: Levels 9+ you vastly outscale; chase her down with your tankiness and sustained damage output.
- Wave: Shove wave hard into her tower so she must choose between farming and poking you.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—extra armor and magic resist scales your tankiness into her burst and execute threat.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early reduces her magic damage and execution threshold, making her ult less lethal.

drmundo__tahmkench.notes:
- Threat: Tahm Kench's Devour traps you for seconds; dodge Tongue Lash to prevent stacks.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Tahm's Tongue Lash heals him and builds Devour stacks.
- Trading: Bait his Tongue Lash by positioning behind the wave, then trade with Q or E.
- Post6: Avoid his half of the lane until level 11; his Devour ult locks you down.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate threat; your tankiness makes his damage manageable early.
- Window: Level 11+ you survive his ult dive under turret; you vastly outscale him.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; deny him Tongue Lash angles and gank setups.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. You scale harder and need the extra tankiness during weak early game.
- Item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces his magic damage and your healing improves against his poke.

drmundo__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Unraveled Earth stuns you if dashed through; Seismic Shove knocks you away and disrupts your engage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; dodge Threaded Volley skillshots and avoid Seismic Shove knockback zones near your wave.
- Trading: Trade short and hard with E when she wastes Seismic Shove; don't chase into Unraveled Earth mines.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall doesn't stop your passive; walk through forming wall and run her down immediately after.
- Spike: Her first item isn't a danger spike; Dr. Mundo scales harder into mid-game with tankiness stacking.
- Window: Post-6 when passive resets; immediately run her down before she repositions with Weaver's Wall again.
- Wave: Shove wave hard; forces her to choose between waveclear and harassing you, limits her Unraveled Earth setup.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; resets your passive cooldown faster and helps stick through her slowing/knockback tools.
- Item: Iceborn Gauntlet; slows enemies after your E slam, reducing Taliyah's kiting and Seismic Shove escape.

drmundo__taric.notes:
- Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your burst and ult healing; his team becomes untargetable.
- Safe farm—Taric has no range threat. Play for Q dodges; his E stun has delay.
- Dodge Dazzle's beam with sidestep; bait it before committing. Never walk into E delay.
- Post-6, Taric becomes teamfight anchor. Your ult timing must respect his invulnerability window.
- First item (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) isn't a danger spike; maintain farm pressure.
- Level 9+ when you outscale his support income. Split and force impossible decisions.
- Hold wave near tower early; reset often to dodge repeated E stuns safely without overextending.
- Stormraider's Surge—his Bastion proximity and kite attempts demand movement to gap close reliably.
- Kaenic Rookern denies his W armor aura and Q healing synergy; punishes his grouping.

drmundo__talon.notes:
- Talon's Blade's End Wound stacks enable massive bleed damage; his burst combo from Shadow Assault Invisibility kills you.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; Talon outranges you early. Stay near tower, CS carefully, avoid pushing into his all-in range.
- Talon's W Rake is his only dodgeable skillshot; bait it by positioning unpredictably. Don't chase him into fog of war.
- Post-6 Shadow Assault Invisibility gives Talon gap-close and burst potential. Play safer; use P to tank his Invisibility engagement.
- Talon first-item spike threatens you. This is a punish window for Mundo; stay alive and scale with Heartsteel and resistances.
- Dr. Mundo power spike comes at two-three items with Heartsteel and resistances. Then you out-stat and out-sustain Talon's damage.
- Shove the wave into Talon's tower. This forces him to CS under tower, denies his roam, and keeps him away from your backline.
- Use Conditioning variant to maximize resistances and HP scaling, making you exponentially tankier into Talon's physical-damage burst pattern over time.
- Add Jak'Sho, The Protean early as second item. Its armor and magic resist scaling hard-counters Talon's burst and Wound bleed damage.

drmundo__thresh.notes:
- threat: Death Sentence chains you into The Box prison, trapping you for massive damage and slow.
- early: Safe farm; Thresh outranges you. Stay behind minions, dodge Q skillshots, avoid all-ins before level 6.
- trading: Never chase a retreating Thresh toward his tower or lantern. Bait Q by positioning unpredictably, then all-in.
- post6: Maximum Dosage lets you tank The Box and escape chains. R cooldown beats Thresh's gank setup window.
- spike: Thresh first item spike (armor + AP from souls) hurts less than yours. Punish his weak early tankiness.
- window: Levels 6-11 when you have R; Thresh lacks defensive items. Force fights before he stacks souls heavily.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; this prevents lantern escapes and forces Thresh into extended fights you dominate.
- rune: Conditioning variant maximizes armor and magic resist scaling into his poke and chain damage over time.
- item: Thornmail reflects his auto-attack damage and applies Grievous Wounds if he builds damage or lifesteal items.

drmundo__teemo.notes:
- Threat: Teemo's Noxious Trap slows you hard; step on shrooms to protect teammates, not yourself.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; he autos once or twice as you walk up—manageable.
- Trading: Max Q Infected Bonesaw; it's a skillshot he can dodge but land it when he repositions.
- Post6: Noxious Trap becomes a zone tool; avoid stepping carelessly but accept shroom damage to deny him map control.
- Spike: First Liandry's or damage item around 1–2 items isn't a major threat; you outduel and outsustain him.
- Window: Mid-game with one or two MR items; run him down with Move Speed and ignore his poke.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; he'll try to kite and poke from range, so deny him free roams.
- Rune: Conditioning variant; you need extra resistances early to tank his On-Hit poison and survive all-ins.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early; cuts his damage amplification and stacks with your sustain to nullify poke.

drmundo__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Buster Shot knockback interrupts your engage; Explosive Charge bomb resets her jump escape repeatedly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; her range scales up but she lacks early pressure on you.
- Trading: Avoid her Q attack-speed steroid; wait for her Explosive Charge bomb to detonate before trading hard.
- Post6: Buster Shot becomes a major disengage tool; she kites you easier with knockback and repositioning.
- Spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer) is a punish window; she gains burst damage, play safe then.
