- Window: Levels 7–11 when your tankiness peaks relative to her damage; run her down in sidelanes.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard; forces her to choose between waveclear and roam, limits her mobility angles.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick to her and stick through her slows and knockback chain.
- Item: Thornmail to punish her attack-speed reliance and reflect damage when she Rapid Fires you down.

drmundo__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate steals your resistances and Health; you cannot out-sustain his stat theft without major advantage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3. Use Infected Bonesaw to poke from distance; avoid all-ins before level 6.
- Trading: Max Q for consistent poke. Dodge nothing—his Chomp and Pillar are point-click or slow-moving; bait his Pillar, then trade.
- Post6: Trundle ult window is lethal. Never fight him without Maximum Dosage ready; wait for his ult before committing.
- Spike: First Frozen Domain (around Spectre's Cowl timing) amplifies his healing and dueling. Respect it; do not force extended trades.
- Window: After Trundle ults, immediately cast Maximum Dosage and kite away. Punish his 4-second cooldown before he resets.
- Wave: Shove hard and roam or reset. Trundle matches split pushes better than you; force map pressure away from sidelanes.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge counters his slow/stick tools and lets you kite his all-in and chase down low-HP targets.
- Item: Randuin's Omen reduces his Attack Damage from Chomp sap and gives survivability against his dueling pressure.

drmundo__twistedfate.notes:
- Threat: Twisted Fate's Destiny reveals you and Gate lets him escape your all-in attempts repeatedly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; he out-ranges you with Wild Cards, so avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait his Pick a Card selection before committing; dodge nothing since his damage is consistent.
- Post6: Destiny makes you vulnerable to ganks and lets him kite indefinitely with Gate repositioning.
- Spike: First Swifties spike is dangerous; he becomes unkitable and can split safely away from you.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Twisted Fate can't Gate away; chase him down with Maximum Dosage active.
- Wave: Shove and reset often; force him to choose between defending tower or roaming with Destiny.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; you need the move speed and slow immunity to stick through his kite.
- Item: Sundered Sky for the movement speed and damage to help you close gaps against him.

drmundo__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's crit AD and Undying Rage ultimate make him a sustained threat; kite and exhaust his ult window.
- Levels 1-3 are manageable; play safe, farm with Q, keep W ready, avoid Spinning Slash trades near your wave.
- Bait his Spinning Slash, trade back with E when he overextends; dodge nothing since he has no skillshots.
- Post-6 Undying Rage negates burst; focus on kiting, farming, and waiting for him to waste ult before all-ins.
- His first crit item (Infinity Edge or Navore) spikes his damage hard; respect it and farm safer until 2 items.
- Dr. Mundo dominates after 2 items when tankiness outscales his AD; suffocate him with Warden's Mail rush and kite.
- Hold wave near tower; deny him free crit damage and force him to push, extending his Spinning Slash cooldown windows.
- Use Stormraider's Surge if you expect early aggression or freezes; Grasp works if confident in scaling and turtle play.
- Rush Warden's Mail to neutralize his lane pressure and crit damage; pivot Randuin's third against full-crit ADC teamcomps.

drmundo__twitch.notes:
- Threat: Spray and Pray pierces through you at range; Deadly Venom stacks true damage before teamfights.
- Early: Safe farm—Twitch has no gap close or burst. Stay healthy, avoid Venom Cask slow, scale.
- Trading: Infected Bonesaw slows him and deals % current health damage. Don't chase into Ambush; bait camouflage.
- Post6: Spray and Pray forces you back or kills squishies behind you. Stay grouped, position around teammates.
- Spike: First Manamune spike (around 1000g) is minor. You outscale into mid-game tankiness; not a danger window.
- Window: After your first tank item (Heartsteel/Jak'Sho), you outduel him one-on-one. He only scales through teammates' distraction.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. He wants range advantage; denying him poke and setup room limits his threat.
- Rune: Standard—you need tankiness and engage tools. Conditioning delays his true damage scaling relative to your survivability.
- Item: Thornmail adds armor and grievous wounds, reducing his sustain window and forcing itemization response from him.

drmundo__udyr.notes:
- Threat: Udyr's sustained damage, shields, and stun chain lock you down while his team dives; you can't escape.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay max range farming; his Blazing Stampede stun and sustained autos outrade you level 1-3 hard.
- Trading: Never trade into his autos. Q max and poke with Infected Bonesaw from range; dodge his gap closes.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage gives you sustain but Wingborne Storm's slow and damage pressure force you to play safer overall.
- Spike: First item (Sundered Sky or Heartsteel around 10-12 min) amps his damage and sustain; don't fight him then.
- Window: After he uses Blazing Stampede and you land free Q pokes; punish cooldown gaps aggressively with E trades.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Let it slow-push into you so you farm safely and track enemy jungler.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Scaling tankiness delays his all-in window and lets you survive his sustained combo longer overall.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean. Reduces his attack speed and damage per stack while you sustain through his assault.

drmundo__veigar.notes:
- threat: Primordial Burst nukes you based on missing health; Dark Matter deals massive damage regardless of MR.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Veigar is weak early, so avoid trading and farm safely for scaling.
- trading: Dodge Dark Matter by moving unpredictably; bait Event Horizon then walk through it with your passive.
- post6: Primordial Burst becomes lethal threat; play around your passive cooldown and never let him catch you low.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; Veigar gets huge AP and Dark Matter cooldown reduction, burst increases.
- window: Post-6 with passive up, walk cage and all-in him; he dies if you reach melee range.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; lets you bait his abilities safely and punish with passive up.
- rune: Conditioning variant; extra resistances reduce Dark Matter and Primordial Burst damage when they matter most.
- item: Abyssal Mask; reduces his spell damage and magic pen, making Dark Matter and Burst less oppressive.

drmundo__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's true damage from Organic Deconstruction stacks shreds your health pool relentlessly.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; Plasma Fission poke forces you to heal early.
- Dodge Plasma Fission by moving unpredictably; don't trade into his skillshots, let him miss.
- Maximum Dosage at 6 lets you survive his burst, but Life Form Disintegration Ray true damage counters healing hard.
- First item spike (Luden's Tempest or similar) is dangerous; you're still vulnerable to poke.
- Post-15 minutes when you stack resistances, you outscale his poke and can all-in him.
- Hold wave near tower; his skillshots are easier to dodge with minions between you and him.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your scaling into resistances faster against his magic damage spam.
- Add Abyssal Mask early to reduce his damage output and maximize your healing efficiency.

drmundo__varus.notes:
- Threat: Chain of Corruption roots you in place; melee range becomes lethal until level 16 when P triggers.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Varus outranges you heavily. Stay near minions, use them as cover from Piercing Arrow.
- Trading: Dodge his Q skillshot by moving unpredictably; never trade into his Blight stacks. All-in only when his ult is down.
- Post6: Chain of Corruption becomes lethal in close fights. Play around it; root breaks your melee dueling until level 16 P cooldown.
- Spike: First item (likely Liandry's or Manamune) is a danger window. He deals consistent magic damage; respect his range advantage.
- Window: Level 16 onwards; your P cooldown drops to 8 seconds, making his ult a minor threat. Dominate melee range then.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Let him push; you outscale and his range advantage shrinks as you itemize tankiness.
- Rune: Conditioning variant; you need the early armor and magic resist to survive his poke and Blight detonations safely.
- Item: Abyssal Mask first after boots; reduces his magic damage from Blight and Hail of Arrows significantly, improving your survivability.

drmundo__vex.notes:
- Threat: Shadow Surge dash + fear from Doom 'n Gloom locks you down and bursts you before you can react or heal.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Vex has no kill threat yet, but don't trade—her Q accelerates and pokes harder than your sustain recovers.
- Trading: Never chase her or dash into her E zone; bait her Q by moving sideways, then trade back with Q when she whiffs.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage lets you survive Shadow Surge burst, but her fear interrupt stops your escape—position to minimize her dash angle onto you.
- Spike: Vex first item (usually Shadowflame) spikes her burst around 9-11 minutes; you're vulnerable—stay grouped and use your ult defensively, not aggressively.
- Window: After Vex ults and lands, she's immobile for 2-3 seconds; punish with Q + W combo while she cools down or repositions.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; her poke forces you to burn resources, and tower cover lets you survive her all-in attempt longer.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—extra resistances scale with your health items and let you tank her combo longer without losing tempo early.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask after Heartsteel; reduces her burst damage and gives you mana to spam healing/trading tools throughout the laning phase.

drmundo__vi.notes:
- Threat: Vi's R Cease and Desist locks you down and dumps all her damage; dodge or die.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Vi's Q is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Trading: Never trade into her W Denting Blows stacks; bait her Q, then all-in with E.
- Post6: Her R becomes a guaranteed engage tool; play safer, respect its range, and position near walls.
- Spike: First item (likely Trinity Force) is dangerous; abuse levels 4–5 before she completes it.
- Window: After landing E Blunt Force Trauma on her, punish with Q and W; she has weak counterplay.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower so Vi must overextend to dive or engage; safety over tempo.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge because her Q and R have heavy lockdown and slows; kite and escape easier.
- Item: Thornmail after core to reflect her high AD and reduce her healing from your tanking.

drmundo__viego.notes:
- Viego's Heartbreaker executes you if you're low; his Sovereign's Domination lets him abuse your immobility.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid walking into Spectral Maw range near minions.
- Bait Spectral Maw by moving unpredictably, then trade with Q and W while he recovers.
- Post-6, play around your Maximum Dosage heal timing; never let him catch you below 40% health.
- First item (Heartsteel or Jak'Sho) is a danger window; farm safely and avoid solo fights.
- Your power spike arrives at Warmog's Armor; sustain outraces his damage and execution threat completely.
- Hold wave near tower; force him to dive or lose CS, then punish with Maximum Dosage.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your tankiness scaling and reduces his burst and execute damage threshold danger.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if Viego gets ahead; reduce Spectral Maw stun duration and survive better.

drmundo__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Hemoplague amplifies damage; his Sanguine Pool dodges your Q and all-ins.
- Early: Safe farm. Vladimir outranges you; don't force trades. Farm Q poke for free.
- Trading: Dodge his E charge-up with movement. All-in when his W is down.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage heals through Hemoplague amplification. Ult before his ult lands to minimize damage.
- Spike: First Protobelt isn't a spike for you. Mundo outscales Vladimir hard; stay patient.
- Window: Post-6 teamfights; run him down with R move speed. He has no kite tools.
- Wave: Shove constantly. Split push and ignore Vladimir; force teammates to deal with him.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Vladimir has no kill pressure; scaling defense and health are optimal.
- Item: Abyssal Mask early if Vladimir rushes Protobelt; reduces his burst and damage amp.

drmundo__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's Thundering Smash stun into all-in with Frenzied Maul marks and sustained damage output.
- Play safe levels 1-3; use Infected Bonesaw to farm ranged minions from distance, avoid short trades.
- Dodge Thundering Smash by moving sideways; never trade into his gap-close without cooldown advantage.
- Do not fight when he dives with Stormbringer active; kite around tower until duration ends.
- Volibear first item (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) is not a dangerous spike; maintain farming.
- Your spike arrives post-first-item with Maximum Dosage healing; you outscale teamfights and split pressure hard.
- Hold wave near your tower; his dive threat demands proximity to base for safety rotations.
- Use Stormraiser's Surge; slows from his kit demand raw stickiness and kite escape tools.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if ahead; tenacity reduces Thundering Smash stun windows for safer play.

drmundo__viktor.notes:
- threat: Gravity Field stuns you if you stay in it; Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm deal consistent magic damage.
- early: Safe farm. Stay outside Gravity Field range; Q poke is manageable. Trade only when Viktor wastes cooldowns first.
- trading: Bait Gravity Field by walking at him, then sidestep it and trade back with Q. Never stand still in his zone.
- post6: Arcane Storm adds sustained damage but doesn't threaten your tankiness. Maximum Dosage outscales his damage output; ult when low.
- spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) is not a major danger window. Your Heartsteel spike at level 6 matches or exceeds his.
- window: Mid-game after Heartsteel when your health pool bloats. Viktor struggles to burst or kite you; run him down with Q spam.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Viktor outranges you; forcing him to approach your tower wastes his poke and lets you trade.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Stacks into tankiness faster than Standard, smoothing your durability against his mixed damage output over time.
- item: Abyssal Mask. His magic damage is primary threat; lowers his damage and boosts your tankiness considerably without compromising your core build.

drmundo__wukong.notes:
- threat: Cyclone's 5-man knockup and sustained spin damage; dodge it or you lose teamfights hard
- early: Safe farm—Wukong lacks waveclear; stay healthy and avoid his Q-W combo trades at level 2
- trading: Bait his W Invisibility by positioning unpredictably, then Q poke him when he reappears defenseless
- post6: Cyclone forces you to position wider and respect his all-in; scale and wait for him to overextend
- spike: His first item (usually Sunderer or Black Cleaver) is a minor danger; you outscale him hard anyway
- window: Past 2 items you dominate 1v1s; force extended fights where his cooldowns matter less than your healing
- wave: Hold wave near your tower—safety from ganks and lets you Q-poke him under tower safely
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—reduces his W dash stickiness and lets you kite his Cyclone spin reliably
- item: Randuin's Omen—cuts his Cyclone knockup window and lowers all his physical burst significantly

drmundo__warwick.notes:
- Threat: Warwick's W Blood Hunt lets him hunt you below 50% health with tripled bonuses; Infinite Duress suppresses and kills.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are safe farm—Warwick has no engage tools yet. Play normally but respect his all-in at level 2 if low.
- Trading: Never trade into Warwick's attack range; his P heals him massively below 50%. Bait his E Primal Howl, then Q him while he's locked out.
- Post6: Infinite Duress is a guaranteed engage tool. Stay above 50% HP and never let him flank. Position near teammates or escape routes always.
- Spike: Warwick's first item (Kaenic Rookern or Spirit Visage) is moderate danger. You spike harder with Heartsteel; abuse that window before he completes.
- Window: After you complete Heartsteel and reach 40% CDR, you outscale Warwick hard. Punish him in sidelane where Infinite Duress has less backup support.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Warwick hunts low-health enemies; staying safe lets you farm safely and denies him his W activation advantage.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge with Inspiration, or First Strike if confident. Stormraider kites his W Blood Hunt; First Strike wins sidelane skirmishes for split damage.
- Item: Randuin's Omen slows his attack speed and movement during his W Blood Hunt frenzies; buy it if he snowballs early kills.

drmundo__xerath.notes:
- threat: Xerath's Shocking Orb stun locks you down; his range keeps you from closing distance safely.
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions to block Arcanopulse; avoid predictable positioning for Shocking Orb.
- trading: Never walk straight at him—bait Shocking Orb by repositioning, then all-in when it's down.
- post6: Rite of the Arcane immobilizes him but pumps out massive damage; use ult to heal through volleys.
- spike: First Liandry's spike hurts but doesn't kill you; your poke is meaningless means you outscale him.
- window: Post-first-item you begin outpacing his damage; use Maximum Dosage to negate his burst and run him down.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower—his poke is meaningless, so force him to overextend or lose cs.
- rune: Conditioning variant—scales your tankiness harder into his consistent magic damage over the full game.
- item: Abyssal Mask early after first defensive item to neuter his magic damage and amplify your sustain.

drmundo__yasuo.notes:
- threat: Yasuo's E-Q combo dashes in, stacks Gathering Storm, then knocks you airborne into Last Breath for massive burst damage.
- early: Dangerous levels 1-3; dodge his Q thrust and avoid letting him stack Flow shield freely by trading when he moves forward.
- trading: Let Yasuo commit E onto you, then immediately trade back with Q and W; his dash cooldown is longer than your abilities.
- post6: Last Breath is devastating when you're airborne—avoid getting knocked up by Q whirlwind and play around his ult cooldown aggressively.
- spike: First Sheen item (Trinity or Iceborn) is his power spike; play safer and don't all-in until you have Randuin's rush completed.
- window: Post-Randuin's (your 3rd item) you outscale his 1v1 significantly; use this window to pressure him and force bad teamfight positioning.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Yasuo zones well with E threat, and you need safety to scale into your item advantages.
- rune: Stormraiders Surge because Yasuo has sticking power and you need the slow-clear plus chase potential to pin him down mid-late game.
- item: Randuin's Omen 3rd item slashes his crit damage and slows his E dashes, directly gutting his primary threat pattern against you.

drmundo__yone.notes:
- Threat: Yone's Q3 dash + Fate Sealed ult creates unstoppable engage that kills you before you heal.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yone outranges you. Stay back, stack Grasp safely, don't get caught by Q3.
- Trading: Dodge his Q3 dash entirely—your passive eats it but costs Health. Trade after he wastes Q cooldown.
- Post6: Fate Sealed ult is lethal engage. Respect massive range, position near walls, dodge it or use passive.
- Spike: BotRK first item is his danger window. He heals off your Health and sticks permanently on you.
- Window: When you hit Warmog's plus Giant's Belt, punish hard—Yone has zero sustain to match your healing.
- Wave: Shove wave hard into tower; denies him safe farming and forces him to fight or lose CS.
- Rune: Grasp—trading tool matches his poke and fuels early tankiness stacking for Warmog's spike timing.
- Item: Rush Randuin's third item after core Heartsteel and Abyssal Mask to cripple his crit and MS.

drmundo__yorick.notes:
- Maiden of the Mist deals sustained damage and raises Walkers; focus cleaver shots on killing her instantly.
- Play safe; Yorick has wave priority and Dark Procession cage is real CC—do not get trapped early.
- Max Q and trade aggressively with cleavers when he dodges; E trades work if you have priority, else scale.
- Eulogy of the Isles changes the lane entirely; Maiden pushes and spawns Walkers—kill her on sight every time.
- First item spike (typically Sheen into Manamune) increases his damage and wave clear; punish him before he completes it.
- Your window is early trades with Q priority and post-Maiden kill windows; use ult to sustain through his all-ins.
- Shove the wave when safe to deny Maiden value; do not let it stack Walkers near your tower.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite Dark Procession cage and stick to Maiden target for cleaver executions.
- Add Unending Despair early if Maiden spam is overwhelming; the grievous wounds reduce her healing and Yorick's sustain.

drmundo__yunara.notes:
- threat: Yunara's On-Hit spread damage and sustained DPS pressure; her Transcendent State upgrades make her harder to kite and duel.
- early: Safely farm; her Q is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably. Avoid extended trades before level 3.
- trading: Bait her W Arc of Judgment as a skillshot, then trade back with Q Infected Bonesaw. Don't let her stack On-Hit freely.
- post6: Maximum Dosage sustain lets you survive her burst, but Transcend One's Self upgrades her chase and damage significantly—play safer.
- spike: Her first item (likely Attack Speed or crit item) accelerates her On-Hit spread. Respect her damage window; don't force fights.
- window: Post-first-buy when you have Heartsteel or Jak'Sho online; your tankiness outscales her early spike. Punish overextension with Q.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; her On-Hit spread excels in extended fights. Deny her poke and force tower interaction.
- rune: Conditioning variant; you scale harder into midgame and survive her duel attempts better with early armor and magic resist.
- item: Thornmail early if she rushes Attack Speed; reflects her On-Hit and forces her to buy Grievous Wounds, slowing her spike.

drmundo__zac.notes:
- Threat: Elastic Slingshot and Let's Bounce! lock you down for 4+ seconds from fog of war.
- Early: Farm safely; his sustain and CC dominate early trades—don't fight unless Zac overextends badly.
- Trading: Max Q and poke with it; dodge Stretching Strikes by moving unpredictably, don't face-check bushes.
- Post6: Let's Bounce! adds knockup chain CC—stay further back, never fight near his tower without vision.
- Spike: His first tank item (Abyssal, Hollow Radiance) around 10–12 minutes strengthens his engage; survive it.
- Window: Levels 13+ when your Warmog's or Heartsteel + R healing vastly outpaces his damage output.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Zac roams and dives; freezing denies his all-in engage attempts.
- Rune: Conditioning variant—survive his early engage safely, scale into midgame tankiness and sustain advantage.
- Item: Randuin's Omen—reduces his knockup effectiveness and slows his bounce mobility, protecting you late.

drmundo__zilean.notes:
- Chronoshift denies your all-ins; he revives whoever you focus, negating your burst damage threat.
- Play safe early; Zilean Time Bombs chunk you hard and you can't dodge skillshots easily.
- Dodge his Time Bombs by moving unpredictably; don't chase him—kite backward and let him come to you.
- Post-6 his revive makes him untargetable as a win condition; focus objectives instead of chasing kills.
- First item doesn't spike him dangerously; use levels 9-11 to all-in before his cooldown reduction peaks.
- You spike hardest at two items with tankiness; force fights when Zilean is alone or vulnerable.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Zilean push in so Chronoshift can't protect him from ganks.
- Use Conditioning to stack tankiness for his late-game poke; you need durability more than speed here.
- Build Mercury's Treads early to reduce Time Bomb stun impact and his Time Warp slow effectiveness.

drmundo__zeri.notes:
- threat: Zeri kites and dodges with Spark Surge; her Lightning Crash stacking MS means you cannot stick or catch her.
- early: Dangerous—Zeri's Burst Fire and Ultrashock Laser outrange your Q; farm safely under tower and avoid extended trades.
- trading: Do not chase or commit to trades; her E dash and kiting make you miss Infected Bonesaw easily.
- post6: Lightning Crash amplifies her damage and MS stacking per hit; she becomes even harder to reach or duel effectively.
- spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer or Sheen variant) spikes her damage hard; do not force fights; respect zone control.
- window: Mid-to-late game when she runs out of kiting space near objectives or when teamfight terrain favors your engage.
- wave: Let wave bounce toward your tower; she controls poke range and can deny your approach; farm safely and scale.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—her slows and MS stacking require you to stick once in range; this grants the chase tool needed.
- item: Randuin's Omen—her attack speed and repeated hits demand AS slow; reduces her MS stacking effectiveness in fights.

drmundo__zyra.notes:
- Stranglethorns knockup traps you; Grasping Roots root locks you down before you can escape or heal.
- Play safe levels 1–3; farm at range with Q, avoid walking into seed clusters near Zyra.
- Dodge Grasping Roots by timing P or moving unpredictably; bait her E cooldown, then all-in with W + E.
- Post-6 Stranglethorns is a lethal engagement tool; play around walls and use Maximum Dosage to escape knockup chains.
- Zyra's first item spike (Liandry's or Zhonya's) is dangerous; dodge her root combos and scale tankier than her damage.
- Your power spike comes at Heartsteel + two resistances; you then duel and outheal her plant DPS reliably.
- Hold wave near your tower; plants tank minions, so slow-pushing wastes time and lets her scale and spawn more.
- Conditioning variant; you need scaling durability and health to face her mixed damage and sustained plant harassment.
- Buy Abyssal Mask second or third; it cuts her magic damage and plant damage while you heal more from W + R.

olaf__ahri.notes:
- Charm stops your movement abilities and forces you toward her; dodge E or you lose all agency.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid pushing up where Charm lands easily.
- Bait out her E with fake engages, then all-in when it's down; dodge Orb return damage.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Charm, but she kites you with Spirit Rush dashes and speed.
- Her first item spike (typically Luden's Tempest) hurts but isn't a hard stop; stay healthy and farm safely.
- Your window is post-6 when you can ult and dive her if she overextends; punish mistakes hard.
- Shove the wave to deny her safe farming and force her to manage pushing minions under tower.
- Take Conqueror for extended trading when you land early hits and need sustained damage to stick.
- Add Hexdrinker early if her poke burns you down; the shield blocks her burst combo attempts.

olaf__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Q stun locks you down, enabling his team to burst you before Ragnarok immunity activates.
- Safely farm at range with Q; avoid trading early when Amumu has mana for repeated engages.
- Dodge Bandage Toss by moving unpredictably; never sit still. Bait his Q, then all-in with E.
- Ragnarok immunity negates his R stun, but his team still damages you; play around cooldown timing carefully.
- His first Liandry's Torment spike hurts, but it's your window to duel before his team groups.
- You spike harder at two items; abuse this before Amumu gets his third defensive item online.
- Shove the wave to deny Amumu's roam window and force him to choose: defend tower or follow.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true damage trading; it stacks through his Tantrum reduction and Curse amplification.
- Add Abyssal Mask to reduce the true damage from his Curse and W Despair burn simultaneously.

olaf__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's invisibility from W and slows from E and R kite you; dodge her skillshots.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q-recast combo chunks hard; farm at range with Q.
- Bait her W invisibility by walking at her; then engage when she lands and vulnerable.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable chain; activate it during her E or R.
- First item spike around Kindlegem timing hurts; punish her before she completes it with aggression.
- After Ragnarok comes online, all-in her when cooldown is ready; she has no escape then.
- Shove the wave hard; force her to choose between farming and roaming with W.
- Conqueror stacks during extended fights; her kiting delays but true damage from E overcomes it.
- Mercury's Treads reduce her slow effectiveness; allows you to stick and close gaps better.

olaf__azir.notes:
- threat: Azir kites you with Sand Soldiers and slows from Conquering Sands; stay out of soldier range
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Azir needs time to stack soldiers, so abuse this window with short trades
- trading: Bait Shifting Sands by approaching; dodge it or let him waste the dash, then all-in with Undertow
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Emperor's Divide knockback and soldier damage; use it to force engages
- spike: His first item spike (Liandry's Torment or Nashors Tooth) is dangerous; respect soldier poke and kite
- window: Levels 4-5 before Azir completes items; when Undertow cooldown resets, you control the tempo with axe resets
- wave: Shove the wave to deny Azir space to place soldiers; force him to defend tower and lose poke
- rune: Predator lets you gap-close despite kite; catch him before soldiers congeal and lock you out
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks sustained soldier magic damage and provides armor for all-ins against his wall

olaf__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's attack speed and lifesteal in Royal Maelstrom let her outstay and outheal your trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her attack speed stacks grow fast, so avoid extended trades early.
- Bait Void Surge with positioning, then Undertow to slow her chase; dodge Above and Below knockup.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you fight through her disables, but her true form attack range outduels you.
- Her first item spike (likely Kraken Slayer or Trinity) is dangerous; respect her damage window hard.
- You spike when she has no stacks and before her first item completes; punish that window.
- Shove the wave to deny her minion stacks; starving her early stacks weakens her scaling significantly.
- Take Conqueror to match her sustained damage in prolonged fights and heal through poke trades.
- Build a Thornmail early to punish her attack speed reliance and reduce her lifesteal effectiveness.

olaf__blitzcrank.notes:
- Rocket Grab is the threat; it locks you down and Blitzcrank kills you while disabled.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Rocket Grab by positioning behind minions, farm cautiously near tower.
- Bait Rocket Grab by positioning unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown with Undertow.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Rocket Grab; activate it aggressively to engage safely.
- Blitzcrank's first item spike is real; respect his damage and use Ragnarok to gap close.
- You spike hardest when Ragnarok is up and Blitzcrank just used Rocket Grab; punish immediately.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Blitzcrank push, then all-in with Ragnarok when he overextends.
- Take Conqueror for sustained damage and tankiness since this is a prolonged all-in matchup.
- Add Hollow Radiance for armor and cooldown reduction to spam Undertow and survive his burst.

olaf__brand.notes:
- Brand stuns you with Sear on ablaze targets; you cannot dodge it once lit.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Pillar of Flame and avoid letting him stack Blaze.
- Bait Sear before going in; once he misses, gap close and trade with Reckless Swing.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his CC chain; activate it when he combos you.
- His first Liandry's Torment spike around 2 items hurts; farm safely and scale with him.
- You outwin mid-game when Ragnarok is up; force teamfights on your activation timer.
- Hold wave near your tower; Brand needs to overextend to trade, making ganks dangerous for him.
- Take Conqueror; sustain through his poke and true damage converts stack faster than Grasp.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; it blocks Blaze stacks and reduces his damage and burn duration.

olaf__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker and Ace in the Hole deal consistent poke damage you cannot fully mitigate.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades where her Headshots trigger; respect her range advantage.
- Dodge Yordle Snap Trap placement by staying mobile; bait her 90 Caliber Net then all-in when she recoils.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her Yordle Snap Trap lockdown; activate when trapped to break free.
- Her first item spike (likely Kraken Slayer) increases Headshot damage significantly; respect extended trades during this window.
- You spike when she wastes Yordle Snap Trap or misses 90 Caliber Net; all-in immediately with Undertow.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her safe trap placement and force her to fight near your minions.
- Fleet Footwork sustains through her poke and helps you dodge Piltover Peacemaker and Yordle Snap Trap.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her Ace in the Hole damage and increase your effective tankiness.

olaf__camille.notes:
- Threat: Her Hookshot knocks you up, then Hextech Ultimatum traps you for extended all-in damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q out-trades your short-range threat without committing heavily.
- Trading: Bait her Hookshot to walls, then all-in when it's down; dodge nothing, she has no skillshots.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her Hextech Ultimatum lockdown and fight freely inside it.
- Spike: Her first Sheen item (Trinity or Iceborn) spikes her Q damage significantly; respect the range.
- Window: You spike harder at level 6 with Ragnarok; use disable immunity to negate her ult setup.
- Wave: Shove hard into her tower; forces her to choose between farming and roaming for ganks.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for extended fight sustain and true damage scaling against her defensive layering.
- Item: Buy Plated Steelcaps early to reduce her Q and basic attack burst before first back.

olaf__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Feral Scream silences you, stopping Ragnarok activation and all offensive plays instantly.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Cho'Gath has no reliable all-in. Farm freely and poke with Undertow.
- Dodge Rupture by moving unpredictably; bait it, then all-in. Never trade into his Vorpal Spikes range.
- Post-6, Ragnarok lets you ignore Feral Scream silence during fights if you keep attacking constantly.
- Cho'Gath's first item spike is minimal threat; your Undertow spam and early pressure outweigh his scaling.
- Your power window is levels 2-5 before he stacks health. Relentlessly shove and force trades.
- Shove the wave hard; deny Cho'Gath Carnivore procs on minions and force him under tower.
- Take Conqueror; true damage and healing synergize with Reckless Swing and Berserker Rage perfectly.
- Build a Maw of Malmortius second; its shield and magic resist counter Feral Scream + Rupture burst.

olaf__drmundo.notes:
- Threat: Dr. Mundo's sustained damage and self-healing through Maximum Dosage makes him outscale your all-in potential.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Infected Bonesaw slows and chunks health, so avoid extended trades near minions.
- Trading: Bait Infected Bonesaw by positioning unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow into Reckless Swing when his Q is down.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage heals his missing health and grants move speed; your Ragnarok disable immunity doesn't stop his healing.
- Spike: First Sunfire Aegis spike makes his Heart Zapper damage unbearable; abuse levels 4-5 before he completes it.
- Window: Your power window is levels 2-4 before his sustained healing scales; force fights when his ult is down.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny him safe farming and force him into your tower range where you control trades.
- Rune: Take Conqueror to stack true damage and healing against his tank stats; stacks during extended fights you force.
- Item: Add Thornmail early to punish his auto-attack trading and reduce his healing from incoming damage taken.

olaf__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's charm from Allure locks you down before Last Caress decimates and repositions away.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Evelynn lacks early damage and you outrade with Undertow harass.
- trading: Bait Allure's delay before committing; dodge nothing since her Q is a skillshot line.
- post6: Last Caress makes her untargetable and mobile; activate Ragnarok when she ults to stay relevant.
- spike: First item (typically Lich Bane or Shadowflame) is her damage spike; punish her before it completes.
- window: Levels 4-5 before her ult; dominate lane with Undertow spam and all-in potential then.
- wave: Shove the wave hard; deny her safe roam angles and force her to show mid.
- rune: Conqueror gives sustained damage to match her poke and scales into your teamfight role.
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks her charm effect and grants defensive stats you naturally want.

olaf__ezreal.notes:
- Threat: Ezreal kites you with Arcane Shift and Mystic Shot spam; you cannot close gaps reliably.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Mystic Shot poke is free damage. Farm under tower, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait Arcane Shift before committing with Undertow; dodge his Q by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables does not stop damage; Trueshot Barrage still hurts. Respect poke.
- Spike: His first item (usually Trinity Force) enables consistent kiting. This is a punish window for Ezreal.
- Window: Mid-game when Undertow cooldown resets; chase him down if he mispositions near your axe.
- Wave: Shove hard when he backs or when Undertow is down; deny him safe farming space.
- Rune: Phase Rush lets you close gaps after Arcane Shift; mitigates his kiting advantage heavily.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks some Trueshot Barrage damage and gives sustain against poke pressure.

olaf__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals heal her and grant Move Speed; kiting you around them while stunning via Riposte creates windows where you cannot engage safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Fiora's early damage is high and Riposte blocks your Undertow axe return, denying cooldown resets and kite potential.
- Bait Riposte with Undertow before committing to all-in; if she parries, back off immediately—her stun punishes greedy follow-up attempts severely.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Riposte stun, but Fiora's Vitals and healing still outscale your tankiness in extended fights post-six.
- Watch her first item spike around 10-12 minutes; Fiora gains significant damage and split-push threat—play grouped and deny her sidelane isolation.
- Your power window is early-to-mid teamfights before she stacks Vital heals; force fights near your team when her kite distance is limited.
- Shove the wave into her tower to deny her sidelane split pressure and control where duels happen; prevents her from isolating you alone.
- Take Conqueror; true damage from Reckless Swing and sustained healing help you duel her constant Vital poke and Duelist's Dance sustain.
- Build Maw of Malmortius after core items; the magic shield blocks Fiora's burst windows when she lands multiple Vitals in succession.

olaf__galio.notes:
- W Shield of Durand taunts you, stopping your engage and letting Galio damage you safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Galio out-ranges you. Farm with Q Undertow from distance, avoid all-ins.
- Bait W Shield of Durand by faking engagement, then disengage. Never walk straight into taunt range.
- E Justice Punch knocks you up before you close distance. Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore it if active.
- Galio first item spike (typically Hollow Radiance) increases his tankiness; punish him pre-6 before he scales.
- Post-Ragnarok activation, you dominate extended fights since disable immunity lets you stick and drain-tank with Berserker Rage.
- Shove the wave hard; Galio needs setup time for W Shield of Durand. Deny him pressure windows.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true damage through his magic resist and tankiness in extended trades.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius; its magic shield and spell vamp reduce Galio's poke and all-in burst.

olaf__garen.notes:
- threat: Garen's Decisive Strike silence locks you out of abilities; his Demacian Justice executes low-health targets.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Garen wins short trades with Decisive Strike bonus damage and silence.
- trading: Bait his Decisive Strike with movement, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing while he's on cooldown.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore his Decisive Strike silence; use this to all-in aggressively.
- spike: Garen's first item spike (Trinity Force) is dangerous; respect his damage and stay healthy.
- window: Your window arrives after Garen uses Decisive Strike; immediately chase and trade before cooldown resets.
- wave: Shove the wave early to deny Garen Perseverance healing and deny his Judgment's multi-target damage value.
- rune: Take Conqueror; true damage from Reckless Swing stacks it quickly and sustains through his poke.
- item: Add Maw of Malmortius to block Demacian Justice execute damage and gain magic resist against Garen's kit.

olaf__gwen.notes:
- Threat: Gwen's W Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable; your Q and E cannot force her to fight.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Gwen outtraces you and her Q Snip Snip! applies true damage centrally.
- Trading: Bait her W Hallowed Mist cooldown before committing; dodge Q Snip Snip! cone and avoid center true damage.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her slows but not her W protection; she controls fight terrain still.
- Spike: First item spike (Riftmaker or Nashors) pressures you harder; play around her mist radius, not direct fights.
- Window: Mid-game when Gwen lacks cooldown reduction; land Q Undertow resets to all-in while her W is down.
- Wave: Shove waves into her tower; forces her to choose between farming and maintaining W Hallowed Mist safety.
- Rune: Conqueror stacks true damage from E Reckless Swing and sustains through her percent-health bonus magic damage.
- Item: Spirit Visage blocks healing from A Thousand Cuts passive and amplifies your own shield and sustain value.

olaf__ivern.notes:
- Threat: Rootcaller roots you mid-fight, preventing Ragnarok activation and stopping your engage threat entirely.
- Early: Farm safely at range; Ivern's early damage is low but Rootcaller catches overextended positioning.
- Trading: Bait Rootcaller with sideways movement, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when it's down.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Rootcaller root duration but not the initial disable chain itself.
- Spike: Ivern's first item spike (typically support item) is minimal; you spike harder with Hollowradiance or Plated Steelcaps.
- Window: Level 2-3 and post-first-back when you have damage items and Rootcaller cooldown is exploitable.
- Wave: Push the wave into Ivern's tower to deny brush creation and force him into unfavorable terrain fights.
- Rune: Conqueror for extended trading and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing pressure throughout laning.
- Item: Hollow Radiance provides armor, magic resist, and health—reduces Rootcaller burst and brush bonus damage significantly.

olaf__janna.notes:
- Janna's Zephyr slow and Monsoon knockback lock you down; kite and disengage are her core strengths.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke with Zephyr outranges you, so farm from distance and avoid extended trades.
- Bait her Zephyr activation before committing; dodge Howling Gale by moving unpredictably, then all-in when cooldowns are down.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables completely negates her Zephyr slow and Monsoon knockback; activate it before engaging her team.
- Watch for her first item spike around 10-12 minutes; punish cooldowns aggressively once she's forced to back.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where Ragnarok active turns her into a non-threat; use it proactively.
- Shove the wave into her tower; prevent her from freely roaming with Zephyr and deny her poke safety.
- Take Conqueror; sustained true damage from Reckless Swing stacks faster than her defensive shields can mitigate.
- Buy Force of Nature if she has magic damage allies; the magic resist and move speed help against her kite.

olaf__jax.notes:
- threat: Jax stuns you with Counter Strike after dodging your damage, then kills you with Relentless Assault stacks.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid trading near his Counter Strike cooldown window since you can't dodge it.
- trading: Bait Counter Strike with Undertow, then all-in with Reckless Swing and Tough It Out for guaranteed damage.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Counter Strike stuns, but Jax gains armor and magic resist—prioritize true damage trades.
- spike: First Triforce spike hurts; play around minions and avoid extended trades when his Empower is up.
- window: Levels 5-8 before Jax gets Triforce; abuse Reckless Swing's true damage when you're missing health.
- wave: Shove and reset; roaming or resetting denies Jax the extended trades where Relentless Assault snowballs.
- rune: Conqueror stacks true damage and healing, letting Reckless Swing drain-tank through Jax's burst phases.
- item: Hollow Radiance reduces Jax's burst and gives you bulk to sustain Reckless Swing's self-damage longer.

olaf__jinx.notes:
- Threat: Zap! slows you from range; Super Mega Death Rocket! executes you when low health.
- Early: Safe farm—stay outside Zap! range; avoid fighting before level 3 when you lack tools.
- Trading: Bait Zap! by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when it misses.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Flame Chompers! roots and tank Super Mega Death Rocket! damage.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune/Serrated Dirk) isn't dangerous; you outscale her early aggression significantly.
- Window: Levels 6-11 are your window—activate Ragnarok and dive past her kiting to force close fights.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower so she overextends; leverage Undertow to punish her positioning.
- Rune: Conqueror—true damage stacks faster into her tank items and sustain keeps you healthy.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks her burst and magic damage from Super Mega Death Rocket!

olaf__kaisa.notes:
- threat: Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks with ally CC trigger massive bonus magic damage; kite and burst you down.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her range outmatches you. Wait for jungle help or her misposition.
- trading: Avoid Void Seeker's mark—dodge sideways. All-in when she wastes Supercharge; she has no escape then.
- post6: Killer Instinct dash closes gaps instantly. Activate Ragnarok preemptively to stay immune while chasing or fighting.
- spike: First item spike around 2-3 items when Living Weapon upgrades unlock. Play safe; don't force extended trades.
- window: Post-6 with Ragnarok active and full health, you outtrade her. Chase her when she uses Supercharge.
- wave: Shove wave when she recalls or is low; deny her farm and force her to extend for CS.
- rune: Take Phase Rush to dodge Void Seeker and escape her all-in burst after she marks you.
- item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage and protect your teammates from Plasma explosions.

olaf__ksante.notes:
- K'Sante's All Out transforms him into an unkitable threat with healing and damage while Olaf struggles with reduced defenses matchup.
- Play safe levels 1-3; K'Sante's early Q-poke with Ntofo Strikes stacks outranges you, so respect his spacing and farm with Q.
- Bait his W Path Maker dash by moving unpredictably, then all-in while it's down; dodge Q shockwave pull by moving sideways.
- All Out makes K'Sante extremely dangerous; your Ragnarok immunity helps, but his All Out reduced defenses punish your true damage E trades.
- First item spike around Sheen or Brutalizer timing (9-10 minutes) is dangerous; respect his damage and play around your cooldowns.
- Post-first-item, Olaf gains window when K'Sante's ult is down; force extended fights where your Berserker Rage and sustain outscale his burst.
- Shove the wave to deny K'Sante safe poke and wave control; push him into tower so his roam impact weakens.
- Conqueror stacks true damage and healing, letting you trade and sustain through K'Sante's early poke and burst during skirmishes.
- Build Force of Nature as third item; magic resist especially counters his All Out bonus damage and gives you survivability to extend fights.

olaf__kalista.notes:
- Threat: Kalista's Rend applies stacking spears; avoid letting her build spear stacks on you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Pierce and Rend combo chunk hard with attack speed.
- Trading: Bait her Martial Poise lunge away from you, then Undertow and trade back.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you walk through Fate's Call knockback; use this aggression.
- Spike: Her first item spike (Kraken Slayer or similar) is dangerous; avoid all-ins then.
- Window: Level 6 onwards with Ragnarok active; chase her down and tank her damage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; her kiting and Rend punish extended pushing hard.
- Rune: Conqueror converts your true damage and repeated hits into sustained trading advantage here.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature early if she stacks magic damage; helps survive poke.

olaf__karthus.notes:
- Threat: Requiem deals unavoidable damage to all champions; dodge Lay Waste to avoid burst.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Karthus weak early, use this to scale and pressure.
- Trading: Bait Lay Waste by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Requiem forces you to end fights quickly or play around channels; stay aggressive.
- Spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; continue pressuring before he gains mana sustain.
- Window: Levels 2-5 are your best window; force fights before Karthus gains defensive items.
- Wave: Shove waves hard to deny Karthus safety and force him to choose: fight or lose CS.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained damage and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing trades.
- Item: Build Force of Nature if Karthus stacks magic damage; scales with resists from Ragnarok.

olaf__karma.notes:
- Threat: Karma's Focused Resolve root locks you down; her poke keeps you at distance before all-ins.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Inner Flame outranges you, so avoid walking up without Undertow ready.
- Trading: Bait Inner Flame by moving unpredictably, then all-in when her cooldown is down; dodge tether setup.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity breaks Focused Resolve root, turning fights in your favor; activate during her tether attempt.
- Spike: Her first item spike (staff items) increases poke damage; punish her immobility by forcing close fights.
- Window: Mid-game when Ragnarok's cooldown aligns with her Mantra timing; engage during her vulnerable windows.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces her to overextend for poke, letting you all-in with Undertow.
- Rune: Conqueror; sustained damage through trades and True Damage from Reckless Swing scales harder than her burst.
- Item: Abyssal Mask; reduces her magic damage and gives survivability to tank her poke and root attempts.

olaf__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Death Lotus channels massive magic damage; dodge it or interrupt with Ragnarok immunity.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Bouncing Blade outranges your early trading potential significantly.
- Bait Shunpo onto you, then trade back hard with Reckless Swing true damage.
- Post-6 Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Death Lotus; activate during her channel to punish.
- Her first Liandry's spike hurts; farm safely and avoid extended trades in that window.
- You spike harder at two items; build tankiness then engage when her ult is down.
- Shove the wave into her tower; deny her Dagger pickups and reset her cooldowns.
- Take Conqueror to stack true damage in extended trades and sustain her poke.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage output and support your tankiness.

olaf__kayle.notes:
- threat: Kayle's Divine Judgment makes her untargetable and invulnerable, negating your burst and all-in potential completely.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayle outranges you heavily, so avoid trading and focus on last-hitting minions only.
- trading: Don't chase Kayle's Radiant Blast skillshot; bait it out, then all-in when it's down and she's vulnerable.
- post6: Ragnarok becomes critical—activate it before her Divine Judgment lands so you stay immune to her invulnerability lock.
- spike: Kayle's first item spike around 1-2 items is dangerous; she gains range and burst, making ganks riskier for you.
- window: Mid-game teamfights when Kayle ult is down and you're high health give you windows to threaten her backline.
- wave: Shove the wave into her tower early; forces her to choose between farming safely or trading, limiting her poke.
- rune: Conqueror gives you sustained damage and healing to survive her poke and scale into mid-game teamfights.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks her burst magic damage and gives you a shield against her Divine Judgment followup.

olaf__kennen.notes:
- Threat: Kennen stuns you repeatedly via Mark of the Storm—avoid his three-hit combo at all costs.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Thundering Shuriken outranges your tools, so respect spacing near minions.
- Trading: Bait his Electrical Surge activation, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing before he marks you thrice.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you tank Slicing Maelstrom; activate it during his ult to dominate fights.
- Spike: First item spike hits around ten minutes—dodge his poke, farm safely, prepare to run him down post-six.
- Window: Level 6 onward is your window; Ragnarok negates his stun lockdown, turning teamfights heavily in your favor.
- Wave: Shove the wave constantly to deny his roaming and force him to defend tower.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained damage during extended skirmishes where Ragnarok keeps you alive and fighting.
- Item: Build Force of Nature early to negate his magical damage and shield yourself from burst.

olaf__kled.notes:
- threat: Kled's Jousting dash and Bear Trap on a Rope hook lock you down before you can retaliate.
- early: Play safe; Kled out-damages you early. Farm at range with Undertow and avoid extended trades.
- trading: Bait his Jousting dash, then engage. Dodge Bear Trap on a Rope by moving unpredictably sideways.
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Kled's cc and chase him when mounted or dismounted.
- spike: Kled spikes harder at first item. Use your sustain scaling to survive and out-duel later.
- window: Mid-game when you're tankier; Kled relies on burst and mobility you eventually out-sustain and out-tank.
- wave: Shove to deny Kled roams and force him to contest; limits his map pressure significantly.
- rune: Conqueror for extended duels; stacking true damage synergizes with your Reckless Swing true damage output.
- item: Force of Nature blocks his physical and mixed damage burst while giving you magic resist scaling.

olaf__lissandra.notes:
- Threat: Lissandra's W Ring of Frost roots you, stopping your engage and Ragnarok disable immunity window.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Q Ice Shard outranges your engage, avoid walking forward unnecessarily.
- Trading: Bait her W Ring of Frost by walking near her, then disengage before it triggers.
- Post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to her R Frozen Tomb stun, but dodge her W root first.
- Spike: Her first item spike (Liandry's or Demonic) is minimal threat; you outscale her hard at two items.
- Window: Olaf powerspikes hard when Ragnarok is active and you close distance; use it to force fights.
- Wave: Shove wave into tower early to deny her safe farming and force her to use mana.
- Rune: Take Unflinching to reduce crowd control duration from her W and E slowing effects significantly.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage and increase your survivability in extended trades.

olaf__locke.notes:
- threat: Locke's Silver Stake magic damage scales with your missing Health; his execute ultimate punishes low-HP aggression.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Locke outranges with Ritual Nails. Farm defensively and avoid clustered minions he can mark.
- trading: Never trade into marked enemies—Locke converts marks into bonus damage. Bait Ritual Nails by positioning behind minions, then all-in.
- post6: Purgatory execute forces you off low-Health fights. Use Ragnarok immunity to frontload damage before he triggers execute threshold.
- spike: First item spike (likely Liandry's or Nashor's Tooth) hurts; avoid extended trades. Your powerspike window is delayed past first base.
- window: Post-first-item when you complete Hollow Radiance or Force of Nature, magic resist nullifies his Silver Stake scaling advantage.
- wave: Shove consistently into him; his execute punishes you under tower. Denies him safety to chain Ritual Nails into your wave.
- rune: Grasp of the Undying—sustain through poke and convert his damage into tankiness during extended short trades.
- item: Hollow Radiance early; scales your tankiness and directly counters his magic damage on-hit and execute threat.

olaf__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force knocks you airborne; follow up with Ground Slam to cripple your Attack Speed hard.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Malphite out-trades you with Thunderclap spam and Granite Shield sustain easily.
- Trading: Bait Seismic Shard with movement, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing before he repositions.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Unstoppable Force knockup; activate R proactively when he engages.
- Spike: Malphite's first armor item (Kaenic Rookern or Thornmail) blocks your sustained damage; respect his defensive power spike.
- Window: Post-6 with Ragnarok active, you win all-ins; hunt him when his ult is down cooldown.
- Wave: Shove hard into tower; forces Malphite to choose between defending tower or roaming with ult.
- Rune: Conqueror stacks through his armor; synergizes with Reckless Swing true damage and extended fights.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from his magic burst and Seismic Shard steal attempts.

olaf__malzahar.notes:
- Threat: Nether Grasp suppression locks you down; Malzahar kills you while you cannot move or use Ragnarok.
- Early: Safely farm; avoid extended trades since Malefic Visions refresh damage through your abilities and you lack escape.
- Trading: Dodge Call of the Void silence by positioning unpredictably; bait his Void Shift shield before committing damage.
- Post6: Nether Grasp becomes lethal; you cannot cleanse it, so respect his zone and never fight isolated without vision.
- Spike: His first Liandry's Torment is dangerous; sustained damage from Malefic Visions burns through your health quickly with magic pen.
- Window: After Nether Grasp cooldown ends, immediately all-in him; he has no defensive tool and Ragnarok immunity breaks his suppress.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny Malzahar's Void Swarm positioning and force him to defend or lose tower pressure.
- Rune: Take Unflinching; reduces Nether Grasp's suppress duration slightly and gives you tenacity to escape his crowd control faster.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance; magic resist blocks Malefic Visions and Liandry's damage while Ragnarok passive stacks your defenses higher.

olaf__mel.notes:
- Mel's Overwhelm stacks enable Golden Eclipse to delete you from any distance regardless of positioning
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Radiant Barrage poke outranges your all-ins, farm with Q when possible
- Never walk through her Solar Snare root; bait it by moving unpredictably, then all-in before cooldown
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable CC but not the damage; use it aggressively post-6
- Her first item spike (likely Liandry's or Shadowflame) is dangerous; avoid extended trades during this window
- You spike harder at two items with defensive stats; look to all-in her when she's overextended
- Shove the wave to deny her Radiant Barrage poke reset procs and create jungle gank opportunities
- Take Phase Rush to kite her projectiles and reposition out of Solar Snare before it roots you
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce her ability damage and increase your survivability in extended fights

olaf__masteryi.notes:
- Threat: Master Yi's Alpha Strike untargetability and Highlander immunity to slows lets him kite and escape your engage relentlessly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Master Yi out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades near his minions.
- Trading: Bait his Alpha Strike with positioning, then commit E true damage when he lands. Never chase him into fog of war.
- Post6: Ragnarok becomes critical. Activate it before his Highlander to stay immune to slows and maintain threat during his ultimate duration.
- Spike: First item spike (Kraken Slayer or Trinity) empowers his sustained damage. Shove wave early and invade his jungle during this window.
- Window: Level 11+ gives you a power edge when Ragnarok cooldown is lower. Hunt him when his Highlander is down; punish relentlessly.
- Wave: Shove the wave constantly to deny him safe farming and force him to fight you in river or jungle.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage stacking and healing through his Meditate trades and kiting patterns.
- Item: Add a Black Cleaver early to shred his armor and stick to him better despite his Highlander Move Speed.

olaf__naafiri.notes:
- Naafiri's packmates pile damage while her bleeds stack; kite and dodge Darkin Daggers skillshots.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her packmates out-trade you early, so farm at range with Q.
- Bait Darkin Daggers by moving unpredictably, then all-in when cooldown is down; dodge the skillshot.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her crowd control; activate it during Hounds' Pursuit.
- Her first item spike around level 9 is dangerous; respect her damage and stay healthy.
- You spike when Ragnarok is active and her cooldowns are down; chase her then relentlessly.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her packmate targets and force her to farm under tower.
- Take Conqueror for sustained trading damage as you manage Berserker Rage stacking throughout fights.
- Add Spirit Visage early if her bleed damage and magic resist scaling threaten your durability.

olaf__nami.notes:
- Nami's Aqua Prison stun locks you down; follow up with Ebb and Flow burst kills you.
- Farm safely at range; her Q is a skillshot—dodge it by positioning unpredictably near minions.
- Bait her Aqua Prison by walking forward, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge it.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her Tidal Wave stun; activate ult proactively before her engage.
- Nami's first item spike (around 2-3 items) increases her burst; punish her before she completes.
- Level 6+ your Ragnarok disable immunity shifts power to you; all-in when she wastes cooldowns.
- Push wave into her tower early to deny her safe farming and force positioning mistakes.
- Conqueror sustains through her poke and true damage burst from Reckless Swing; synergizes perfectly.
- Hollow Radiance mitigates her bonus magic damage from Tidecaller's Blessing and Ebb and Flow spam.

olaf__nasus.notes:
- Wither slows your Attack Speed and Move Speed, crippling your ability to stick and trade damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nasus will stack Siphoning Strike. Avoid extended trades near his minions.
- Bait Wither with fake engages, then disengage. Trade when his W is on cooldown only.
- Ragnarok makes Nasus tankier and gives him range. Your all-in pressure window shrinks significantly post-6.
- His first item spike (typically Sheen into Trinity) increases his Q damage—punish him before completion.
- You spike hardest levels 1-5 before his defensive scaling. All-in aggressively before he completes items.
- Push the wave into his tower early. Force him to choose between farming safely or fighting you.
- Take Conqueror; it stacks faster than his scaling and sustains through his Spirit Fire poke.
- Build a Kaenic Rookern early if he stacks armor. It amplifies your true damage and blocks his resist.

olaf__nautilus.notes:
- Threat: Nautilus' point-and-click Staggering Blow root locks you down for Depth Charge follow-up damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Dredge Line cooldown is long, so respect its range always.
- Trading: Bait Dredge Line by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it misses; dodge Riptide by spacing.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Depth Charge CC, but still respect the knockup damage window.
- Spike: Nautilus' first item (Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) spikes his tankiness; this is your punish window.
- Window: You spike harder mid-game when Ragnarok active uptime matters most; abuse this before his items stack.
- Wave: Shove waves hard to deny Nautilus repeated Dredge Line engages from river; minimize his hookable range.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for true damage synergy with Reckless Swing and extended fight sustain against his tanks.
- Item: Add Force of Nature if Nautilus builds AP; it blocks his Titan's Wrath DoT damage scaling.

olaf__neeko.notes:
- threat: Neeko's E Tangle-Barbs roots you, setting up her R Pop Blossom for guaranteed stun and burst damage.
- early: Safely farm; respect Neeko's Q Blooming Burst range and E Tangle-Barbs potential. Stay unpredictable to dodge skillshots.
- trading: Bait out her E Tangle-Barbs, then all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing. Don't trade into her W.
- post6: Activate R Ragnarok before her R Pop Blossom lands to stay immune to the stun; maintain attacking to extend immunity.
- spike: First Liandry's Torment hits around 10 minutes; dodge more carefully but you can still all-in if her cooldowns are down.
- window: All-in her when E Tangle-Barbs is on cooldown and your Q Undertow is available; pick up axe for reset potential.
- wave: Shove to her tower; forces her to choose between farming and preparing E Tangle-Barbs, limiting her ability to set up ganks.
- rune: Take Conqueror; sustained true damage from E Reckless Swing and attack speed from P Berserker Rage maximize extended fights.
- item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce her burst and magic damage while providing armor, health, and cooldown reduction.

olaf__nidalee.notes:
- Threat: Nidalee's Javelin Toss poke from range forces you to engage or take sustained damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; dodge her Javelin Toss by moving unpredictably and staying behind minions.
- Trading: Bait her Javelin Toss, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing while she's on cooldown.
- Post6: Nidalee gains Pounce mobility; respect her burst combo but your Ragnarok immunity negates her disable threat.
- Spike: Her first Liandry's Torment spike hurts; avoid prolonged fights but punish her when she wastes cooldowns.
- Window: Level 6 onward with Ragnarok active—activate it mid-fight to ignore her burst and lock her down.
- Wave: Shove it consistently; forces Nidalee to defend or roam, reducing her free poke and gank setup.
- Rune: Conqueror; sustain through her poke and true damage scaling rewards extended trading where you dominate.
- Item: Abyssal Mask; grants magic resist and passive healing reduction counter, reducing her burst and her healing.

olaf__orianna.notes:
- Threat: Command: Shockwave launches you away from fights, disrupting your engage and teamfight presence entirely.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Orianna out-ranges you heavily. Use minions for cover, avoid her Q poke.
- Trading: Bait Command: Attack forward, then all-in when her Ball is far. Dodge nothing; close gap fast.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through Command: Shockwave knockback during ultimate activation; use this aggressively.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or Luden's) around 10 minutes is dangerous; respect her poke, farm safely then.
- Window: Level 6 onwards when Ragnarok active lets you ignore her lockdown; all-in when her ult cooldown resets.
- Wave: Push to her tower when safe; forces her to defend, reducing her time to poke or roam.
- Rune: Conqueror; sustains through her magic damage poke and true damage from Reckless Swing self-hit.
- Item: Force of Nature scales against her magic damage and gives move speed to close gaps faster.

olaf__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's Brittle effect amplifies all your damage taken; avoid extended fights when Brittle procs.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ornn's Q-W combo chunks hard and his terrain collision denies all-ins.
- Bait Ornn's Q fissure by sidestepping, then close with E true damage while he recovers.
- Post-6, Ragnarok immunity trivializes Ornn's Brittle slow and knockup; use it to engage his ult.
- After Ornn completes first item, his resistances spike hard; delay all-ins until you have Black Cleaver.
- You spike hardest at two items with Black Cleaver and Titanic Hydra; force fights then.
- Shove the wave to deny Ornn's Q slam safety and force him to engage into your tower.
- Take Conqueror to shred his scaling resistances and apply true damage pressure throughout the fight.
- Build Black Cleaver early to shred his bonus resistances and convert your E true damage advantage.

olaf__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's W Shield Vault stuns you, setting up his burst combo before you can retaliate or escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q Comet Spear outranges your trading. Farm defensively and avoid his empowered spells.
- Bait his W Shield Vault by positioning near minions, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge Q.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore his W stun, massively swinging the matchup in your favor.
- His first item spike around 1000 gold isn't a major threat; you can duel him if he wastes W.
- After level 6, all-in when Pantheon engages poorly or wastes Ragnarok duration; you win extended fights.
- Shove the wave early to deny him roam pressure and control his all-in range near your tower.
- Take Conqueror for extended trading power and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing against his tanky builds.
- Build Force of Nature if he stacks magic damage; it amplifies your healing and reduces his burst.

olaf__rammus.notes:
- Rammus taunts lock you down; Frenzying Taunt forces you into his Defensive Ball Curl damage return.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades since Rammus outscales early with Armor stacking.
- Bait Powerball by positioning near walls; dodge the skillshot, then all-in before Defensive Ball Curl activates.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Frenzying Taunt disable; activate during his taunt to stay aggressive.
- After Rammus completes Thornmail, his Spiked Shell damage spikes hard; respect the armor scaling window.
- You spike when Rammus runs out of mana or Defensive Ball Curl cooldown; punish immediately.
- Shove the wave into his tower to deny him easy Armor stacking from minion trades safely.
- Take Conqueror; you need sustained damage to shred his resistances and drain-tank his return damage.
- Buy Force of Nature if magic damage is high; it blocks his Soaring Slam and Powerball.

olaf__renataglasc.notes:
- Threat: Hostile Takeover forces Olaf to attack while berserk, wasting Ragnarok's disable immunity value.
- Early: Farm safely; Renata's Q Handshake is a skillshot you can dodge by positioning unpredictably.
- Trading: Avoid her marked targets to deny Leverage bonus damage; bait Q before committing trades.
- Post6: Ragnarok counters Hostile Takeover's disable effect but not the berserk damage; activate carefully for value.
- Spike: First item spike (Liandry's or similar) is moderate threat; your Berserker Rage scaling outpaces her.
- Window: Mid-game when Ragnarok cooldown resets frequently; hunt her isolated before teamfights form.
- Wave: Shove waves hard to deny her safe farming and force her into risky rotations.
- Rune: Conqueror applies true damage stacking; synergizes with Reckless Swing's true damage on targets.
- Item: Hollow Radiance provides magic resist against her E Loyalty Program and R Hostile Takeover.

olaf__riven.notes:
- Riven's stun from Ki Burst locks you down before you can retaliate or escape fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q combo outdamages you early. Farm at range with Undertow.
- Bait her E Valor for protection, then engage when it's on cooldown with Reckless Swing.
- Ragnarok makes you immune to her W Ki Burst stun; activate it aggressively when she rotates.
- Her first item spike around 1000 gold is dangerous; respect her all-in before you complete items.
- Punish Riven when she wastes Q Broken Wings on the wave; all-in her immediately after.
- Shove the wave to deny her melee CS and force her to choose between farming or roaming.
- Conqueror scales your true damage from Reckless Swing and sustain through extended trades significantly.
- Buy Force of Nature if Riven builds lethality; its magic resist and move speed counter burst.

olaf__sett.notes:
- Threat: The Show Stopper slam locks you down and deals massive damage; Haymaker true damage punishes low health.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Sett's alternating punches and Knuckle Down out-trade you; farm at distance with Q.
- Trading: Bait Facebreaker by positioning on one side only; dodge Haymaker's center by moving unpredictably during his W channel.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity counters The Show Stopper; activate R when Sett commits to his ultimate engage attempt.
- Spike: Sett spikes harder with first item; avoid extended fights until you complete your core; poke with Undertow instead.
- Window: You scale better; outmaneuver him mid-game when his engage cooldowns reset slower than your Q cooldown resets.
- Wave: Shove wave into tower; prevents Sett from using the wave to trap or all-in you with terrain advantage.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying; sustain through Sett's trades and scale health into damage for Berserker Rage value.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces Haymaker's shield value and his healing from Pit Grit significantly in extended fights.

olaf__sion.notes:
- Threat: Sion's Q stun locks you down; his R knocks you up and chains crowd control.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Sion's Q requires charge time, so abuse his vulnerability early.
- Trading: Bait his Q charge by backing off, then all-in with E true damage while he recovers.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through his R charge; activate it when he commits.
- Spike: First item spike (Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) strengthens him; farm safely and scale.
- Window: Mid-game when Ragnarok is up and Sion lacks defensive items; run him down relentlessly.
- Wave: Shove hard into tower; force him to choose between defending tower or fighting you.
- Rune: Conqueror for sustained true damage trading and healing through his poke and tanking.
- Item: Add Force of Nature second if Sion builds heavy AP; mitigates magic damage and slows.

olaf__singed.notes:
- Singed kites you with Mega Adhesive and Fling while applying Grievous Wounds; you cannot chase effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his Poison Trail and respect Fling range—farm at distance.
- Bait Mega Adhesive before committing trades; dodge Fling skillshot by moving unpredictably sideways always.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disables; activate it when he Flings to close gap.
- His first Rylai's spike is dangerous; buy early Abyssal Mask to survive his poke.
- You spike harder at two items with defensive stats; all-in when his Insanity Potion cooldown is down.
- Shove the wave to deny him safe roaming; force him to farm under tower pressure.
- Take Conqueror for sustained damage and healing against his tankiness and Grievous Wounds debuff.
- Build Hollow Radiance early to reduce his Poison Trail damage and amplify your survivability significantly.

olaf__syndra.notes:
- Threat: Scatter the Weak stun chains after Dark Spheres hit; Unleashed Power deals massive damage from range.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; dodge Q Dark Spheres and respect her E Scatter the Weak range.
- Trading: Bait her E Scatter the Weak before all-inning; dodge Q Dark Spheres with movement, engage after.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her E stuns; activate during her Unleashed Power burst.
- Spike: First item Liandry's Torment spike hurts; abuse Olaf's early strength before her damage multipliers scale.
- Window: Level 6 onward with Ragnarok active; dive through her stuns and close distance with sustained pressure.
- Wave: Push wave into her tower; forces her to choose between farming and poking with abilities.
- Rune: Adaptive Force in Precision; sustained damage and lifesteal synergize with Berserker Rage and Reckless Swing healing.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces her magic damage and gives armor against her entire spell rotation's scaling.

olaf__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Taliyah's Unraveled Earth stuns you mid-dash; her Seismic Shove denies your engages.
- Early: Farm safely at range; dodge Threaded Volley and avoid pushing into her minefield.
- Trading: Bait Seismic Shove or Unraveled Earth before committing; use Undertow to soften trades.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall enables her kite and escape; she controls the map's mobility.
- Spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Demonic) hurts; punish before completion or wait it out.
- Window: Post-Ragnarok activation you ignore disables; all-in when she's out of minefield coverage.
- Wave: Shove waves hard; force her to choose between waveclear and roaming pressure.
- Rune: Conqueror for sustained dueling and magic resist stacking through prolonged fights.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces her burst and amplifies your magic resist stacking value.

olaf__teemo.notes:
- Teemo's blind from Blinding Dart negates your autos and Reckless Swing damage output.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Undertow, avoid his auto-poison stacks.
- Bait his Blinding Dart with fake engages, then all-in when it's on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through his slows and engage despite Noxious Trap.
- His first Liandry's or Nashor's spike hurts; abuse him before he completes it.
- Post-6 with Ragnarok active you ignore his traps and blind—dive him when ready.
- Shove the wave to deny his brush control and force him into open fights.
- Press the Attack to maximize damage windows when his Blinding Dart is unavailable.
- Build Mercury's Treads to reduce blind duration and gain tenacity against his poisons.

olaf__talon.notes:
- Talon all-ins with Q and W gap-close damage, then escapes with E before you can retaliate effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q axe throws and avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait Talon's W Rake by moving unpredictably, then all-in when his E Assassin's Path is on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you stick to Talon post-6, but his Shadow Assault escape still kites you.
- Watch for Talon's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; play safer when he completes it, then exploit cooldowns.
- Your window is when Talon wastes E Assassin's Path terrain vault; immediately engage before he repositions again.
- Let the wave push toward your tower so Talon must overextend to dive; farm safely and punish ganks.
- Take Conqueror; true damage from E Reckless Swing and sustained trading synergize with its stacking armor shred.
