- Buy Force of Nature if Talon deals heavy early magic damage or gets multiple kills snowballing.

olaf__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate strips your Armor and Magic Resist, gutting your survivability when you need it most.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Chomp saps your Attack Damage and slows, denying extended trades.
- Trading: Avoid extended fights where Trundle auto-resets with Chomp; bait Pillar of Ice then disengage hard.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you fight through Subjugate's stat theft, but expect doubled steals over four seconds.
- Spike: First item spike (Hollow Radiance or similar) is dangerous; Trundle gains massive healing and resistances on his domain.
- Window: Mid-game when Trundle lacks tankiness; all-in before he completes defenses and Subjugate becomes overwhelming.
- Wave: Shove waves hard to deny Frozen Domain value and force Trundle to choose between farming and roaming.
- Rune: Conqueror stacks true damage and healing, bypassing the Armor and Magic Resist he steals from you.
- Item: Add a Maw of Malmortius to mitigate magic damage and shield against his burst health theft.

olaf__twitch.notes:
- Twitch's Spray and Pray pierces through you, applying Deadly Venom stacks across your entire team.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Twitch out-ranges you heavily. Farm with Q when he's not visible.
- Dodge Venom Cask by moving sideways; it's his only ranged slow. All-in when he's on cooldown.
- Post-6 Spray and Pray becomes lethal; respect his range and positioning. Play around fog of war.
- His first item spike (Manamune or Kraken Slayer) is dangerous. Abuse him before he completes it.
- You spike hardest mid-game with Ragnarok active; force teamfights when his ult is down or cooldown.
- Shove the wave into his tower to deny him safe farming and reduce his Ambush value.
- Take Conqueror; true damage and healing scales with extended fights where he can't kite forever.
- Buy a Maw of Malmortius for magic resist and spell shield against his Contaminate burst.

olaf__varus.notes:
- Varus Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; dodge it or you're locked down for his full combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Varus outranges you with Piercing Arrow, so farm from distance or lose health.
- Bait his Hail of Arrows by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down; avoid his root.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Chain of Corruption; activate it proactively when you see the tendril coming.
- His first crit item spike hurts; don't fight him alone then, instead farm safely or group.
- Level 6 onwards you win all-ins if you dodge Chain of Corruption; look for gank setups.
- Shove the wave to deny him safe poke range and force him to farm under tower.
- Take Conqueror; it stacks fast in extended trades and converts your damage into healing against his poke.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius to block his Blight detonations and gain magic resist against his burst.

olaf__vayne.notes:
- Threat: Vayne's Silver Bolts true damage and Condemn stun lock you down and burst through your tankiness.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vayne out-trades you with Tumble kiting and Silver Bolts procs; farm passively.
- Trading: Avoid chasing Vayne into terrain where Condemn stuns you; bait her Tumble, then engage with Q.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank her burst, but Final Hour invisibility makes landing Undertow nearly impossible.
- Spike: Her first item spike (Blade of The Ruined King) is dangerous; you lack sustained damage to duel.
- Window: You spike hardest mid-game with tankiness; engage when she's isolated without terrain nearby for Condemn walls.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Vayne needs terrain for Condemn stuns, denying her tower-dive threat.
- Rune: Press the Attack amplifies your all-in potential and helps overwhelm her kiting-focused survival strategy.
- Item: Add Spirit Visage for magic resist against her true damage scaling and stronger shield from W.

olaf__vex.notes:
- Threat: Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your dashes and Ragnarok's dash immunity doesn't block fear.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Mistral Bolt outranges your engagement tools, farm under tower.
- Trading: Avoid walking into Personal Space range; bait Looming Darkness before all-inning with Undertow.
- Post6: Shadow Surge marks you for guaranteed follow-up; use Ragnarok to stay attacking and unstoppable.
- Spike: Vex's first item spike (Luden's) threatens burst; this is your punish window to engage.
- Window: Level 6+ when Ragnarok online; activate it, ignore her fear, and drain her with Berserker Rage.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard; forces Vex to CS while backing or taking tower damage.
- Rune: Conqueror; sustains you through poke and true damage from Reckless Swing stacking.
- Item: Force of Nature; magic resist and tenacity reduce Vex burst and fear lock duration.

olaf__viego.notes:
- Threat: Viego's W stun locks you down; his R executes you before you respond or escape.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Viego has no real damage yet, so CS freely and avoid his W.
- Trading: Bait Viego's W by moving unpredictably, then E him during his charge-up for true damage trade.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore his W stun, but his R execution still threatens you hard.
- Spike: His first Blade of the Ruined King spike (health shred + lifesteal) is a danger window; respect it.
- Window: You spike when Ragnarok is active and he wastes W; all-in him then before R cools down.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; let Viego push and gank him, since he needs kills to scale.
- Rune: Conqueror because true damage stacking plus tankiness from it sustains through his percent health damage better.
- Item: Hollow Radiance blocks his execute damage and reduces his magic resist, cutting his survivability during fights.

olaf__vladimir.notes:
- Threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool makes him untargetable; you cannot reliably all-in him without reading his dodge timing.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Vladimir outranges you with Transfusion and you cannot force favorable trades yet without resources.
- Trading: Bait Sanguine Pool with Undertow or E, then commit with Reckless Swing when he's vulnerable and pooled.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore his crowd control, but Hemoplague amplifies all his damage significantly—respect the burst.
- Spike: First item spike (Protobelt or similar AP item) increases Vladimir's burst window; play around cooldowns and avoid clumping.
- Window: Your level 6 spike with Ragnarok active immunity outduels him if you close the gap before Hemoplague lands.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny Vladimir safe Transfusion farming and force him to choose between defending or scaling safely.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage trading; it ignores his resistances and stacks through his tankiness.
- Item: Build Force of Nature early to reduce his magic damage and spike your resistances before he completes AP items.

olaf__warwick.notes:
- Threat: Warwick's W Blood Hunt and R Infinite Duress lock you down when low; you cannot escape.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Warwick outduels you early. Farm at range, avoid close trades.
- Trading: Bait his E Primal Howl before committing Q Undertow; his damage reduction negates your burst.
- Post6: R Ragnarok immunity to disables is critical—activate it the moment R Infinite Duress suppresses you.
- Spike: Warwick's first item spike around 1200g is dangerous; your E Reckless Swing true damage scales better later.
- Window: Your power edge arrives mid-game when Ragnarok cooldown resets; use it to duel freely and dive.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Warwick W Blood Hunt triggers and reduce gank setup time.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained dueling damage; true damage from E Reckless Swing stacks it faster than Warwick heals.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce his W Blood Hunt healing and E Primal Howl damage reduction value.

olaf__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's Shocking Orb stun locks you down; follow-up damage while immobilized kills you fast.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, dodge his W barrage positioning.
- Bait Shocking Orb by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown immediately.
- Ragnarok immunity to his stun turns the fight; activate during his E cooldown.
- First item spike (Lost Chapter) hurts; abuse window before he completes it fully.
- Post-Ragnarok activation and when his E is down you can gap close and duel.
- Shove wave into tower; denies his W zone control and forces him to react.
- Conqueror stacks through his poke and converts true damage into healing via Reckless Swing.
- Maw of Malmortius shields magic burst and synergizes with your missing health mechanics perfectly.

olaf__xinzhao.notes:
- Threat: Xin Zhao's Three Talon Strike knockup chains with Audacious Charge engage; you get locked down and burst.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; Xin out-trades you early. Play safe, farm with Q, avoid all-ins before level 6.
- Trading: Dodge Wind Becomes Lightning's slow and Challenged mark; if marked, Audacious Charge gains range. Trade only after his Q cooldown.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore his knockup chain. Activate during his Three Talon Strike to fight freely.
- Spike: His Trinity Force spike hurts hard around 10-12 minutes. Play safe then; your damage doesn't match yet.
- Window: You spike at level 6 with Ragnarok; fight him when your ultimate is up and his isn't.
- Wave: Shove the wave constantly; roaming and skirmishing suits you better than extended laning. Deny him freeze opportunities.
- Rune: Take Conqueror; true damage from Reckless Swing and extended fights favor you over his burst windows.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance; his attack speed and damage get reduced, and you gain tankiness to survive his burst.

olaf__yorick.notes:
- Yorick's Maiden and Mist Walkers deal sustained damage you can't burst through safely alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Yorick out-trades with Q bonus damage and Mist Walker harassment.
- Bait his E Mourning Mist by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore his W Dark Procession wall and E slow.
- His first item spike (Stride Breaker or Black Cleaver) is dangerous; avoid extended fights.
- You spike harder at level 11 when Ragnarok upgrades; use it to teamfight his summons.
- Shove the wave hard to deny him Mist Walkers from minion kills and poke safety.
- Take Conqueror to stack true damage stacking against his tankiness and sustained trading patterns.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early if his poke and Maiden damage threaten your lane sustainability.

olaf__yone.notes:
- Yone's Fate Sealed blink dash pulls you in; dodge it or die to follow-up damage chain.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Undertow, avoid trading into his Way of the Hunter procs.
- Bait his Q Mortal Steel stacks, then all-in when he wastes Gathering Storm; dodge Fate Sealed at all costs.
- Post-6 Ragnarok immunity lets you tank his rotation, but Fate Sealed still locks you down if you're caught out.
- His first item spike (likely Kraken Slayer or Navori) is your window; he's immobile before two items, run him down.
- Level 11 when Ragnarok cooldown drops; you can reengage constantly and sustain through his magic damage trades effectively.
- Shove the wave hard; force him to choose between pushing back or roaming, limiting his map pressure and gank setup.
- Conqueror stacks faster against his mixed damage and sustains you through his magic damage and true poke attempts.
- Build Hollow Radiance to reduce his magic damage and shield strength, then pursue your normal tanky Olaf itemization path.

olaf__yunara.notes:
- Threat: Yunara's On-Hit spread damage and Transcendent State upgrades force you into unfavorable extended fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q poke outranges your engage, farm with Q when possible.
- Trading: Bait her W Arc of Judgment by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E true damage.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her slows, but Transcendent State makes her deadlier—respect her burst.
- Spike: Her first item spike is dangerous; play around her range advantage until you complete your items.
- Window: You dominate post-Sheen when you can stick and trade true damage; use E aggressively then.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny her safe poke range; reset and repeat to control tempo.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage scaling in extended trades against her high On-Hit.
- Item: Add Maw of Malmortius to block her bonus magic damage from Critical Strikes early.

olaf__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's Lightning Crash and Spark Surge mobility chains let her kite and burst you down while staying out of range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Burst Fire pokes hard and Spark Surge creates distance. Farm with Undertow and avoid extended trades.
- Bait Spark Surge dashes away from you, then close with Undertow and Q to reset cooldown. Don't chase blindly into walls.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her slows, but Lightning Crash damage and stacking Move Speed still chunk hard.
- Her first Manamune or Trinity Force spike is dangerous; she gains range, sustain, and burst. Push for kills before this completes.
- You spike harder mid-game around level 11 when Ragnarok cooldown drops and you itemize tankiness; abuse this before her late-game scaling.
- Shove the wave into her tower to deny her roam potential and force her to choose: farm or roam without pressure.
- Take Conqueror; extended trades let you stack it while Berserker Rage sustain keeps you alive as her magic damage trades.
- Build a Maw of Malmortius to block her burst magic damage and shield yourself against Lightning Crash's high-impact discharges.

olaf__zyra.notes:
- Grasping Roots roots you in place; Zyra plants siege you down while immobilized and vulnerable.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her seeds spawn early, giving her plants for Q and E damage.
- Bait Grasping Roots by moving unpredictably, then all-in when her root cooldown is down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her roots and plants during teamfights; activate and run her down.
- First item spike around 800-1200 gold is dangerous; dodge root engage patterns before she completes items.
- After level 6, all-in when Grasping Roots misses; Ragnarok immunity makes her ult and roots useless.
- Shove the wave hard into her tower; plants cannot defend, and you deny seed placements near you.
- Conqueror stacks on her plants and roots; true damage from E ignores her shield value.
- Spirit Visage scales with your passive Life Steal and reduces Zyra's magic damage significantly mid-fight.

shen__aatrox.notes:
- threat: Aatrox's Q combo and W trap lock you down; his healing sustain outpaces your damage output
- early: Safe farm until level 3; dodge his Q swings and respect W damage; don't trade extended
- trading: Bait his Q cooldown, then trade with Q+E; never fight inside his W impact zone
- post6: Stand United lets you bail teammates; use it to escape his all-in or enable your jungler
- spike: His first item (usually Black Cleaver) is dangerous; avoid all-in trades when he has it completed
- window: Post-first-item, you spike harder with resistances stacked; abuse him when his cooldowns are down mid-fight
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Aatrox needs to extend to all-in you, and ganks punish him
- rune: Aftershock; it converts his burst into survivability and gives you armor/MR when he engages
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts his healing into a weakness you can exploit repeatedly in extended fights

shen__ahri.notes:
- Charm stops your Shadow Dash mid-dash and forces you toward Ahri helplessly; extremely punishing.
- Play safe; Ahri out-ranges you early. Farm with Q when she positions aggressively.
- Never dash predictably into Charm range. Bait her E with positioning, then trade or disengage.
- Stand United now shields an ally while you're vulnerable; respect her ult's teamfight impact immediately.
- First item spike (typically Liandry's or Shadowflame) around 12 minutes—play safe, farm under tower if needed.
- Post-15 minutes when you have Jak'Sho or first magic resist item; her burst damage falls off.
- Hold wave near your tower; you lack waveclear and pushing invites Charm + gank combos.
- Aftershock: reduces Charm's all-in damage and gives resistances to survive her burst trades.
- Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing for you and blocks Charm's movespeed bonus.

shen__akali.notes:
- Threat: Akali's W invisibility lets her burst you unpredictably; her E-R combo executes before you can react reliably.
- Early: Relatively safe—trade with Q poke and E-Grasp when she walks up; avoid extended fights in minion waves.
- Trading: Bait her E marked dash by backing away, then E-taunt her commitment; block her Q with W when possible.
- Post6: She becomes untouchable in shroud—E taunts her out but demands prediction; never chase into her W fog.
- Spike: First item (Protobelt or similar AP) is her danger spike; stay healthy and respect her all-in potential then.
- Window: Early game before her shroud mastery and levels 2–5 when E cooldown punishes her; post-item she controls fights.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower—lets you E-taunt her if she dives and keeps you safe from shroud engages.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination (Secondary into Relentless or Ravenous)—extra sustain and repositioning help you survive her burst windows.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her magic burst and synergizes with your defensive itemization without disrupting core build flow.

shen__akshan.notes:
- Threat: Avengerang's repeated poke and Heroic Swing mobility let Akshan kite and damage you safely from range.
- Early: Dangerous; Avengerang out-ranges your Q. Stay behind minions, avoid extended trades, focus on farming safely.
- Trading: Never chase Akshan into fog or terrain; he'll Heroic Swing away. Bait his E cooldown before committing.
- Post6: Stand United lets you ult an ally Akshan targets, but his Comeuppance scales with missing health—risky.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Kraken) accelerates his poke damage. Play safer; don't extend past river.
- Window: Mid-game when Akshan lacks defensive items. Land Shadow Dash taunts and all-in before his kite scales.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Akshan abuses shoved lanes with Heroic Swing mobility and Avengerang range.
- Rune: Aftershock; his Avengerang and attack speed combo punish extended trades—Aftershock armor mitigates burst and poke.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces his on-hit damage and Avengerang scaling, while giving you MR and healing reduction.

shen__alistar.notes:
- Alistar's Pulverize and Headbutt combo launches you into the air, leaving you vulnerable to follow-up damage and repositioning.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Alistar out-damages you early. Farm at range with Q, avoid pushing into him near minions.
- Bait his Q by positioning behind minions; if he commits Pulverize, Shadow Dash away or use Spirit's Refuge to block follow-up.
- Stand United's shield and teleport let you escape ganks and aid allies, but Alistar's CC still locks you down post-ult.
- Alistar's first item (Sunfire, Thornmail) is not a major spike; use this window to scale safely and farm for your items.
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items, you out-tank and out-duel him; punish him if he overextends without backup nearby.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Alistar's all-in threat is too high if lane is pushed. Safer to farm and scale.
- Take Aftershock for consistent survivability against his burst CC combo; negates Pulverize and Headbutt burst damage most effectively.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early to block his magic damage and CC amplification, turning his combo threat into manageable damage.

shen__amumu.notes:
- Threat: Amumu's R stuns and applies Curse; your W cannot block it, so you die in teamfights.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Amumu has no engage. Avoid bunching near him to deny W damage.
- Trading: Bait his Q Bandage Toss by moving unpredictably, then trade with E Shadow Dash while it's down.
- Post6: Amumu gains massive teamfight power with R Curse of the Sad Mummy; stop grouping predictably mid.
- Spike: First item (typically Liandry's) is moderate threat. Abuse him before he completes it and groups.
- Window: You spike harder at Sunfire Aegis or second defensive item; duel him before his R teamfight value.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; Amumu wants grouped teamfights. Deny his engage by staying split.
- Rune: Aftershock; his Q and R both trigger it, giving you armor and magic resist when stunned.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his bonus magic damage from Cursed Touch into healing, reducing his burst threat.

shen__ambessa.notes:
- Threat: Public Execution suppression into stun locks you down; Drakehound's Step mobility lets her chase and kite your engage.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1–3; Ambessa out-trades you with Cunning Sweep. Farm safely behind minions; do not extend without Spirit Blade protection.
- Trading: Bait her Cunning Sweep, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and reposition. Avoid extended fights; use Q poke when she misses.
- Post6: Stand United becomes crucial—shield allies she targets or ult away when she closes. Public Execution gap-close forces you to respect her range.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Manamune or Serrated Dirk) increases her burst and chase threat. Play safer; wait for her cooldown windows to trade.
- Window: Punish Ambessa when her E and W are down; she loses mobility and shield. Force fights on your terms after she wastes abilities.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; let it crash into you. Limits her all-in range and forces her to overextend for kills or resets.
- Rune: Aftershock. Converts her high-damage all-in attempts into mitigated burst; synergizes with your tankiness and Shadow Dash engage timing.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces her burst and Cunning Sweep damage; active healing reduction cripples her sustain and comeback potential.

shen__annie.notes:
- Pyromania stun after 4 spells; if caught, you're taunted and burst before Stand United saves you.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Annie outranges you. CS from distance, dodge Incinerate cones, don't force trades.
- Bait her spellcast cooldowns before engaging. Shadow Dash avoids Incinerate but not point-click stuns; don't chase.
- Stand United cannot save you from Pyromania stun into Summon Tibbers combo. Play around her stun counter.
- Annie first-item spike (Liandry's or similar) is dangerous around level 9–11. Farm safely, scale tankier.
- After Annie burns Pyromania and you land Shadow Dash taunt, you win the all-in. Abuse cooldown windows.
- Push wave into her tower. Annie struggles with mana pushing; denies her poke setup and ult threat range.
- Use Aftershock; it blocks burst damage and stun duration, reducing Pyromania combo lethality after you engage.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern early if Annie rushes Liandry's; the healing reduction denial hurts her sustained damage most.

shen__aphelios.notes:
- Threat: Aphelios out-ranges you significantly; his Calibrum marks and follow-up burst punish close approaches relentlessly.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3. Stay behind minions, avoid the river, and respect his range—do not trade.
- Trading: Never chase Aphelios or walk into his effective range. Dodge Calibrum marks by positioning behind waves.
- Post6: Stand United lets you gank or escape ganks, but Aphelios gains Moonlight Vigil burst—respect the damage spike.
- Spike: First item is a danger window; Aphelios gains raw stats and damage. Play safe and farm defensively.
- Window: You spike when Aphelios runs out of ammo or swaps to Severum. All-in during weapon transitions only.
- Wave: Slow-push toward Aphelios to force him to choose between farming and trading; limits his kiting room.
- Rune: Aftershock. Reduces burst from Moonlight Vigil and his sustained poke—armor and resistances matter more than sustain here.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Cuts through his sustained dps and any grievous wounds he may apply with off-hand weapons.

shen__aurelionsol.notes:
- Threat: Aurelion Sol's Astral Flight mobility and sustained Breath of Light damage zone you out and prevent engagement.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Aurelion Sol outranges you. Farm under tower, avoid walking into Breath of Light channel.
- Trading: Never chase Aurelion Sol or walk into his Breath of Light splash. Bait Astral Flight, then Shadow Dash engage.
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical to save teammates from Falling Star stun chains. You cannot duel him anymore.
- Spike: First item is danger window; Aurelion Sol gains Stardust scaling, making him unkillable. Play safe, scale defensively.
- Window: After Aurelion Sol exhausts Astral Flight cooldown, Shadow Dash in and trade hard before he resets flight.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Aurelion Sol must walk forward to damage; punish with Shadow Dash taunts into allies.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision); sustain and durability let you survive poke and scale into teamfights.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage and heals him less when he damages you with abilities.

shen__ashe.notes:
- Threat: Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns you from range; Frost Shot slows lock you down for her team.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay behind minions to block Volley cones; avoid predictable positioning for arrow.
- Trading: Dodge Volley by repositioning; never chase Ashe into fog. Use Shadow Dash to gap-close and taunt aggressively.
- Post6: Stand United saves teammates from stun chains but doesn't prevent the arrow; play around cooldown timers.
- Spike: First Manamune or crit item spikes her damage; threaten all-in before she stabilizes with items.
- Window: Levels 4-5 before her ultimate; pressure hard with Shadow Dash while she lacks teamfight security.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Ashe outranges you; let her push for gank setup and jungle assistance.
- Rune: Aftershock. Triggers on Shadow Dash taunt; converts her poke into your tankiness multiplier for trading.
- Item: Mercury's Treads. Reduces stun duration from Enchanted Crystal Arrow and Frost Shot slow for mobility resets.

shen__aurora.notes:
- threat: Aurora's Across the Veil invisibility and The Weirding slow lets her kite and escape your all-ins repeatedly.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Aurora outranges you with Twofold Hex. Wait for her to use it, then trade.
- trading: Bait Across the Veil with Shadow Dash threats; when she wastes it, engage hard before cooldown resets.
- post6: Stand United becomes her escape tool too—coordinate with jungler or accept she can split safely with ult cover.
- spike: First Shadowflame or Horizon Focus spike hurts; punish her before she finishes it by forcing fights near minions.
- window: Mid-game when Shadow Dash cooldown is lower than hers; chain-taunt her out of positioning and layer shields.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Aurora wants extended fights and roaming—denying space forces her into bad trades.
- rune: Grasp + Domination; extra tankiness and Cheap Shot procs when you land Shadow Dash taunts on her.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her spirit damage into healing and reduces her curse effectiveness if she builds AP.

shen__azir.notes:
- threat: Conquering Sands slows you; Emperor's Divide knocks back and interrupts Shadow Dash engagement attempts.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Azir out-ranges you. Farm safely, avoid walking into Sand Soldier lines.
- trading: Never trade into grouped Sand Soldiers. Bait Shifting Sands dash by positioning unpredictably, then Shadow Dash.
- post6: Stand United scales better for teamfights. Use ult to save allies Azir pressures; he cannot stop teleport.
- spike: First item (Liandry's or Shadowflame) around 10 min is moderate danger. You spike harder with two items.
- window: Mid-game (13-18 min) when Azir has limited cooldowns. Engage after his Shifting Sands or Conquering Sands lands.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Azir will push for poke damage; deny roam pressure and gank setup.
- rune: Aftershock. Blocks Emperor's Divide knockback effect and mitigates Sand Soldier poke during leveled fights.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces Azir's magic damage and applies Wound, cutting his sustain in extended fights.

shen__belveth.notes:
- threat: Bel'Veth's sustained DPS and attack speed stacks shred you; kite and burst you down before you lock her down.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Bel'Veth has weak early all-in. Use Q to poke and maintain distance; avoid overextending.
- trading: Bait her Q Void Surge cooldown, then trade back. Never let her stack attack speed freely; E taunt on approach.
- post6: Stand United lets you save allies from Endless Banquet burst, but you cannot stop her stat scaling. Play around cooldowns.
- spike: Her first item (likely attack speed or crit) spikes her DPS hard around 1-2 items; play safe, stack resistances.
- window: Mid-game before she fully stacks; abuse E taunt + W blocks to lock her down and force bad fights.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; forces Bel'Veth to dive or chase sideways, triggering your E taunt engage or W blocks.
- rune: Aftershock; gives you burst tankiness and damage reduction against her sustained high-attack-speed combo damage in extended trades.
- item: Thornmail; reflects her attack damage back and applies grievous wounds, reducing her lifesteal from E Royal Maelstrom healing.

shen__blitzcrank.notes:
- Threat: Rocket Grab catches you out of position; one mistake means death or forced ultimate.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay behind minions to block Rocket Grab and farm passively.
- Trading: Never trade when Rocket Grab is up; bait it by positioning near minions, then all-in.
- Post6: Stand United lets you escape Rocket Grab followup or save grabbed ally; use reactively.
- Spike: Blitzcrank's first item (typically Hollow Radiance or Abyssal) is not a major spike; farm safely.
- Window: Your power spike comes mid-game when you itemize MR; Blitzcrank falls off without successful hooks.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Rocket Grab danger increases if you're extended or split alone.
- Rune: Aftershock because Blitzcrank wants short all-ins and you need survivability on his engage attempt.
- Item: Build Kaenic Rookern early to reduce Static Field damage and enemy heal amplification threat.

shen__brand.notes:
- threat: Brand's Blaze stacking + Q stun chain locks you down; Pyroclasm bounces chain-stun you into oblivion
- early: Dangerous. Stay out of Q range; let wave push to you. Abuse minion block to avoid Sear stuns
- trading: Never trade into ablaze stacks on you. Bait his Q with E Shadow Dash, then all-in before stun resets
- post6: Stand United becomes your lifeline—teleport out before Pyroclasm bounces lock you; never fight near Brand after level 6
- spike: First Liandry or Rylai spike hurts hard. Punish him pre-first-item when he's mana-starved and vulnerable to all-ins
- window: Level 4-5 before his Q cooldown resets; engage when his Q is down and Blaze stacks fall off you
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Brand needs range; denying him safe poke on minions starves his Blaze stack resets and mana
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces Pyroclasm burst damage on you and amplifies your E taunt engage into guaranteed trade wins
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Cuts Brand's magic damage by 15% and reduces his Blaze DoT duration, making trades survivable early

shen__braum.notes:
- Threat: Concussive Blows stun locks you; Unbreakable blocks your Q projectile entirely.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; Braum Q applies stacks and slows you hard.
- Trading: Never trade into his shield. Bait Unbreakable with Q before committing E.
- Post6: Stand United saves allies from his R knockup; use it reactively.
- Spike: First item (typically Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance for him) empowers his tankiness dangerously.
- Window: Mid-game when Unbreakable cooldown expires and his mana runs low; rotate aggressively.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Pushing lets him land free Q slows and stack Concussive Blows.
- Rune: Aftershock. Reduces his burst and CC duration when you E through his team.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage into healing reduction against Concussive Blows procs.

shen__briar.notes:
- Briar's Head Rush stun and Blood Frenzy lock onto you; you cannot kite or escape her dive.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q has shorter range but stun is lethal; farm with Q from distance.
- Never dash toward her; bait Head Rush, then Shadow Dash away perpendicular; block her autos with Spirit's Refuge.
- Stand United becomes your lifeline; use it preemptively when she marks you with Certain Death, not reactively.
- Her first item spike (likely Black Cleaver or Sterak's) forces you to stack armor; farm safely and scale.
- Post-teamfight or when she wastes Head Rush cooldown; punish with Q trades while her engage tool recovers.
- Hold wave near tower; her engage range is short without Blood Frenzy; deny her roam time and picks.
- Run Aftershock; the damage reduction triggers on her Head Rush stun and negates burst from Certain Death follow-up.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early if ahead; it cuts her bleed healing and provides armor plus magic resist simultaneously.

shen__caitlyn.notes:
- threat: Caitlyn's Headshot and Ace in the Hole deal massive damage; her traps immobilize you before empowered shots.
- early: Dangerous levels 1-3. Stay behind minions to block Piltover Peacemaker, dodge Yordle Snap Trap, avoid her attack range.
- trading: Never walk into trap zones. Bait her 90 Caliber Net recoil backward, then Shadow Dash forward to taunt and trade.
- post6: Ace in the Hole forces you to position safer. Use Stand United proactively to shield allies before she lines up.
- spike: First item (Kraken Slayer or similar) spikes her Headshot damage hard. Play safer, respect her range, farm defensively.
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when Caitlyn lacks peel. Shadow Dash through her team to reach and taunt her.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Prevents Caitlyn from setting traps aggressively and forces her to overextend for poke damage.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces her burst and trap damage significantly when you engage with Shadow Dash or get hit by abilities.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces her physical Headshot and Ace in the Hole damage; boosts your survivability against her critical scaling.

shen__cassiopeia.notes:
- threat: Miasma grounds you, blocking Shadow Dash and Stand United teleport; Petrifying Gaze stuns if facing her.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Cassiopeia needs levels to threaten. Stay out of Noxious Blast range, dodge it.
- trading: Avoid trading into her poison zones. Bait Miasma onto minions, then all-in with Shadow Dash + Twilight Assault.
- post6: Stand United teleport is blocked by Miasma grounding. Play around her W placement; predict and dodge it.
- spike: First Liandry's or Zhonyas spike hurts but isn't fatal. Punish by forcing fights before she stacks AP.
- window: Mid-game teamfights when Miasma is on cooldown; engage immediately with Shadow Dash before she resets W.
- wave: Shove wave into her tower; limits her Miasma placement options and denies her roam angles to help team.
- rune: Aftershock; reduces her burst and Petrifying Gaze stun damage while granting armor for her poison tick damage.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces her spell damage and converts some to healing, countering Cassiopeia's sustained magic damage.

shen__corki.notes:
- threat: Missile Barrage true damage and poke pressure from range; you cannot dodge skillshots reliably.
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions, avoid pushing. Let Corki push toward your tower for ganks.
- trading: Never chase Corki; Valkyrie escape outranges your Shadow Dash. Bait Phosphorus Bomb, then all-in with Q.
- post6: Stand United shields allied carry from Missile Barrage damage; use ult proactively when Corki ults your team.
- spike: First item (Trinity Force or Manamune) is dangerous. Play safe, scale into tankiness, avoid extended fights.
- window: Mid-game when you stack resistances; Corki needs multiple rotations to break your defenses and shields.
- wave: Shove hard when Corki bases. Deny CS and pressure tower; he needs space to deal poke.
- rune: Grasp + Domination. Extra tankiness and early sustain offset his poke; Cheap Shot procs on Shadow Dash.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his magic damage and true damage conversion; blocks Missile Barrage burst effectively.

shen__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Rupture and Feral Scream silence combo locks you down; Feast true damage threat grows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Cho'Gath out-trades you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid close fights.
- Bait Rupture by moving unpredictably, then trade back. Never let him land Feral Scream; it silences E.
- Post-6, Feast true damage scales hard with his size. Play around cooldown; don't facetank at low health.
- His first item spike (usually tank item) isn't dangerous; punish his immobility and slow waveclear then.
- Mid-game teamfights are your window; kite with Q, use E to taunt his engage patterns repeatedly.
- Shove the wave consistently; Cho'Gath waveclear is slow, denying him safe farming and forcing him vulnerable.
- Use Grasp plus Precision; sustain and poke from range counters his limited early trading ability.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern to reduce his magic damage and cut his healing from Carnivore substantially.

shen__darius.notes:
- Hemorrhage stacks into true damage ult; his enrage AD gain and healing make extended fights lethal for you.
- Play safe, farm at range with Q. Levels 3-5 are your best window; abuse this before he scales.
- Stand close or max range to dodge E-Q hook sweet spot; block his Q spin with W always.
- Your R utility scales but his ult damage grows per stack; don't frontline trades after he stacks you.
- First item spike (usually Black Cleaver) strengthens his trading; punish him levels 3-5 before he completes it.
- Levels 3-5 before first item completion; pressure him aggressively if you have level or HP advantage then.
- Hold wave near tower; shove when he's low or missing so he can't freeze and all-in you.
- Standard Grasp plus Precision: Grasp sustain and scaling match his durability while Precision gives you dueling output.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to block his physical damage passive and ult scaling; slots naturally into defensive core.

shen__diana.notes:
- threat: Diana's Lunar Rush dash resets on Moonlight targets; kite poorly and she chains kills.
- early: Relatively safe. Diana's Q is her only ranged poke; dodge Crescent Strike, farm freely.
- trading: Never trade into her third auto (Moonsilver Blade cleave). Bait Q, then E Shadow Dash through her.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from Moonfall draw-in; reposition before she ults near you.
- spike: First item (Protobelt or Lich Bane) at 1200g—minor danger. You outscale hard; farm safely.
- window: Mid-game with Spirit Visage + Kaenic Rookern online; her magic damage cannot burst you.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Diana wants sidelane roams; deny her tempo by staying grouped.
- rune: Aftershock—her combo (Q-E or R) triggers it instantly; you need the armor + shield burst.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her ability power into reduced magic damage and heals you passively.

shen__drmundo.notes:
- threat: Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper persistent damage and Maximum Dosage sustain make him unkillable in extended fights.
- early: Safe farm until level 3; avoid trading into his Q Infected Bonesaw slow; farm at range with Q.
- trading: Bait his Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E Shadow Dash taunt; don't fight his W active.
- post6: Stand United cannot stop his Maximum Dosage healing; use ult to save allies, not to engage him.
- spike: His first item spike (likely Thornmail or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; you cannot outdamage his sustain yet.
- window: Once you complete two magic resist items, kite and poke with Q; he cannot close gaps without losing health.
- wave: Shove and reset; holding wave near tower lets him farm safely with Q and outscale your pressure.
- rune: Aftershock; you need the burst tankiness to trade early and resist his persistent W damage in fights.
- item: Kaenic Rookern shreds his magic resist and reduces his Heart Zapper effectiveness significantly in all-ins.

shen__draven.notes:
- Draven's raw physical damage output and auto-attack DPS will shred you if you get caught; avoid prolonged trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, don't walk up for melee trades against his early pressure.
- Bait Stand Aside by positioning unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through minions to avoid the knockback and slow effect.
- Stand United becomes your lifeline; use it proactively to save allies Draven targets, not reactively to save yourself.
- First item spike (likely Youmuu's or Collector) is dangerous; respect his all-in damage and play around your teammates.
- Punish Draven when Blood Rush is on cooldown and he misses axe catches; he loses mobility and DPS fast.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Draven needs to push and catch axes forward, limiting his all-in threat range.
- Use Aftershock for survivability against his burst auto trades; the armor and magic resist procs help tank early poke.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his physical damage output and provide grievous wounds if he builds lifesteal later.

shen__evelynn.notes:
- threat: Evelynn's Allure charm and Last Caress burst catch you isolated; avoid being caught alone.
- early: Safe farm—Evelynn lacks early kill pressure. Farm defensively; respect her all-in if she lands Allure.
- trading: Bait her Allure charm, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and trade back hard.
- post6: Last Caress forces you to group and eliminates her window for solo dives on you.
- spike: First Protobelt spike is moderate danger. Stand United lets you cover teammates; countergank her ganks.
- window: You outfarm and outscale her; leverage teamfights where you can taunt and protect carries easily.
- wave: Shove hard toward her tower—forces her to farm dangerously and limits her roam frequency badly.
- rune: Aftershock gives armor, magic resist, and damage to survive her Allure follow-up burst combos safely.
- item: Build Kaenic Rookern early to lower her magic damage and reduce her charm efficiency overall.

shen__elise.notes:
- Cocoon / Rappel stun locks you with no counterplay; her burst and gank setup define the matchup threat.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Elise out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid close trades entirely.
- Never chase or trade when her E is up. Bait Cocoon / Rappel by positioning near minions, then Shadow Dash away.
- Post-6, her Spider Form dive potential skyrockets. Your Stand United window to save teammates becomes her gank timer—watch map constantly.
- Her first item (Liandry's Torment or similar AP items) around level 9–11 spikes her burst. This is a punish window; play passive.
- Your power edge comes when you hit level 6 and stand near allies. Shadow Dash around her dives to peel or counter-engage.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Elise's gank setup (Cocoon + Spider Form) is deadliest in the river; deny that space advantage.
- Pick Aftershock. You need the tankiness, damage reduction, and CC resistance against her lock-down and burst combo.
- Add Kaenic Rookern into your build to reduce her magic damage and apply grievous wounds when she Spider Form heals off you.

shen__ezreal.notes:
- Mystic Shot spam from range; he pokes safely and reduces his cooldowns, wearing you down.
- Play safe; Ezreal outranges your Q early. Farm under tower, avoid pushing into his poke.
- Dodge nothing—he has no point-and-click. Let him waste Mystic Shot, then all-in with Shadow Dash.
- Stand United shuts down his burst if he commits. Use it to engage or save allies.
- First item (Manamune) is not a spike threat. Punish him before he scales into mid-game.
- Post-12 minutes when Ezreal lacks defensive items. Chase him down with Shadow Dash and Spirit's Refuge.
- Hold wave near your tower. Let him push in, then Shadow Dash ganks become safer and deadlier.
- Aftershock; you need the burst mitigation and CC amplification when you finally land Shadow Dash on him.
- Add Kaenic Rookern if he goes AP (Riftmaker). Otherwise, Hollow Radiance covers his poke sustainably.

shen__fiora.notes:
- Her Vitals heal and speed her up; extended trades with her ult active are losing.
- Play safe; her early damage is real. Farm defensively, let her push if she wants.
- Never E blindly into her W—she'll parry your taunt and punish hard. Bait W first.
- Her Grand Challenge reveals all Vitals; kite away and don't let her stick to you.
- She spikes immediately; dodge her first item window. Thornmail early denies her healing sustain.
- After she wastes W on minions or uses it defensively, E becomes safe and strong.
- Hold wave near tower; her mobility lets her roam easily. Don't feed her side pressure.
- Grasp + Precision; sustain and damage let you match her extended trades better.
- Thornmail first; it cuts her healing on-hit and makes her regret extended trades with you.

shen__fiddlesticks.notes:
- threat: Crowstorm deals extreme AOE damage; fear from Terrify forces you away from teamfights helplessly.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Fiddlesticks lacks early burst. Play for CS, avoid getting caught by Reap silence.
- trading: Dodge Reap's center to avoid silence. Never trade when Fiddlesticks is unseen; Terrify fear punishes aggression immediately.
- post6: Crowstorm forces you to respect massive range. Stand United allies away from Fiddlesticks to avoid ult lockdown engagement.
- spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Zhonyas) is a danger window. Play safer; Fiddlesticks amplifies damage significantly then.
- window: Post-level 9 with Spirit Visage, you outsustain and duel better. Fiddlesticks' cooldowns are longer; punish between ult windows.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Fiddlesticks thrives on catching you extended; deny vision control and teamfight setup space.
- rune: Aftershock. Fear duration reduction and armor shield both counter Terrify fear and Crowstorm AOE burst extremely effectively.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Applies grievous wounds to Fiddlesticks' drain healing, forcing longer drain durations for less sustain value.

shen__fizz.notes:
- threat: Fizz's Playful / Trickster untargetability dodges Shadow Dash taunt and negates Spirit's Refuge blocks.
- early: Safe farm until level 3. Fizz's short range means you out-range him with Q; abuse it.
- trading: Bait Playful / Trickster before committing E. Trade with Q when his E is down; never all-in.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from Chum the Waters shark knockup. Play around your ult cooldown.
- spike: First Sheen item spikes Fizz hard around level 9–11. Play safe and scale; avoid extended trades.
- window: After Fizz wastes Playful / Trickster, you have 14–16 seconds to land E and force favorable fights.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Fizz ganks easily; denying him roam pressure is safer than pushing.
- rune: Aftershock. Converts Fizz's burst into tankiness when you're caught; extra resistances help against Seastone Trident bleed.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces Chum the Waters damage and converts Fizz's magic damage into healing for you.

shen__garen.notes:
- Garen's Decisive Strike silence blocks your W counterplay; respect its threat range always.
- Levels 1-3 are safe farm; position spirit blade above you for short Q trades.
- Block his Q silence with W, then trade empowered Qs while he's on cooldown.
- Post-6 both have teleport tools; play for macro control and ult to winning sidelanes.
- First item is not a Garen spike; abuse objective control while he farms defensively.
- Your power window is when his E is on cooldown; dash through him to disengage.
- Hold wave near tower; his all-in threat forces you to play safe and reactive.
- Grasp plus Precision; sustain keeps you healthy into his poke and all-in attempts.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his damage and lower W cooldown via tankiness scaling.

shen__galio.notes:
- Threat: Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you into bad positions; his E Justice Punch knocks you up before you can react or escape.

- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Galio outranges you with Q Winds of War; farm from distance and avoid walking into his E charge path.

- Trading: Bait Galio's W Shield of Durand by walking toward him, then E Shadow Dash away before taunt hits; Q him as he recovers.

- Post6: Stand United makes you vulnerable—Galio's R Hero's Entrance reaches your ally faster. Ward their bot lane; only ult into winning fights, never reactive.

- Spike: Galio spikes harder on first item (Magic Resist + tankiness). Avoid direct trades then; farm safely and scale into your own item completions.

- Window: Post-first item, you match his tankiness. Force fights when his W Shield of Durand and E Justice Punch are on cooldown; abuse the gaps.

- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Galio wants to shove and roam; denying him push control limits his map pressure and ult threat.

- Rune: Aftershock. Reduces W taunt and E knockup damage; gives armor/magic resist when you're forced into close trades or ganks.

- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Converts his magic damage into healing for you while providing magic resist; weakens his burst and extends your survivability.

shen__gnar.notes:
- Mega Gnar's Wallop stuns you point-blank; his GNAR! ult pins you into walls for massive damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar's Hyper bonus damage outdamages your early trades even before Rage peaks.
- Bait his Hop away from you, then Shadow Dash through him while he's on cooldown mid-bounce.
- Stand United becomes your primary tool; use it preemptively when his Rage peaks to negate GNAR! damage.
- His first item spike around 1000g is dangerous; avoid extended trades when he's built even slight tankiness.
- You spike when Gnar is out of Rage between transformations; all-in during his Mini Gnar phase.
- Hold wave near your tower; this lets Mini Gnar push to you where his short range hurts less.
- Pick Aftershock; it procs on Shadow Dash taunts and negates his Wallop burst before stun lands.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if you lack them; reduces Wallop and GNAR! stun duration significantly.

shen__graves.notes:
- Collateral Damage detonates in a cone; dodge or shield allies when Graves ults.
- Levels 1–3: Farm safely at range with Q; avoid close trades near your tower.
- Bait Quickdraw by positioning near walls, then E-taunt when he dashes away from you.
- Stand United shields the target from Collateral Damage's cone explosion; use it reactively.
- First item (Manamune or Serrated Dirk) is not a major spike; maintain your farm.
- Your window opens when Graves runs out of ammo; E-taunt and trade immediately.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Graves' bullets stop at minions, reducing his pressure.
- Aftershock: Graves is burst-heavy and you need the armor burst to survive early.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to tank his magic damage and reduce Collateral Damage's cone effect.

shen__gragas.notes:
- Threat: Body Slam stun chains into Explosive Cask knockback, removing your ability to respond or escape reliably.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his E cooldown is long, so abuse it with E-Q poke combos after he uses it.
- Trading: Bait Body Slam by positioning near minions, then E-Q when he's on cooldown; dodge nothing, he has no skillshots.
- Post6: Never channel Stand United while Gragas has Body Slam up and is in range—he interrupts it into kill combos.
- Spike: His first item is a minor spike; you remain safer if you don't get caught by Body Slam chains.
- Window: Early levels 2-5 after each Body Slam cooldown expires; all-in him with E-Q combos before his next engage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; this lets Body Slam whiff and forces him to overextend for kills or farm.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination; Second Wind sustain directly counters his poke and extended fight pressure from Happy Hour passive.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern amplifies your tankiness against his magic damage and gives grievous wounds to reduce his healing.

shen__hecarim.notes:
- Devastating Charge knocks you back and deals massive damage; stay aware of his positioning.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hecarim out-trades you early. Farm with Q from distance.
- Dodge Devastating Charge by staying unpredictable; use E Shadow Dash to escape or taunt him mid-charge.
- Post-6, Stand United saves teammates from Onslaught of Shadows shockwave fear; use it proactively.
- His first item spike (Triforce or similar) is dangerous; respect his damage window and play back.
- Your window comes mid-game when you have resistances and cooldown; abuse W Spirit's Refuge to block his Q.
- Hold wave near your tower; prevents Devastating Charge ganks and lets you safely scale into teamfights.
- Use Aftershock for burst reduction on Devastating Charge knockback and Onslaught of Shadows engagement.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his W Spirit of Dread healing and magic damage output.

shen__gwen.notes:
- Threat: Her %HP magic damage and passive healing stack mean extended fights heavily favor her; avoid prolonged brawls.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are safe farm—she lacks early damage. Stay at range, use Q to poke safely.
- Trading: Short trades only. Bait her W (Hallowed Mist) before committing; dodge her Q (Snip Snip!) cone.
- Post6: Her ultimate adds poke and slow but doesn't shift the matchup fundamentally; continue short-trade pattern.
- Spike: Her first item spike (likely Riftmaker or Nashor's) increases damage output—respect it but don't surrender lane.
- Window: After she uses W defensively without enemies nearby, immediately all-in with E-Q before mist cooldown resets.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Pushing lets her kite and scissors-stack; farming safely under tower limits her.
- Rune: Aftershock gives burst tankiness against her %HP damage and mitigates short-trade loss; outweighs Grasp sustain.
- Item: Build Spirit Visage early as noted—magic resist directly counters her passive's %HP scaling and healing output.

shen__heimerdinger.notes:
- threat: Heimerdinger's turrets and grenade spam force you to play around zones; you cannot engage freely.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay at distance, avoid grenade damage, let him push slightly toward your tower.
- trading: Dodge his W rockets with unpredictable movement; E through his grenade to taunt him when he overextends.
- post6: Stand United lets you save a collapsing sidelane; use it proactively when Heimerdinger rotates to pressure allies.
- spike: His first item (typically Liandry's or Luden's) is your punish window—he is immobile and squishy; all-in him.
- window: Mid-game before his turret setup becomes oppressive; levels 7-10 you can duel him before stacking turrets.
- wave: Shove hard into his tower when safe; force him to choose between managing wave and defending turrets.
- rune: Aftershock. You need the burst tankiness to survive grenade+turret spam when you E in to taunt.
- item: Kaenic Rookern stops his magic damage and reduces grievous wounds from Liandry's burn significantly.

shen__illaoi.notes:
- Threat: Test of Spirit rips your spirit out; dodge it or you take massive damage and heal her.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay max range, dodge Test of Spirit, never trade without Shadow Dash ready.
- Trading: Bait her Test of Spirit skillshot, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and trade back hard.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Test of Spirit damage. Use ult to save teammates instead.
- Spike: First item (Sunfire or similar) is dangerous. Stay back, farm safely, and prepare to group.
- Window: Once you have Abyssal Mask or Kaenic Rookern, you outscale her and win extended trades.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Illaoi needs tentacles; denying space near terrain weakens her teamfight setup.
- Rune: Aftershock. Blocks her burst after Shadow Dash taunt and reduces her all-in damage significantly.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Blocks her Harsh Lesson physical damage and provides pure tankiness against her kit.

shen__irelia.notes:
- Threat: Her Bladesurge resets on marked targets; she chains dashes infinitely and kites away from your Shadow Dash.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Ionian Fervor stacks quickly in short trades. Farm at range, avoid melee skirmishes.
- Trading: Bait her Flawless Duet to a minion, then E-Q when she overextends chasing it down hard.
- Post6: Stand United lets you cover her roams and negate her all-in. Watch her ult damage and Mark spread.
- Spike: Her first item spike (Trinity Force or similar) is dangerous. Establish your lead before she completes it.
- Window: Early game before first item is your window; play aggressive levels 1-5 to deny her scaling and stacks.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower so she must overextend to farm; her Bladesurge resets punish her hard.
- Rune: Standard Grasp + Precision; sustain from Grasp and Precision keeps you healthy against her poke and repeated trades.
- Item: Build Kaenic Rookern early; it cuts her burst and scales into her magic damage from Vanguard's Edge.

shen__janna.notes:
- Janna's Monsoon knocks you back and heals allies, negating your engage and ultimate follow-up.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Howling Gale outranges your Q, so farm behind minions only.
- Dodge Howling Gale by moving perpendicular; bait it before committing to Shadow Dash engages.
- Stand United loses value post-6 since Monsoon interrupts dives and separates you from your ally.
- Janna's first item spike (Redemption or Kaenic) is not dangerous; exploit her immobility window now.
- Your window is mid-game when Janna lacks mobility items; rotate to force teamfights where she's vulnerable.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Janna has no waveclear, so safe farming starves her utility.
- Use Aftershock to tank Howling Gale poke and prepare for all-in trades with Shadow Dash.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce Janna's Zephyr slow and Eye Of The Storm shield strength.

shen__jax.notes:
- Jax's Counter Strike (E) blocks your Q-empowered autos; don't attack during it, wait it out.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades with Jax early.
- Trade immediately after his E ends by E-Q while he's exposed and vulnerable to you.
- Post-6 you disengage his ult easily with Stand United; use it to break his all-in.
- Jax spikes hard at first item (Trinity or Shojin); play conservatively during this window.
- Your punish window is right after Counter Strike ends; commit E-Q trade then reset.
- Hold the wave near your tower; this lets you farm safely and wait for ganks.
- Use Grasp + Precision; sustain and tankiness help you survive his early damage pressure.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early to reduce his magic damage and Counter Strike stun effectiveness.

shen__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow from range punish your approach; dodge or eat poke damage.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Jayce out-ranges your Q and E. Farm with Q when safe, avoid pushing.
- Never walk straight at Jayce in Cannon Stance. Bait Shock Blast by positioning behind minions, then E-taunt.
- Post-6, Stand United saves allies from Shock Blast wombo combos. Use it proactively on threatened teammates.
- First Manamune spike (levels 8–10) increases his poke damage. Play further back; this is not your punish window yet.
- Level 9+ when your Spirit's Refuge blocks more autos and E-taunt close range becomes threatening. Itemize and then skirmish.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Jayce wants to kite and poke you; deny him free positioning and mana usage.
- Play Grasp + Precision for extra tankiness and sustain to offset Shock Blast poke without relying on shields alone.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early if Shock Blast burst feels unmanageable; it reduces his magic damage and gives useful MR.

shen__jhin.notes:
- Threat: Jhin's W Deadly Flourish and R Curtain Call deal massive damage from extreme range you cannot reach.
- Early: Play safe levels 1–3; Jhin outranges you badly, so farm under tower and avoid walking into his firing lines.
- Trading: Never chase Jhin or walk predictably in lane; bait W by moving laterally, then E Shadow Dash through minions to all-in.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from Curtain Call's burst if timed right, but respect his mega-cannon damage window.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk into Essence Reaver) hurts; play safer, scale through teamfights where you control positioning.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Jhin has no escape; E taunts lock him down for your team to shred him.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Jhin wants to kite away, so freezing denies him space and limits his roam threat.
- Rune: Aftershock gives you burst tankiness when E Shadow Dash taunts, letting you survive his counterplay better than Grasp here.
- Item: Buy Kaenic Rookern; it cuts magic damage and converts Jhin's crit attempts into reduced threat when you block with W.

shen__jinx.notes:
- Threat: Super Mega Death Rocket damages based on missing health; stay healthy and respect long-range poke.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Jinx outranges you with Zap! and Pow-Pow. Stay behind minions.
- Trading: Bait Zap! by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and close gap.
- Post6: Stand United shields the marked ally from rocket damage but doesn't prevent the slow or area hit.
- Spike: First item (Kraken Slayer or similar) increases her damage output; respect her range, scale into teamfights.
- Window: Mid-game when you finish Jak'Sho and Kaenic Rookern; her single-target pressure falls behind your tankiness.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Jinx has kill pressure if you push and get caught by Zap!.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination; sustain from poke damage and gain roaming tools to pressure her bot lane.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts her physical and magical damage into healing, making you very hard to burn down.

shen__ksante.notes:
- K'Sante out-sustains extended trades and his W blocks your E taunt entirely—avoid all-ins into it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, respect his all-in potential, don't get cornered.
- Short Grasp trades only—poke with Q and back off before he closes distance for extended fights.
- Post-6, his R turns fights by knocking you back and diving; use your R for peel value.
- His first item spike (around 1000g) is dangerous; punish windows are early before he completes items.
- Shen power spikes at level 6 with R utility; abuse levels 1-5 for safe Grasp procs.
- Hold wave near your tower; K'Sante has chase and gank setup, so deny him leverage on side.
- Grasp + Precision for short trades and sustained scaling; Aftershock is too passive into his duel threat.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his healing and block magic damage when he activates All Out.

shen__kaisa.notes:
- Kai'Sa's Plasma stacks + high attack speed burst; kite you down and pop you fast.
- Play safe, farm with Q from distance, avoid extended trades; she outduces you early.
- Don't chase her; bait Killer Instinct near your tower, then E-taunt her incoming dash.
- Post-6, her all-in threat skyrockets; play further back and use R defensively on allies.
- Her first Manamune/Nashors spike is dangerous; respect her damage and don't trade greedily then.
- Mid-game with Jak'Sho online, you survive her burst better; exploit that tankiness window.
- Hold wave near your tower; she's shorter-ranged, so force her to overextend for CS.
- Aftershock; you need the burst mitigation and tenacity to survive her all-in Killer Instinct combo.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce her magic damage output and block Plasma's bonus damage.

shen__kalista.notes:
- threat: Kalista's Rend stacks and burst damage output; kite away and avoid prolonged trades.
- early: Dangerous levels 1–3; she out-trades you hard. Stay behind minions, avoid her Q Pierce.
- trading: Never chase Kalista; she kites with Martial Poise. Bait her spear placement, then E Shadow Dash in.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from Fate's Call setup. Play around her Oathsworn ally's position carefully.
- spike: First item (likely Runaan's Hurricane or Blade of The Ruined King) makes her duel stronger; farm safely.
- window: Mid-game when you've stacked resistances and cooldowns reset faster; E Shadow Dash in, taunt, tank Rend safely.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; her kite range punishes shoves. Let her push into your defensive position.
- rune: Grasp + Domination; sustain and early Cheap Shot proc from E Shadow Dash taunts pay dividends.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces her crit and on-hit damage, strengthens your defensive scaling into her build path.

shen__karthus.notes:
- Requiem deals unavoidable damage to all enemies; stack magic resist early and often.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Karthus lacks early kill pressure, farm freely and scale.
- Dodge Lay Waste by moving unpredictably; his isolated damage isn't a threat to you.
- Post-6, respect Requiem's channel but continue playing normally; your tankiness negates most damage.
- First item Liandry's or Rylai's isn't a spike threat; keep farming and scaling safely.
- Mid-game after first magic resist item, you outscale hard; abuse tankiness and engage windows.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Karthus struggles to dive and you scale better.
- Aftershock; reduces Requiem burst and amplifies your tankiness into late game where you win.
- Add Spirit Visage after first core item; healing amplification makes you unkillable against his poke.

shen__karma.notes:
- Threat: Karma's Focused Resolve root locks you down; Mantra-empowered abilities burst and kite you relentlessly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Stay behind minions to block Inner Flame; never walk into Focused Resolve range.
- Trading: Dodge Inner Flame skillshots by moving unpredictably. Never all-in; Karma kites and sustains through Inspire shields.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Focused Resolve root. Play around cooldowns; engage only when her W is down.
- Spike: Karma's first item (Liandry's or Luden's) is dangerous. Respect her damage window; itemize early MR like Spirit Visage.
- Window: Shen wins when Shadow Dash catches Karma out of position or when her Mantra cooldown is long mid-fight.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Karma has superior range; let her push and gank through river when she overextends.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination. Extended trades and extra sustain help you survive her poke; Taste of Blood heals back Inner Flame spam.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her healing and shield value; buy it second or third to nullify Inspire efficiency.

shen__kassadin.notes:
- Threat: Riftwalk mobility lets Kassadin kite you endlessly; Force Pulse slow prevents your chase.
- Early: Safe until level 3. Farm with Q from range; avoid all-ins before Shadow Dash cooldown resets.
- Trading: Bait Force Pulse by holding position, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and Q. Never chase.
- Post6: Riftwalk gives Kassadin infinite escape. Stand United becomes your only way to force fights.
- Spike: First item (Manamune or Liandry's) is a punish window—low damage before scaling. Trade hard early.
- Window: Levels 2-5 before Riftwalk. Dominate lane with Spirit's Refuge blocks and Shadow Dash taunts now.
- Wave: Shove hard early to deny Kassadin level 6 safely. Prevent him roaming with mana pressure.
- Rune: Aftershock—Force Pulse slow triggers it, armor helps you trade without dying to his magic burst.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces Kassadin's magic burst and neuters Force Pulse slow damage simultaneously.

shen__katarina.notes:
- threat: Death Lotus channels massive magic damage; dodge it or she deletes your team in teamfights.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Katarina lacks kill pressure, so cs freely and avoid unnecessary Q trades.
- trading: Bait her Shunpo onto you, then E Shadow Dash to taunt and lock her down hard.
- post6: Stand United becomes critical—shield teammates she targets and teleport to peel or counter-engage instantly.
- spike: First item spike (Nashor's Tooth or Demonic) is dangerous; respect her damage and play safer.
- window: Post-6 when enemies are grouped; use R Stand United to deny her channel positioning advantage.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; forces her to commit Shunpo to all-in, enabling your Shadow Dash counter.
- rune: Aftershock gives armor and magic resist to survive her burst and trade safely early.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing reduction, weakening her sustained carry threats.

shen__kayle.notes:
- Threat: Divine Judgment makes Kayle invulnerable; avoid fighting during her ultimate window.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayle outranges you—stay behind minions and avoid poke.
- Trading: Bait her Q Radiant Blast, dodge it, then Shadow Dash in for E taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save allies from Divine Judgment; coordinate team fights around her cooldown.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Nashor's Tooth or Riftmaker) accelerates her damage—play safer, farm.
- Window: Levels 2-5 before Divine Judgment or post-ult cooldown (100+ seconds mid-game)—engage decisively.
- Wave: Shove the wave into her tower to deny her safe farming and roam pressure.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) sustains through poke and scales into teamfights better.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her magic damage and Divine Judgment healing effectiveness.

shen__kayn.notes:
- Umbral Trespass locks you down and deals massive burst damage; you cannot block it with W.
- Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayn lacks kill pressure early. Use Q to harass from range safely.
- Bait Reaping Slash by moving unpredictably, then trade back with Q. Never let him land free Blade's Reach.
- Post-6, Umbral Trespass is a free all-in if you're isolated; stay near teammates or play safer.
- Kayn's first item spike is dangerous if he lands Umbral Trespass; respect his all-in threat window hard.
- You spike when Kayn is still transforming and lacks damage. Punish early; rotate to help teammates safely.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Kayn can roam and Umbral Trespass punishes overextension brutally.
- Play Aftershock; the armor and damage reduction counter his burst and Umbral Trespass lockdown window.
- Add Kaenic Rookern if Kayn goes AP-heavy post-transform, or Thornmail if he builds sustain items.

shen__kennen.notes:
- Threat: Kennen's Mark of the Storm stun chain locks you down; his Slicing Maelstrom applies marks during teamfights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1–3; avoid Thundering Shuriken poke and stay outside Electrical Surge range to prevent early mark stacking.
- Trading: Bait Thundering Shuriken by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and trade; don't walk into Electrical Surge procs.
- Post6: Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom applies marks to your whole team; use Stand United to shield allies caught in the storm.
- Spike: Kennen's first AP item (Protobelt or Liandry's) spikes his burst; stay healthy and don't get isolated before teamfights.
- Window: You outscale and teamfight better with Stand United; punish him when he overextends without ult available or mark reset.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; prevents Kennen from roaming freely and forces him to commit to all-ins for cs.
- Rune: Aftershock gives you survivability against his burst combo and stun lock; armor and magic resist reduce mark application damage.
- Item: Buy Kaenic Rookern early to reduce his AP damage and provide grievous wounds if he heals via items.

shen__kindred.notes:
- threat: Mounting Dread's repeated procs into Wolf pounce burst chunks your health before you respond.
- early: Farm safely at range with Q; avoid close trades where Kindred lands multiple Mounting Dread attacks.
- trading: Bait Dance of Arrows sideways, then E Shadow Dash in to taunt and disengage cleanly.
- post6: Stand United shields the marked Hunt target or yourself; use it to negate Lamb's Respite timing.
- spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer or Collector) spikes Kindred hard; avoid extended fights near Hunts.
- window: After Kindred wastes E Mounting Dread on minions, all-in with E-Q combo and Force of Nature stacking.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; let Kindred push, then E-taunt incoming threats and reset patiently.
- rune: Aftershock; it buffs armor/magic resist when E Shadow Dash triggers, reducing Mounting Dread burst damage.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts Lamb's magic damage and applies grievous wounds to reduce Lamb's Respite healing output.

shen__kled.notes:
- Kled's Chaaaaaaaarge!!! rams you and shields him; dismount him before he engages or he dominates.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kled out-damages you early. Farm defensively and avoid his Q hook range entirely.
- Bait his E Jousting by positioning near walls; punish the cooldown with Q Twilight Assault trades.
- Post-6, Kled's ult gives him engage tools and a shield. Use R Stand United to save allies or create picks.
- Kled's first item spike (around 2-3 items) is dangerous. Respect his damage; farm safely and stack resistances.
- Your window opens when Kled dismounts. Chase him down and lock him out with E Shadow Dash taunt.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Let Kled push in so you can all-in him when dismounted or E-taunt.
- Use Grasp + Domination. Extra damage from Grasp trades and burst from Domination helps chip Skaarl down faster.
- Build Thornmail early if ahead or even. Reflect his high attack speed from W Violent Tendencies back at him.

shen__kogmaw.notes:
- Kog'Maw's W Bio-Arcane Barrage percent max health damage scales infinitely; you cannot itemize away infinite scaling.
- Play safely level 1-3; Kog'Maw outranges you heavily with W active, so farm from distance only.
- Never trade into his W range; wait for him to use Q Caustic Spittle, then E Shadow Dash in aggressively.
- Post-6, Stand United becomes your escape tool; use it proactively when Kog'Maw commits resources toward you.
- Kog'Maw's first Manamune or Crown spike accelerates his poke; use this window to shove and roam with Stand United.
- Your power window is immediately post-6 when you can roam; abuse Stand United to impact sidelanes while Kog'Maw lacks mobility.
- Shove the wave consistently to deny Kog'Maw the safety to farm; force him to overextend or miss CS.
- Pick Aftershock for damage reduction on his inevitable all-in attempts; Grasp trades are bad when he outranges and out-damages you.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early to reduce his magic damage and shred his resistances; this directly counters his W scaling.

shen__leblanc.notes:
- Threat: LeBlanc chains and roots you, then Mimic chains for guaranteed damage and CC lock.
- Early: Dangerous. Farm safely at range with Q; avoid short trades near her. Stay healthy.
- Trading: Dodge or tank E Ethereal Chains; if she misses, all-in with E Shadow Dash taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from her chain root. Play safer, use ult on allies instead.
- Spike: First item (Lost Chapter components) is minor. Shen scales better; farm safely until two items.
- Window: After LeBlanc uses Distortion, she has no escape for 4 seconds. Punish with E Shadow Dash.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Shen needs safety; pushing lets her Distortion behind you easily.
- Rune: Aftershock. Provides burst durability when E taunts her, reducing her chain + Mimic burst damage instantly.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces her AP scaling and provides magic resist early when she threatens most.

shen__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's Dream-Laden Bough max Health damage over time chunks you hard; kite and disengage when stacked.
- Levels 1–3 are safe; Lillia has no reliable all-in. Farm near tower, avoid prolonged trades.
- Bait Swirlseed by moving unpredictably; it's her only skillshot. Trade when she misses or on cooldown.
- Stand United neuters her all-in and escape attempts; use it to turn fights or save allies.
- First item (typically Liandry's or Riftmaker) is a danger window; stack resistances early to reduce her damage.
- Post-6 when her ultimate lands Dream Dust; you have a 3–5 second window to all-in or disengage.
- Hold wave near tower; Lillia has no good dive tool. Prevent her from proxying or rotating safely.
- Grasp + Precision lets you sustain her poke and win short trades; Aftershock is greedy here.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early to reduce her sustained magic damage and grievous wounds from allies' healing.

shen__leona.notes:
- Leona's E into R combo stuns and locks you down; you cannot escape or block both reliably.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q stun is point-and-click after Shield of Daybreak lands—do not trade close.
- Bait her E Zenith Blade by positioning away from her intended dash target, then punish her immobility.
- Stand United becomes your primary survival tool; use it proactively before her R Solar Flare connects in fights.
- Her first Sunfire Aegis or Kaenic Rookern around minute 9-10 is dangerous; she gains tankiness and waveclear pressure.
- You spike harder at two items with tankiness layering; abuse this window before her cooldowns reset fully.
- Hold the wave near your tower; her E dashes into you if the wave is far forward—deny her engage.
- Pick Aftershock; the armor and magic resist proc mitigates her burst from Q and E before you retaliate.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if ahead; reduces her E immobilization and R stun duration—critical for kiting her.

shen__lucian.notes:
- Lucian's Lightslinger bonus magic damage from ally shields/enemy immobilize stacks burst fast.
- Levels 1-3: Farm safely at range with Q. Avoid melee trades; Lucian wins short fights.
- Trading: Dodge Piercing Light skillshot. Bait E Relentless Pursuit, then E Shadow Dash taunt him back.
- Post6: Stand United shields you from Lucian burst and enables aggressive plays after ult lands.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Serrated Dirk) spikes his damage—play safer, don't over-extend.
- Window: Level 9+ with Jak'Sho The Protean reduces his repeated poke and burst significantly.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Shen scales better; force Lucian to commit to all-ins or reset.
- Rune: Aftershock—reduces Lightslinger burst damage when you taunt, letting you trade back safely.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage from shields into healing reduction counterplay.

shen__lux.notes:
- Threat: Light Binding roots you from range; Final Spark triggers Illumination for massive burst damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; stay beyond Q range, dodge her E slow, farm with Q.
- Trading: Bait Light Binding by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through her for taunt and reset.
- Post6: Stand United blocks her ult burst on allies; use it proactively to negate her damage.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts; respect her range but you spike harder with Jak'Sho.
- Window: Level 6 onward when Stand United shields are available; abuse cooldown windows on her Q.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces her to overextend for poke, exposing her to ganks.
- Rune: Aftershock; reduces her burst damage and gives you early tankiness to survive Light Binding.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing reduction counter-value on your tankiness.

shen__lulu.notes:
- threat: Whimsy turns you into a critter; you cannot attack, cast, or use Stand United while disabled.
- early: Safely farm; Lulu outranges you. Stay behind minions, avoid her Glitterlance bolts. Do not fight before level 3.
- trading: Bait Whimsy onto yourself by walking forward, then disengage immediately. Never all-in if her W is up.
- post6: Stand United becomes risky; Lulu shields her ally and disengages. Use ult only for guaranteed picks or saves.
- spike: Lulu's first item (usually Mandate or Zhonya's) strengthens her utility and survivability. Farming safely remains priority; avoid extended fights.
