- window: You spike at Jak'Sho + Spirit Visage; Lulu's utility weakens your taunt threat but not your tankiness edge.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Lulu controls range and kite patterns. Freezing prevents her from roaming freely and helps ganks.
- rune: Grasp + Domination; sustain and tankiness mitigate poke, while Teleport pressure rewards tower-locked farming and map pressure.
- item: Add Kaenic Rookern if Lulu builds Mandate or damage; it converts her healing auras into grievous wounds against her team.

shen__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force engages your team in fights; his Granite Shield passive sustains through your poke relentlessly.
- Early: Safe farm. Short trades with Grasp procs favor you; avoid extended exchanges where his passive shield regenerates.
- Trading: Bait Seismic Shard with positioning, then trade back. Dodge nothing—only his R is a skillshot threat.
- Post6: Unstoppable Force becomes his win condition. Track it constantly; never position where he can catch your team.
- Spike: First item (usually Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) moderately spikes him. Punish before he finishes; stay even.
- Window: When his R is on cooldown after a failed engage or you catch him alone in sidelane.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Prevents his R from catching you grouped; lets you react to roams safely.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Short trades with Grasp optimize your advantage over his passive shield regen.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his magic damage and his team's healing, directly countering Malphite's teamfight contribution.

shen__malzahar.notes:
- Threat: Nether Grasp suppression locks you down; Void Shift makes him unkillable when healthy.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid Malzahar's Q silence and kite back when he approaches.
- Trading: Dodge Call of the Void with movement; never trade into Void Shift's damage reduction.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Nether Grasp suppression—play around cooldown timers only.
- Spike: First Liandry's buys him durability; punish before it completes with aggressive all-ins.
- Window: Force fights when Void Shift is down after he takes damage or CC.
- Wave: Shove wave hard into his tower to deny Voidling spawns and force his positioning.
- Rune: Aftershock—survives Nether Grasp burst and gives armor against his voidlings early damage.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage and applies grievous wounds to his sustained threat.

shen__maokai.notes:
- Threat: Twisted Advance roots you point-blank; combine with Bramble Smash knockback for guaranteed damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3. Respect Twisted Advance range; position near minions, never overextend alone.
- Trading: Bait Twisted Advance by walking forward, then Shadow Dash away or sidestep root entirely.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from Twisted Advance root follow-up if you telegraph it early.
- Spike: First item (usually Hollow Radiance or Abyssal Mask) is not a major threat window; farm safely.
- Window: Mid-game when Maokai runs out of mana; abuse cooldowns between his Q and W casts.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Maokai wants to all-in; denying him engage angles is critical.
- Rune: Aftershock. Twisted Advance trigger guarantees shield proc before root lands; doubles survivability in all-ins.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces Bramble Smash and Nature's Grasp magic damage while giving you grievous wounds output.

shen__missfortune.notes:
- threat: Miss Fortune's Make It Rain and Bullet Time deal massive damage; dodge or get slowed and shredded
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Love Tap bonus damage hurts, but avoid extended trades near her minions
- trading: Bait Make It Rain with Shadow Dash, then engage; never fight when Strut is active
- post6: Stand United saves allies from Bullet Time but doesn't prevent her damage output; play around cooldown
- spike: First item (likely Manamune or crit) is Shen's window to dominate before her damage scales
- window: After Bullet Time ends or during its long cooldown; all-in with Shadow Dash and sustained tanking
- wave: Hold wave near tower; let her push in so Shadow Dash taunts hit more enemies
- rune: Aftershock; reduces burst from Make It Rain and Bullet Time while providing survivability in short windows
- item: Kaenic Rookern early; cuts her physical damage and provides defensive stats to survive poke

shen__mel.notes:
- threat: Mel's Overwhelm stacks enable Golden Eclipse to oneshot you from any range; stack buildup is relentless.
- early: Levels 1-3 are safe—Mel's early damage is low. Farm freely, but respect Solar Snare root range.
- trading: Avoid trading into Radiant Barrage volleys. Bait Rebuttal with Shadow Dash to waste her projectile defense.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from Golden Eclipse if Overwhelm stacks are high; play around her ult timer.
- spike: Mel's first item (typically Liandry's or Shadowflame) around 10 minutes increases burst—play safer, stack Spirit Visage early.
- window: Mid-game, before Mel maxes Radiant Barrage cooldown. Punish her when Golden Eclipse is down and stacks reset.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Mel wants to kite forward and stack Overwhelm; deny her the space.
- rune: Aftershock—her burst and crowd control are constant; the armor/magic resist on proc mitigates her poke pattern.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into grievous wounds application, reducing sustained Overwhelm buildup and burst healing.

shen__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Realm of Death isolates you; Mordekaiser steals stats and kills you alone in his dimension.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Mordekaiser needs 3 stacks for Darkness Rise; abuse before he gets it.
- Trading: Bait his E Death's Grasp, then Shadow Dash through him to taunt and reposition away safely.
- Post6: Realm of Death becomes lethal. Never fight alone; group with teammates or play safer, deeper lane.
- Spike: First item spike around 10-12 minutes; Mordekaiser gains durability. Punish before he gets Indestructible shield value.
- Window: Your window is levels 2-5 when Mordekaiser lacks ultimate and shield scaling. Extend early lead hard.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. This denies Mordekaiser isolation and forces him to dive or roam.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Grasp sustains you into his poke; Precision gives dueling stats you need.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his damage aura and magic damage, directly countering Darkness Rise and Obliterate.

shen__morgana.notes:
- threat: Dark Binding locks you down; Tormented Shadow punishes immobile targets; Black Shield blocks your taunt.
- early: Safe farming window—Morgana Q is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably side-to-side.
- trading: Bait Dark Binding by walking forward, then Shadow Dash when she commits; avoid Tormented Shadow zone.
- post6: Stand United shields the bind damage and lets you escape; use ult proactively before her chains land.
- spike: Morgana's first item (Zhonyas or Demonic) is dangerous; you cannot all-in her safely yet.
- window: You spike harder mid-game when Shen gains tankiness; Morgana falls off harder than you do later.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; Morgana has no wave clear without Tormented Shadow, so farm safely under tower.
- rune: Aftershock—blocks Dark Binding's lockdown damage and triggers on Shadow Dash taunt for bonus tankiness.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage to healing reduction, weakening Soul Siphon sustain significantly.

shen__naafiri.notes:
- Threat: Naafiri's packmates swarm you; her bleeds stack damage while you farm passively and can't kite effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Darkin Daggers skillshots and avoid extended trades where packmates pile on you.
- Trading: Bait her Darkin Daggers, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and reset her packmate positioning advantage.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your escape tool; use it to leave before Hounds' Pursuit catches you or allies.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune/Serrated Dirk) is dangerous; stay near tower, don't get isolated where packs overwhelm you.
- Window: After Naafiri uses E Eviscerate to heal packmates, immediately push wave and deny her reset window advantage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; don't shove into her packmate advantage; let her push into your defensive zone.
- Rune: Aftershock; mitigates the multi-target packmate burst and armor helps against her bleed and physical damage layers significantly.
- Item: Thornmail reduces her attack damage and reflects it back; stacks well against her relentless packmate auto-attacks.

shen__nasus.notes:
- Threat: Nasus' Wither cripples your kiting; his stacked Siphoning Strike one-shots you late game.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Respect his Siphoning Strike damage and avoid extended trades early.
- Trading: Proc Grasp on him safely while he farms; dodge nothing—just maintain distance and poke.
- Post6: Your R value skyrockets; use it to save teammates. Never fight him 1v1 side lane.
- Spike: First item (usually Sheen) moderately dangerous. Punish him by grouping and using R globally.
- Window: Early game before stacks; mid-game while R is available to impact fights elsewhere on map.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Deny him free scaling farm and enable R rotations safely.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Short Grasp procs while he farms; sustain mitigates poke trades.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his Wither slow effect and gives you tankiness against his scaling.

shen__nami.notes:
- Nami's Q stun chains into her team's burst; avoid Aqua Prison at all costs or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nami outranges you. Farm defensively, dodge Q, don't commit to trades.
- Bait Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down. E through her team if she wastes it.
- Stand United breaks her Aqua Prison chain potential; use ult to save teammates caught in her combo.
- First item (likely Liandry's or Luden's) around 10-12 minutes is your window to farm safely; no danger yet.
- You spike harder mid-game with tank items stacking; duel and teamfight her isolated or when Q is down.
- Hold wave near your tower; Nami's poke and Q safety force you to farm defensively without overextending.
- Pick Aftershock; negates her burst and gives armor when Aqua Prison chains, letting you survive and retaliate.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern early; reduces her magic damage and applies Grievous Wounds if she builds AP healing.

shen__nautilus.notes:
- threat: Dredge Line roots you and pulls you into his team; follow-up cc and damage chains kill you.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to bait Dredge Line into terrain or minion collision; dodge skillshot.
- trading: Never fight near terrain. Bait his Q, then Shadow Dash in to taunt and trade with Q.
- post6: Stand United cannot block Depth Charge knockup; position away from walls or expect forced engages.
- spike: First item (Sunfire or Hollow Radiance) moderately threatens you; abuse Shen's early tankiness before his damage scales.
- window: Levels 4–5 before Nautilus completes first item; trade aggressively when his Q is on cooldown.
- wave: Shove it. Force him to choose between defending tower or roaming; limits his gank setup windows.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces Dredge Line and Depth Charge burst; provides armor and resists when cc'd.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces Riptide and Depth Charge magic damage; early magic defense denies his poke.

shen__nidalee.notes:
- threat: Nidalee's Javelin Toss (Q) from range deals massive damage; dodge it or she dominates trades.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Nidalee out-ranges you. Stay behind minions, avoid straight lines, stack waves.
- trading: Never trade when her Javelin is up. Bait it, then all-in with Shadow Dash (E) taunt.
- post6: Stand United (R) shields and teleports to allies; use it defensively when she hunts teammates hard.
- spike: First item spike is moderate threat. Stay healthy, respect Javelin range, hold wave near tower.
- window: Post-6 when teammates are grouped; your ult shields while hers requires long setup. Punish immobile allies getting caught.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Nidalee roams constantly, so denying her gank setup is critical.
- rune: Aftershock; her Javelin is poke, not an all-in threat, so immediate tank stats and resistances win.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; blocks her burst damage trades and gives you mana sustain for repeated Twilight Assault (Q).

shen__neeko.notes:
- Threat: Tangle-Barbs root locks you down; Pop Blossom stun from stealth sets up ganks and burst.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay near minions; dodge Blooming Burst seeds, respect Tangle-Barbs range.
- Trading: Bait Tangle-Barbs by moving unpredictably, then trade back with Q. Never all-in before her E cooldown.
- Post6: Stand United saves teammates from Pop Blossom burst. Play around your team's position, not just lane.
- Spike: First item (Protobelt or Luden's) around 9-11 minutes is her damage spike. Farm safely, don't duel.
- Window: After Tangle-Barbs misses or is on cooldown, run her down with Q and E. Punish rotationally.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Neeko wants to roam and Pop Blossom gank; deny her mana-free roam.
- Rune: Aftershock. Blocks Tangle-Barbs CC burst and Pop Blossom combo damage, turning her engage into your mitigation.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces her magic damage and applies grievous wounds if she ever builds Riftmaker or AP sustain.

shen__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's Slipstream dash closes gaps fast; her Apotheosis pull locks you down for follow-up burst damage.
- Levels 1–3 are safe; Nilah lacks engage tools early. Farm freely with Q, stay near your tower.
- Trade when her E is down; bait Jubilant Veil with Shadow Dash taunt, then disengage cleanly.
- Stand United at level 6 lets you negate her all-in burst by shielding a teammate away from her.
- First item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Manamune) is not a major threat window; keep farming and scaling safely.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have two items and can teamfight with Stand United shields.
- Hold the wave near your tower; her gap-close threat makes shoving suicide. Wait for jungler assistance to push.
- Pick Grasp + Precision; sustained tankiness and Precision healing from Spirit Visage synergize better than burst runes here.
- Add Kaenic Rookern if she builds magic damage; if AD-heavy instead, Thornmail reflects her auto-attack trading patterns.

shen__nocturne.notes:
- Unspeakable Horror fear + Nocturne's all-in burst chain locks you down and kills you.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid close fights. Let Nocturne push into you.
- Trade only after Nocturne wastes Q Duskbringer; dodge fear with positioning, never face-check.
- Post-6, Paranoia removes vision before Nocturne gap-closes. Play near teammates for Stand United safety.
- First-item spike is dangerous; respect his damage and don't extend into river vision.
- Shen spikes mid-game when grouping matters; use Stand United to turn fights and chain taunts.
- Hold wave near your tower; ganks are harder if Nocturne can't flank isolated you.
- Aftershock: stuns Nocturne after E Shadow Dash taunt, reducing his burst window significantly.
- Mercury's Treads reduce Unspeakable Horror fear duration and block more of Nocturne's lockdown chain.

shen__nunuwillump.notes:
- Biggest Snowball Ever! knocks you up, roots you with Snowball Barrage, then Absolute Zero obliterates you.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nunu will look to snowball gank. Stay near tower, cs carefully, expect jungle attention.
- Never trade into Willump's autos—Call of the Freljord buffs hurt. Dodge Snowball Barrage with Shadow Dash repositioning.
- Stand United becomes your primary tool post-6; shield allies during Absolute Zero engage or retreat with them.
- Nunu's first item spike around 8-10 minutes is dangerous. Play defensively, respect Biggest Snowball Ever range, farm safely.
- You spike when Nunu wastes Absolute Zero or Biggest Snowball Ever. Punish with Shadow Dash engages and Twilight Assault.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Nunu wants to roam. Defend pushed positions, force him to dive or leave.
- Aftershock; it mitigates Biggest Snowball Ever knockup damage and Absolute Zero burst when you're caught in teamfights.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce Absolute Zero's magic damage and amplify your tankiness against Nunu's primary threat.

shen__orianna.notes:
- threat: Command: Shockwave launches you toward her Ball, making you vulnerable to follow-up magic damage bursts.
- early: Safer than most matchups; farm at range with Q, avoid walking into her Ball path.
- trading: Dodge Command: Attack by moving unpredictably; E through her when she positions Ball aggressively.
- post6: Stand United lets you ult out before Shockwave lands; use it defensively or to counter-engage.
- spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) is a danger window; avoid prolonged trades in her slowed field.
- window: You outscale her mid-game tankiness; group with team when her Ball positioning limits teamfight value.
- wave: Hold it near your tower; her Command: Dissonance slows you, so proximity to safety matters most.
- rune: Grasp + Domination; extra sustain and raw tankiness outvalue Aftershock against her poke-heavy kit.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; her magic damage scales hard and Shockwave applies slow for easy procs.

shen__olaf.notes:
- Threat: Reckless Swing true damage and Ragnarok disable immunity make Olaf unkitable and drain-resistant in extended fights.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Olaf's Q Undertow outranges your trading. Use Q to poke when he walks up for CS.
- Trading: Avoid trading into his W Tough It Out shield. Bait his Q Undertow, then E Shadow Dash through him to taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Reckless Swing true damage. Use R proactively on allies or to disengage teamfights entirely.
- Spike: Olaf's first item (usually bruiser HP) is your punish window. Your tankiness scales faster; abuse early Titanic Hydra or Sunfire trades.
- Window: Mid-game before Olaf stacks armor/magic resist. Force teamfights around your ult cooldown before he reaches two items and becomes unkillable.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Olaf wants to run you down in sidelane; deny him positioning by staying safe with minions.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Grasp sustain and tankiness scale better than Aftershock into Olaf's damage profile and true damage threat.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern or Unending Despair. Kaenic Rookern reduces his healing; Unending Despair slows him when he trades into you with W active.

shen__ornn.notes:
- Ornn's Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, amplifying his next ability damage massively—avoid the final flame burst.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Ornn's Volcanic Rupture pillars control space. Farm at range with Q, dodge fissures.
- Bait Searing Charge into terrain so he wastes the shockwave; don't trade into Brittle status without your shield.
- Ornn ult at 6 forces you to respect the elemental's slow and Brittle application—reposition or use Shadow Dash to avoid.
- First item spike (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) strengthens him significantly; play around cooldowns and avoid extended trades then.
- Your window opens when Ornn wastes Bellows Breath or E; punish with Shadow Dash engage into Q + W combo.
- Hold wave near your tower; Ornn's pillars and terrain control punish forward positioning—safety lets you scale and survive ults.
- Use Grasp + Domination for healing sustain and early potency; Ornn's raw tanking makes Grasp trades valuable over Aftershock.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early to reduce Bellows Breath and ult Brittle amplification before your other resistances stack.

shen__pantheon.notes:
- Threat: Shield Vault stun chains into damage; dodge it or he snowballs your lane hard.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are dangerous. Stay behind minions, avoid straight lines; bait Shield Vault before trading.
- Trading: Never fight when his Mortal Will is up. Trade after he wastes empowered spell.
- Post6: Stand United saves you from all-ins, but don't rely on it; play safer spacing.
- Spike: First item (Manamune or Black Cleaver) hurts but isn't a hard spike; you stabilize.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you if you land Shadow Dash taunts; Pantheon falls off harder late.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower. Pantheon wants short-range engages; denying proximity starves his kill threat.
- Rune: Aftershock. It blocks Shield Vault stun damage and gives armor when he trades hard.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his burst into healing for you and nearby allies immediately.

shen__poppy.notes:
- Heroic Charge into wall stun locks you down; her W grounds you and stops Shadow Dash dashes.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing into her. Farm at range with Q, respect her all-in.
- Bait her Heroic Charge by positioning away from walls, then trade back with Q collision damage.
- Stand United now saves teammates from Keeper's Verdict knockaway; coordinate ult timing to negate her pressure.
- First item spike (Hollow Radiance or Abyssal Mask) strengthens her tankiness; farm safely and scale instead.
- Post-9 minutes when you have two items and CDR; kite her dashes and dominate teamfights.
- Hold wave near tower; her wall stun is weaker when you control space and stay mobile.
- Aftershock because her Heroic Charge and Keeper's Verdict burst demand armor and damage reduction instantly.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if her CC chains feel oppressive; Kaenic Rookern blocks her magic damage.

shen__rakan.notes:
- threat: Grand Entrance knock-up chains into The Quickness charm, locking you down for the enemy team.
- early: Dangerous levels 1-3; Rakan out-trades with Gleaming Quill healing. Play safe, farm with Q from range.
- trading: Avoid his W knock-up at all costs. Bait The Quickness charm by spacing; Shadow Dash away.
- post6: Stand United cannot cleanse or prevent his charm. Use it reactively after charm lands, not proactively.
- spike: First item (support item) is not a spike. Your Abyssal Mask or Kaenic Rookern spikes harder.
- window: Mid-game when you have two items and Spirit Visage; Rakan's charm matters less with your tankiness.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Rakan wants to roam and charm your backline; denying him tempo.
- rune: Aftershock. Grand Entrance knock-up triggers it, reducing his burst and charm follow-up damage significantly.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his Gleaming Quill healing on allies and The Quickness magic damage output.

shen__rammus.notes:
- Frenzying Taunt locks you down, letting Rammus stack Defensive Ball Curl damage and kill you with allies.
- Play safe and farm at range with Q; Rammus has no early engage tool before level 6.
- Never trade into his W; bait Frenzying Taunt by spacing, then all-in when it's on cooldown.
- Stand United becomes your escape; use it proactively when Rammus Powerball approaches or channels Soaring Slam.
- Rammus first item (Thornmail or Jak'Sho) is a danger window; respect his tankiness and don't force fights.
- You spike when Rammus wastes Frenzying Taunt or when teammates group; all-in during these windows.
- Hold the wave near your tower so Rammus must overextend to punish you or roam unprofitably.
- Use Aftershock to survive his burst and taunt combo; armor scaling matters less than crowd control defense.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his Magic Resistance and lower his Defensive Ball Curl return damage significantly.

shen__rell.notes:
- Threat: Rell's Magnet Storm pulls you in and chains CC; her Break the Mold steals your resistances relentlessly.
- Early: Dangerous. Avoid prolonged trades; she outdamages you early. Farm safely, use Q range advantage when she's not mounted.
- Trading: Dodge Shattering Strike skillshot when possible; bait her Crash Down cooldown before committing to extended fights.
- Post6: She becomes significantly more threatening; Stand United can't cleanse her R pull, only shield the burst afterward.
- Spike: First item spike (around 1200g) is dangerous. Her armor/resist steal compounds; avoid all-ins when her Break procs repeatedly.
- Window: Mid-game after you stack resistances and cooldowns matter more. Kite her when Magnet Storm is down; punish mounted state.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Rell wants to crash down and engage; deny her space to close gaps effectively.
- Rune: Aftershock. It mitigates her Crash Down burst and gives you immediate armor/magic resist when she engages you.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Its magic damage reduction and grievous wounds application directly counter her sustained Break the Mold damage.

shen__renekton.notes:
- Threat: Ruthless Predator stun into Cull the Meek combo bursts your HP before Shadow Dash connects.
- Early: Let level 1 pass safely. At level 2, use Shadow Dash as escape from stun combo.
- Trading: Spirit's Refuge blocks Cull the Meek damage. Bait his Ruthless Predator before trading back with Twilight Assault.
- Post6: Stand United removes his kill threat as you scale; prioritize ultimate value and farming safely.
- Spike: First item spike is dangerous early. Play safer until you complete your first defensive item completion.
- Window: Levels 7+ you outscale him. Punish when his Dominus cooldown is down; he loses sustained tankiness.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Limits his all-in range and forces him to overextend for kills.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Grasp sustain lets you weather his burst trades while scaling harder.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his physical damage and armor-shred from empowered Slice and Dice.

shen__riven.notes:
- Riven's three-part Q knockback and W stun lock you down; avoid both simultaneously.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q. Don't trade into her all-in.
- Bait her Q third-cast knockback, then E through her for guaranteed taunt punish.
- Stand United negates her burst; use ult proactively when she ults to block damage.
- Her first-item spike (Titanic or BCE) is your punish window—play aggressive before she completes.
- Post-15 minutes when you stack resistances; her sustained damage falls off relative to your shields.
- Hold wave near tower; her all-in threat forces you safe, so deny her roam pressure.
- Standard Grasp + Precision; sustain from Grasp lets you trade her poke without falling behind.
- Kaenic Rookern converts her AD scaling into healing reduction, gutting her sustained damage output.

shen__ryze.notes:
- Threat: Ryze's W roots you if you have Flux on you, preventing E escape and Stand United usage.
- Early: Safe farm until level 3; Ryze outranges Q, so avoid extended trades early.
- Trading: Bait Ryze's W before committing E in; dodge nothing since his abilities are skillshots you can sidestep.
- Post6: Stand United cannot be cast while rooted by W; Realm Warp gives Ryze escape and repositioning power.
- Spike: First item (Archangel's Staff or Tear path) doesn't spike him hard; you can pressure before it finishes.
- Window: Level 2-3 before Ryze maxes W; abuse it with E trades before his root becomes reliable.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Ryze scales hard, so deny him roaming pressure and safe farm.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) lets you sustain his poke and win extended fights with Precision secondaries.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his spell damage and provides MR flex when he gets ahead in AP scaling.

shen__samira.notes:
- Samira's Inferno Trigger at close range outputs massive damage; stay out of melee engagement windows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Samira outdamages you early. Farm at range with Twilight Assault, avoid all-ins.
- Bait Wild Rush by positioning near walls, then Shadow Dash to taunt as she dashes through.
- Stand United becomes your survival tool post-6; use it proactively before Samira closes to Inferno Trigger range.
- Her first item spike (likely Manamune or Kraken Slayer) is dangerous; scale safely and stack resistances then.
- You spike when Samira overextends without cooldowns; Shadow Dash + Twilight Assault combo punishes her hard.
- Hold wave near your tower; Samira has strong all-in kill pressure, so deny her roam and safety.
- Run Aftershock; the burst mitigation and armor/MR directly counter her all-in combo and early pressure.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early to reduce her magic damage and weaken her Daredevil Impulse bonus threat.

shen__sejuani.notes:
- threat: Sejuani's R stun locks you down; her Q knockup chains into E stun with Frost stacks.
- early: Safe farm. Stay out of Q range; dodge her W slows to prevent Frost stack setup.
- trading: Bait her Q charge, then E taunt her during recovery; avoid extended trades before level 3.
- post6: Stand United cannot cleanse R stun; use it reactively to shield allies, then teamfight away.
- spike: First item spike (Sunfire or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous; she gains tankiness and waveclear power.
- window: You spike at Jak'Sho completion; her E stun window closes when she lacks Frost stacks.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; she can collapse with Q, so deny roam opportunities safely.
- rune: Aftershock provides armor and MR when taunted; negates her early burst and E stun damage.
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her AP from Sunfire and negates her W slow effectiveness mid-fight.

shen__senna.notes:
- threat: Piercing Darkness heals her while damaging you; Dawning Shadow shields her team globally and chunks you.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Q outranges you. Stay behind minions, avoid extended trades without minion advantage.
- trading: Bait Piercing Darkness by positioning behind creeps, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and punish positioning.
- post6: Stand United becomes defensive only; Dawning Shadow shields her entire team globally. Ult to save diving allies instead.
- spike: First item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Sundstone) is her power window. Play safer, focus on wave control and roams.
- window: Level 6 spike and before her first item complete. Roam and create picks on isolated targets before she scales.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; her long-range harass forces you to farm safely without pushing into danger zone.
- rune: Aftershock; the armor and magic resist proc helps you survive her poke and all-in attempts reliably.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces her healing from Piercing Darkness and scales into her team's magic damage.

shen__seraphine.notes:
- threat: Encore charm chains you into her team; Beat Drop slows you heavily; avoid getting surrounded by allies
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; dodge High Note poke, stay outside her Q range, preserve health for all-in
- trading: Bait High Note by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through her to taunt and all-in; dodge E
- post6: Stand United saves allies from Encore charm; use ult proactively to prevent her teamfight setup, not reactively
- spike: First item (Liandry's or Luden's) is dangerous; abuse her immobility before she completes it with early aggression
- window: Levels 4-5 before Encore; levels 9-11 with Jak'Sho online; punish her when W cooldown is up
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; her poke incentivizes her to shove, denying her sidelane roam safety
- rune: Aftershock; reduces Encore charm damage and gives armor/MR when you Shadow Dash through multiple enemies
- item: Kaenic Rookern; applies Grievous Wounds when you taunt her into allies, blocks her healing from W

shen__sett.notes:
- threat: Haymaker's true damage center and Facebreaker stun delete you if you get caught out of position.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; use Q range to cs from distance, avoid all-ins before E cooldown resets.
- trading: Never trade when Sett has W Grit stacked; bait his E with Shadow Dash positioning, then punish.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from The Show Stopper; respect his all-in range and play safer.
- spike: First item spike (around 1000g) empowers his trading; farm safely and only trade if he wastes E.
- window: You spike when Sett wastes Facebreaker; immediately Shadow Dash in and force him out with taunt pressure.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Sett wants extended trades, so deny him space and let him overextend.
- rune: Aftershock; it blocks burst from Haymaker true damage and Facebreaker stun, giving you survive window.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces his Haymaker true damage and blocks his healing if he builds any lifesteal.

shen__shyvana.notes:
- Threat: Shyvana's Dragon Form all-in with Q recast and E engage deals massive damage; you cannot match her sustained DPS.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Shyvana outdamages you. Use Q to farm from range, avoid all-ins. Ward river for jungle.
- Trading: Bait Shyvana's W Inferno Aegis shield usage before committing. Never trade into her consecutive Q Emberstrike recasts; kite away.
- Post6: Dragon's Descent ult makes her untargetable, CC immune, and charges you down. Use R Stand United to save teammates she dives.
- Spike: First item spike (usually Sunfire or damage item) is dangerous. Play safe, stack Spirit's Refuge blocks, let E cooldown reset.
- Window: When Shyvana's R Dragon's Descent is down (90+ second cooldown early), you have 15 seconds to pressure or farm safely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Shyvana clears fast and roams. Freezing denies her gank setup and lets you scale safely.
- Rune: Standard Grasp + Precision sustains you through her poke and scales into teamfights; aftershock is too short-duration against her DPS.
- Item: Build Kaenic Rookern early if Shyvana stacks magic damage; it cuts her burst and amplifies your W Spirit's Refuge value.

shen__sion.notes:
- threat: Decimating Smash full charge stuns you; Unstoppable Onslaught knocks up and deals massive damage on collision.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Sion needs time to charge. Use Q to poke and kite away safely.
- trading: Bait his Q charge, then Shadow Dash away before release. Never fight him head-on during his channel.
- post6: Unstoppable Onslaught is a major threat. Use Stand United to save allies he targets; play around cooldown.
- spike: First item (typically Kaenic Rookern or Abyssal Mask) makes him tankier. Play safe; farm and scale instead.
- window: Mid-game when his ult cooldown is longest. Pressure side lanes; group for teamfights when Stand United ready.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Sion needs space to charge Q; denying that space limits his aggression.
- rune: Aftershock; it procs on his E and taunts, giving armor/MR to tank his damage immediately after.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage and gives grievous wounds, reducing his self-healing from attacks.

shen__singed.notes:
- threat: Singed's Fling combines with Mega Adhesive to root you, then poison + Insanity Potion burns you down relentlessly.
- early: Dangerous. Stay near minions; Fling into tower range kills you. Q poke when safe; avoid extended trades pre-3.
- trading: Never trade into his poison trail. Bait Fling by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash away or toward tower safety.
- post6: Stand United lets you escape rooted situations, but Singed gains Grievous Wounds on poison; you heal less from shields.
- spike: First item (Rylai's or similar) locks you down harder. Punish him before it by trading short, then disengaging cleanly.
- window: Mid-game before Singed full items; your tankiness scales better. Use Stand United to enable winning teamfights elsewhere on map.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Singed wants to drag you out with Fling. Deny him angles, farm safely under tower.
- rune: Aftershock. It triggers off his Fling, giving instant armor and health to mitigate poison combo burst damage immediately.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. It blocks Grievous Wounds from his Insanity Potion poison, letting your shields and healing function at full value.

shen__sivir.notes:
- Sivir's Spell Shield (E) blocks your Shadow Dash (E) taunt, neutralizing your engage and playmaking tool.
- Farm safely at range with Twilight Assault (Q); avoid trading into her early attack speed and kite potential.
- Bait Spell Shield (E) with a fake Shadow Dash (E) engage, then commit when it's down for guaranteed taunt.
- Stand United (R) becomes your primary engagement and teamfight tool since Shadow Dash (E) gets negated by her shield.
- First item spike (likely Kraken Slayer or Manamune) increases her damage and attack speed; play safer, farm, scale defenses.
- After Sivir uses Spell Shield (E) or when cooldown is near, shadow dash becomes viable for taunt combos and dives.
- Hold wave near your tower; she kites and pokes better in open space, forcing her to overextend for farm.
- Grasp + Precision maximizes trading windows and sustain when baiting her shield, letting you win short skirmishes consistently.
- Build Kaenic Rookern third or fourth to reduce her attack damage and healing amplification from your tank items.

shen__skarner.notes:
- Impale suppresses you and drags you into his team; you cannot escape or use Stand United.
- Play safe near tower; Skarner's early duel is weak but Seismic Bastion shield makes him tanky early.
- Never chase Skarner past river; bait Ixtal's Impact into walls you control, then Shadow Dash away.
- Impale completely shuts down Stand United—use it only when Skarner ult is on cooldown or far away.
- His first item (likely Hollow Radiance or tank item) strengthens his dueling; avoid fighting him then.
- After Skarner uses Impale on a teammate, he has no suppress for 20+ seconds; punish immediately.
- Shove the wave hard to deny him Quaking stacks and pressure him under tower for ganks.
- Take Aftershock for armor/magic resist burst when Skarner engages; Grasp is too passive into his lockdown.
- Buy Mercury's Treads early to reduce Impale suppress duration and strengthen your escape windows overall.

shen__smolder.notes:
- Threat: Smolder's Q Super Scorcher Breath and R MMOOOMMMM! scale with stacks; sustained poke burns you down.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are manageable; farm safely and avoid clumping. Space from his Q range when possible.
- Trading: Dodge his Q Super Scorcher Breath skillshot; bait it then trade back with Q Twilight Assault.
- Post6: Stand United shields the ADC but leaves you vulnerable to all-in. Play safer after he reaches 6.
- Spike: First item (likely Liandry's Torment or similar) spikes his damage; respect his poke and farm from range.
- Window: Early game before stacks stack high is your best window; punish him when Dragon Practice stacks are low.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; you need to kite and space, and extended fights favor his sustained damage.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) for sustain and durability; Grasp heals offset his poke damage over time.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his ability damage and applies grievous wounds if he heals; flex pick into his scaling.

shen__sona.notes:
- threat: Crescendo stun locks you and sets up enemy ganks; Sona's poke and healing sustain deny your kill pressure.
- early: Relatively safe; Sona has no all-in. Farm freely with Q while staying outside Hymn of Valor bolt range.
- trading: Avoid extended trades since her healing outpaces your damage. Bait Crescendo with Shadow Dash positioning before committing.
- post6: Massive danger window. Stand United becomes reactive; Crescendo chains with jungler ganks. Play safer and deeper.
- spike: First item (around 10 min) accelerates her cooldown reduction and shield spam. Pressure other lanes or respect the power.
- window: Mid-game when Sona lacks ultimate cooldown. Engage when her Crescendo is down; force fights on your terms.
- wave: Shove constantly to deny Sona safe spacing for poke; force her to choose between defending or roaming.
- rune: Aftershock to negate her burst and stun lock duration; pairs with tankiness to survive Crescendo chain.
- item: Kaenic Rookern blocks her shield aura application and reduces magic damage from team fights.

shen__sylas.notes:
- threat: Sylas steals Stand United, uses it better than you, then chain-CCs your ally with Abscond after teleporting in.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; avoid trades. Stack Spirit's Refuge charges near minions, farm with Q only when Sylas commits E.
- trading: Bait Sylas's E with a step-in toward him, then immediately E-Q when he's committed to the dash. Dodge nothing; he has no dodgeable threat pre-6.
- post6: Never ulti an ally while Sylas is alive with E ready—he will steal Stand United and chain-CC them. Avoid all ally engagement.
- spike: First item (typically Abyssal Mask or Riftmaker) is a danger window; his sustain and bulk spike together. Play safer, shorter trades.
- window: Trade windows exist post-6 only after Sylas E goes on cooldown. Step in to bait it, then E-Q immediately when he commits.
- wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Pushing draws Sylas jungle attention and forces unsafe Stand United engagements; safety trumps CS here.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces E-Q combo burst and gives armor/MR when taunted, letting you survive his W-Q counter-poke in extended trades.
- item: Add Kaenic Rookern if Sylas builds Riftmaker or AP-heavy early; reflects his magic damage and reduces healing on his W against you.

shen__tahmkench.notes:
- Threat: Devour locks you down for seconds; combine with Abyssal Dive knockup to isolate and kill you.
- Early: Safe until level 3. Farm with Q from range; avoid melee trades where he stacks Acquired Taste.
- Trading: Bait Tongue Lash with Shadow Dash repositioning, then E-taunt him while he recovers; never trade directly.
- Post6: Devour becomes point-and-click removal from fights. Play around Stand United to protect teammates he targets for ult.
- Spike: First Spectre's Cowl or tank item is his spike. Punish before it completes; he scales harder with health.
- Window: Levels 1–5 before Devour and tankiness items. Abuse mobility with Shadow Dash to avoid his slow-poke trade.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Tahm wants extended fights in lane; deny him space to layer crowd control.
- Rune: Aftershock. Converts his burst and crowd control into survivability; Devour into Abyssal Dive combo is less lethal.
- Item: Add Kaenic Rookern. Blocks his magic damage and heals him less; reduces Devour combo threat significantly.

shen__talon.notes:
- Talon's Q leap into melee range followed by W Rake burst combo kills you before you respond.
- Play safe behind minions; Talon has no waveclear early, so he must all-in to trade.
- Never chase Talon through lane; bait his Q leap, then E Shadow Dash to counter-engage him.
- Stand United shields an ally, but Talon's all-in burst and Assassin's Path escape make ganks difficult.
- His Serrated Dirk spike (first item) is a major danger window; respect all-in range significantly more.
- After Talon uses Assassin's Path on terrain, punish him before cooldown resets with aggressive positioning.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Talon roams easily, and losing side priority gives him map control.
- Take Aftershock for the armor and tenacity to survive his Q-W combo and reduce taunts he dodges.
- Add Kaenic Rookern into your build to reduce his bleed damage and counter his sustained all-in.

shen__teemo.notes:
- Noxious Trap slows and damages you repeatedly; dodge mushroom clusters and clear them with Q.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Teemo's Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot punish melee trades heavily.
- Never chase Teemo into brush where Guerrilla Warfare lets him go Invisible; bait Q instead.
- Stand United shields an ally but leaves you vulnerable; Teemo uses Noxious Trap to control fights.
- Teemo's first-item spike (typically Nashor's Tooth or Liandry's) is a danger window; respect his damage.
- Shen spikes at levels 6+ with Stand United; roam and use R to win side lanes.
- Hold wave near your tower; this denies Teemo roam pressure and lets you farm safely.
- Take Grasp + Domination for sustain and early bush control via Relentless Hunter.
- Add Kaenic Rookern early to reduce Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap damage significantly.

shen__thresh.notes:
- threat: Death Sentence's pull and chain into Flay knockback combo chains your position and cc locks you down hard.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid predictable paths. Stay behind minions to bait Death Sentence, then Shadow Dash away.
- trading: Never trade when Thresh has Death Sentence off cooldown. Bait it with positioning, dodge with E, then all-in.
- post6: Stand United lets you ult away after Thresh lands Death Sentence, neutralizing his pick potential on you completely.
- spike: Thresh first item (typically support item) is not a major spike. Continue farming safely; your power scales better.
- window: Once you hit two items and level 9, your tankiness and cooldown reduction heavily outpace his damage output.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces Thresh to overextend for Death Sentence and sets up your E + ult counterplay.
- rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision); sustain from Grasp mitigates his poke and Flay's blockable damage over time.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; its passive converts his magic damage into healing reduction, weakening any burst or sustained poke pattern.

shen__tristana.notes:
- Buster Shot knocks you away from teamfights; Explosive Charge plus followup burst punishes immobile positioning.
- Play safe; Rocket Jump range lets her all-in you level 2 if you overextend for CS.
- Bait Rocket Jump with Shadow Dash positioning, then E-taunt her while she's mid-air or landing.
- Stand United becomes a reactive tool; use it to negate Buster Shot knockback damage on allies.
- Her first item (likely Kraken Slayer or Infinity Edge) spikes damage hard; respect range and avoid fights.
- You spike at level 6 with Stand United; use it to enable dives or protect carries being hunted.
- Hold wave near your tower; her range and poke outscale shoved lanes—farm safely and wait for roams.
- Aftershock: mitigates her all-in burst and pairs with your E-taunt for consistent damage reduction.
- Add Kaenic Rookern if she builds significant magic damage or pair with Mercury's Treads for Buster Shot safety.

shen__trundle.notes:
- Threat: Subjugate steals your resistances, turning you into a squishy target for his team.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Trundle's Chomp saps AD and Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes.
- Trading: Avoid trading into his Frozen Domain; use Q to poke from range when possible.
- Post6: Subjugate is point-and-click and unstoppable; you cannot ult away—play around Stand United defensively.
- Spike: Trundle's first item (Hollow Radiance or Sunfire) is dangerous; his damage and tankiness spike hard.
- Window: Post-first-item when you complete Spirit Visage or Abyssal Mask; your resistances scale faster than his steal.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; let Trundle push into you so Pillar cannot trap you far out.
- Rune: Aftershock; the armor and magic resist burst mitigates Subjugate's stat theft immediately after activation.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage and healing attempts into reduced effectiveness against you.

shen__tryndamere.notes:
- Threat: Tryndamere's critical strikes and sustained damage with Undying Rage make him unkillable in extended fights.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid trading into his crit windows and respect his all-in potential with Spinning Slash.
- Trading: Bait his Spinning Slash, then Shadow Dash taunt him. Use W Spirit's Refuge to block his critical auto attacks.
- Post6: Undying Rage makes him completely unkillable for five seconds; never commit to fighting him alone after level 6.
- Spike: His first item spike (Infinity Edge or Essence Reaver) significantly increases crit damage; farm safely and avoid all fights.
- Window: Shen has an advantage when Tryndamere is low Fury and has burned Undying Rage; punish aggressively then.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower to deny Tryndamere split-push opportunities and prepare for roaming with Stand United.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) because you need the sustain and damage to stay relevant in this matchup.
- Item: Build Kaenic Rookern to reduce his critical strike damage and provide armor plus healing reduction utility.

shen__twistedfate.notes:
- threat: Destiny reveals you; Gate enables roams and kite angles you can't reach with Stand United
- early: Safe farm. Twisted Fate lacks early threat. Stay healthy, farm from range with Q, respect ganks post-3
- trading: Bait Wild Cards by moving unpredictably; Shadow Dash through them if possible. Don't trade into Pick a Card procs
- post6: Twisted Fate gains map pressure and escape; you gain Stand United to counter-roam. Play around his ult cooldown
- spike: First Lich Bane or Nashor's Tooth hurts; use that window to shove and roam before he scales
- window: Mid-game before Twisted Fate completes second item; your tankiness and Stand United allow proactive plays
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Twisted Fate wants to roam; denying him safe farm limits his map impact
- rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) — sustain and durability against poke; Precision gives tenacity against crowd control
- item: Kaenic Rookern — reduces Twisted Fate's magic damage and Pick a Card burst when you're low health

shen__twitch.notes:
- Threat: Spray and Pray piercing bolts at range deal massive damage; you cannot block projectiles with Spirit's Refuge.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Twitch weak pre-6. Farm at range with Q, avoid overextending into Ambush range.
- Trading: Avoid trading when Twitch has Deadly Venom stacks; he converts them into true damage via Contaminate.
- Post6: Spray and Pray range forces you off-map; Stand United becomes your only counterplay to his ult burst.
- Spike: Twitch first item (likely AD crit) spikes around minute 11; punish him before it completes with aggression.
- Window: Level 6 is your advantage window; use Stand United to gank while Twitch lacks mobility or defensive items.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; Twitch excels in extended trades at range, so deny him space to reposition safely.
- Rune: Aftershock; blocks Contaminate burst and provides tankiness when you engage his weak early melee range with E.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern; converts his on-hit true damage from Deadly Venom into reduced magic damage taken overall.

shen__urgot.notes:
- Threat: Fear Beyond Death execute threshold; stay healthy or get executed below the cutoff
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; Urgot wins short trades with Echoing Flames; play safe, farm with Q
- Trading: Avoid trading into Purge's close range; bait Disdain by positioning near minions, then Shadow Dash
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical—use it preemptively when Urgot ults; never let him catch you alone
- Spike: First item (typically Manamune or Black Cleaver) is a danger window; respect his damage spike hard
- Window: After Urgot wastes Disdain with no champion hit, punish aggressively with Q and auto trades
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Disdain tramples minions and Urgot wants to engage close—deny space
- Rune: Aftershock; blocks Disdain's initial damage and gives you tankiness to survive his burst trades
- Item: Kaenic Rookern; reflects his own physical damage back and reduces Purge's slow effectiveness slightly

shen__varus.notes:
- Threat: Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; Piercing Arrow and Hail of Arrows kite and slow you relentlessly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Varus outranges you heavily. Stay behind minions, avoid predictable Shadow Dash patterns.
- Trading: Bait Piercing Arrow by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through minions to close. Never all-in before level 6.
- Post6: Stand United lets you engage or save allies; Varus cannot chain-corrupt you if you teleport away instantly.
- Spike: Varus first item (likely Manamune or Liandry's) is a danger window. Respect his damage spike hard.
- Window: Post-6 when allies are gankable or when Varus wastes Chain of Corruption on someone else nearby.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; let Varus push and gank side lanes via Stand United while he overextends.
- Rune: Aftershock for burst mitigation and extra tankiness when Shadow Dashing into his combo damage pattern.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his Blighted Quiver magic damage and Hail of Arrows slow effectiveness significantly.

shen__veigar.notes:
- threat: Event Horizon cage stuns you for free; Primordial Burst one-shots at low health.
- early: Safe farm only—stay out of E range, dodge Q bolts, avoid extended trades early.
- trading: Bait Event Horizon by walking near its edge, then Shadow Dash through gap safely.
- post6: Stand United saves you from Primordial Burst burst; use it reactively when ulting allies.
- spike: First item (Luden's or Liandry's) is dangerous; rush Abyssal Mask to tank his damage.
- window: After Veigar wastes Event Horizon, dash in and trade hard before cooldown resets.
- wave: Hold wave near tower—let Veigar push, then punish overextension with Shadow Dash taunts.
- rune: Aftershock—you need armor and magic resist on engagement, not Grasp's sustain here.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage spikes into reduced burst threat immediately.

shen__velkoz.notes:
- threat: Vel'Koz stacks Organic Deconstruction then bursts true damage; his skillshots chunk you from range.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to block Plasma Fission; dodge Tectonic Disruption knockup. Farm safely with Q.
- trading: Dodge Plasma Fission by positioning unpredictably. Never all-in; Vel'Koz outranges you. Use E to gap close only when guaranteed.
- post6: Stand United becomes your primary tool. Shield allies before Vel'Koz ult lands; teleport out if he channels nearby.
- spike: First item (Lost Chapter into Liandry's usually) accelerates his poke. Farm safely; don't fight. Your spike is later.
- window: After Vel'Koz ults and misses or after his W cooldown ends. Then Shadow Dash in and force close combat.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Vel'Koz outranges you; pushing invites skillshot spam and ganks. Play for scaling and teamfights.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces burst and lets you trade back safely when you Shadow Dash through his spells.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage into reduced healing against him; underrated pickup into poke mages.

shen__vex.notes:
- Threat: Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your Shadow Dash, trapping you for her combo.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Twilight Assault; avoid pushing lane and feeding her Gloom stacks.
- Trading: Bait her Doom 'n Gloom fear onto a minion, then all-in before cooldown resets.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your escape tool; use it proactively before Shadow Surge marks you.
- Spike: Her first item is danger; respect Looming Darkness zones and play around cooldowns defensively.
- Window: Post-first-item, if Vex wastes Doom 'n Gloom on wave, Shadow Dash in and trade hard.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; let her push into you so Shadow Dash guarantees taunt hits.
- Rune: Aftershock—absorbs Mistral Bolt poke damage and shields you through her burst combo windows.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing, scaling your survivability against repeated rotations.

shen__viego.notes:
- Threat: Viego's Heartbreaker execution and shockwave knockaway deny your Stand United save and teamfight positioning.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Viego outduels you. Use Q to poke from range, avoid all-ins.
- Trading: Bait Spectral Maw charges—dodge sideways. Trade when his W is down; E in only if he commits.
- Post6: Stand United becomes reactionary only. Never preemptively ult; wait for Heartbreaker telegraphing before shielding allies.
- Spike: First item (Black Cleaver typically) is his danger spike. Stay grouped with allies to reduce execution angles.
- Window: Mid-game when his team lacks wraiths to pilot. Push waves and roam; Viego weakest without corpses nearby.
- Wave: Slow-push toward his tower. Deny him wraith corpses from minions; forces him to fight you directly.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination. Extended trades trigger Grasp healing; Ghost Poro denies Harrowed Path camouflage vision gaps.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his Blade of the Ruined King percent current health damage and healing output significantly.

shen__vladimir.notes:
- threat: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool dodges your Shadow Dash taunt and negates Stand United shielding windows.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Vladimir has no real threat. Use Q to poke and kite.
- trading: Bait Sanguine Pool with Shadow Dash feint, then all-in when it's on cooldown. Never chase.
- post6: Stand United becomes useless if Vladimir pools; use it proactively before he commits to fight.
- spike: Vladimir first item (likely Protobelt or Liandry's) is not a danger; you scale better into teamfights.
- window: Mid-game when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down (18s cooldown); look to all-in with E + Q combo.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Vladimir pushes naturally and will be vulnerable to ganks there.
- rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision); sustain matches Vladimir's healing and Precision damage helps execute pooled targets.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; it cuts his Hemoplague amplification and gives you survivability against magic damage spam.

shen__viktor.notes:
- threat: Gravity Field slows then stuns you; Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm deal sustained magic damage you cannot block.
- early: Dangerous. Viktor out-ranges you with Hextech Ray. Stay behind minions, avoid extended trades, dash away if he approaches.
- trading: Bait his Hextech Ray by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash through him to taunt and escape his followup combo.
- post6: Stand United saves you or an ally from Arcane Storm burst, but Viktor's sustained AoE damage still pressures teamfights.
- spike: First Hextech Ray augment spike around 1500 gold is dangerous. Respect his damage; play safer until you have Abyssal Mask.
- window: After Viktor uses Gravity Field cooldown, engage aggressively. Your Twilight Assault trades well when his W is down.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Viktor scales hard and outranges you; minimize his poke angles and protect your jungler from ganks.
- rune: Grasp + Domination. Sustain into his poke while Shadow Dash procs Cheap Shot for extra damage in short trades.
- item: Kaenic Rookern amplifies your magic defense and reduces his spell damage output when you need early survivability.

shen__vi.notes:
- threat: Vi's Cease and Desist locks you down and lands guaranteed damage; you cannot dodge it once she reaches you.
- early: Safely farm; avoid fighting. Vi outdamages you levels 1–3. Stay near tower, use Q at range, dodge her Vault Breaker.
- trading: Never trade into her Denting Blows stacks—her armor break and attack speed compound fast. Bait Vault Breaker, then E away.
- post6: Stand United saves your ally from Cease and Desist knockup and follow-up damage. Use it preemptively when she closes distance.
- spike: First item (Titanic or Trinity) is her biggest damage window. Stay safe, farm under tower, do not extend for kills.
- window: Post-first-item when you complete Kaenic Rookern or dual resist items. Her burst falls off; you sustain and outheal her.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Vi wants to all-in close range. Denying her gank setup and forcing her to farm top is ideal.
- rune: Aftershock. You need armor, health scaling, and burst mitigation against her point-blank gauntlet and knockup chain.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her physical burst and Denting Blows shred into healing; buy it early in the build order.

shen__volibear.notes:
- threat: Thundering Smash stun into Frenzied Maul burst combo deletes you before you can react or escape.
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; stay max range, avoid letting him close distance for Thundering Smash engage.
- trading: Never trade into his face; bait Thundering Smash by moving unpredictably, then Shadow Dash away before combo lands.
- post6: Stormbringer leap range forces you to respect all-in threat; Stand United saves you but costs map pressure.
- spike: First item (usually tankier items) strengthens his all-in; punish by farming safely and scaling into teamfights.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you have more utility and defensive tools; he lacks sustained damage vs. your shielding.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Volibear's early roam threat and all-in danger demand you stay safe and grouped.
- rune: Aftershock; flat tankiness procs on his inevitable Thundering Smash engage, letting you survive and retaliate.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts his magic damage burst into healing reduction, crippling his Frenzied Maul sustain and damage scaling.

shen__warwick.notes:
- Threat: Warwick's Infinite Duress suppression locks you down; his healing sustain lets him win extended fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Warwick out-damages you. Farm with Q from range, avoid close trades.
- Trading: Never trade when below 50% health—his W and healing punish you hard. Bait his E.
- Post6: Infinite Duress is lethal if he lands it. Play around cooldown; use R to escape or save allies.
- Spike: First item (usually Kaenic Rookern or Abyssal) is his spike. Stay healthy and play safe, don't all-in.
- Window: Mid-game when Stand United is up more than Infinite Duress. Use cooldown advantage to skirmish.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Lets you kite toward safety and use turret if he all-ins.
- Rune: Aftershock. Reduces burst from his Q and gives armor/MR when taunted by E or ulted.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Converts his high magic damage (Q, P, W) into healing reduction against him.

shen__wukong.notes:
- threat: Cyclone knocks you up and deals massive damage; Nimbus Strike closes gaps before you taunt him.
- early: Dangerous. Stay back from minions; dodge his Nimbus Strike dashes. Let wave push to your tower.
- trading: Bait Warrior Trickster by walking forward; he must use it to escape. Then Shadow Dash taunt the real one.
- post6: Stand United becomes critical. Use it to cover allies he dives; never let him free-engage your backline.
- spike: First item (usually Black Cleaver) is his spike. Punish by playing safe, farming, waiting for Stand United value.
- window: After he wastes Warrior Trickster and Nimbus Strike, you have 8+ seconds to pressure or trade favorably.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. He needs to all-in or roam; denies his gank setup and dive angles.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces Cyclone burst and gives armor to block his Crushing Blow armor shred effectively.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Converts his physical damage into healing reduction and grants you tenacity against his knockup.

shen__xayah.notes:
- threat: Xayah's E Bladecaller roots you in place; she then kites and damages freely with autos.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay outside Q Double Daggers range; don't fight near dropped Feathers.
- trading: Bait her W Deadly Plumage before trading. Dodge Q Double Daggers skillshot; E Shadow Dash through her.
- post6: Xayah gains escape with R Featherstorm untargetability. Use Stand United proactively on low teammates instead.
- spike: First item (likely Kraken Slayer) spikes her damage hard around 2100 gold; farm safely, don't duel.
- window: Post-6, when Xayah has no ult available (60s cooldown), all-in with E Shadow Dash and R Stand United.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Xayah wants spacing to kite; denying her room limits E Bladecaller effectiveness.
- rune: Grasp + Domination. Extra sustain and Zombie Ward counter her feather vision and kiting pressure.
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her crit and lifesteal damage while giving you magic resist for lane.

shen__xinzhao.notes:
- threat: Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge gap-close and Three Talon Strike knockup lock you down for his burst combo.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions; avoid all-ins before level 3 since his early trades win hard.
- trading: Let him push; bait Audacious Charge toward your tower, then Shadow Dash away or counter-engage with Q.
- post6: Stand United saves you from his all-in burst if you're caught; use it proactively before he charges.
- spike: First item spike (Trinity Force area) is dangerous. He gains damage and stickiness; stay safe and scale.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you have Spirit's Refuge active and stack resistances; he falls off versus grouped enemies.
- wave: Shove it in. Denies him all-in opportunities and forces him to chase or concede CS under tower.
- rune: Aftershock. Reduces his burst damage on Audacious Charge impact and gives you instant armor and health.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces his healing from Determination and provides magic resist against his W and E slows.

shen__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's Q Arcanopulse and W Eye of Destruction chunk you from range; dodge these skillshots or stay out of lane.
- Play safe levels 1–3; Xerath out-ranges you heavily. Farm under tower, avoid the river, wait for jungle proximity before trading.
- Never trade into his Q or W; both are skillshots you can dodge by moving unpredictably. Bait his E, then all-in short-range.
- Stand United lets you gank or save allies, but Xerath's immobile during Rite of the Arcane—flank or dive him then.
- Xerath first item (Liandry's Torment or Luden's Tempo) spikes hard; stay grouped and play safe. Wait for your first MR item.
- You spike when Abyssal Mask or Kaenic Rookern completes; then sideline him and threaten flanks while mitigating his poke damage.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Xerath push to you so your jungler has gank angles and you minimize skillshot exposure.
- Pick Aftershock for guaranteed tankiness when you E into his team, reducing his burst and making trades survivable in teamfights.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early if Xerath deals heavy magic damage; the anti-heal and MR hardcounter his poke and sustained damage.

shen__yasuo.notes:
- threat: Yasuo's Last Breath one-shots you if you're Airborne; dodge his Q stacks relentlessly.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Yasuo outranges you. Use Q to poke without committing, stay back.
- trading: Never get hit by consecutive Steel Tempests. Bait his Q, then Shadow Dash through him to taunt.
- post6: Yasuo gains kill pressure; avoid grouping with teammates he can Last Breath into. Play safer.
- spike: His first Shuriya's Battlegear spike hurts but isn't lethal. Farm safely; you scale better into midgame.
- window: After Yasuo uses Wind Wall defensively, punish with Q poke and Shadow Dash aggression immediately.
- wave: Freeze near your tower; Yasuo wants to dash through minions. Denying him engages keeps you safe.
- rune: Aftershock. Converts Shadow Dash into survivability against his physical damage and burst.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts Yasuo's crit damage into healing for you while providing armor and MR.

shen__yone.notes:
- Yone's Fate Sealed ult pulls you in after blinking behind; dodge or die to follow-up damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Yone out-damages you early. Farm with Q from distance, avoid his Q stacks.
- Don't chase Yone when he walks away; bait his Mortal Steel dash, then Shadow Dash taunt him.
- Stand United cannot save you from Fate Sealed's pull if Yone lands it; stay spread from allies.
- Yone's first-item spike (likely crit item) is his punish window; respect his damage and play safer.
- Your window opens at level 6 if Yone wastes Fate Sealed; all-in with Shadow Dash + Stand United.
- Hold wave near your tower; Yone can roam with Soul Unbound. Punish him when he leaves lane.
- Pick Aftershock for the armor and tenacity against his Mortal Steel knockup and Fate Sealed pull combo.
- Add Kaenic Rookern if Yone builds magic damage; it cuts his Way of the Hunter magic damage.

shen__yorick.notes:
- threat: Maiden of the Mist amplifies Yorick's sustained damage; Mist Walkers swarm and prevent you from splitting safely.
- early: Dangerous—Yorick out-damages you level 1-3; farm safely at range with Q, avoid all-ins, respect his Q healing.
- trading: Never chase Yorick into Dark Procession; bait his E Mourning Mist before trading, then Shadow Dash out immediately.
- post6: Eulogy of the Isles makes him a split-push threat; use Stand United to cover teammates Maiden threatens elsewhere.
- spike: First item (typically Spear of Hades or Black Cleaver) is moderate danger; your tankiness scales better—don't panic, farm safely.
- window: Mid-game teamfights when Maiden is down or far from Yorick; coordinate with team to collapse while he's vulnerable.
- wave: Shove hard and reset; denies Yorick safe lane farming and forces him to chase you into your team.
- rune: Grasp + Domination; sustain and extra tankiness let you survive poke while Relentless Hunter helps you roam away safely.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces his armor pen and provides healing reduction aura to weaken his self-sufficiency and Maiden threat.

shen__yunara.notes:
- Threat: Yunara's Q Attack Speed and On-Hit spread melts you; her E mobility lets her kite and avoid taunt.
- Early: Dangerous. Stay out of Q range; dodge W skillshot. Farm safely at range with Q blade. Do not trade.
- Trading: Bait her W arc before committing E taunt. Never chase; she kites backwards and spreads damage through minions.
- Post6: Stand United shields her when you dive; her R upgrades make her untouchable. Play around cooldowns instead.
- Spike: First item (likely Kraken or Nashors) is dangerous. She gains raw damage and Attack Speed to overwhelm you.
- Window: After her E cooldown ends and before her R comes up. All-in when she cannot escape or upgrade.
- Wave: Shove constantly into her tower. Deny her Q spread damage against grouped minions; reset and repeat for lane control.
- Rune: Aftershock. Gives armor/magic resist when you E taunt, reducing her On-Hit and spread damage burst immediately.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern. Converts her magic damage On-Hit and W/R slows into healing reduction, crippling her sustained poke.

shen__yuumi.notes:
- Threat: Yuumi's healing and shielding from You and Me! and Zoomies keeps her ally alive through your combo.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Yuumi deals minimal damage attached. Focus CS, avoid overextending into her Q poke.
- Trading: Bait her Q Prowling Projectile by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown. Don't chase attached Yuumi.
- Post6: Stand United becomes useless against her untargetability in You and Me!; play around her ally instead of Yuumi.
- Spike: First item (Mikael's or early Redemption) is not a danger spike; Shen can still pressure the wave safely.
- Window: Mid-game when Yuumi's ally detaches for skirmishes. Punish with Shadow Dash + Twilight Assault before she reattaches.
- Wave: Shove the wave constantly; it forces Yuumi's ally to defend or roam, reducing her effectiveness across the map.
- Rune: Standard Grasp + Precision; sustain and durability keep you healthy against poke while you control the lane.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces healing output from Yuumi's P and E, cutting her ally's sustain noticeably.

shen__zaahen.notes:
- Threat: Zaahen's W Dreaded Return pulls you in and his Q combo healing makes him unkillable in extended trades.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid getting pulled by W. Farm with Q from range, don't walk up unnecessarily.
- Trading: Bait his W pull, then E Shadow Dash away or through him to taunt and create distance before he combos.
- Post6: Stand United gives you an escape if caught by W, but don't rely on it; play further back instead.
- Spike: His first item spike is dangerous; you're weak and vulnerable to all-ins. Play extremely safe and farm passively.
- Window: You spike harder at two items with defensive layers; punish his overextension with E into Q and kite away.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize W pull range and force him to overextend for CS safely.
- Rune: Aftershock — reduces W pull damage burst and gives armor to survive his Q combo damage immediately after.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern blocks his Q healing and R healing, forcing longer fights where your shields and scaling win.

shen__zac.notes:
- threat: Elastic Slingshot engage into Let's Bounce knockup combo locks you down; Unstable Matter chunks burst you early.
- early: Safely farm; Zac outranges Q and W. Stay near minions to bait Stretching Strikes into creeps, not you.
- trading: Never trade after Zac lands Q grab. Dodge Elastic Slingshot by positioning away from walls; bait it away.
- post6: Stand United becomes your escape tool. Use it proactively when Zac channels Elastic Slingshot to deny his engage.
- spike: Zac's first item (typically Abyssal Mask) is not a spike threat. Punish his base return with Spirit Dash trades.
- window: Levels 4–5 before Elastic Slingshot cooldown resets. Force trades with Q + auto when his E is down.
- wave: Shove it hard into his tower. Denies Elastic Slingshot setup space and forces him to either defend or roam.
- rune: Aftershock; it converts his knockup and burst into armor and magic resist, reducing Let's Bounce combo damage significantly.
- item: Kaenic Rookern; your magic resist scales with his % max health damage from Unstable Matter and reduces his healing output.

shen__zed.notes:
- Threat: Death Mark enables Zed to all-in you with guaranteed damage; you cannot dodge or cleanse the mark proc.
- Early: Safe until level 3. Farm passively with Q; avoid pushing. Zed has no reliable all-in before Shadow Dash rank 2.
- Trading: Never trade into his Living Shadow active. Bait his W forward, then Shadow Dash through him to taunt and disengage.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your lifeline. Use it proactively when Zed Death Marks you; shield and teleport away before mark triggers.
- Spike: First Serrated Dirk spike (level 9–11) is dangerous. You are safer itemizing early defense; punish his base when he backs.
- Window: Levels 4–5 before his ultimate. Aggressive Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash combos lock down his all-ins; dominate before level 6.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Zed needs space to flank; denying roam angle and forcing him to commit to lane pressure.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Sustain and health scaling let you outlast his poke and survive Death Mark proc damage in extended fights.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts his mixed damage and slows to mitigation; synergizes with your other resistances and shields against his repeated ult hits.

shen__ziggs.notes:
- Threat: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb and Mega Inferno Bomb deal magic damage from range; you cannot dodge or block them with W.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Ziggs outranges you heavily. Farm passively and avoid walking into Bouncing Bomb predictable paths.
- Trading: Do not chase Ziggs expecting short trades. Use Q to farm; only Shadow Dash when he wastes cooldowns.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your safety net, but Mega Inferno Bomb still hits you even mid-teleport. Stay cautious.
- Spike: His first item (Liandry's or Luden's) amplifies his poke damage. This is a danger window; play passive farming.
- Window: Post-first-item, you outscale. Once you have two resistances and health, his poke becomes manageable and teamfight value grows.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Ziggs pushes hard; let minions crash so you farm safely and deny roams.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination. Grasp sustains poke and Domination adds kill pressure when you finally all-in; Aftershock is useless here.
- Item: Build Kaenic Rookern early as your first or second item to reduce his magic damage and apply Grievous Wounds if needed.

shen__zoe.notes:
- threat: Paddle Star! deals massive damage at range; E Sleepy Trouble Bubble sets up doubled damage burst you cannot block
- early: Safe farm until level 3—Zoe outranges you heavily; dodge Q relentlessly and never fight near her without Shadow Dash ready
- trading: Bait Paddle Star! by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Shadow Dash + Q Twilight Assault when she wastes cooldowns
- post6: Stand United now enables you to teamfight; Zoe's Portal Jump escape makes her harder to catch but her burst stays lethal
- spike: First item (Luden's Tempest or Shadowflame) spikes her burst hard—respect the damage window; farm safely and scale your defenses
- window: After Zoe lands Sleepy Trouble Bubble on an ally, immediately Shadow Dash in to taunt and shut down her follow-up
- wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize Paddle Star! angles and force Zoe to use abilities on minions instead of poke
- rune: Aftershock—procs on Shadow Dash taunt to reduce her burst damage and survive E + Q combos with armor and MR
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing reduction, forcing her to land more shots and giving you tankier teamfights

shen__zyra.notes:
- threat: Grasping Roots roots you in place; Stranglethorns knockup chains with roots into guaranteed damage
- early: Dangerous—Zyra's plants out-trade your Q poke. Farm safely at range; avoid her seed zones
- trading: Never walk through her E path. Bait Grasping Roots by positioning near minions, then all-in
- post6: Stand United cannot cleanse roots or knockup. Use ult to save allies caught in Stranglethorns, not escape
- spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) at ~11min is not a danger spike; farm safely and scale
- window: Mid-game teamfights where Zyra lacks seeds are your advantage. Force fights away from her garden
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Zyra must position forward to plant seeds; punish her overextension there
- rune: Aftershock—the knockup from Stranglethorns triggers it, giving you armor and magic resist to tank her burst
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts her magic damage into healing reduction pressure, making sustained fights favorable

sivir__aatrox.notes:
- Threat: Aatrox's Q three-swing combo deals massive physical damage; dodge swings or use Spell Shield.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his Q sweetspot. Farm with Q from range when possible.
- Trading: Bait his Q swings with movement, then trade back with W-enhanced autos. Never face-check.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite his World Ender form; use movespeed to stay safe.
- Spike: Aatrox first item is dangerous; respect his damage and healing. Stay outside Q range.
- Window: After he wastes Q cooldown, punish with Boomerang Blade and Ricochet autos. Abuse cooldown gaps.
- Wave: Shove when safe to deny him melee farm and reduce his all-in window pressure.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork gives movespeed and sustain to kite and duel his sustained damage better.
- Item: Add Maw of Malmortius to block his magic damage from Deathbringer Stance and healing.

sivir__ahri.notes:
- Ahri's Charm locks you down instantly; Spell Shield only blocks it if you react fast enough.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Boomerang Blade, never walk up to trade directly.
- Bait her Charm by positioning unpredictably, then trade back with Boomerang Blade when she misses.
- On The Hunt lets you kite her Spirit Rush dashes; use Move Speed to create distance.
- Watch Ahri's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; respect her burst and play further back.
- After Ahri burns Spirit Rush, punish her 20+ second cooldown window by grouping with your team.
- Shove the wave into her tower to deny her roam pressure and control river access.
- (Rune page not specified; select Precision for dueling or Resolve for survivability based on team needs)
- Buy Mercurial Scimitar early if Charm lands repeatedly; cleanse and reposition to stay safe.

sivir__akali.notes:
- Akali's W invisibility and E dash combo let her all-in you with no counter-play window available.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Akali out-trades you early. Farm with Q from range, never commit.
- Bait her W Twilight Shroud, then use Spell Shield to block her E Shuriken Flip dash.
- Post-6 Perfect Execution gives Akali a guaranteed engage tool; respect her all-in and play back.
- Akali's first item spike (around 1-2 items) is dangerous; farm safely and don't walk up alone.
- Sivir spikes harder at two items with attack speed and lifesteal; then kite and duel her.
- Shove the wave hard into her tower so she can't roam freely or threaten you mid.
