- Take Fleet of Foot primary for sustain and kiting mobility against her constant dive pressure.
- Buy Mercurial Scimitar early if she gets ahead; the active cleanse helps you survive her burst.

sivir__akshan.notes:
- threat: Akshan's E Heroic Swing mobility and repeated attacks overwhelm Sivir's positioning; his W marks create gold/resurrect pressure.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect his attack speed and dual-hit P passive damage. Farm from distance with Q.
- trading: Never trade into his P stacks near three hits. Bait his E grapple by positioning away from terrain.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite and cooldown-reset with attacks, but Comeuppance punishes immobile targets hard—stay mobile.
- spike: First Navori Flickerblade is moderate threat; your Infinity Edge spike matches or exceeds it if you scale safely.
- window: Post-first item when you have attack speed and crit, you outduel him in extended trades if E Spell Shield ready.
- wave: Shove consistently to deny him terrain for E swings and push him under tower where he cannot trade safely.
- rune: Fleet Footwork provides extra kiting and sustain against his repeated attacks and closing mobility.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks Comeuppance burst and shields against his mixed damage, fitting naturally into your build path.

sivir__alistar.notes:
- Threat: Alistar's W+Q combo knocks you up then headbutts you—unshieldable and deadly without escape.
- Early: Safely farm at range; his short legs mean he cannot threaten you level 1-3 reliably.
- Trading: Bait his Q or W by standing back, then trade with Q+W when he wastes cooldowns.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite away from his engage and dodge his combo more easily.
- Spike: His first item is not a major threat window; punish him if he engages without ultimate.
- Window: After he uses Q+W unsuccessfully, immediately all-in with Boomerang Blade and Ricochet before cooldowns return.
- Wave: Push the wave into his tower to deny him engage angles and force him to overextend.
- Rune: Press the Attack—sustained damage pressure forces Alistar to respect your range and delays his all-in.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if he lands frequent knockups; cleanse the displacement to escape combos.

sivir__amumu.notes:
- threat: Amumu's Q Bandage Toss stun into R Curse of the Sad Mummy teamfight engagement locks you down instantly.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid pushing lane into Amumu's gank range pre-6.
- trading: Bait Q Bandage Toss with movement, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; never engage his W Despair range.
- post6: Lethal threat spike. R Curse of the Sad Mummy stun + W Despair shreds you; play only with teammates nearby.
- spike: First item (Tear into Liandry's typically) is moderate. Your Infinity Edge spike outdamages; punish by kiting and positioning safely.
- window: Mid-game when you complete two items and Amumu has one. Abuse superior damage range and E Spell Shield timing.
- wave: Shove hard when safe. Denies Amumu jungle gank setup; forces him into vulnerable positions or wastes his gank window.
- rune: Lethal Tempo. Sustained attack speed and kiting into slows keeps you mobile and extends trade windows against immobile Amumu.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanses R Curse of the Sad Mummy stun and W Despair curse, enabling immediate escape or counterattack.

sivir__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Flash Frost stun into Frostbite double damage combo locks you down and bursts health.
- Early: Safe farm. Respect her Q range; stay outside it while last-hitting minions safely.
- Trading: Bait Flash Frost with movement, then trade back. Never walk into Crystallize walls.
- Post6: Glacial Storm zone control limits your positioning; kite around edges and use E Spell Shield.
- Spike: First item is danger window. Her Q-E combo hits harder; play safer, farm safely.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where your R On The Hunt speed advantage lets you kite her ult.
- Wave: Shove it in. Anivia struggles clearing fast; force her to choose between farm and defense.
- Rune: Nimbus Cloak helps you escape Flash Frost stun and Crystallize traps with speed burst.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar removes slow from Glacial Storm, letting you kite and escape Crystallize.

sivir__aphelios.notes:
- Threat: Calibrum outranges you and marks for chunks; Gravitum roots you, shieldable but dangerous.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range, avoid extended trades with unknown offhand.
- Trading: Bait Gravitum root with E Spell Shield, then all-in; dodge Calibrum shots by positioning.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you chase or escape; use it to punish Severum matchups.
- Spike: First item is danger window if Calibrum active; play back until he runs ammo.
- Window: Severum + any gun is your easiest matchup; all-in early before he stacks lifesteal.
- Wave: Shove with Ricochet to force his waveclear ammo usage and deny Calibrum poke safety.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo—attack speed lets you trade faster and kite Gravitum threat better overall.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar removes Gravitum root mark and Calibrum mark for immediate repositioning safety.

sivir__ashe.notes:
- threat: Ashe's Volley (W) poke and Enchanted Crystal Arrow (R) stun lock you down hard.
- early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions to block Volley cones; respect her range advantage.
- trading: Bait her Volley by positioning unpredictably, then trade back with Boomerang Blade (Q) safely.
- post6: Her Enchanted Crystal Arrow becomes shieldable with E—block it to gain health and movespeed.
- spike: First item is a danger window; her slows scale harder. Respect her damage output.
- window: Post-six with ultimate and boots, you outduel her. Run her down; she has zero mobility.
- wave: Shove it in. Force her to choose between farming and poking; control tempo advantage.
- rune: Fleet of Foot keystone synergizes with your P and sustains against her poke pattern.
- item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from her burst and provides magic resist for survivability.

sivir__annie.notes:
- threat: Annie stuns you with Pyromania after 4 spells; Summon: Tibbers damage and Tibbers' burn forces you to kite constantly.
- early: Dangerous. Annie out-trades you level 1-3. Farm safely at range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid melee range engagements.
- trading: Bait Annie's W Incinerate cone, then trade back. Never let her stack Pyromania freely. E Spell Shield her stun attempt.
- post6: Massive power spike. Summon: Tibbers forces immediate kiting. Use R On The Hunt to escape and reposition away from Tibbers burn.
- spike: Annie first item (Liandry's Torment or similar) strengthens her all-in. Sivir's first item (Infinity Edge) enables more Q poke safely.
- window: After Annie uses Pyromania stun, her cooldowns reset the counter. Punish the 4-spell reset window before she restacks and re-engages.
- wave: Shove the wave hard with Q and W Ricochet. Push Annie into tower to deny her roam and force defensive mana spending.
- rune: Press the Attack enables faster trading and kiting. Sustain matters into Annie's poke; also synergizes with W Ricochet bounces.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks Summon: Tibbers initial damage and gives lifeline shield when Annie's burst arrives during all-in attempts.

sivir__aurelionsol.notes:
- Threat: Aurelion Sol's Breath of Light and Singularity zone you out; dodge with Spell Shield or movement.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Aurelion Sol lacks kill pressure. Use Q to poke from range safely.
- Trading: Bait Breath of Light with Spell Shield, then trade back with Q and W attacks immediately.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you stick and kite around Singularity; his Falling Star stun is dangerous—respect it.
- Spike: First item spike (around 1200 gold) is minimal threat. Your attack speed and lifesteal outpace his damage.
- Window: Mid-game (2-3 items) you spike harder; use speed advantage to kite his Singularity and duel him.
- Wave: Shove waves hard into tower. Sivir's range and Q clear safely; prevent him from roaming grouping.
- Rune: Attack Speed or Precision primary; scales into late-game duel potential against his scaling and farming.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his magic damage burst and gives lifesteal sustain against poke pressure.

sivir__aurora.notes:
- threat: Aurora's W invisibility and E slow let her kite and escape your all-ins relentlessly.
- early: Safe farm. Aurora out-ranges you with Q missile; respect it and CS from distance.
- trading: Bait her W leap with aggressive positioning, then unload when she's on cooldown.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you chase, but Aurora's R creates slowing zones—don't chase into them.
- spike: First item is dangerous; her Q-R combo with mobility means you need defensive stats.
- window: After Aurora wastes W or E, you have 8-10 seconds to force favorable fights.
- wave: Shove it hard; Aurora needs space to kite, so denying her room limits her.
- rune: Fleet Footwork lets you match her sustained poke and kite attempts with extra MS.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse her E slow and keep chasing when On The Hunt active.

sivir__azir.notes:
- Azir's Conquering Sands slow and Sand Soldier poke chip you down; dodge Q skillshot consistently.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Conquering Sands and avoid stepping into Sand Soldier attack range.
- Bait Conquering Sands with positioning, then trade back hard with Boomerang Blade when it's down.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and dodge Azir's soldiers; his ult wall knocks you back dangerously.
- Azir's first item spike (around 2-3 items) increases soldier damage; respect range and play safer then.
- Sivir dominates mid-game teamfights when Azir lacks cooldown reduction; abuse On The Hunt's speed advantage.
- Shove the wave quickly with Ricochet to deny Azir's soldiers free range; prevent him stalling safely.
- Pick Precision rune page; attack speed and lifesteal sustain you through poke and extended fights.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius early; its magic shield blocks Conquering Sands slow burst and soldier damage.

sivir__blitzcrank.notes:
- Threat: Rocket Grab one-shots you out of position; stay behind minions or die instantly.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; farm safely behind your wave, never extend forward alone.
- Trading: Bait his Q by positioning near minions; use E on reaction if caught.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite and reposition better; still respect hook range.
- Spike: First item is danger window; Blitzcrank threatens hooks with more mana pool early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you kite with R and he becomes a peeler threat.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; deny him hook angles and protect your position.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork; extra mobility helps you dodge hooks and reposition safely constantly.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar; cleanses any debuffs and grants movement speed to escape danger.

sivir__bard.notes:
- Threat: Bard's Q stun chain and R stasis lock you down; roaming picks off your team.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay spread from minions to avoid Q piercing through them.
- Trading: Bait his Q with positioning, then trade back. Use E Spell Shield on his Q or R.
- Post6: R Tempered Fate stasis is shieldable but dangerous. Respect roam timings; he ganks bot hard.
- Spike: First item spike minimal threat. Punish his roam windows by pressuring bot lane with On The Hunt.
- Window: When Bard roams bot (60% presence), shove mid hard and take tower plates or CS lead.
- Wave: Shove to tower between his roams. Denies his return time and forces him to respond.
- Rune: Precision primary. Attack Speed scaling and lifesteal synergize with your kit and Bloodthirster rush.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses his stun chain and protects against surprise portal ganks into your position.

sivir__belveth.notes:
- Bel'Veth's W knock-up and E root lock you down; her attack speed stacks make her duel unkillable.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q dash and W combo threaten all-ins. Farm at range with Q bounces.
- Never trade into her W range; bait it with positioning, then kite backward. Dodge W with E Spell Shield.
- Her R transforms her into a dueling monster with more range and attack speed; avoid extended fights post-6.
- First item spike (likely Blade of The Ruined King) around 10 minutes threatens all-ins; play safer, farm safely.
- You spike when she lacks cooldowns or after she wastes W; punish with Q poke and kite away.
- Shove the wave hard; it denies her the all-in angle and forces her to farm further away.
- Precision primary (Press the Attack or Lethal Tempo); attack speed helps duel and proc Fleet of Foot reliably.
- Add Maw of Malmortius into build if behind; its magic shield blocks W knock-up damage and E true damage.

sivir__brand.notes:
- threat: Brand's W Pillar of Flame poke forces you to respect his range; one hit chains into his combo.
- early: Safely farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade; Brand's W has delay, giving you time to reposition.
- trading: Don't walk into W's area. Bait his Q Sear with positioning, then E Spell Shield it for health burst.
- post6: R Pyroclasm bounces unpredictably off enemies; avoid grouping tightly. Use R On The Hunt speed to kite and engage.
- spike: Brand's first item isn't a spike for him; punish his vulnerable early by maintaining distance and farming safely.
- window: Post-6 with R active, engage when Brand wastes W. Your speed advantage lets you close and all-in him.
- wave: Shove the wave with W Ricochet bounces; denies Brand safe positioning to land W, pushes him into tower.
- rune: Precision with Fleet of Foot keystone; synergizes with your P to kite Brand's poke and extended trades.
- item: Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist and nullifies burst; protects against full W into E into Q chain.

sivir__braum.notes:
- Threat: Braum stuns you after 4 stacks—his passive with ally help creates unavoidable cc lock.
- Early: Safely farm at range; avoid extended trades near him to prevent passive stacking.
- Trading: Bait his E Unbreakable with Q Boomerang Blade, then trade while shield is down.
- Post6: On The Hunt MS lets you kite his R Glacial Fissure knockup easier; shield the ult.
- Spike: First item rarely threatens you; abuse early levels before he stacks resistances with W.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete Infinity Edge and Navori Flickerblade—Q cooldown resets let you control.
- Wave: Shove it hard to deny him easy stacking opportunities on minions and allied champions.
- Rune: Press the Attack—constant attack speed lets you kite and apply pressure he can't match.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if his team has additional cc threats beyond passive stun.

sivir__briar.notes:
- Threat: Briar's W Blood Frenzy locks onto you relentlessly; her Q Head Rush stun into armor break chains you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Stand behind minions; dodge her Q Head Rush leap by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Trading: Never trade when she's low health—Crimson Curse healing amplifies. Bait her Q Head Rush, then kite backward hard.
- Post6: Certain Death marks and fears you. Use E Spell Shield to block the mark or fear effect entirely.
- Spike: Briar's first item spike (around 10-11 minutes) is dangerous. Stay grouped; avoid isolated positions where she hunts prey.
- Window: After Briar wastes W Blood Frenzy duration without hitting you, she's vulnerable. Stack Q Boomerang Blade hits for poke.
- Wave: Shove the wave into her tower. Forces her to choose between farming and roaming; limits her hunting patterns.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork or Lethal Tempo. Fleet gives constant kite tools; Tempo wins extended trades when she whiffs abilities.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar or Maw of Malmortius. Scimitar cleanses her Crimson Curse bleed stacks; Maw shields against burst.

sivir__cassiopeia.notes:
- Threat: Miasma grounds you, stopping all movement abilities and kiting tools completely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Cassiopeia out-ranges your Q and Q is dodgeable skillshot.
- Trading: Bait her Q Noxious Blast with E Spell Shield, then all-in with W.
- Post6: Petrifying Gaze stuns you if facing her—position sideways or behind minions to avoid.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) lets her kite forever; respect her range spike.
- Window: Level 2-3 before she has full poison control, or post-items when you have lifesteal.
- Wave: Shove hard and fast with W; she struggles to clear under tower pressure.
- Rune: Precision primary with Alacrity secondary; attack speed lets you kite poison clouds faster.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse ground effect from Miasma when needed.

sivir__camille.notes:
- Camille's E Hookshot knocks you up, leaving you vulnerable to her full combo and The Hextech Ultimatum lock.
- Play safe level 1-3; avoid extended trades near walls since she can all-in with E into ult range.
- Bait her Q Precision Protocol recast by backing away, then punish her cooldown with your W Ricochet harassment.
- Post-6, The Hextech Ultimatum is a guaranteed engagement tool; use E Spell Shield to block her W or E only.
- First item Trinity Force spike is dangerous; respect her damage window and maintain distance until you complete Infinity Edge.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where R On The Hunt lets you kite and reposition away from her E.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her wall access near lane; prioritize pushing her under tower to limit roam threat.
- Fleet Footwork gives you mobility and sustain to trade safely and reposition when she threatens hookshot engagement.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse The Hextech Ultimatum's anchor and escape her damage-amplified basic attacks immediately.

sivir__corki.notes:
- Threat: Corki's Missile Barrage (R) and Phosphorus Bomb (Q) deal heavy poke damage; block both with Spell Shield.
- Early: Play safely; Corki outranges you early. Farm from distance, avoid W Valkyrie gap-close by positioning near tower.
- Trading: Bait his Q with Spell Shield, then trade back. Never chase after his W escape; respect mana advantage.
- Post6: His R becomes a constant threat. Use E proactively on Big Missiles or predictable spam; play safer overall.
- Spike: First item (Trinity Force range) is dangerous. Stay back, use Boomerang Blade from max range, shield incoming R.
- Window: Mid-game when Corki runs low on mana or misses key Missiles. Punish with On The Hunt aggression.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Corki's poke and range make shoving unsafe; let him push into your space.
- Rune: Press the Attack for extended trading and true damage synergy against his poke-heavy kit.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields magic damage spikes from Q and R; build early against mana-efficient poke.

sivir__darius.notes:
- Threat: Darius pulls you with Apprehend, stacks Hemorrhage, then executes with Noxian Guillotine true damage.
- Early: Play safe; avoid pushing up. Farm at range with Boomerang Blade, respect his all-in threat.
- Trading: Never trade short. Bait his Apprehend hook, dodge it with movement, then kite backward hard.
- Post6: Noxian Guillotine becomes lethal at five Hemorrhage stacks. Never let him stack you fully.
- Spike: First item (Phage into Triforce components) strengthens his dueling. Avoid extended fights during this window.
- Window: After landing Boomerang Blade and triggering Spell Shield, punish with On The Hunt kite and burst.
- Wave: Shove it hard into tower; deny him all-in engagement range and force him to chase.
- Rune: Hail of Blades fits; scales your attack speed for faster trading and On The Hunt synergy.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you against Noxian Guillotine true damage execute threshold when low health.

sivir__draven.notes:
- threat: His stacked Adoration auto damage outdamages your extended trades pre-6; avoid prolonged exchanges.
- early: Dangerous levels 1-3; stay behind minions and farm W bounces when autos unsafe.
- trading: Wait for his axe drop or Stand Aside use, then trade briefly with Q.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite and escape his all-in; relative threat decreases significantly.
- spike: His first item spike is dangerous; respect his damage window and play safe farm.
- window: After 2 items you outscale hard; punish him if he falls behind in kills.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize gank risk and maximize Draven's aggression punish.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for bonus movespeed to kite and disengage his axe-stacking trades safely.
- item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if ahead to maximize your dueling advantage over him.

sivir__drmundo.notes:
- threat: Dr. Mundo's sustained damage and healing make him impossible to burst; his slows lock you down for trades.
- early: Play safe; his Q Infected Bonesaw slows and hurts based on health. Farm at range, avoid extended trades early.
- trading: Bait his Q with movement, then trade back with Boomerang Blade. Never walk into Heart Zapper range intentionally.
- post6: Maximum Dosage heals him and grants Move Speed; you cannot kill him alone. Play for team fights and poke.
- spike: First item makes him tanky and harder to duel. This is a punish window; avoid 1v1 extended fights.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where your team focuses him down. On The Hunt lets you kite and reset cooldowns with attacks.
- wave: Shove the wave when safe; prevents him from all-inning you and lets you roam for picks with mobility.
- rune: Lethal Tempo grants attack speed and extended range for kiting and chasing isolated targets in this matchup.
- item: Mortal Reminder reduces his healing from Maximum Dosage and Passive, forcing him to choose between tanking and sustaining.

sivir__diana.notes:
- threat: Diana's Lunar Rush gap-close with no cooldown on Moonlight targets; you die if caught.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid letting her land Q Crescent Strike.
- trading: Bait her Q Crescent Strike, then trade back with your Q. Never fight in her W Pale Cascade.
- post6: Moonfall pulls you in and slows; use E Spell Shield to block it or kite hard with R On The Hunt.
- spike: First item spike (Nashors or similar AP) is dangerous. Play safer; she outdamages you early.
- window: Post-first-item when you have attack speed and lifesteal; kite her Lunar Rush attempts and trade autos.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Diana wants to all-in; denying her engage window keeps you safe.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for extra kite potential and sustain against her burst and all-in pressure.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks her burst and magic damage while you scale into her range.

sivir__ekko.notes:
- Threat: Ekko's E Phase Dive lets him close gaps, burst with bonus damage, and teleport away—you can't kite or escape easily.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-damages you in extended trades. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade from range, avoid close combat.
- Trading: Bait Ekko's Q Timewinder by moving sideways, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces. Never chase him into fog or walls.
- Post6: Ekko's R Chronobreak lets him escape all-ins risk-free and heal back damage. Play around his ult cooldown; don't commit without vision.
- Spike: Ekko's first item spike (around 1-2 items) is dangerous—his burst and mobility spike hard. Farm safely, don't contest until you scale.
- Window: Your advantage comes at three items when you have sustained damage and lifesteal. Group with team and kite backward with On The Hunt.
- Wave: Shove the wave into Ekko's tower to deny him safe CS and force him to choose between farming and roaming. Deny pressure.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork—the movement speed from attacks and Ekko trades helps you kite, survive Phase Dive, and escape E engage attempts.
- Item: Build Mercury's Treads early against Ekko's magic damage and crowd control from Q Timewinder slow to reduce burst and improve survivability.

sivir__elise.notes:
- threat: Cocoon stun locks you out; dodge it or E it, else you die to her all-in burst.
- early: Safe farm. Stay back from her Spider Form all-in range; Q poke from distance only.
- trading: Bait Cocoon with movement, then trade back with Q. Never let her land E for free.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite her Spider Form better, but her Rappel engage is faster now.
- spike: First item spike (around Liandry's or similar AP) increases her burst; play safer and respect all-ins harder.
- window: Mid-game with On The Hunt active and items online; chase her down or escape ganks easier.
- wave: Shove it in. Force her to contest under tower or roam; denies her freeze setup.
- rune: Precision (Fleet of Foot synergy) keeps you healthy and mobile to dodge Cocoon threats constantly.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks her magic burst and gives AD; builds into your damage naturally.

sivir__evelynn.notes:
- Threat: Allure charm locks you down; Last Caress burst vaporizes you before you react or escape.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid pushing up where she roams.
- Trading: Never trade into her W Allure range. Bait her engage, then kite backward with E Spell Shield ready.
- Post6: Last Caress makes her a one-shot threat. Play safer, maintain distance, group with teammates for safety.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous. Her burst damage spikes hard; farm safely, don't duel isolated.
- Window: Your R On The Hunt lets you kite and escape. Use it preemptively before she engages.
- Wave: Shove it in hard. Keep pressure on tower so she can't roam; denies her gank setup.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork. Sustain and kiting synergy against her all-in threat keeps you healthy and mobile.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanse her W Allure charm and gain movement speed to dodge Last Caress.

sivir__ezreal.notes:
- Threat: His E + Flash combo gaps you instantly; Spell Shield only blocks one ability, not both.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay out of Mystic Shot range; dodge it when possible to deny stacking.
- Trading: Bait his Q with positioning, then trade back. Never all-in; he outranges you early.
- Post6: His Trueshot Barrage is shieldable for huge value—read the cast and block it for free.
- Spike: First item hurts but isn't a kill window. Respect his damage but maintain farm pressure.
- Window: Mid-game after two items; you out-shove and rotate faster than he can match roaming.
- Wave: Shove constantly. You out-wave him, pressure sidelanes, and deny him safe farming opportunities mid-game.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork. Sustain through poke and gain Move Speed to kite his gap-close attempts.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanses any slow or CC from his E combo before he can follow up.

sivir__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Crowstorm deals sustained damage in an area you cannot escape; it forces you to Spell Shield or die.
- Play safe near tower; Fiddlesticks cannot threaten you early without ultimate, but respect Terrify if he goes unseen.
- Bait Reap's center slow-silence by positioning off-center; use Q to trade from range and W to kite away.
- Crowstorm transforms the matchup into a teamfight threat; position with allies and use On The Hunt to escape.
- His first item spike matters less than yours; you spike harder with Navori Flickerblade and attack speed items.
- You have a window when Fiddlesticks' ultimate is down; shove and group with your team to force fights.
- Shove the wave into his tower to deny Terrify setup in fog of war and limit his roam threat.
- Take Lethal Tempo to scale attack speed and reduce spell cooldowns faster with On The Hunt during teamfights.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if Fiddlesticks lands successful Terrify chains; the active cleanses fear and saves your life.

sivir__gangplank.notes:
- Threat: Cannon Barrage zoning and Powder Keg slow lock you down for his team's engagement.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; respect his Parrrley poke range and don't extend past river ward.
- Trading: Bait Powder Keg placement with positioning, then trade when it's on cooldown; dodge nothing.
- Post6: Cannon Barrage forces you to respect map control; use On The Hunt to kite away.
- Spike: His first item (likely Sheen/Triforce) spikes his burst; farm safely and don't get isolated.
- Window: Once you have Navori Flickerblade, your cooldown resets let you kite his slows indefinitely.
- Wave: Shove to his tower when safe to deny Powder Keg placement windows; reset often.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork for sustained lane pressure and safety; procs with your passive for repeated escapes.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Powder Keg slow and his crowd control, enabling clean kiting.

sivir__fizz.notes:
- Threat: Chum the Waters engages you from fog; E Playful / Trickster dodges your damage and sets up shark knockup.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid pushing into river where Fizz roams or ganks freely.
- Trading: Bait E Playful / Trickster with Q or W, then trade; never chase him toward his tower or jungle.
- Post6: Chum the Waters forces you to respect fog of war; stay grouped and save E Spell Shield for it.
- Spike: Fizz's first item spike is dangerous; he gains burst to all-in you; respect his all-in range and play safer.
- Window: After Fizz wastes E Playful / Trickster on wave, you have 12+ seconds to trade or farm safely before cooldown.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; prevent Fizz from freezing it and denying you farm while setting up ganks for him.
- Rune: Press the Attack grants damage to all-ins; you need the extra burst to threaten Fizz before his cooldowns reset.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks burst and provides magic resist; buy it early if Fizz snowballs or threatens one-shots.

sivir__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you into his team; E Justice Punch knocks you up before fights start.
- Play safe near tower; his Q Winds of War outranges your Q Boomerang Blade. Farm passively, avoid pushing.
- Bait his E Justice Punch by positioning near walls, then kite sideways. Never fight in confined jungle spaces.
- His R Hero's Entrance shields allies and knocks up your team; play around objective timing and respect engage range.
- After first item Galio spikes defensive tankiness; you spike harder with Infinity Edge. Punish him before he stacks armor.
- Mid-game teamfights when Galio lacks cooldowns; use R On The Hunt to lead fights and reset spell cooldowns with autos.
- Hold wave near your tower. Galio wants to group; denying him roam pressure and reset opportunities is critical.
- Press Attack or Hail of Blades with attack speed runes. Maximize autos to reset R cooldowns and kite his engage.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse his W taunt and maintain positioning while your team collapses on him.

sivir__gnar.notes:
- Gnar stuns you with Wallop or GNAR! ulti while you lack reliable escape tools.
- Play safe at range; farm with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid Gnar's all-in range entirely.
- Bait his Q Boomerang Throw, then all-in while cooldown is down; dodge Wallop with E.
- GNAR! transforms him into a major threat; respect his stun range and reposition accordingly.
- His first item spike is dangerous; maintain distance and use E Spell Shield reactively for stuns.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items; abuse this window to pressure him.
- Shove the wave hard; force him to choose between farming or roaming for ganks.
- Lethal Tempo page for sustained teamfight damage and kiting pressure against his tanky form.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse stuns from Wallop or GNAR! before they lock you.

sivir__graves.notes:
- threat: Graves' bullets cannot pass through units; cluster positioning lets him burst you safely behind minions.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range farming. Use Q to harass from distance; never walk into his effective range.
- trading: Dodge Smoke Screen with Spell Shield or movement. Bait his Quickdraw dash, then trade back hard immediately.
- post6: Collateral Damage is a long-range execution threat. On The Hunt lets you kite and reset fights; use it.
- spike: First item (likely Black Cleaver or Serpent's Fang) is dangerous. You spike harder at two items with lifesteal.
- window: After Graves burns Quickdraw for damage, he loses defensive stats for seconds. Attack him immediately in that window.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. His short range forces him to walk up; use tower safety to punish overextension.
- rune: Lethal Tempo — your on-hit pressure and extended trades beat his burst when you have room to kite.
- item: Maw of Malmortius — blocks burst damage and shields you; neutralizes his all-in threat significantly.

sivir__hecarim.notes:
- Threat: Devastating Charge knockback into Onslaught of Shadows fear locks you down for his team's burst.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid pushing up where E can gap-close.
- Trading: Bait his E with positioning, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; dodge nothing, he has no skillshots.
- Post6: Onslaught of Shadows fear duration terrifies you; use E Spell Shield to block it and gain speed.
- Spike: First item makes his E damage spike; respect his all-in range and hold E defensively.
- Window: After blocking his R with Spell Shield, immediately kite with Q and R On The Hunt for chase.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Hecarim needs to engage; denying space prevents his gap-close angles.
- Rune: Fleet of Foot keystone synergizes with P Fleet of Foot for repeated speed bursts to kite.
- Item: Mercury's Treads reduce Onslaught of Shadows fear duration, giving you time to Spell Shield or escape.

sivir__gwen.notes:
- threat: Gwen's A Thousand Cuts healing and W Hallowed Mist invulnerability let her duel and sustain through your damage.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Snip Snip! true damage in center outranges your auto-attack trading. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade.
- trading: Avoid stepping into her Q cone where true damage applies. Bait W Hallowed Mist to waste her defensive tool, then trade.
- post6: Needlework applies A Thousand Cuts on-hit to multiple champions; her R engage threat forces your team to respect Gwen's all-in potential.
- spike: First item spike (Nashors or Riftmaker) empowers her dueling; don't fight her isolated. Group with teammates to reduce her value.
- window: Your R On The Hunt teamfight utility and attack speed scaling outpace her dueling. Group mid-game and leverage your team's engage.
- wave: Shove wave into her tower; denies her freeze setup and forces her to choose between CS and pushing back wave safely.
- rune: Press the Attack; you need all-in trading pressure to overcome her healing and defensive mist tools in extended duels.
- item: Build Mortal Reminder early to cut her A Thousand Cuts healing and reduce her sustain advantage significantly in extended fights.

sivir__heimerdinger.notes:
- threat: Heimerdinger's turrets zone you and his E stun locks you down for his team's burst
- early: Dangerous; stay back from turret range, use Q to farm safely from distance, avoid walking into E
- trading: Bait his E with sidesteps, then all-in with W-enhanced autos; never face-check brush where turrets hide
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite turrets and chase him down; pressure him before he stacks upgrades
- spike: First item spike is moderate threat; his turrets deal more damage but you out-duel him with items
- window: Post-first-item onwards you out-damage his turrets with Infinity Edge and attack speed; abuse this to zone him
- wave: Shove hard into his tower; forces him to choose between defending tower or helping teamfights, limits turret placement
- rune: Fleet Footwork; the movement speed helps you kite turret range and dodge his E grenade casts
- item: Maw of Malmortius; blocks his E stun burst and shields you when he upgrades for teamfight engage

sivir__hwei.notes:
- Hwei's Subject abilities lock you into predictable patterns; dodge his Q/W/E skillshots or get primed for Signature burst.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Hwei outranges you. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade at distance, avoid walking into his ability zones.
- Bait his Subject casts by positioning near minions, then use E Spell Shield to block his follow-up damage or crowd control.
- On The Hunt at level 6 lets you chase or escape, but Hwei's Spiraling Despair slow cripples your kiting potential significantly.
- Hwei's first item spike (around 1800 gold) increases his damage; play safer until you complete your first item to match.
- Your window comes when Hwei whiffs his Subject abilities or after you dodge with E Spell Shield; punish with W Ricochet trades.
- Shove the wave into Hwei's tower early; forces him to cs under tower and limits his ability to roam mid-fight.
- Fleet Footwork or Press the Attack; Fleet sustains poke trades while PTA helps your W Ricochet burst through his tankiness.
- Add Maw of Malmortius into your build; blocks Hwei's magic burst and shields you when primed for his Signature finisher.

sivir__illaoi.notes:
- Threat: Illaoi's E Test of Spirit forces your spirit out; you take damage even if you dodge the tentacle swings.
- Early: Safe farm only. Stay outside E range (roughly mid-lane). Never walk into river; her W Harsh Lesson all-ins you.
- Trading: Dodge her Q Tentacle Smash with sidestep movement. Never fight near terrain where tentacles spawn; bait her into wasting W.
- Post6: Illaoi's R Leap of Faith spawns tentacles per champion hit. Stay spread and never group; kite away from her idol impact.
- Spike: Her first item (likely Black Cleaver) is a danger window. Play safe, don't commit to fights; wait for your Navori Flickerblade.
- Window: Post-Navori Flickerblade, your Q spam reduces cooldowns faster via R On The Hunt. Shred her from range; never let her close.
- Wave: Shove the wave in. Illaoi struggles to farm under tower. Forces her to roam or lose CS; you maintain lane safety.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo. Extended kiting range and attack speed let you drain her health from max distance without walking into tentacle range.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius second. Illaoi deals physical damage; Maw's shield and spell vamp reduce her E spirit damage threat significantly.

sivir__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller roots you in place; dodge it or use Spell Shield to block and gain movement speed.
- Farm safely at range with Boomerang Blade; Ivern has no early all-in threat without jungle help.
- Bait Rootcaller by moving unpredictably, then trade with Boomerang Blade while his Q is on cooldown.
- Daisy adds sustained damage and CC; use On The Hunt to kite away and maintain distance safely.
- Ivern's first item spike is mild; abuse your sustained DPS with Ricochet to out-duel him early.
- Mid-game when Sivir has two items, you out-damage Ivern significantly; force extended fights and kite backward.
- Shove the wave to deny Ivern time to gank; your Boomerang Blade clear is faster than his.
- Press Attack or Lethal Tempo for consistent damage; Tempo scales better into extended Ricochet teamfights.
- Buy Mercury's Treads early if Ivern's jungler has heavy CC; otherwise prioritize Navori Flickerblade for cooldown.

sivir__janna.notes:
- Threat: Janna's peel denies your all-ins; Howling Gale knockup and Monsoon disengage neutralize your damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Janna outranges you. Use Q to CS from distance, avoid close trades.
- Trading: Bait her Q with movement, then all-in when it's down. Shield her Howling Gale knockup.
- Post6: Monsoon lets her save her ADC and heal them. Your ult doesn't guarantee kills anymore.
- Spike: First item (around 1100 gold) isn't a danger; she needs multiple items to truly peel.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and she has one. Push your lead before scaling.
- Wave: Shove hard every wave—she has zero waveclear and can't match your push. Deny her safety.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo (attack speed extension lets you trade and kite her peel attempts effectively).
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar (cleanses Zephyr slow and removes her Monsoon effects if timed correctly).

sivir__jax.notes:
- threat: Jax's Counter Strike dodges your Boomerang Blade and stuns you for counterplay punishment.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Jax out-trades you in extended fights, farm at range.
- trading: Bait Counter Strike with Boomerang Blade before committing; never fight during his E window.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite and reset fights; Jax ult gives armor/magic resist durability.
- spike: His first item spike is dangerous; you lack sustained damage to out-duel him yet.
- window: Mid-game with Infinity Edge and attack speed; you out-damage his single-target focus then.
- wave: Shove the wave quickly with Ricochet; deny Jax time to all-in you between rotations.
- rune: Lethal Tempo; attack speed stacking helps you kite and lifesteal through his sustained fights.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar; removes any crowd control Jax applies, letting you stick distance and attack.

sivir__jayce.notes:
- threat: Jayce's Shock Blast and Thundering Blow combo at range one-shots or heavily chunks you before you retaliate
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Jayce out-ranges your Q and will punish close farming; CS from distance with Q only
- trading: Never walk into Shock Blast range; bait his Q with positioning then all-in; dodge Shock Blast with Fleet of Foot movement
- post6: On The Hunt lets you chase or kite; use it to position safely around his Acceleration Gate and avoid Shock Blast
- spike: First Manamune spike (his power) is dangerous; respect his range and damage; farm safely until your attack speed items come online
- window: After Jayce wastes Shock Blast, trade aggressively; your W out-damages him in close range once you have Navori Flickerblade attack speed
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; let it bounce back so Jayce must overextend to farm; punish his advances with E Spell Shield
- rune: Press the Attack gives you all-in pressure when you close distance and rewards W Ricochet's repeated attacks in extended trades
- item: Add Maw of Malmortius early if Shock Blast threatens to one-shot; blocks burst and gives you survivability to engage

sivir__jhin.notes:
- threat: His W root locks you down; dodge it or E it before he chains CC into damage.
- early: Safe farm. Stay unpredictable; don't stand on his W mark. Use Q to farm from distance.
- trading: Bait his W with movement, then trade back with Q. Never fight during his reload.
- post6: His R pierces and roots from extreme range. E blocks it or dodge with Fleet of Foot.
- spike: First item (likely Serrated Dirk) spikes his burst. Farm safely; you outscale into mid-game.
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you. On The Hunt lets you kite his reload phase and duel him.
- wave: Push to his tower. Force him to farm under turret where W traps are less threatening.
- rune: Precision primary for Fleet of Foot synergy; you need mobility to dodge his W consistently.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses his W root if caught, freeing you to E-dodge his follow-up.

sivir__jinx.notes:
- Jinx's Zap (W) and Super Mega Death Rocket (R) deal massive damage; dodge W, shield it with E.
- Play safe and farm; her Fishbones outrange your Boomerang Blade—stay behind minions, avoid long trades.
- Bait her Zap (W) by positioning near minions, then shield it with Spell Shield to gain health and speed.
- Her Super Mega Death Rocket (R) scales hard and hits globally; respect it, position carefully mid-map after level 6.
- First item spike (around 10-12 minutes) is dangerous; farm safely and avoid skirmishes until you complete your first item.
- Your power window comes mid-game with Navori Flickerblade—use R to lead fights and reset cooldowns through sustained attacks.
- Hold the wave near your tower; her long-range forms punish pushed waves, and safety farming scales you toward late-game.
- Take Lethal Tempo for attack speed to match her DPS scaling and pressure in extended teamfights with R active.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if her Zap (W) slow prevents your escape; cleanse it and dash away safely.

sivir__kaisa.notes:
- threat: Her mid-late game 1v1 dominance with Plasma stacks and R reset potential overwhelms you.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; dodge her W poke with E Spell Shield or positioning.
- trading: Bait her W with movement, use E to block it, then trade back with Q.
- post6: Killer Instinct dash lets her engage unpredictably; stay grouped and avoid isolated positions immediately.
- spike: Three items is her powerspike; you cannot duel her alone, group with team immediately.
- window: Early game before three items; punish her stretched position and force favorable teamfights then.
- wave: Push her into tower to deny Plasma stacking from your minions; prevent her scaling safely.
- rune: Hail of Blades page maximizes your early aggression and W attack speed burst damage.
- item: Add Mercurial Scimitar into build to cleanse any burst or slow attempts she lands.

sivir__kalista.notes:
- Threat: Rend stacking on minions forces you to respect execute damage; her Oathsworn support creates unpredictable engage windows.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect Rend buildup on minions and avoid extended trades near low-HP waves.
- Trading: Bait Pierce with Spell Shield; dodge Rend by positioning away from minions she's impaled; trade when her E is down.
- Post6: Fate's Call enables surprise engages from her support; track their positioning closely and stay positioned to kite backward safely.
- Spike: First item spike is her danger window; Rend damage and Pierce pressure spike hard—farm safely and avoid low minion HP.
- Window: You outscale mid-game onward; punish her when Rend stacks reset and her support roams; leverage your range advantage then.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower to deny Rend execution setups and limit her support's all-in engage range window.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo gives you sustained damage and kiting power against her Martial Poise mobility for critical teamfight advantage.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse any surprise engage setup or slow from Rend before it becomes execution threat.

sivir__karma.notes:
- Threat: Karma's R-Q poke bursts through your health; her W root locks you down for followup damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Use Q to trade from distance; avoid walking into W tether range.
- Trading: Bait her Q with movement, then trade back. Block R-Q with E Spell Shield when she commits.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite her W tether and chase if she wastes Mantra poorly.
- Spike: First item (Spellthief's into support item) isn't a major threat window; farm safely and scale.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete attack-speed items, Ricochet waveclear outpaces her shield spam and pushes wave past her.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard with W Ricochet. Your bouncing attacks force her to choose between defending tower or roaming.
- Rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot keystone sustains poke and lets you kite her W tether.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius early against her burst to survive R-Q and block her shield utility.

sivir__kassadin.notes:
- threat: Kassadin's Riftwalk mobility and burst magic damage catch and eliminate you before escaping.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q Boomerang Blade; never let him close distance freely.
- trading: Bait his Q Null Sphere with E Spell Shield, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces.
- post6: Extremely dangerous. Riftwalk lets him gap-close and burst unpredictably; play near tower, never overextend.
- spike: First item spike is his threat window. Respect his damage; farm safely and scale instead.
- window: Mid-game when you have two items and R On The Hunt active—kite him with allies.
- wave: Push wave into tower. Deny him safe farming space and force him to Riftwalk for CS.
- rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot; sustain and kiting synergize with your P and mobility.
- item: Build Maw of Malmortius early to block his magic burst and gain defensive stats.

sivir__karthus.notes:
- Karthus' Requiem deals unavoidable global damage; dodge it by staying mobile and using E Spell Shield preemptively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lay Waste damages from range. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade at distance, avoid walking into blast zones.
- Bait Lay Waste by moving unpredictably. Use E Spell Shield to block Requiem channel cast or Wall of Pain slow.
- Post-6, Requiem forces you to position carefully. Never clump; spread with allies. Your R On The Hunt lets you kite him easily.
- Karthus first item spike (Liandry's or Rod) around 10-12 minutes is dangerous. Punish him before completion; he's immobile and vulnerable.
- Sivir spikes at Infinity Edge completion. Karthus struggles against your attack speed and mobility; R On The Hunt lets you stick and duel.
- Shove the wave into Karthus' tower. Force him to farm under turret or roam; he lacks wave clear and can't duel you early.
- Lethal Tempo grants attack speed for extended dueling against immobile Karthus; your R On The Hunt synergizes perfectly for all-ins.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar as flex pick; cleanses Wall of Pain slow, letting you stick to and kite Karthus in teamfights.

sivir__katarina.notes:
- Katarina's Death Lotus channels massive damage; dodge it or block with Spell Shield preemptively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Katarina outtrrades you up close, farm with Q from distance.
- Bait her Shunpo onto you, then Spell Shield her followup damage or Bouncing Blade.
- Post-6, Death Lotus becomes her primary threat; position away from walls and grouped enemies.
- First item spike (Protobelt or Nashors) makes her stronger; respect her all-in window closely.
- Sivir spikes when Katarina wastes Shunpo or ult; punish with R and kite freely.
- Shove the wave hard with Q and W; deny her roam windows and gank setup.
- Precision (Attack Speed + Crit) scales better into lategame teamfights than Lethal Tempo alternatives.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if she has heavy CC; cleanse setup enables you to escape.

sivir__kayn.notes:
- Threat: Kayn's Shadow Step lets him flank you; Umbral Trespass locks you down while dealing massive damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayn has no reliable all-in yet, so cs freely from range with Q.
- Trading: Bait Kayn's Q Reaping Slash, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; never let him dash close.
- Post6: Umbral Trespass forces you to position around teammates; use E Spell Shield to block the burst damage.
- Spike: Kayn's first item spike (likely Serrated Dirk into lethality) is dangerous; you're vulnerable if caught isolated.
- Window: You spike harder mid-game with crit items; group with team to deny Kayn flank angles and picks.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard; it denies Kayn safety to scale and forces him to choose between farm or roam.
- Rune: Press the Attack for early trade pressure and sustained damage; helps you punish his positioning mistakes.
- Item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar early if Kayn gets ahead; cleanse the Umbral Trespass damage and reposition immediately.

sivir__kennen.notes:
- Threat: Kennen's Mark of the Storm stun locks you; his Slicing Maelstrom teamfight ultimate deletes immobile ADCs.
- Early: Relatively safe. Stay beyond Thundering Shuriken range; farm safely with Q bounces from minions, avoid melee range.
- Trading: Never trade into his W passive marks. Bait Thundering Shuriken with E Spell Shield, then punish with Q.
- Post6: Extremely dangerous. Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom forces you into defensive positioning; stay grouped with allies for peel support.
- Spike: First item (likely Nashor's Tooth or similar) significantly increases his sustained DPS and mark application; play cautious.
- Window: After Kennen wastes Lightning Rush cooldown, he loses mobility and attack speed. Trade aggressively during this downtime window.
- Wave: Shove wave hard into tower using Q and W. Deny Kennen roaming opportunities and reduce his gank pressure.
- Rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot and Overheal for sustain against his constant mark application and poke.
- Item: Mercury's Treads reduce his stun duration; build early if Kennen plays aggressively into your positioning.

sivir__kled.notes:
- Kled's Q Bear Trap on a Rope hook into all-in burst when mounted; dodge or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kled out-trades you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid melee.
- Bait his Q with E Spell Shield; block the hook to gain health and speed burst.
- Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants Kled map pressure and speed; use R On The Hunt to match roam speed.
- His first item spike (likely Stridebreaker or Black Cleaver) makes him tankier; abuse this window with poke.
- You spike harder at two items; Kled falls off if dismounted and you kite with R.
- Shove the wave hard; force Kled to choose between farming and roaming with Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
- Take Lethal Tempo for sustained attack speed and dueling into his Violent Tendencies W trades.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if his Q becomes oppressive; cleanse the hook threat and kite.

sivir__khazix.notes:
- Kha'Zix isolated you with Leap and Taste Their Fear burst; E blocks one combo piece only.
- Play safe; Kha'Zix weak pre-6 but Leap range threatens. Farm with Q from distance, avoid isolation.
- Bait Leap with positioning, then trade back with W bounces. Never face-check river or side brush.
- Void Assault invisibility triggers Unseen Threat isolated bonus; R speed helps you kite but expect all-in.
- First item Serrated Dirk window is real danger; farm safely, don't contest skirmishes without vision control.
- Post-Serrated, Sivir scales better into teamfights; group with allies, use R to enable fights where he can't isolate.
- Shove wave hard; isolation requires Kha'Zix catching you alone. Waveclear denies him picking isolated targets safely.
- Precision secondary for Attack Speed and lifesteal scaling; sustains through poke and enables kiting pressure.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if he evolves Wings Leap; cleanse the burst setup before Taste Fear lands.

sivir__kindred.notes:
- Mounting Dread + Wolf's Frenzy combo chunks you hard; dodge the slow or die fast.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kindred out-trades you early. Farm at range with Q bounces.
- Bait Mounting Dread's slow with Fleet procs, then trade back. Never let Wolf stack freely.
- On The Hunt grants you speed to kite; use it to escape Kindred's Hunt marks.
- First Crit item is Kindred's spike window. Play safer until you hit Infinity Edge power.
- Post-first-item you outdamage Kindred hard. Group and teamfight where Lamb's Respite can't save them all.
- Shove the wave constantly; it denies Kindred Hunt setup space and forces her to chase you.
- Precision (Attack Speed + Crit) lets you out-DPS Kindred in extended trades and teamfights.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early if Mounting Dread slows cripple your kiting; cleanse and run.

sivir__kogmaw.notes:
- threat: Post-15 Kog'Maw with Navori + IE chunks faster; his W percentage damage outscales your early dominance.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; outdamage him but avoid extended trades. Use Q poke when he overextends.
- trading: Bait his Q with positioning, then trade back. Never walk into W range; E is unavoidable.
- post6: Living Artillery pressures from range; respect the damage spike on low-health targets. Stay healthy.
- spike: First item is danger window; his attack speed and range spike hard. Push him out before it completes.
- window: Pre-15 with early lead is your window. Deny CS, force base, prevent him reaching Navori + IE spike.
- wave: Shove hard and roam; deny his scaling time and prevent him farming safely in side lane.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for dueling pressure and kiting his close-range W; sustain helps pre-15 trading.
- item: Maw of Malmortius protects against his magic damage burst and shields your health before W melts you.

sivir__leblanc.notes:
- LeBlanc's all-in burst with Sigil of Malice detonation and Ethereal Chains roots lock you down.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid walking into E chain range.
- Bait her W Distortion dash with positioning, then use E Spell Shield to block her Q or E follow-up.
- Post-6, R Mimic doubles her threat; respect her burst windows and keep distance when cooldowns are up.
- LeBlanc's first item spike (usually Luden's Tempest) threatens you hard; dodge skillshots and farm safely under tower.
- You spike when you complete Navori Flickerblade or Infinity Edge; her cooldowns reset on your attacks then.
- Hold the wave near your tower; shove only when her W is on cooldown to prevent all-in roams.
- Press Attack or Lethal Tempo maximizes your attack speed to proc Navori resets and kite her burst.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse Ethereal Chains root and escape her all-in with the active dash.

sivir__leona.notes:
- threat: Zenith Blade lands, she dashes onto you instantly—if support doesn't peel, you die.
- early: Safe farm; stay further back than normal to avoid her E range entirely.
- trading: Never trade into her; dodge her Q damage and respect her all-in threat range.
- post6: Solar Flare stuns the center—use Spell Shield on it if you're caught in center.
- spike: First item isn't a huge danger; her threat comes from level spike and CDR.
- window: Mid-game when you have items and kiting tools; she needs to land E first.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; deny her E engagement range and force her to overextend.
- rune: Press the Attack; sustained damage output lets you out-trade her in extended fights.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar gives you cleanse against her stuns if support can't peel consistently.

sivir__leesin.notes:
- threat: Dragon's Rage knock-up chains into his combo; blocks one spell with Spell Shield then dies.
- early: Dangerous. Stay back from Lee Sin; his Sonic Wave range exceeds yours. Farm safely with Q.
- trading: Bait Sonic Wave with movement, then trade back hard. Never let him land Resonating Strike.
- post6: Dragon's Rage becomes lethal initiation. Position near allies so knock-up doesn't isolate you; use On The Hunt to kite.
- spike: First item spike hurts. Play safer during his Sheen/Brutalizer window; your damage doesn't match yet.
- window: After Lee Sin wastes Sonic Wave without hitting, trade aggressively before cooldown resets in six seconds.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. Sivir's immobility makes sidelane checks dangerous; force teamfights where On The Hunt shields allies.
- rune: Fleet Footwork — sustain and kite tools let you survive poke and escape close-range threats safely.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar — cleanse Dragon's Rage slow, unstick from Tempest cripple, and dodge burst follow-up combos easily.

sivir__lissandra.notes:
- Threat: Lissandra's W Ring of Frost roots you in place; follow with Q Ice Shard combo kills you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Ice Shard outranges your Boomerang Blade, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait her W Ring of Frost with forward movement, then Spell Shield the follow-up Q Ice Shard.
- Post6: Frozen Tomb stun locks you down hard; respect her ultimate and play around Spell Shield availability.
- Spike: First item spike around 800g is low threat; abuse her mana constraints before she completes items.
- Window: You spike hard at two items with attack speed; kite and pressure when her cooldowns are down.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard; it denies her W Ring of Frost engage range and prevents her roams.
- Rune: Press the Attack; early trading damage helps you win skirmishes before she scales defensive stats.
- Item: Mercury's Treads; tenacity reduces W Root duration and Frozen Tomb stun, increasing your kite potential.

sivir__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's Dream-Laden Bough passive combined with her spam damage forces you to respect her poke range constantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q gives stacking Move Speed so she zones aggressively. Last-hit from max range only.
- Dodge E Swirlseed with movement; it's her only reliable skillshot. Bait her W Watch Out! Eep! then trade back hard.
- On The Hunt lets Lillia kite you endlessly while her attacks reduce cooldowns. Stay grouped with team after level 6.
- Her first Navori Flickerblade spike is dangerous; she spams abilities and kites faster. Avoid solo fights; wait for team advantage.
- You spike harder at two items with crit and lifesteal. Group mid and force teamfights where she can't kite five.
- Shove the wave hard into her tower; forces her to choose between farming and roaming. Denies her roam pressure.
- Press Lethal Tempo to match her sustained damage and kite potential in extended fights and teamfights.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if her team has heavy CC; otherwise prioritize Infinity Edge for faster damage.

sivir__lucian.notes:
- threat: Lucian's Q double-procs Lightslinger passive; two rapid Piercing Lights with bonus damage burst you down.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to block Q. Farm safely; don't trade unless he wastes cooldowns.
- trading: Bait his Q with positioning, block it with E, then trade back. Avoid his W slow zone entirely.
- post6: The Culling forces you to space wider and use E defensively. He becomes stronger in all-ins.
- spike: First item spike (Serrated Dirk components) is his danger window. Play safer; don't get caught pushing.
- window: Mid-game after your first item. You outscale him hard if you survive lane—punish his mistakes then.
- wave: Shove it out. Lucian struggles to farm under tower; push him out of XP range consistently.
- rune: Fleet Footwork. Sustain mitigates his early poke and synergizes with your passive for kiting safety.
- item: Maw of Malmortius. Blocks his Piercing Light burst damage and gives you shield for surviving all-ins.

sivir__locke.notes:
- Locke's Silver Stake and Ritual Nails mark you; he converts marks into burst damage you cannot fully prevent or block.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q range is deceptive and marks set up his all-in. Farm from max range with Q.
- Never eat his Ritual Nails marks intentionally. Bait his W Soul Ignition self-damage window, then trade hard during his heal delay.
- Post-6, Purgatory's execution threshold and cooldown reset on champion hits make him a threat. Respect his all-in potential; maintain distance.
- First Sheen or Manamune spike doubles his mark conversion damage. Play safer, use E Spell Shield reactively to block Q or E.
- Sivir's spike comes with Navori Flickerblade and multiple items; your cooldown resets from R On The Hunt let you kite endlessly then.
- Hold wave near your tower. His E Ashen Pursuit dash gap-closer gets blocked by terrain; let him over-extend chasing minions near turret.
- Pick Precision with Lethal Tempo. Extended auto-attack range from Tempo and Fleet of Foot kiting outscale his early burst pattern decisively.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early if his mark stacking feels unmanageable; cleanse reduces his conversion windows and gives you movement speed to escape.

sivir__lulu.notes:
- threat: Lulu's W polymorph disables you hard; her ult shields and empowers her ADC in fights.
- early: Safe farm. Lulu lacks early damage. Stay out of her Q line; farm at range.
- trading: Avoid her Q Glitterlance—it slows heavily. Bait it with positioning, then trade with Boomerang Blade.
- post6: Wild Growth turns her ADC into a raid boss. Eliminate their ADC before she ults them.
- spike: First item spike is moderate. Abuse the window before her support items come online.
- window: Mid-game with R active. Use On The Hunt to kite and burst the ADC down fast.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Lulu makes trades slow; avoid extended skirmishes in extended lanes.
- rune: Lethal Tempo—attack speed lets you burst trades faster before she shields or disables you.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses polymorph CC and provides AD; add it if her W becomes oppressive.

sivir__lux.notes:
- Lux's Q Light Binding locks you down; follow up with R Final Spark and Illumination proc deals massive burst damage.
- Play safe behind minions; dodge E Lucent Singularity by positioning away from its detonation zone, then farm freely during cooldown.
- Bait Q Light Binding by moving unpredictably, then trade with W Ricochet; E Spell Shield blocks Q or R to negate all-ins.
- Post-6, respect R Final Spark range; stay behind minions and use E Spell Shield reactively to block her ultimate damage and refresh.
- First item Luden's Tempest is minimal threat; punish her immobility by grouping with allies and using R On The Hunt to engage.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you; R On The Hunt grants your team speed while her E Lucent Singularity setup takes time to land.
- Shove the wave hard with W Ricochet to deny Lux safe poke range; prevent her from controlling spacing around minion clusters.
- Fleet Footwork sustains poke damage and synergizes with your mobility; Precision tree helps scaling into late teamfights where you dominate.
- Add Maw of Malmortius early to block burst damage from her R Final Spark and Illumination passive combined magic burst.

sivir__malzahar.notes:
- threat: Nether Grasp suppression locks you down; Malzahar kills immobilized targets easily with Void Swarm.
- early: Safe farm. Stay outside Call of the Void range; dodge portals. Don't fight level 1-3.
- trading: Bait Call of the Void with Spell Shield; block the silence to trade freely with Boomerang Blade.
- post6: Nether Grasp is lethal. Positioning matters critically. Never get caught alone without Spell Shield available.
- spike: First item around 10-12 minutes threatens you. Play safer; respect the gank setup Malzahar enables.
- window: After Nether Grasp is on cooldown, punish hard. Use On The Hunt to chase or reset safely.
- wave: Shove hard with On The Hunt active. Denies Malzahar time to threaten with ult; keeps him pushed.
- rune: Precision primary for attack speed and healing; sustain and duel pressure counter his poke damage.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Malefic Visions and provides magic resist; lifeline breaks Nether Grasp suppression chains.

sivir__maokai.notes:
- Threat: Maokai's W roots you in place, preventing kiting and allowing his team to collapse.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Maokai lacks kill threat but Q slows you. Stay spaced out.
- Trading: Bait his Q with lateral movement, then trade with W bounces. Never face-check brush.
- Post6: Nature's Grasp forces you back or into a root. Play safer, use On The Hunt to escape.
- Spike: First item is minimal danger. Your On The Hunt lets you kite his advances effectively.
- Window: Mid-game when Maokai's cooldowns reset slowly. Abuse mobility and Boomerang Blade poke from range.
- Wave: Shove consistently; prevents Maokai from setting up W engages in neutral territory near you safely.
- Rune: Precision with Lethal Tempo; attack speed and range extension let you kite roots and roots.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar; removes his W root and speeds you away, negating his primary threat.

sivir__masteryi.notes:
- Threat: Master Yi's Alpha Strike makes him untargetable while dealing damage; Spell Shield blocks one cast only.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Master Yi outduels you; farm with Q Boomerang Blade at range.
- Trading: Never trade into him directly. Bait Alpha Strike with positioning, then Spell Shield it to gain MS.
- Post6: Highlander makes him immune to slows and extends on kills. Stay grouped with allies; never fight alone.
- Spike: First item (likely Berserker's Greaves or Wuju Style stacking) is his danger window. Respect his duel threat.
- Window: You spike harder at two items with attack speed and crit. Group mid and use On The Hunt.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Master Yi roam pressure and jungle gank setup opportunities.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo lets you match his attack speed during Highlander fights and sustain trades better.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse slows from jungle ganks and maintain kite distance against him.

sivir__mel.notes:
- threat: Mel's Overwhelm stacks enable Golden Eclipse to burst you from range; dodge Radiant Barrage.
- early: Safely farm at range with Boomerang Blade; avoid close trades where she stacks Overwhelm.
- trading: Bait her Radiant Barrage with Spell Shield, then trade back; never walk into Solar Snare.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite her root attempts; her ult range means you stay threatened.
- spike: Her first item spike (around Nashor's Fang or Liandry's) increases Overwhelm damage; farm safely then.
- window: You spike harder mid-game with crit; abuse Infinity Edge + Navori Flickerblade to out-duel her.
- wave: Shove waves hard with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade; deny her close-range Overwhelm stacking opportunities.
- rune: Precision (Lethal Tempo) because attack speed lets you kite and reposition against her root pressure.
- item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar third or fourth to cleanse Solar Snare and enable more aggressive kiting.

sivir__missfortune.notes:
- threat: Her R Bullet Time deals massive damage in a cone; dodge or use E Spell Shield
- early: Safe farm. Stay away from low minions to avoid her Q Double Up bouncing to you
- trading: Avoid trading into her Love Tap bonus damage on new targets; bait her W cooldown
- post6: Her R becomes a major threat; use E Spell Shield to block it or position sideways
- spike: First item spike (likely Manamune or early crit) isn't dangerous; you outscale her significantly
- window: Mid-game onwards you outscale her; leverage your waveclear with Q Boomerang Blade and R On The Hunt
- wave: Shove the wave to deny her Love Tap value and limit her safe trading opportunities
- rune: Precision primary for Attack Speed and Triumph; sustain and dueling edge you need here
- item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if her E Make It Rain slow is limiting your kiting significantly

sivir__milio.notes:
- threat: His R cleanses your CC and shields allies; coordinate burst timing with your team to overwhelm.
- early: Safe farm—Milio has no real lane threat. Push wave freely and harass with Q when he positions poorly.
- trading: Bait his E shield with Q poke, then all-in. His Q is shieldable with E; dodge it or block it.
- post6: His R turns fights; respect the healing and cleanse. Focus on positioning to avoid getting caught in teamfights.
- spike: First item isn't a danger window. Sivir outpushes and kites around his zone; maintain lane control and pressure.
- window: Your power spike is teamfight initiation when Milio lacks ultimate. Use R mobility to catch him out of position.
- wave: Shove wave constantly—you outpush him. Force him to choose between backing or getting poked under tower.
- rune: Fleet Footwork. He can't threaten you early; sustain and kite his poke while scaling into duelist.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanses any slow from his Q and gives you emergency mobility against his team's CC.

sivir__mordekaiser.notes:
- Realm of Death isolates you from allies and steals your stats, turning fights unwinnable if caught alone.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Mordekaiser outtraces you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid his E pull range.
- Never walk into Death's Grasp range. Bait his E with Fleet of Foot movement, then trade with Q.
- Realm of Death at level 6 is a hard counter—you cannot escape or block it with Spell Shield.
- Mordekaiser first item spike (likely Rylai's or Liandry's) strengthens his durability and kite potential; respect his damage output.
- You spike when Mordekaiser is below 50% HP and far from minions—kite and poke with Q bounces relentlessly.
- Shove the wave hard into his tower to deny him melee range engage; maintain distance and safety.
- Press Attack or Lethal Tempo; you need extra trading damage and attack speed to match his sustained output.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if you struggle; the active removes Death's Grasp pull and cleanses threat instantly.

sivir__morgana.notes:
- Threat: Dark Binding roots you long enough for Morgana to unload damage; dodge it or die.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay mobile, avoid predictable positioning near minion clusters she can Dark Binding into.
- Trading: Bait her Q by moving unpredictably, then trade back with Boomerang Blade. Never face-check brush.
- Post6: Soul Shackles is wide AoE on cast—use Spell Shield immediately when she ults to negate chains.
- Spike: Her first item (Liandry's Torment or Zhonya's Hourglass) is dangerous. Respect her damage; don't overextend.
- Window: You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items. Use mobility to kite around her low waveclear.
- Wave: Push past her into tower. Her waveclear is weak; force her to use mana or fall behind.
- Rune: Press the Attack—short trades reward your attack speed and proc bonus damage before she roots you.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Dark Binding root if caught, then you kite freely with Fleet of Foot.

sivir__naafiri.notes:
- Threat: Naafiri's packmates amplify her all-in damage; her dash-heavy kit lets her stick and overwhelm you.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3. Stay back; Naafiri trades efficiently with pack damage. Avoid extended fights near her.
- Trading: Dodge Darkin Daggers with positioning or E Spell Shield to block and gain health back safely.
- Post6: Hounds' Pursuit lets Naafiri chase relentlessly with packmate backup. Use R On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate threat. Spike harder when she gets Serrated Dirk; play safe then.
- Window: Post-first-item, you out-range and out-kite her. Use Q Boomerang Blade to poke safely and farm.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard. Push her into tower and create distance; deny her roaming pack engage.
- Rune: Precision secondary for Triumph and Bloodline sustain to survive her bleed stacking and all-in burst.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from her Q and R burst, especially if she builds lethality.

sivir__nautilus.notes:
- threat: His Q hook pulls you into his team; dodge it or shield it preemptively.
- early: Safe farm at range. Stay outside Q range (roughly 900 units). Farm with Q.
- trading: Bait his Q by positioning unpredictably, then trade back with W bounces when it misses.
- post6: His R chases and knocks up; use your R to disengage and kite away safely.
- spike: First item (Sunfire or tank item) isn't a huge danger; you outrange and kite him.
- window: After he wastes Q without hooking you, fight back immediately before cooldown resets.
- wave: Shove the wave when safe to deny him hook engages; retreat if he positions aggressively.
- rune: Fleet Footwork (you already have Move Speed tools; synergizes with passive and kiting).
- item: Mercurial Scimitar (cleanses root from Staggering Blow if hit, keeps you mobile).

sivir__neeko.notes:
- threat: Neeko's E Tangle-Barbs roots you, then Pop Blossom stuns; you die immobilized.
- early: Safe farm only. Neeko Q Blooming Burst outranges you; stay back, scale.
- trading: Never chase her into fog. Bait E Tangle-Barbs with movement, then trade.
- post6: Pop Blossom preparation hidden by disguise—assume she's ulting. Play ultra-safe, hug tower.
- spike: First item is danger. Her Q damage and root duration spike hard.
- window: After she wastes E without hitting you, all-in before cooldown resets.
- wave: Shove hard early to deny her roam and setup for Pop Blossom ganks.
- rune: Precision—Fleet of Foot + Bloodline sustain keeps you alive through poke.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar removes root from E, lets you escape Pop Blossom stun.

sivir__nidalee.notes:
- Nidalee's Javelin Toss poke from fog of war forces Sivir to play passively or risk burst damage.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm at maximum range, avoid brush, respect Javelin Toss range from fog.
- Bait Javelin Toss with E Spell Shield when Nidalee commits; punish her immobility during channel.
- Post-6 Nidalee gains all-in threat via Pounce; play safer, use E reactively for cougar form dives.
- Nidalee's first item spike (usually Nashor's Tooth or Shadowflame) increases burst; Sivir can still kite.
- Sivir power window comes at three items when attack speed and crit let her kite cougar.
- Shove the wave early to deny Nidalee brush control and force her to defend tower.
- Precision (Attack Speed/Crit scaling) or Lethal Tempo for dueling; scales better than Hail of Blades.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if Nidalee builds heavy poke; cleanse Javelin debuffs and heal burst simultaneously.

sivir__nilah.notes:
- threat: Nilah's W Jubilant Veil dodges your autos; her R Apotheosis burst pulls and traps you in teamfights.
- early: Dangerous—stay behind minions, avoid trading when her W is up, farm safely with Q Boomerang Blade.
- trading: Bait her W Jubilant Veil with autos, then trade back with Q; dodge her E Slipstream dash.
- post6: Her R Apotheosis becomes a massive teamfight tool—never group tightly; kite away and spam Q from range.
- spike: First item is a danger window; she gains sustained damage and healing share—respect her damage and disengage.
- window: After she uses W Jubilant Veil and E Slipstream, punish with Q Boomerang Blade and autos before cooldowns reset.
- wave: Shove the wave with Q to keep her pushed out; prevents her from engaging with W plus Q combo.
- rune: Fleet of Foot—sustains your poke, rewards your kiting playstyle, and gives mobility to escape her engage attempts.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar—cleanses her R Apotheosis pull and provides lifesteal to match her healing share advantage.

sivir__nocturne.notes:
- Threat: Unspeakable Horror fear duration traps you; Paranoia removes vision for his all-in engage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Nocturne weak pre-6, so farm freely and avoid overextending.
- Trading: Bait Shroud of Darkness with Boomerang Blade before committing to Ricochet attacks.
- Post6: Paranoia removes your vision; position near tower and use Spell Shield to block fear.
- Spike: Nocturne's first item spike (around 8-10 min) dangerous; respect his Unspeakable Horror range.
- Window: Post-first-item, Sivir outranges and kites; punish Nocturne when Paranoia is down with poke.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; Nocturne roams better than you, so deny him roam advantage.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork; extra mobility lets you kite Nocturne and reposition from Unspeakable Horror.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Unspeakable Horror fear and removes Paranoia vision debuff immediately.

sivir__nunuwillump.notes:
- Biggest Snowball Ever! knockup locks you down for Nunu's followup combo damage.
- Play safe; Nunu ganks early. Stay near tower, farm with Q Boomerang Blade range.
- Bait E Snowball Barrage with positioning, then trade. Never face-check brush where W initiates.
- R Absolute Zero slows hard. Use E Spell Shield to block it or kite hard.
- Nunu's first item spike (typically tank item) reduces your damage. Punish levels 5-8 before it.
- Post-15 minutes: Sivir outdamages Nunu. Group with R On The Hunt active; abuse superiority.
- Shove the wave quickly. Nunu wants to roam and gank; denying cs forces him mid.
- Precision main (attack speed and crit scaling). Sivir scales harder into teamfights than Nunu does.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if Nunu builds heavy CC; cleanse E root and kite freely.

sivir__orianna.notes:
- Threat: Command: Shockwave launches you into her team; Command: Attack pokes you down safely from range.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Q outranges your autos, so stay back and last-hit only.
- Trading: Dodge Command: Attack with E Spell Shield to gain health and movespeed; never face-check her.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you chase or kite her, but Shockwave zones you hard from teamfights.
- Spike: First item spike (Lost Chapter into Luden's) strengthens her poke; farm safely and scale instead.
- Window: You spike harder at two items (attack speed + lifesteal); look to duel her in sidelane then.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; her Command: Dissonance slows you if you push, so farm defensively.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo; attack-speed ramp lets you kite her Ball and proc Fleet of Foot frequently.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius; her magic damage and burst are real threats mid-game teamfights.

sivir__ornn.notes:
- threat: Ornn's E Searing Charge into terrain knocks you up, leaving you vulnerable to his full combo.
