- early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay away from terrain and avoid trading near walls or your tower.
- trading: Bait his Q Volcanic Rupture with movement, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces on minions.
- post6: Call of the Forge God forces you to kite away; use E Spell Shield to block Brittle status.
- spike: Ornn's first item spike is moderate danger; his tankiness increases but he lacks burst to all-in you.
- window: Your power window comes after first item when you have crit and lifesteal to duel his tankiness.
- wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Ornn's forge range and force him to chase or miss CS.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for extra kiting speed and sustain to trade safely against his poke and terrain setups.
- item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse Brittle status from his W and R before enemy engage.

sivir__poppy.notes:
- threat: Heroic Charge stuns you into wall; E Spell Shield blocks it but costs your defensive tool.
- early: Safe farm. Stay mobile with Fleet of Foot procs; avoid walls behind you where Poppy can pin.
- trading: Bait W Steadfast Presence dash-stop with Q Boomerang Blade; dodge E by positioning away from walls always.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite and reset E cooldown with attacks; use ult to escape Keeper's Verdict knockback.
- spike: Poppy's first armor item (Kaenic Rookern or similar) is not a major threat; you outrange her safely.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where you have R up; kite backwards while allies follow your Move Speed buff from ult.
- wave: Shove and reset. Poppy needs walls to threaten you; denying wave control removes her setup for ganks.
- rune: Precision (Fleet of Foot synergy) because you need sustained kiting and healing against her all-in potential.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Poppy's E stun slow if you time it; protects against wall-pin follow-ups.

sivir__qiyana.notes:
- Threat: Audacity gap-closes and Supreme Display stuns your entire team; survive her engage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Qiyana outtraded early. Use Q range advantage from distance.
- Trading: Bait Audacity with positioning, then trade back with Q. Never face-check brush.
- Post6: Supreme Display detonates grouped enemies. Space away from teammates and play around cooldown.
- Spike: Qiyana first item spikes hard. Play safer, farm with Q, avoid all-ins.
- Window: Post-teamfight or when Qiyana ult on cooldown, you kite and duel better.
- Wave: Shove when safe; deny her Audacity engage range and reset opportunity frequently.
- Rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot keystone; sustain and kite her poke.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses Supreme Display stun and blocks follow-up burst damage hard.

sivir__quinn.notes:
- threat: Quinn's Vault interrupts you and slows; her Harrier bonus damage chunks hard in extended trades.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3. Quinn out-damages you early; farm with Q from distance, avoid close range.
- trading: Don't fight when Harrier is active on you. Bait her Vault with positioning, then trade back.
- post6: Behind Enemy Lines gives Quinn sustained chase and repeated Harrier marks. Play near tower; use E defensively.
- spike: First item (Manamune or similar AD items) around 10 minutes—Quinn spikes hard. Respect range, farm safely then.
- window: Mid-game teamfights favor you when your ult (On The Hunt) is up and Quinn's cooldowns are staggered.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Quinn can Vault through minions to gap-close; denying her engage angle is critical.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for sustain and kiting; you need the extra movement and healing to survive Quinn's poke.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks her Blinding Assault damage spike and gives you magic shield when she bursts.

sivir__rell.notes:
- Threat: Rell's W crash is unshieldable AoE knockup that catches you if positioned poorly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; she's slow unmounted so abuse range and kite backward.
- Trading: Bait her Q Shattering Strike with E Spell Shield, then punish her cooldown.
- Post6: Magnet Storm ult pulls nearby enemies—stay behind frontline to avoid crash and pull.
- Spike: First item isn't major threat; she needs tank items to become truly dangerous.
- Window: Post-first-item when you spike attack speed and lifesteal; kite and farm safely.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower so she can't position to crash engage on you.
- Rune: Fleet of Foot (matches your P, sustains against poke and trading damage).
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar removes pull CC from Magnet Storm and boosts survivability against her.

sivir__rakan.notes:
- Threat: Rakan's W Grand Entrance engages you; use E Spell Shield to block knockup and deny his entire play
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; respect his Q poke range but punish if he wastes W without backup nearby
- Trading: Bait his W by positioning close; when he dashes in, E blocks knockup and you retaliate freely with Q
- Post6: The Quickness is wide AoE charm—stay spread from allies and position to sidestep his path through lane
- Spike: First item window is dangerous for you; Rakan gains survivability and roam threat—play safer, ward river constantly
- Window: Your R On The Hunt powerspike lets you chase and kite him when he misuses W; punish hard
- Wave: Shove consistently with Q bounces and W ricochet to deny his roam setup and keep him defending turret
- Rune: Press the Attack maximizes your Q damage and dueling when he whiffs W; you win the trade
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar removes his R charm debuff and gives you splitpush mobility to escape his roam ganks

sivir__rammus.notes:
- Threat: Frenzying Taunt locks you down; Rammus then deals sustained damage via Spiked Shell scaling.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q harass; never let Rammus gap-close with Powerball.
- Trading: Bait Frenzying Taunt with positioning, then kite away. Dodge Powerball impact or use Spell Shield reactively.
- Post6: Soaring Slam adds AOE threat and slow. Respect the range; maintain distance and use On The Hunt to escape.
- Spike: First armor item (Thornmail or Kaenic) spikes his tankiness hard. Punish before it completes with poke.
- Window: Mid-game when Rammus lacks full resistances. Abuse Q poke and W bounces before he becomes unkillable.
- Wave: Shove hard and reset. Rammus wants extended trades in lane; denying him mana and time pressures him.
- Rune: Press the Attack—sustained attack speed and damage amp help you lock him down once isolated.
- Item: Mortal Reminder if Rammus builds heavy healing; otherwise Maw of Malmortius for magic bulk versus Soaring Slam.

sivir__reksai.notes:
- Void Rush lunge and Unburrow knock-up lock you down; dodge with E Spell Shield or R movement.
- Play safe level 1-3; Rek'Sai's burst trades win early. Farm with Q, avoid close range duels.
- Bait Unburrow by standing near her Burrow entrance, then Q away. Never trade into her max Fury Bite.
- Post-6, Void Rush makes her untargetable and mobile. Use E reactively to block follow-up abilities after she lands.
- First item spike (likely Warrior Enchant) is dangerous; farm safely and respect her all-in damage until you scale.
- Mid-game teamfights favor Sivir once you have Infinity Edge and attack speed. Kite backward and use R for allied peel.
- Shove the wave hard; Rek'Sai needs vision control and gank setup. Denying her Burrow access limits her playmaking.
- Precision (Attack Speed/Crit scaling) or Fleet Footwork (sustain and kite); Fleet matches her early pressure better.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar if she gets ahead; cleanses her crowd control and provides survivability against her burst.

sivir__renekton.notes:
- Threat: Renekton's W stun plus empowered E armor shred lock you down and burst you easily.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, never contest melee range trades.
- Trading: Bait his E dash, then Spell Shield his incoming W to negate the stun.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite away from him; use R to escape his all-in.
- Spike: His first item (likely Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his damage and stay back.
- Window: After he wastes E and W on minions, punish with Q harass and spacing.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny him melee farming and force him to chase you down.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo allows you to kite and trade with him via attack speed and range.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius early if he snowballs to block his burst and heal reduction.

sivir__rengar.notes:
- Rengar all-ins from brush or ult with burst damage; dodge Bola Strike or die.
- Play safe; farm ranged; avoid pushing into brush; respect his leap range from nearby bushes.
- Bait his Bola Strike with movement, then trade back with Boomerang Blade; never face-check brush.
- His Thrill of the Hunt camouflage forces you to play passive and position defensively always.
- His first item spike (around 10-12 min) is a kill window; respect it and farm safely.
- You spike when you complete Infinity Edge or Navori Flickerblade; kite and abuse range then.
- Shove wave into his tower to deny him brush control and force fights in open.
- Fleet Footwork keeps you mobile and healthy against his all-in burst in lane trades.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early if Rengar threatens repeated burst; its shield blocks chunk damage.

sivir__riven.notes:
- Riven's Broken Wings combo chains fast; dodge or Spell Shield the third hit knockback.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q trades favorably. Farm with Q from distance, avoid extended fights.
- Bait her Broken Wings third activation, then Spell Shield it to block knockback and gain MS.
- On The Hunt lets you kite and duel better; use it to chase or escape her.
- Her first item spike (Black Cleaver or similar AD) is dangerous; play back and farm safely until you scale.
- Post-first-item, your attack speed and On The Hunt let you kite and out-duel her sustained damage.
- Push the wave out to deny her all-in range; force her to chase you toward your tower.
- Precision (Attack Speed and Crit scaling) or Lethal Tempo keystone suits your extended auto-attack trades against her.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early if she threatens you; blocks burst and gives you tankiness and AD.

sivir__rumble.notes:
- Threat: The Equalizer (R) is a massive AOE slow that zones you hard and forces bad positioning fights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Rumble out-damages you early. Farm from distance with Q, avoid Flamespitter (Q) cone.
- Trading: Bait his W for shield waste, then trade back. Use E Spell Shield to block Electro Harpoon (E) slow.
- Post6: Rumble becomes extremely dangerous. The Equalizer (R) wall denies entire zones. Play around edges, never group in narrow areas.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's typically) makes his poke unbearable. Respect range, stay healthy, and prepare to buy Maw early.
- Window: Mid-game when Rumble's ult is on cooldown and he's not in Danger Zone yet. Push damage and objectives hard.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Rumble wants to trap you in The Equalizer (R) zones; closer to base keeps you safe.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo lets you kite and duel Rumble when he closes. Resets on champions help you escape his pressure.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his magic damage spike and gives you the MR to survive poke and all-ins safely.

sivir__ryze.notes:
- Threat: Ryze's Spell Flux debuff amplifies his damage; Realm Warp allows him to kite or escape your all-ins.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid standing near minions since Spell Flux bounces. Last-hit from range with Q.
- Trading: Bait Ryze's Overload with positioning, then trade back. Use Spell Shield to block Rune Prison root or Spell Flux.
- Post6: Realm Warp gives Ryze escape and ally engage tool. Don't chase him into fog; respect the portal pressure.
- Spike: Watch Ryze's first item completion; he gains mana and damage. Stay mobile and respect his burst window.
- Window: You outpace him mid-game with On The Hunt and attack speed. Punish when his Realm Warp is down.
- Wave: Shove the wave in; Ryze struggles to clear fast. Deny him safe farming and force him to fight.
- Rune: Press the Attack maximizes your all-in damage and lets you win short skirmishes before he scales.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius; the spell shield blocks Ryze's burst and the magic resist counters his scaling damage.

sivir__samira.notes:
- threat: Samira's level-3 and level-6 all-ins with E Wild Rush combo into R Inferno Trigger kill you.
- early: Levels 1-3 are safe—outscale her trades with auto-shielded Q poke before her all-in threat exists.
- trading: Don't waste Q on her when W Spell Shield is up; bait it first with autos.
- post6: Respect her kill threat at any HP; she can all-in lethal after unlocking R Inferno Trigger.
- spike: Her first item spike is dangerous; don't get caught out of position during her power window.
- window: You have a punish window pre-6 when she lacks ult and kill pressure on you.
- wave: Shove the wave to deny her engage angles; fast clear with Q and W limits her all-in setup.
- rune: Fleet of Foot—sustain and mobility let you kite her E Wild Rush and duel safely post-6.
- item: Build Maw of Malmortius early to block her magic damage burst and survive her level-6 all-in.

sivir__sejuani.notes:
- Threat: Sejuani's Glacial Prison stun locks you down; follow-up Winter's Wrath and Arctic Assault chain CC.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Sejuani needs Frost stacks to threaten. Stay max range, use Q to poke safely.
- Trading: Dodge Arctic Assault with Fleet of Foot move speed or E preemptively. Never trade into her W spam.
- Post6: Glacial Prison creates massive gank threat. Play safer, position near tower, use E to block the bola skillshot.
- Spike: Sejuani first item spike is minimal threat. Your Infinity Edge and attack speed spike outpaces her tankiness window.
- Window: Sivir power window is mid-game with R active. On The Hunt's cooldown reduction lets you kite and duel her.
- Wave: Shove the wave quickly; Sejuani struggles to contest pushed waves. Deny her engage setup near your tower.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo or Fleet of Foot; you need sustained damage and kite potential against her heavy CC.
- Item: Add Mercury's Treads early if Sejuani lands repeated stuns; tenacity reduces her CC chain lock duration significantly.

sivir__senna.notes:
- Threat: Her long-range Q poke and global R damage scales infinitely with souls; respect her range.
- Early: Safe farm—she outranges you. Stay behind minions, use Q to farm from distance safely.
- Trading: Dodge her Q with movement; bait W root with E Spell Shield to gain health back.
- Post6: Her R pressures map globally and shields allies; focus on pushing lane to deny souls.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune) isn't a major spike; you outscale her; keep farming safely.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete Infinity Edge and Bloodthirster; your DPS vastly exceeds her sustained damage.
- Wave: Shove constantly into tower to deny soul spawns and deny her poke opportunities safely.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo—sustains your auto-attack DPS advantage and helps you kite her immobile teamfight presence.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from her Q and R poke damage when needed.

sivir__seraphine.notes:
- Threat: Encore charm chains you and allies; abuse cooldown gaps between her spell casts.
- Early: Safe farm—Seraphine Q range limits her threat; stay outside High Note zone, farm safely.
- Trading: Bait Beat Drop with movement; dodge the line skillshot, then all-in with Q and W.
- Post6: Encore chains charm through your team; position sideways to avoid line, never clump with allies.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or Luden's) spikes her damage around 10-12 minutes; farm safely, don't fight.
- Window: Sivir gains edge when Seraphine W is down; force trades on cooldown, punish relentlessly.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard with Q and W; deny Seraphine mana sustain and poke safety.
- Rune: Press the Attack—execute short bursts in lane, proc it with Q then basic attacks.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar—cleanses charm from Encore, breaks her cc chain before she chains your team.

sivir__sett.notes:
- threat: Facebreaker stun locks you; The Show Stopper carries you into his team for deletion
- early: Dangerous. Stay back, use Q range to farm safely; avoid close trades near minions
- trading: Bait Facebreaker by positioning on one side only, then trade back with Q and W
- post6: Massive threat window. The Show Stopper deletes you if landed; play safer, respect ult range
- spike: First item spike is moderate danger. Prioritize spacing and use E to block his W
- window: Mid-game when you have two items and ult active; kite and burst him with team
- wave: Shove it in. Sivir pushes faster; Sett struggles to all-in under tower; deny his engage
- rune: Resolve secondary for Conditioning; extra armor helps survive his true damage and early all-ins
- item: Mercurial Scimitar; cleanse The Show Stopper mid-flight to dodge displacement and reduce slam damage

sivir__shen.notes:
- Shadow Dash taunt locks you down; use Spell Shield to block it or position around minions to bait the dash.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Shen's Q poke chunks hard and his Ki Barrier shields frequently when trading back.
- Bait Shadow Dash by positioning aggressively, then kite away; use Spell Shield reactively on the taunt, not proactively.
- Stand United lets Shen save teammates across the map; play around his ultimate cooldown and expect gank assistance.
- Shen's first item spike (typically tank item) is not a danger window; abuse your early DPS advantage before then.
- Post-first item when Sivir completes Infinity Edge, you spike harder than Shen's defensive items; abuse this window hard.
- Shove the wave into Shen's tower to deny him free sustain from minions and force him to farm under tower.
- Pick Precision (Attack Speed) runes to maximize Ricochet bounces and trading damage; outpace his defensive scaling early.
- Add Maw of Malmortius if Shen's team has heavy magic damage threatening your teamfight positioning or survivability.

sivir__shyvana.notes:
- Threat: Dragon's Descent leap into melee range closes gaps Sivir cannot escape without cooldowns.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Shyvana will all-in if you're caught extended near her.
- Trading: Bait Molten Burst with positioning, then trade back with Boomerang Blade while she's on cooldown.
- Post6: Dragon's Descent makes her a lethal all-in threat; stay near tower or group with team.
- Spike: First item spike is moderate threat; her damage and durability spike harder mid-game with multiple items.
- Window: Early lane before level 6 and when she wastes Dragon's Descent on another lane.
- Wave: Shove waves into tower to deny her melee farm and prevent her from roaming freely.
- Rune: Press the Attack for consistent trading damage and attack speed to match her scaling.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from her burst and blocks her combo's full damage.

sivir__singed.notes:
- threat: Singed's E Fling yanks you backward and leaves you vulnerable to his poison damage.
- early: Play safe—Singed outranges your Q early. Farm with Q from distance; avoid walking into poison.
- trading: Dodge nothing (his E is point-and-click). Trade when he wastes E on minions; use Q.
- post6: On The Hunt lets you kite his Poison Trail and chase if he overextends badly.
- spike: His first item (likely Rylai's or Liandry's) isn't a major threat window; maintain distance.
- window: Once you complete Navori Flickerblade, your Q cooldown resets let you spam safely and poke.
- wave: Shove the wave hard—Singed hates losing push. Forces him to either chase (vulnerable) or lose cs.
- rune: Precision with Fleet of Foot; your passive and rune both scale your kiting power heavily.
- item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse Fling's knockback and any slow applied afterward from adhesive.

sivir__sion.notes:
- Threat: Sion's Q stun and R knockup lock you down; you cannot kite or escape reliably.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Sion needs time to stack HP; abuse range advantage with Q poke.
- Trading: Bait his Q charge with positioning; dodge the knockup window, then trade with W ricochet bounce.
- Post6: Unstoppable Onslaught is a major threat. Play near tower; use E Spell Shield to block the knockup.
- Spike: Sion's first item (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) is dangerous. Reduce all-in attempts; stay safe and scale.
- Window: After Sion uses Q or R with no charge, punish hard with full W into Q combo quickly.
- Wave: Shove the wave in; Sion's slow waveclear and limited early mobility make him vulnerable to roams and jungle help.
- Rune: Precision with Lethal Tempo; you need attack speed and sustained DPS to pressure and kite his kit.
- Item: Add Mercurial Scimitar early if Sion stacks armor; cleanse slows from E and stay mobile for kiting.

sivir__smolder.notes:
- threat: His Q damage scaling means stacks = lethality; deny him CS and kill pressure.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; use Q to CS from range, avoid all-ins.
- trading: Bait his E engage, then trade back hard; dodge Q with movement.
- post6: MMOOOMMMM slows and zones; respect Mom's damage and stay mobile with On The Hunt.
- spike: First item spike (likely AD item) strengthens Q; punish by denying stacks before it completes.
- window: Pre-stack-25 he's weak; shove him out and starve stacks before stack-125 makes him unkillable.
- wave: Shove hard and roam; deny CS denies stacks, which denies his scaling entirely.
- rune: Precision with Fleet of Foot synergy and Overheal for sustain into his poke.
- item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his Q scaling and provides magic resist for Mom's ult.

sivir__sona.notes:
- Threat: Crescendo stuns your entire team; block it with Spell Shield to deny her engage.
- Early: Safe farm—Sona has no waveclear and short range. Farm freely, avoid her Q poke.
- Trading: Dodge nothing; Sona has no skillshots. Use Boomerang Blade to harass her safely.
- Post6: Crescendo is her win condition. Always hold Spell Shield for her ultimate in fights.
- Spike: First item doesn't spike her threat. Punish her immobility and low range constantly.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights when you Spell Shield Crescendo—she's useless; chase and close out.
- Wave: Push her under tower hard. She can't waveclear; deny her safety and gold.
- Rune: (Not specified in prompt; choose your standard Sivir page with attack speed scaling focus.)
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses crowd control if Crescendo lands despite your Spell Shield attempt.

sivir__skarner.notes:
- Threat: Impale suppresses you without counterplay; E cannot block it. Position away from walls.
- Early: Safe farm. Skarner needs levels for threat. Use Q to harass from range safely.
- Trading: Avoid trading near walls where Ixtal's Impact can slam you. Bait Seismic Bastion before committing.
- Post6: Impale is point-and-click suppression. Never fight isolated. Stay near teammates or disengage entirely.
- Spike: First item empowers his Quaking stacks. Respect his damage; don't duel. Kite and poke instead.
- Window: Before six you outrange and outduel him. Push advantage with Q poke and farm lead.
- Wave: Shove waves quickly. Skarner excels in extended fights; deny him time to stack Quaking.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork. Your P synergizes for kiting; Fleet adds escape mobility against his gapclosers.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanses Impale suppression if timed correctly; buy early against confident Skarner players.

sivir__soraka.notes:
- threat: Soraka's Equinox silence locks you down; her Wish keeps her team alive through your damage.
- early: Safe farm—Soraka has no waveclear. Stand back, let her push, farm safely under tower.
- trading: Dodge her Starcall with Fleet of Foot movement. Bait Equinox with Spell Shield to block silence.
- post6: Wish sustain makes extended fights unwinnable. Keep engages short and force picks when she's isolated.
- spike: First item (Moonstone or Staff) strengthens her healing. Punish before she completes it with poke.
- window: When her Astral Infusion drops her below 30% HP—she can't heal allies or herself effectively.
- wave: Shove hard constantly. Soraka can't match waveclear; force her to use mana healing under tower pressure.
- rune: Precision primary—Press the Attack amplifies your burst when you force short trades onto her.
- item: Mortal Reminder—Grievous wounds cut her healing in half, making her Wish and Astral Infusion less threatening.

sivir__swain.notes:
- Threat: Nevermove roots you in place; Demonic Ascension drains your health while you're trapped and vulnerable.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Swain lacks damage. Stay near minions, use Q to harass from distance safely.
- Trading: Bait Nevermove with positioning, then trade with Q and W. Never fight in E's return path.
- Post6: Demonic Ascension forces you into awkward kiting patterns. Avoid grouping; use R mobility to escape drain radius.
- Spike: First item (likely Liandry's or Rylai's) strengthens his teamfight control. Farm safely, don't force trades into it.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete Navori Flickerblade; your Q cooldown resets faster than his E comes back up.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; prevents Swain from roaming and lets you kite backward into safety if ganked.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo; extended kiting range and attack speed let you stay outside Demonic Ascension drain while outputting damage.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar; cleanses the slow from Vision of Empire and Nevermove to maintain kiting distance and escape.

sivir__sylas.notes:
- Sylas W Kingslayer healing and all-in damage forces you into lethal range; respect his gap close.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance with Q Boomerang Blade, avoid extended trades near him.
- Bait his E Abscond/Abduct by positioning near walls, then trade when it's down; dodge Q Chain Lash.
- Sylas gains massive threat post-6 stealing R On The Hunt; he'll run you down with your own ultimate.
- His first item spike (likely AP damage item) is dangerous; stay further back and abuse Q range advantage.
- You spike when Sylas wastes E Abscond/Abduct; immediately trade or shove wave before he resets or re-engages.
- Shove the wave; Sylas needs to all-in close range, so pushing denies him all-in angles and safety.
- Press Attack or Lethal Tempo enables sustained damage trading that Sylas cannot match early; use it.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if Sylas gets significant AP; it cleanses his burst and grants escape speed.

sivir__tahmkench.notes:
- Devour at three stacks; he'll all-in after stacking you with Tongue Lash three times.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q range is deceptive, stay away from low minions.
- Shield his Tongue Lash with E when he goes for stacks; stay outranged always.
- Post-6 Devour is utility for allies; focus on kiting and maintaining range advantage.
- First item isn't a major threat window; keep spacing and use your range superiority.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where your R kite speed and range dominate his.
- Shove the wave out; deny him minions to stack and prevent him from all-ining.
- Take Fleet of Foot page; sustain and kiting synergize with outranging his limited range.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if he stacks hard; cleanse slow and maintain distance for safety.

sivir__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Unraveled Earth stun trap denies your positioning; Seismic Shove interrupts your damage windows.
- Early: Safely farm at range with Boomerang Blade; avoid walking into Worked Ground zones.
- Trading: Bait Seismic Shove with forward movement, then trade back; use Spell Shield reactively on it.
- Post6: Weaver's Wall limits your map mobility; stay grouped and use On The Hunt to match her roam.
- Spike: Taliyah's first item spike (mana/CDR) is dangerous; she chains Unraveled Earth faster—respect minefield zones.
- Window: After Taliyah uses Seismic Shove or Weaver's Wall, immediately group and pressure with On The Hunt.
- Wave: Shove wave into her tower constantly; deny her safe Unraveled Earth placement and roam tempo.
- Rune: Precision (Attack Speed/Damage) lets you trade efficiently and proc Fleet of Foot to kite her.
- Item: Add Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse Seismic Shove knockback and reposition freely after stuns.

sivir__syndra.notes:
- Threat: Unleashed Power at close range deletes you; Scatter the Weak stun into burst kills you instantly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Dark Sphere and Force of Will outrange your Q, abuse minions for cover.
- Trading: Never trade into her Dark Spheres; bait Scatter the Weak with E, then all-in when cooldown expires.
- Post6: Unleashed Power forces you into Spell Shield duty; stay beyond her sphere cluster range or risk deletion.
- Spike: First item makes her burst inconsistent but still dangerous; respect her positioning but don't concede lane.
- Window: After she wastes E or ult, immediately push wave and look for roam opportunities; she lacks mobility.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; her skillshots and stun chain are stronger in open space, deny her positioning.
- Rune: Precision Primary with Legend: Bloodline; sustain keeps you healthy after taking poke from her ranged abilities.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius; the magic shield and lifeline passive save you from full Unleashed Power burst combos.

sivir__talon.notes:
- Threat: Talon's Shadow Assault invisibility lets him gap-close and burst you before you react or escape.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Talon out-trades close range. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance only.
- Trading: Never fight inside melee range. Bait his W Rake, then trade back with Q. Use E Spell Shield to block Q Noxian Diplomacy when he gaps close.
- Post6: Shadow Assault is lethal. Stay grouped, position near teammates, and hold E Spell Shield reactively for his burst combo.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Serrated Dirk) is dangerous. You lack defensive items; stay passive and scale toward your power spikes.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete Infinity Edge and E cooldown is low enough to block repeated all-ins consistently.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Pushing out lets Talon roam free and use terrain to flank you from fog.
- Rune: Precision primary with Press the Attack for trading pressure; secondary Resolve gives survivability against all-in attempts.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius early to block burst and survive his full rotation with shield plus E block.

sivir__taric.notes:
- Threat: Taric's E stun locks you down; his R creates invulnerable zone negating your damage window.
- Early: Safe farm. Taric lacks waveclear and poke—farm freely but respect all-in if his jungler arrives.
- Trading: Bait his E with movement, then trade back. Use Spell Shield to block his stun.
- Post6: His R denies kills but also stops his engage. Use the window when it's down.
- Spike: First item isn't a danger spike for Taric. Punish his immobility and low waveclear.
- Window: Mid-game when Taric lacks items. Push waves hard, force rotations, extend your advantage before teamfights scale him.
- Wave: Shove hard every wave. Taric cannot answer waveclear—force him to choose between defending tower or grouping.
- Rune: Precision. Attack speed and cooldown reduction synergize with On The Hunt and Ricochet bounces.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar. Cleanse his stun and escape; Taric has no way to re-engage after.

sivir__teemo.notes:
- Teemo's Noxious Trap slows and damages; avoid stepping on mushrooms in lane and river.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid brush where Teemo hides invisibly.
- Bait Teemo's Q Blinding Dart with E Spell Shield to gain health and movespeed back.
- On The Hunt at six lets you chase Teemo down and reduce cooldowns with attacks.
- Teemo's first item spike (likely Liandry's or Nashor's) isn't a major threat; farm safely.
- Sivir spikes hardest with Infinity Edge and attack speed; duel and teamfight then.
- Push the wave into Teemo's tower to deny him safe mushroom placement near minions.
- Take Fleet Footwork; sustain lets you stay healthy against Toxic Shot poke and trades.
- Buy Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse Toxic Shot poison stacks before they stack heavily.

sivir__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Rocket Jump W reset on kill lets her kite and dive; Buster Shot R executes you post-6.
- Early: Levels 1-3 are safe; farm freely with Q poke. She cannot all-in you yet reliably.
- Trading: Dodge her W with E Spell Shield when she jumps in; bait it, block it, punish.
- Post6: Her R becomes a kill execute. Never stay in turret-dive range without Flash available always.
- Spike: First item (likely Trinity Force or Manamune) is her punish window; respect her damage spike hard.
- Window: Pre-6 she's vulnerable; abuse levels 1-5 for poke and zoning before her ultimate threat arrives.
- Wave: Shove with R + W after 6; force her under tower to deny Rocket Jump reset kills.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo for extended trades and attack speed to match her Rapid Fire Q ramping.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses her Explosive Charge E bomb before detonation to deny burst damage entirely.

sivir__trundle.notes:
- Trundle's Subjugate steals your armor and resistances, making you extremely vulnerable to his team's damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near Trundle since he outdamages you early with Chomp.
- Bait Trundle to commit before using Spell Shield; save it for Subjugate cast, not Chomp.
- At level 6, On The Hunt lets you kite away from Trundle's Pillar of Ice engages better.
- Trundle's first item spike is moderate danger; he gains tankiness but you scale harder with attack speed items.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have two items and can kite around Frozen Domain with mobility.
- Shove the wave hard; Trundle wants extended trades near towers, so deny him that positioning advantage.
- Precision: Lethal Tempo gives you attack speed and movement to kite away from Trundle's slow and engage.
- Add Mercury's Treads early if Trundle lands Chomp frequently; the slow resistance helps you maintain kiting distance.

sivir__thresh.notes:
- threat: Death Sentence hook into pull kills or forces Flash; use Spell Shield to block it entirely.
- early: Safe farm. Stay max range with Q poke. Never let him close gap for E knockup chain.
- trading: Bait his Q by positioning unpredictably. Once on cooldown, trade hard. Block his hook with E always.
- post6: On The Hunt MS lets you kite his engage easier. His ult slows but doesn't lock you down.
- spike: Thresh first item isn't a major spike. Sivir's Infinity Edge spike is stronger; pressure him then.
- window: After blocking his Q hook, you have 10+ seconds to force fights or shove and disengage safely.
- wave: Shove it hard. Your range and Q poke control space; prevent him from setting lantern hooks safely.
- rune: Arcane Comet page for reliable Q poke pressure that Thresh cannot fully mitigate with shield timing.
- item: Mercurial Scimitar gives you cleanse backup if his hook somehow connects; upgrade from Maw for this.

sivir__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's Undying Rage makes him unkillable; use cooldowns before ulti activates.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Q poke from distance, avoid close-range trades with him.
- Bait Spinning Slash by positioning near minions; trade after he commits the gap.
- Post-6 Undying Rage negates your burst; kite with Fleet of Foot and On The Hunt.
- First-item powerspike around 10-12 minutes; play safer, focus on waveclear and poking with Q.
- Your window is when his Undying Rage is down; all-in with R active then.
- Shove the wave constantly; your Q and W clear fast, denying his all-in range.
- Press Conqueror for sustained damage; his extended fights favor your scaling and lifesteal stacking.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early if he stacks AD; the cleanse helps kite Mocking Shout slow.

sivir__twistedfate.notes:
- Threat: Destiny reveals you; Gate enables ganks. Pick a Card stuns you into burst damage.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay beyond Wild Cards range; dodge them sideways. Avoid extended trades near minions.
- Trading: Bait Pick a Card with movement. Trade when his W is on cooldown only.
- Post6: Destiny forces you to play around map vision. Expect jungle pressure; position defensively near tower.
- Spike: First Sheen item (around 1100g) spikes his burst. Play safer; respect his damage spike window.
- Window: Post-Navori Flickerblade, you outscale his midgame. Group with team; leverage your teamfight ultimate advantage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Denies his roam angles and protects you from Gate teleport ganks.
- Rune: Precision (Fleet of Foot + Bloodline). Sustain keeps you healthy against poke and all-ins.
- Item: Mercury's Treads—reduces stun duration from Pick a Card, improving your survivability against his combo.

sivir__twitch.notes:
- Twitch's Spray and Pray pierces through Sivir; dodge with E Spell Shield or position behind minions always.
- Play safe near tower; Twitch's long-range threat and Deadly Venom stack make early aggression extremely dangerous for you.
- Never trade into Twitch's attack range; bait his W Venom Cask with E, then farm safely after.
- Post-6, Spray and Pray range makes teamfighting lethal; stick with allies and use E reactively to block bolts.
- First item spike (likely Infinity Edge) is a danger window; respect his damage and avoid extended fights.
- Sivir's window arrives when Twitch misses Q Ambush cooldown; all-in aggressively during the 8-second window afterward.
- Shove the wave hard into tower; deny Twitch safe farming and force him to choose between farm and roaming.
- Precision or Hail of Blades; raw damage and attack speed help you out-duel him before his spike.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early if he stacks Deadly Venom heavily; cleanse the poison burst before it kills you.

sivir__varus.notes:
- threat: Chain of Corruption roots you on initial hit; use Spell Shield proactively to block it.
- early: Safe farm. Stay outside Piercing Arrow charge range; back off when he channels Q.
- trading: Avoid his E desecration ground. Bait his Q charge then trade with Boomerang Blade.
- post6: His R chains nearby—position away from allies. Spell Shield blocks the root, dodge the spread.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; he gains sustained Blight damage. Play safer, farm defensively.
- window: Post-first-item with crit build you scale better. Outfarm and teamfight with On The Hunt.
- wave: Shove consistently. Prevent him from setting up long-range Piercing Arrow charges in lane safely.
- rune: Lethal Tempo—attack speed synergizes with Ricochet bounces and On The Hunt for extended trades.
- item: Maw of Malmortius. Blocks his W magic damage from Blight detonations and R magic damage.

sivir__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's sustained close-range damage and shields from W Iron Mantle overwhelm Sivir's kiting attempts.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Udyr out-trades you at melee range, so farm from distance with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Bait Udyr's E Blazing Stampede stun by moving unpredictably; dodge his gap-close attempts with E Spell Shield when possible.
- On The Hunt grants allies speed and reduces cooldowns on-hit, making Udyr stickier; respect the damage spike post-6.
- Udyr's first item spike is dangerous; farm safely and avoid extended fights until you complete your first item.
- Sivir gains advantage when Udyr wastes his Recast cooldowns; punish windows appear when his stance abilities are on cooldown.
- Shove the wave into Udyr's tower to limit his all-in window and deny him extended melee engages on you.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustained kiting and healing to offset Udyr's relentless damage; mobility counters his gap-close threat.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early if Udyr lands frequent stuns; the active cleanse lets you escape his follow-up damage chains.

sivir__urgot.notes:
- Threat: Disdain catches and throws you; Fear Beyond Death executes below threshold—both unavoidable point-click threats.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Urgot lacks kill pressure pre-6, so cs safely and respect his Q range.
- Trading: Bait Corrosive Charge with movement, then trade back; dodge Disdain by spacing wide or kite backward hard.
- Post6: Fear Beyond Death execution threshold forces you to play safer; stop extended fights and respect ult range always.
- Spike: Urgot's first item spike (Goliath's Greathammer or similar) is moderate danger; Sivir scales better, so farm safely through it.
- Window: Post-first-item when your attack speed and lifesteal dominate; kite him and use Ricochet bounces to stay safe.
- Wave: Shove waves fast with Ricochet and Boomerang Blade; prevent Urgot from grouping and executing your team in fights.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo for extended kite trading and attack speed to abuse range and Ricochet bounces against him.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse any slow from Corrosive Charge and maintain kite mobility against his approach.

sivir__vayne.notes:
- threat: Vayne's Silver Bolts true damage and Condemn stun lock you down with no counterplay available.
- early: Farm safely at range; avoid extended trades where Vayne lands three attacks on you consistently.
- trading: Never engage when Vayne has two Silver Bolts stacks; bait her Condemn into empty space.
- post6: Final Hour makes Vayne invisible during Tumble, untargetable; use E Spell Shield reactively for Condemn.
- spike: Vayne's first item (Kraken Slayer or similar) amplifies Silver Bolts damage—respect spacing, don't all-in.
- window: After Vayne wastes Tumble or Condemn, immediately trade with Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; prevents Vayne from free positioning to kite and land condemns freely.
- rune: Precision (Fleet of Foot synergy) keeps you mobile and healthy during poke exchanges safely.
- item: Build Maw of Malmortius early to tank Silver Bolts true damage and survive Condemn combos.

sivir__veigar.notes:
- Threat: Event Horizon stuns you if you walk through cage; Primordial Burst one-shots you when low.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; use Q range to cs without walking up; avoid his W range.
- Trading: Bait Event Horizon by moving unpredictably; dodge his Q with sidesteps; use E to block W or Q.
- Post6: Primordial Burst kills you instantly if you're below 50% health; play safer and group with team.
- Spike: First item (Luden's or Crown) lets Veigar one-shot; respect his damage and play further back now.
- Window: You outscale Veigar late; punish him when his ult is down; teamfight when he wastes E.
- Wave: Shove consistently to deny him cs and push him off wave; prevents him from roaming easily.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo lets you kite and duel him; Attack Speed helps you chase and stick targets.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst damage and gives you survivability against his magic damage.

sivir__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's Q Plasma Fission and W Void Rift poke you down before teamfights begin.
- Play safe behind minions; Vel'Koz Q is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably.
- Bait his Q by walking forward, then sidestep the split. Trade with W Ricochet after.
- His R Life Form Disintegration Ray forces you to kite or use E Spell Shield defensively.
- Vel'Koz first item spike (Lost Chapter or similar) increases his poke; farm safely and don't fight.
- Post-teamfight, Sivir wins when Vel'Koz is on cooldown; R On The Hunt lets you chase down.
- Shove the wave in; Vel'Koz struggles to farm under tower and his poke is weaker there.
- Fleet of Foot (Precision primary) sustains your health against his repeated poke damage over time.
- Add Maw of Malmortius to block Organic Deconstruction true damage burst from his passive stacking.

sivir__vex.notes:
- Vex's Doom 'n Gloom fear interrupts your dash attempts; play around her empowerment windows.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Vex out-ranges you early. Farm with Q from distance only.
- Bait her E Looming Darkness before committing to trades; dodge the slow zone with positioning.
- Post-6, Shadow Surge marks you for an all-in. Never stay alone; group with team.
- Vex's first item spike is dangerous. Respect her damage and play safer until you scale.
- You outscale Vex hard mid-game. Play safe early, then abuse teamfights with R On The Hunt speed.
- Hold the wave near your tower early. Punish her if she overextends for CS.
- Attack Speed or Precision for sustained damage; enables kiting and teamfight impact with your kit.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse the fear from Doom 'n Gloom after she marks you.

sivir__vi.notes:
- Vi's Cease and Desist locks you down with no counterplay; R into your team ends fights instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; Vi's Vault Breaker is a skillshot you can dodge by positioning carefully.
- Bait her Q by stepping unpredictably, then trade with Boomerang Blade when her gauntlets recharge.
- Cease and Desist forces you to Spell Shield the knockup or rely on teammates to peel.
- First item spike (Trinity Force or Black Cleaver) pressures you hard; farm safely and respect range.
- You spike when Vi wastes Cease and Desist on a teammate; group and fight with On The Hunt.
- Shove the wave hard to deny Vi all-in opportunities and force her to roam or sacrifice CS.
- Precision or Lethal Tempo: sustained damage and attack speed help you kite and trade in extended fights.
- Buy Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse Vi's Cease and Desist knockup and escape the follow-up damage combo.

sivir__viktor.notes:
- Threat: Viktor's Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm deal massive AOE damage; dodge them or die.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Viktor outranges you; farm with Q from distance only.
- Trading: Bait Viktor's W Gravity Field, then all-in. Never trade into his E poke.
- Post6: Arcane Storm zones you hard. Use On The Hunt to kite away and escape.
- Spike: First augment (100 Fragments) spikes Viktor hard. Play safer; avoid extended fights then.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you if Viktor wastes cooldowns. Punish with R speed and W.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Viktor controls lane; safety trumps CS here always.
- Rune: Precision primary for sustained damage and Fleet of Foot synergy against poke.
- Item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar early if Viktor lands consistent W slows and stuns.

sivir__vladimir.notes:
- threat: Vladimir's E and R deal massive AOE damage; you lack defensive tools to mitigate it.
- early: Safe farm. Stay outside E range. Use Q to harass without walking into his effective zone.
- trading: Bait his W with aggression, then disengage. Never trade when his resource bar is full for Q.
- post6: Lethal threat. His R infects a large area and amplifies all damage. Play further back immediately.
- spike: First Protobelt or Zhonyas spike is dangerous. He gains defensive utility and burst damage simultaneously.
- window: Early game before level 6. Punish his lack of defensive tool and cooldown management pressure.
- wave: Shove and reset. Denies Vladimir's passive stacking and forces him to use abilities to clear.
- rune: Precision with Lethal Tempo. Extra attack speed lets you kite and output sustained damage safely.
- item: Maw of Malmortius. The spell shield and magic resist block his burst and reduce amplified damage.

sivir__volibear.notes:
- Threat: Volibear's Q stun and gap-close lock you down; his all-in burst with W follow-up deletes you.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Q range forces you to respect distance—farm with Q when possible.
- Trading: Never trade when his Q is up; bait Q with positioning, then kite and punish with autos.
- Post6: Stormbringer lets him engage from extreme range; On The Hunt gives you an escape but demands positioning.
- Spike: His first item spike is dangerous; avoid extended fights and rely on Q poke and kiting.
- Window: Mid-game when you have attack speed items; kite his engages and punish with W bounces on minions.
- Wave: Shove the wave when his Q is down; deny him gank timing and reset pressure quickly.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork; the Move Speed burst synergizes with kiting and escaping his gap-close attempts.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar; cleanses his W mark and provides mobility to escape or reposition after his engage.

sivir__warwick.notes:
- Warwick's R Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5 seconds; you cannot escape or counterplay it.
- Farm safely at range with Q Boomerang Blade; avoid letting him close the gap with W Blood Hunt.
- Bait his Q Jaws of the Beast by spacing back, then punish with Q and W Ricochet.
- Post-6, Warwick's R threat forces you to maintain distance; E Spell Shield cannot block the suppress.
- Warwick's first item spike is moderate danger; focus on farming safely and scaling into your items.
- You spike when you complete Infinity Edge; your damage and attack speed overwhelm his tankiness then.
- Push the wave hard to deny him roaming opportunities and force him to farm under tower.
- Precision primary with Attack Speed rune maximizes your DPS to pressure him before his level spike.
- Add Maw of Malmortius early if Warwick snowows; the shield and MR block his burst leverage.

sivir__xayah.notes:
- Threat: Xayah's E Bladecaller roots you when she has 3+ feathers; her R is untargetable and knockup.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near her dropped feathers to prevent E setup.
- Trading: Use W Ricochet procs to out-trade her before level 6; dodge Q Double Daggers skillshot.
- Post6: Respect her R Featherstorm invulnerability and knockup; reposition when she jumps to avoid follow-up E root.
- Spike: Xayah's first item spike (Infinity Edge or Bloodthirster) is a danger window; respect her damage.
- Window: Your power edge is levels 2-5 with W proc trades before her ultimate unlocks; exploit it.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize feather setup space; prevents her E from catching you far out.
- Rune: Take Lethal Tempo for extended W trades and sustained damage output against her squishy frame.
- Item: Add Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse the root from E Bladecaller and escape her follow-up damage.

sivir__xerath.notes:
- threat: Xerath's long-range skillshots (Q, W, E) deal magic damage and CC from safety; dodge or die.
- early: Safely farm at range with Q bounces; avoid walking into Arcanopulse or Shocking Orb engagement zones.
- trading: Bait Shocking Orb with movement, then trade back with W attacks; block his burst with E Spell Shield.
- post6: Rite of the Arcane traps you in lane—use On The Hunt to kite sideways and dodge barrages.
- spike: First item spike (Luden's or Liandry's) is dangerous; respect his damage and stay behind minions always.
- window: You spike when you complete Infinity Edge and Navori Flickerblade; use cooldown reduction to duel him.
- wave: Shove waves hard with Q and W to deny Xerath safe positioning for his long-range abilities.
- rune: Fleet Footwork grants movespeed to dodge skillshots and sustain poke; matches your self-buffing playstyle perfectly.
- item: Build Maw of Malmortius early if ahead or even; its magic shield blocks his burst damage.

sivir__xinzhao.notes:
- Threat: Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge closes gap instantly; his burst combo kills before you kite away.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3. Stay behind minions, use Q to farm safely from range, avoid short trades.
- Trading: Never trade when Three Talon Strike is up—his third attack knocks you airborne. Bait it on minions.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite better, but Xin's Crescent Guard passive makes him stick harder.
- Spike: First item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Black Cleaver) is his danger window. Play safer, build defensively.
- Window: Once you complete Navori Flickerblade, your Q cooldown resets fast enough to kite his all-ins consistently.
- Wave: Push wave in; Xin struggles when wave is near enemy tower. Denies his gap close opportunities.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork—extra mobility procs on your attacks help you escape his charge attempts immediately.
- Item: Build Maw of Malmortius early if Xin is snowowing; the shield and MR prevent burst kills.

sivir__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo gaps you with E Sweeping Blade dashes and knocks you airborne with Q Steel Tempest whirlwind.
- Play safe levels 1–3; respect his Q stacking for airborne. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait his W Wind Wall by faking Q casts, then trade with autos. Never walk into E range.
- Post-6, R On The Hunt lets you kite away from his R Last Breath engage attempts.
- His first-item spike (Infinity Edge or Trinity Force) is dangerous; stay grouped and use E Spell Shield.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed items; duel him when he lacks ultimate cooldown resets.
- Shove the wave hard; deny him roam opportunities and force him to farm under tower pressure.
- Precision: Press the Attack rewards your auto-attack trading while building toward extended fights versus his dashes.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar if he stacks crowd control or builds tanky; the cleanse helps escape E chains.

sivir__yone.notes:
- Yone's Mortal Steel dash at 2 stacks closes gaps; dodge or Spell Shield the second Q.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q poke outranges you. Farm with Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait his Mortal Steel by repositioning; use Spell Shield only on the gap-closing dash variant.
- Fate Sealed pulls you in after his blink. On The Hunt lets you kite away.
- First item spike (likely Shieldbow or Manamune) hits around 10-12 minutes; respect his all-in potential then.
- Post-first-item, Sivir wins if Yone wastes cooldowns. Punish his Spirit Unbound when he repositions defensively.
- Push the wave constantly; Boomerang Blade clears fast and denies him melee trading opportunities safely.
- Fleet Footwork sustains poke and enables kiting; Precision secondary for attack speed scaling into late game.
- Maw of Malmortius blocks his Way of the Hunter magic damage and provides lifeline security.

sivir__yorick.notes:
- Threat: Yorick's Maiden and Mist Walkers overwhelm you; E blocks one spell but not summon pressure.
- Early: Safe farm—avoid close trades. Use Q to harass from range; don't let him stack graves.
- Trading: Bait his W Dark Procession wall, then kite backwards. Never trade into his Q Last Rites.
- Post6: Eulogy of the Isles makes him unstoppable in extended fights; avoid direct engagements near his Maiden.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Sheen-based) is dangerous. Play safer; don't contest him in side lane yet.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights away from sidelane give you advantage if Maiden can't be summoned or is far.
- Wave: Shove waves quickly then rotate to teamfights. Don't let him freeze or trap you sidelane alone.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo—attack speed lets you kite Walkers and duel him when Maiden isn't active nearby.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius protects against his E Mourning Mist armor shred and sustained poke damage.

sivir__yunara.notes:
- threat: Yunara's Q slows you and W applies on-hit damage; kite carefully or get stuck for burst.
- early: Safe farm. Stay near minions to block her Q with Boomerang Blade; avoid isolated positioning.
- trading: Bait her W Arc with movement, then trade back with Q Boomerang Blade while she's on cooldown.
- post6: Yunara's Transcend upgrades her E to a dash and W to a laser; respect the dash range.
- spike: First item spike around 10 minutes is moderate threat; stay grouped and use E Spell Shield preemptively.
- window: After Yunara uses W or E cooldowns, punish with R On The Hunt; kite around terrain.
- wave: Shove early to deny her melee spacing; push to her tower so she farms under pressure.
- rune: Fleet Footwork for constant kiting; sustain and mobility let you maintain distance throughout fights.
- item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if Yunara lands frequent slows; cleanse and gain speed to reset spacing.

sivir__yuumi.notes:
- threat: Yuumi's ADC gains on-hit healing and buffs while she stays attached; focus their carry.
- early: Safe farm. Yuumi's Q is a skillshot—dodge it sideways. She deals minimal damage attached.
- trading: Bait her W detach when she autos you, then punish the ADC while she repositions.
- post6: Her ult follows her mouse while attached and heals allies—stay spread to avoid multi-hit damage.
- spike: First item (usually Moonstone Renewer or similar) doesn't spike her damage; this is your punish window.
- window: Mid-game before Yuumi full builds. Her ADC lacks sustained damage without her; abuse this weakness.
- wave: Shove the wave. Force her ADC to choose between farming or letting Yuumi roam elsewhere.
- rune: Press the Attack. Extra damage and attack speed help you duel their ADC during her detaches.
- item: Maw of Malmortius. Blocks burst and shields against her ult's damage if their team is magic-heavy.

sivir__zaahen.notes:
- Threat: Zaahen's W Dreaded Return pulls you in; his Q healing and stacking Determination make him durable and dangerous.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid close range where his Q combo and W pull threaten you. Farm from distance with Q.
- Trading: Bait his W pull with positioning, then use E Spell Shield to block his Q follow-up damage and heal denial.
- Post6: On The Hunt gives you and allies speed to kite away from his engages; use it proactively before he closes distance.
- Spike: His first item spike (likely into Sundered Skyward) is dangerous; respect his damage and healing. Stay beyond W range.
- Window: Your advantage arrives when his Determination stacks drop; punish him during cooldowns with Q poke and W bounces for chip damage.
- Wave: Shove the wave with Q and W bounces to deny him melee farm and force him to choose between wave and roaming.
- Rune: Press the Attack for extended trading windows; your attack speed and bonus damage help you kite and outduel his early stacking.
- Item: Build Mortal Reminder early to reduce his Q healing and R healing significantly, crippling his dueling sustainability.

sivir__zac.notes:
- Threat: Zac's E Elastic Slingshot engagement and R Let's Bounce! knockup chain delete you before escape tools matter.
- Early: Safe farm—Zac wants close range. Stay max distance, use Q Boomerang Blade to poke and maintain spacing carefully.
- Trading: Never trade into Zac's W Unstable Matter explosion. Bait his Q Stretching Strikes, then kite backward hard immediately after.
- Post6: Zac R Let's Bounce! forces you to E Spell Shield preemptively or position far back; map awareness becomes critical now.
- Spike: First item spike is medium threat. You scale better; avoid forced teamfights until you have Lord Dominik's Regards or Infinity Edge.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where Zac lacks cooldowns or positioning. Punish overextended Zac before his team follows up on engage.
- Wave: Shove consistently to deny Zac free E Elastic Slingshot setup from river. Pressure turret, maintain vision control, rotate safely.
- Rune: Hail of Blades—ramping attack speed lets you escape faster and chunk Zac down before he closes threat range.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar removes any slow debuffs from R Let's Bounce!, improving kite potential and fight survival significantly.

sivir__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark amplifies all his damage output over 3 seconds, potentially one-shotting you if you're caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zed outranges you early. Use Q to farm from distance, avoid close trades.
- Bait Zed's W Living Shadow before committing. Dodge his Q Razor Shuriken with movement; it's his main poke.
- Post-6 Death Mark makes Zed extremely lethal. Never fight him alone; use E Spell Shield to block his R.
- Watch for Zed's first item spike around 10-12 minutes. Play safer, group with team, avoid isolated sidelane fights.
- Sivir scales better; abuse your item advantage mid-game. Group for teamfights where R On The Hunt dominates.
- Shove the wave hard. Your Q clears fast and forces Zed to defend; prevents his roams to kill allies.
- Precision (consistent damage) or Resolve (tankiness). Your sustained DPS and E shield reward aggressive positioning into his skillshots.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse Death Mark effects and gain mobility when needed for safety.

sivir__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs' Mega Inferno Bomb forces you into bad positions; dodge it or die to collateral damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ziggs outranges you. Farm with Q from distance, avoid walking into Bouncing Bomb.
- Bait Bouncing Bomb with sidesteps, then trade back with Q. Use E to block Satchel Charge knockback.
- Mega Inferno Bomb changes the lane completely; respect its range and position near walls to minimize impact.
- Ziggs' first item spike is dangerous; play safer and respect his zone until you finish Infinity Edge.
- Your window opens post-6 when On The Hunt lets you dodge Mega Inferno Bomb with movement speed.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Ziggs' poke and zone control punish overextended positioning on the map.
- Pick Runes with Heal and Biscuits to sustain against Ziggs' relentless poke damage throughout the laning phase.
- Add Maw of Malmortius early to block his magic damage and survive Mega Inferno Bomb volleys.

sivir__zeri.notes:
- Threat: Zeri's Q Burst Fire with AS-scaling and E dash mobility create bursty all-ins you cannot outfight.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid extended trades. Use Q range to farm from distance safely.
- Trading: Bait her E Spark Surge dash, then trade back. Spell Shield her Q Burst Fire cast.
- Post6: Lightning Crash amps her damage and Move Speed hugely—respect all-in threat. Spell Shield the burst Q.
- Spike: First item is danger window; Zeri deals increased damage. Play safer, farm with Q, avoid fights.
- Window: You scale better into mid-game teamfights; itemize defensively first, then punish her immobility without ult.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Zeri's mobility and all-in threat punish overextended positioning hard.
- Rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot keystone refreshes your Movement Speed against her chase and burst.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if she lands W Ultrashock Laser slows consistently in lane phase.

sivir__zilean.notes:
- Threat: His Q sticks to you and detonates; block it with E Spell Shield to negate damage and gain stats.
- Early: Safe to farm. Stay positioned to dodge Time Bombs; they're skillshots. Use Q Boomerang Blade to pressure from distance.
- Trading: Bait his Q onto you, then E Spell Shield it for free health and movespeed. Trade back immediately with autos.
- Post6: Chronoshift makes him unkillable in fights but doesn't stop you. Focus on denying his roams; he lacks waveclear.
- Spike: First item doesn't threaten you directly. Sivir scales harder into mid-game; punish his lack of durability now.
- Window: Mid-game when you have two items and he's still building. Push waves constantly to prevent roams and deny kills.
- Wave: Shove constantly. Zilean has no waveclear, so you control the lane and deny his roam windows to help teammates.
- Rune: Press the Attack for consistent trading and auto-attack pressure; exploits his low durability early and throughout laning.
- Item: Navori Flickerblade to reduce Q cooldown after autos, enabling faster wave shove and more frequent poke against low-durability Zilean.

sivir__zoe.notes:
- Zoe's Paddle Star! and Sleepy Trouble Bubble lock you down or chunk you from range safely.
- Play safe; farm with Q from distance. Dodge Paddle Star! by moving unpredictably; never stand still.
- Bait her E with positioning, then dodge sideways. Use Spell Shield to block Sleepy Trouble Bubble when she commits.
- On The Hunt lets you chase or kite her Portal Jump; she becomes vulnerable when blinking back.
- First item spike (Luden's Tempest or similar AP) is dangerous; respect her damage and maintain distance.
- Mid-game when you have two items, you out-duel her and can chase with R if she wastes E.
- Hold wave near tower; force her to overextend for poke. Prevents Zoe from roaming and setting up ganks.
- Pick Precision primary for attack speed and Triumph sustain; you need consistent kiting and teamfight healing.
- Build Maw of Malmortius early if she's ahead; the magic shield and sustain counter her burst and poke.

sivir__zyra.notes:
- Threat: Long-range E root and zoned CS from plants; shield the root with Spell Shield.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1-3; farm safely behind minions, avoid clustered positions near her seeds.
- Trading: Bait her E Grasping Roots, then Spell Shield it for health and MS burst.
- Post6: Stranglethorns knocks airborne and enrages plants; position behind minions and dodge the thicket center.
- Spike: First item spike is her threat window; play safer, farm from range with Q Boomerang Blade.
- Window: After she wastes E or R, punish overextensions with W Ricochet bounces and On The Hunt chase.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower to minimize seed trap zones and deny her plant engagement angles.
- Rune: (Not provided in options; choose defensive page favoring safety and poke resistance over all-in trades.)
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar cleanses root CC and gives MR; add after core damage items if needed.

kogmaw__fizz.notes:
- Fizz's Playful / Trickster dodges your damage while closing gap to all-in you.
- Levels 1-3: Farm safely at range with Caustic Spittle; avoid extended trades near Fizz.
- Never trade when Fizz's Playful / Trickster is up; bait it before committing damage.
- Post-6: Chum the Waters locks you down; position behind minions and play further back.
- Fizz's first item spike is moderate danger; abuse your range advantage before he completes it.
- Kog'Maw spikes when Fizz wastes Playful / Trickster; unload full combo before cooldown resets.
- Hold wave near your tower; Fizz excels in extended all-ins so deny him engagement range.
- Standard (default): You need consistent kiting and damage, not early lane dominance here.
- Build Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Chum the Waters engagement and mitigate all-in burst.

kogmaw__camille.notes:
- Camille's Hookshot E closes gap and knocks you up, leaving you vulnerable to her burst.
- Levels 1–3: Play safe near tower. Caustic Spittle Q poke is your only safe tool.
- Never trade with Camille when she has Q up; bait her Hookshot E by walking away.
- Post-6 The Hextech Ultimatum R traps you in zone. Kite perpendicular; avoid direct fights inside.
- First item Kraken Slayer spike is dangerous; respect her damage and play further back.
- Your window is mid-game when Living Artillery R chunks her from range; she cannot engage safely.
- Hold wave near your tower. Camille wants short trades; deny her by farming safely at distance.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale her significantly and need survivability early to reach that point.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stall during Hextech Ultimatum R and survive all-in attempts safely.

kogmaw__aatrox.notes:
- Aatrox's The Darkin Blade and Infernal Chains close distance and deal massive damage; you die if caught.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; farm safely with Caustic Spittle from range, never face-check him.
- Bait The Darkin Blade swings by moving unpredictably, then trade with Bio-Arcane Barrage when he whiffs.
- World Ender gives Aatrox movespeed and fear; kite backwards hard and land Living Artillery on low-health targets.
- First item spike (likely Black Cleaver or similar) is dangerous; play safer and farm from maximum range.
- Post-first-item when Aatrox lacks boots, Living Artillery poke and kiting with range advantage becomes your window.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Aatrox push into you so Infernal Chains whiffs and you kite.
- Use Scaling rune page; you scale harder and need to survive early without committing to trades.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stop The Darkin Blade combos and World Ender all-in attempts.

kogmaw__galio.notes:
- Galio's W Shield of Durand taunts you into melee range, disabling and bursting you easily.
- Stay at maximum attack range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge Winds of War by moving sideways.
- Never trade into his W charge window; bait Justice Punch away from you, then kite.
- Hero's Entrance grants shields to allies and knocks you up—position away from Galio's team cluster.
- Galio's first item spike is moderate danger; your attack range and percent health damage outscale him.
- You spike harder mid-game with Kraken Slayer and attack speed; abuse range to stay untouchable.
- Hold wave near your tower; force Galio to overextend into your range or waste mana on poke.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder than Galio into late game with sustained kiting and true damage.
- Add Void Staff if Galio builds early magic resist; penetration ensures your percent health damage sticks.

kogmaw__gnar.notes:
- Gnar's Wallop stun in Mega form locks you down for his team's burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar's early Hyper bonus damage punishes extended trades hard.
- Bait his Boomerang Throw by repositioning sideways, then trade while cooldown is down.
- GNAR! transforms him into a threat; respect his increased tankiness and crowd control range.
- His first item spike (usually Trinity Force) is dangerous; play behind minions and kite.
- Abuse Gnar when he's in Mini form and has low Rage; farm safely then.
- Hold wave near your tower; Gnar needs to engage to generate Rage; deny space.
- Take Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed and percent health damage scaling.
- Add Void Staff if Gnar builds early Magic Resist; amplifies your magic damage output.

kogmaw__gragas.notes:
- Gragas' E Body Slam stun locks you down for his team's follow-up burst damage.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm at range with Q, avoid close trades near walls.
- Dodge his E by repositioning sideways; bait it by standing near terrain he'll target.
- Post-6, his R Explosive Cask knocks you into his team—position away from walls.
- First item spike (Liandry's or similar) threatens you; farm safely and scale into W.
- You spike harder mid-game when W Bio-Arcane Barrage range outpaces his engagement tools.
- Hold wave near your tower; let Gragas push in where your team can collapse.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outrange and out-duel him once items arrive.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to survive his E stun combo and his team's burst.

kogmaw__graves.notes:
- Collateral Damage and End of the Line burst you before you kite; close-range all-in threat
- Play safe behind minions; Graves' bullets block on units, so body-block with wave early
- Never trade into his dash range; bait Quickdraw away, then kite with W Bio-Arcane Barrage
- Collateral Damage outranges your R Living Artillery early; respect ult timing and play further back
- First Kraken Slayer spike hurts hard; farm safely and avoid skirmishes during his power window
- Mid-game when you have Runaan's Hurricane and W range, kite circles around terrain to abuse range
- Hold wave near your tower; Graves hates extended fights where your W DPS and R spam shine
- Scaling rune page; you outscale his burst with attack speed, range, and artillery poke scaling
- Add Phantom Dancer for movespeed and shield to survive Collateral Damage burst and kite easier

kogmaw__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan IV's Cataclysm traps you inside arena with no escape; you die fast.
- Levels 1-3: Farm safely at max range with W. Avoid Q trade patterns.
- Never trade into Jarvan's Martial Cadence proc. Bait his Q, then kite back hard.
- Post-6: Cataclysm is a death sentence. Stay max range, play around fog of war.
- First item spike (Phage item): Jarvan gets tankier and stronger. This is danger window.
- Your window: After Jarvan wastes Cataclysm cooldown. Punish him relentlessly with W range advantage.
- Hold wave near your tower. Force Jarvan to engage into tower range or lose cs.
- Use Scaling rune page. You outscale him hard; survive early, dominate mid-game fights.
- Add Phantom Dancer. Ghost lets you kite away from Cataclysm lockdown attempts reliably.

kogmaw__janna.notes:
- Threat: Janna's E shields block your W percent-health damage and E slow prevents kiting away from ganks.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Janna has no damage. Stay max range with W, avoid Q knockup.
- Trading: Never trade into her shield. Wait for E cooldown, then use Q to corrode resistances before attacking.
- Post6: Monsoon knockback and healing flip the lane; respect R's range and disengage when she channels it.
- Spike: First item (Kraken Slayer or Blade of the Ruined King) is your window; her Ardent is hers.
- Window: When Janna's E is down and you have ult range; burst her before she shields allies.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Janna zones poorly at range but punishes pushes with R setup.
- Rune: Scaling; you outscale her utility and need survivability against poke while farming safely for late.
- Item: Void Staff removes her bonus armor from resistances and shreds shields on teammates she protects.

kogmaw__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Sonic Wave into Resonating Strike dash plus Dragon's Rage kick chains kill you instantly.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; Sonic Wave is a skillshot—bait it by positioning unpredictably.
- Never trade when Lee Sin lands Sonic Wave; kite away and retaliate only when he commits dash.
- Dragon's Rage at level 6 turns Lee Sin into a delete button; respect the knockup range always.
- Lee Sin first item spike (Black Cleaver or similar) is lethal; farm safely and don't extend.
- Kog'Maw spikes after two items (Blade + Kraken); kite and use range to punish his engagement.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Lee Sin wants to dive you so deny him angle.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outrange and out-dps him late, so survive the early dive attempts.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to stop Dragon's Rage chain or buy Phantom Dancer for the shield.

kogmaw__nautilus.notes:
- Nautilus roots you with Staggering Blow or pulls with Dredge Line, then all-ins with Depth Charge.
- Play safe near tower; avoid melee range. Farm with Q Caustic Spittle from distance only.
- Never walk into Dredge Line range. Bait his Q, then trade back with W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Depth Charge at 6 guarantees his all-in succeeds. Stay near tower; avoid overextending completely.
- First Titan's Wrath spike (levels 4-5) forces you to respect his damage and engage threat.
- Win when Nautilus wastes Dredge Line; punish immediately with full W Bio-Arcane Barrage range and kite.
- Hold wave at tower. Nautilus has no safe waveclear; let him burn mana or miss CS.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale him hard and kite him better with attack speed later.
- Add Randuin's Omen to reduce his root duration and physical damage from Staggering Blow early.

kogmaw__morgana.notes:
- Threat: Dark Binding roots you in place, letting Morgana combo Tormented Shadow and close for all-in burst damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Morgana's Q range exceeds yours, so farm from distance with Caustic Spittle when possible.
- Trading: Never walk into Tormented Shadow circles; bait Q by moving unpredictably, then trade back with W attacks safely.
- Post6: Soul Shackles chains lock you down after root attempts; stay mobile and respect her all-in range significantly more.
- Spike: Morgana's first item (typically Liandry's Torment or Zhonya's) spikes her survivability; punish her before completion with poke.
- Window: Mid-game when your Bio-Arcane Barrage on-hit damage scales; kite her chains and burst from range before she engages.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; force Morgana to overextend for farm, making her vulnerable to ganks and your kiting.
- Rune: Scaling; you outscale her in extended teamfights and duels, so prioritize late-game power over early aggression.
- Item: Zhonya's Hourglass; use stasis to cleanse Dark Binding effects and negate Soul Shackles chain damage mid-fight instantly.

kogmaw__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's Paranoia removes vision and lets him gap-close; you die isolated without teammates nearby.
- Play safe; farm at range with Q. Don't extend past river; Nocturne all-ins early.
- Dodge Duskbringer; never trade into his Umbra Blades proc. Use E Void Ooze to kite away.
- Paranoia is lethal. Stay grouped, ward deep, and position near allies to discourage his engage.
- His first item (likely Duskbringer + Manamune components) doesn't spike harder than your Kraken Slayer.
- You outrange and out-duel him once you have Kraken Slayer and attack speed boots.
- Push the wave to his tower so he can't roam freely mid-map during Paranoia windows.
- Use Scaling; you scale faster into late-game teamfights where grouped positioning negates Paranoia threat.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass after core items to survive his burst and Unspeakable Horror duration.

kogmaw__poppy.notes:
- threat: Poppy's E Heroic Charge pins you into walls for stun; you die immobilized.
- early: Dangerous. Stay max range with W Bio-Arcane Barrage; dodge E by moving perpendicular.
- trading: Never trade when near walls. Bait E by walking toward open space, then kite.
- post6: R Living Artillery reveals and damages from safety, but Poppy R knocks you away helplessly.
- spike: First item is danger window. Her tankiness peaks; farm safely, avoid all-ins until you scale.
- window: Mid-game after two items when W Bio-Arcane Barrage damage outpaces her resistances significantly.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Poppy needs wall proximity for E stun; deny her angle.
- rune: Scaling. You scale harder; survive early safely and outrange her in teamfights later.
- item: Add Void Staff to shred her W Steadfast Presence armor and magic resist bonus.

kogmaw__pyke.notes:
- Pyke's E Phantom Undertow stun into Q Bone Skewer pull chains you into Death From Below execution.
- Stay behind minions levels 1-3; Pyke Q is a skillshot you can block with wave.
- Never face-trade short; bait his E dash, then W Bio-Arcane Barrage him as he returns.
- Post-6, Death From Below executes you at low health; respect ult range and play safer positioning.
- Pyke's first item spike (Serpent's Fang or Manamune) is a danger window; avoid extended fights.
- Your window opens when Pyke wastes E or W; punish with full Q W combo range.
- Hold wave near your tower; deny Pyke roam opportunities and force him to farm under pressure.
- Pick Scaling; you outscale Pyke hard and need time to reach critical range with W.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to block Death From Below execution and survive his all-in chains.

kogmaw__qiyana.notes:
- Qiyana's Audacity dash closes gap and Royal Privilege bonus damage burst you down instantly.
- Play safe; her early damage is high. Farm at maximum range with Caustic Spittle.
- Never trade when her weapon is enchanted from Terrashape. Bait her Audacity then punish.
- Living Artillery range lets you kite; her Supreme Display of Talent stun is lethal threat.
- Her first item spike is dangerous. Play further back; don't get caught by Audacity.
- Mid-game teamfights when she wastes cooldowns; you outrange and shred with Bio-Arcane Barrage.
- Hold wave near tower. You need distance safety; pushing lets her flank with Audacity easily.
- Scaling. You scale better; she needs early kills. Survive lane, win teamfights with range.
- Phantom Dancer. Dodge her Audacity with the movement speed; its passive blocks her burst.

kogmaw__riven.notes:
- Riven's gap-closing combo (Q+E+W) stuns and bursts you before you kite effectively.
- Stay at max W range; dodge Broken Wings with spacing, farm safely with Caustic Spittle.
- Never trade into her Q combo. Bait her E, then kite backward with W attacks.
- Wind Slash range threatens you heavily; respect it and position behind minions or teammates.
- First item (usually Black Cleaver) lets her duel and all-in; play safer, farm ranged.
- When Riven wastes E or Q cooldown, kite backward and pummel with W range advantage.
- Hold wave near your tower; her all-in threat forces you to farm safely and scale.
- Use Scaling; you outscale her hard and need ramp time to survive early pressure.
- Buy Zhonya's Hourglass to survive her combo burst and reset positioning for counterattack.

kogmaw__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's W stun locks you down for all-in, followed by E armor shred and Q heal sustain.
