- Play safe behind minions; Renekton out-trades short-range. Use Q from distance to corrode his resistances early.
- Never fight when Renekton has high Fury. Bait W by repositioning; it's a point-and-click stun.
- Renekton ult gives him health pool and Fury generation—his all-in threat spikes massively at level 6.
- First Sheen item (Lich Bane or Nashor's Tooth) is his damage spike; punish with range advantage.
- Post-15 minutes when Renekton's engage cooldowns lengthen; kite with W range and land R artillery safely.
- Hold wave near your tower; Renekton excels at dive, so deny him positioning advantage on extended lane.
- Use Scaling; you outscale him hard with attack speed and percent-health damage from W ramping.
- Add Phantom Dancer or Wit's End; MS and resistances let you kite his all-in without dying.

kogmaw__ryze.notes:
- Ryze's Rune Prison roots you if you have Flux on you; you cannot kite or escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ryze out-ranges and out-damages early. Farm from maximum distance with Q.
- Never walk into Spell Flux's debuff radius. Bait Rune Prison by positioning unpredictably; dodge nothing.
- Realm Warp gives Ryze escape and engage tools. Post-6, respect his ability to reposition allies.
- Ryze first item spike (Tear into early mana items) is not a major threat window for you.
- Your advantage window is mid-game when Bio-Arcane Barrage comes online and you outrange his combo.
- Hold the wave near your tower. Ryze's gank setup with Realm Warp punishes overextended positions.
- Use Scaling; you scale harder into late game with attack speed and on-hit damage.
- Add Void Staff if Ryze builds mana-stacking defensive items; it scales with your poke and artillery.

kogmaw__talon.notes:
- Talon's all-in burst from Q and W combo kills you before you kite away safely.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; stay behind minions, use Q to corrode his resistances early.
- Never trade without W active; dodge Rake returning blades, bait Q by stepping back.
- Shadow Assault forces you to play around invisibility; position near teammates or use R defensively.
- First item spike (Serrated Dirk into Black Cleaver) is lethal; farm safely and scale.
- Power window comes at two items when you have Kraken Slayer and attack speed advantage.
- Hold wave near your tower; Talon excels at roaming and all-ins, deny his pressure.
- Use Scaling to outscale his early dominance and reach your two-item power spike safely.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive Shadow Assault burst and buy time for teammates to counter.

kogmaw__udyr.notes:
- Udyr closes gap with Blazing Stampede and stuns you; you die immobilized and unable to kite.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; stay behind minions, position far back, and avoid Udyr's first engagement attempt.
- Never trade into his Wilding Claw combo; kite backward when he approaches and use Void Ooze to slow.
- At level 6, Wingborne Storm tracks you down relentlessly; maintain maximum distance and use terrain to escape.
- Udyr's first item spike (typically Sunfire Aegis) is dangerous; abuse range advantage before he completes it.
- Your window comes mid-game when you have Kraken Slayer and Runaan's Hurricane; kite and shred him.
- Hold wave near your tower; this forces Udyr to dive you under tower where you control range.
- Use Scaling; Kog'Maw outscales Udyr in extended fights with proper itemization and attack-speed stacking.
- Add Randuin's Omen to reduce his attack speed and crit damage from his repeated auto-attacks.

kogmaw__urgot.notes:
- Urgot's Fear Beyond Death execute threshold kills you even through shields and defense.
- Stay beyond Corrosive Charge range; farm safely with Bio-Arcane Barrage from distance.
- Never let Urgot land Disdain; kite backwards when he charges, dodge predictable Corrosive Charge.
- Fear Beyond Death is a skillshot; dodge sideways or use range advantage to avoid impale.
- Urgot's first item spike (likely Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his all-in damage window.
- You spike harder mid-game with attack speed and range items; maintain distance and poke.
- Hold wave near your tower; Disdain is less effective when you're closer to safety.
- Use Scaling; this matchup rewards patience, range, and late-game attack speed over early aggression.
- Build Phantom Dancer early if Urgot snowows; the movespeed and dueling stats help kite safely.

kogmaw__varus.notes:
- Varus Chain of Corruption immobilizes you; follow-up Piercing Arrow or auto-attacks delete your health bar.
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; Varus out-ranges and out-damages early. Farm passively, avoid his Q.
- Never stand still for Piercing Arrow—sidestep unpredictably. Trade only after he wastes Q; use W for safety.
- Post-6, Chain of Corruption becomes lethal engage tool. Stay at maximum Bio-Arcane Barrage range and position away from walls.
- Varus first-item spike (likely Manamune or Kraken Slayer) is a danger window. Play safer; you spike later.
- Kog'Maw power edge: two items onward with attack speed and range. Kite backward and use E to slow his advance.
- Let wave slow-push toward you; Varus wants to all-in at mid-wave. Fight near your tower for safety and gank defense.
- Use Scaling rune page; you scale harder into mid and late game than Varus does long-term.
- Add Wit's End as defensive item option; magic resist and attack speed counter his Blighted Quiver and mixed damage pattern.

kogmaw__yuumi.notes:
- Yuumi attaches to allies, healing and shielding them while granting on-hit healing; you cannot pressure her directly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Yuumi's Q slows and you lack range advantage early; farm passively near tower.
- Never chase Yuumi's Q—it gains bonus damage on delay; let it miss, then trade with W attacks.
- Final Chapter at six heals her team and follows her ally; your poke becomes less effective overall.
- Yuumi's first item spike (usually support items) is minimal; use early-mid game before her team scales hard.
- Your power window is mid-game when you have two items and her team lacks defensive items yet.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Yuumi shields her allies, so shoving wastes your range advantage and mana.
- Use Scaling rune page; you outscale Yuumi's support items and her utility doesn't counter your core build.
- Add Void Staff to shred magic resist on her shielded targets and amplify your magic damage pressure.

drmundo__azir.notes:
- Threat: Azir's sustained Sand Soldier DPS shreds you if you can't close the gap or control the fight.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; avoid walking through soldier range; use Q poke when soldiers are on cooldown.
- Trading: Dodge his E dash by positioning unpredictably; don't let him kite freely—force him to use cooldowns.
- Post6: Emperor's Divide is terrain while moving; walk through the push part, then engage. Ult lets him kite harder.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) moderately threatens you; not a hard punish window if you itemize MR early.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights with multiple MR items (Abyssal + Spirit Visage) let you run him down and kill him.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; prevents Azir from kiting away and forces him to fight you at disadvantage.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; extra mobility and tenacity help you stick to Azir and survive his sustained damage.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask early as your first MR item to reduce his soldier damage and tank harder.

drmundo__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's burst and mobility from Phase Dive and Chronobreak let him kite and escape your all-in attempts.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-damages early. Farm at range with Q, avoid extended trades near him.
- Bait his Phase Dive by walking into him; when he rolls away, he's immobile for your combo.
- Post-6 Chronobreak makes him unkillable if ahead; focus on scaling and not dying to his burst.
- First item (Hextech Alternator into Protobelt) is dangerous; respect his damage and play defensive during this window.
- You outscale hard once you hit Heartsteel and two resistances; bully him out at 2+ items.
- Hold wave near tower; force him to all-in under turret where you have the defensive advantage.
- Conditioning variant to stack resistances and survive his burst damage throughout the game.
- Add Abyssal Mask early if Ekko rushes AP to neuter his magic damage and sustain through it.

drmundo__briar.notes:
- Threat: Briar's Q stun into all-in burst and healing overwhelms you before you can kite and combo her down.
- Early: Farm safely at range with Q poke; dodge her Q leap by positioning near minions, never isolated.
- Trading: Bait her Q by standing still, then W and full combo when she misses; save last Q for post-E.
- Post6: Her R fear and inevitable chase forces you to land full combo fast or kite hard with W active.
- Spike: First item (likely Stridebreaker or Eclipse) makes her stickier and deadlier; punish her before completion with cleaver poke.
- Window: Levels 4–5 before her ult; bully her with W trades and cleaver spam when Q is down.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower so her Q engage costs her minion aggro and extends her all-in timer.
- Rune: Conditioning variant to scale tankiness and reduce her early all-in damage while you farm and scale faster.
- Item: Jak'Sho, The Protean early (third item) to halve her bleed stacks and reduce her sustain significantly.

drmundo__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Crowstorm fear from fog of war; he obliterates grouped teamfights instantly before you react.
- Safe farm early; Fiddlesticks has no lane pressure. Stay healthy, avoid unnecessary poke, scale.
- Bountiful Harvest is point-and-click drain—you cannot dodge it. Trade only when he's on cooldown.
- Post-6 Crowstorm fear locks you down hard. Ward river, track him, never group blind.
- First item spike (Liandry's or Zhonyas) is not dangerous; you outscale him heavily mid-game.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you; you're tankier and deal sustained damage. Force fights when he's vulnerable.
- Shove the wave into his tower; deny him roam opportunities and force him to respond.
- Conditioning variant for scaling tankiness; you need raw HP and resistances to survive Crowstorm.
- Abyssal Mask reduces his damage and drains his mana pool, suffocating his sustained pressure.

drmundo__illaoi.notes:
- threat: Test of Spirit rips your spirit out; you take echo damage and can't fight back effectively.
- early: Safe farm behind wave. Use Q poke from range; tentacles can't punish you there. Break tentacles.
- trading: Max Q. Trade with Q only from behind minions. Never walk up to deny her E.
- post6: Leap of Faith spawns tentacles per champ hit. Avoid grouping; she turns fights into tentacle nightmares.
- spike: First item (likely Hollow Radiance) is medium threat. You outpoke her still; don't get complacent.
- window: Levels 1–5 before Leap of Faith. Consistent Q poke kills her if she stays. End early.
- wave: Thin it so she can't slow-push and trap you. Prevent stacking; deny her ult value.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge. You need mobility to kite tentacles and escape her Test of Spirit radius.
- item: Jak'Sho, The Protean. Tentacles deal physical damage; armor and on-hit tenacity reduce her lockdown.

drmundo__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's Q resets and Marked procs let her stick to you endlessly and burst you down.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Infected Bonesaw, avoid her all-in trades.
- Dodge her E Flawless Duet by walking forward or sideways; never let her stack to 4.
- Maximum Dosage gives you healing but Irelia's ult Vanguard's Edge Marks you for free resets.
- Her first item spike is dangerous; buy Bramble Thornmail early before she snowballs with resets.
- You spike when Bramble Thornmail is complete; she cannot trade into you or heal off autos.
- Hold the wave near your tower so her Q resets cannot extend into your backline.
- Stormraider's Surge gives you escape speed when she lands E or gaps with Q resets.
- Add Plated Steelcaps early if she threatens all-in; swap to Thornmail into Warmog's never build path.

drmundo__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller roots you; dash-in allies burst you before you escape or heal up.
- Safe farm early; Daisy trades poorly into you, but avoid Rootcaller hooks near walls.
- Bait Rootcaller by moving unpredictably; dodge the vine skillshot, then all-in Ivern immediately.
- Post-6, Daisy becomes a real threat; focus it down before committing to Ivern fights.
- Ivern first item (Moonstone or Mandate) isn't a spike; you outscale and out-duel him.
- Your power window opens mid-game when you have two items; Ivern can't kite forever.
- Hold wave near your tower; Rootcaller punishes overextension, and you need gank setup protection.
- Conditioning variant maximizes your tankiness against Ivern's magic damage and Daisy's persistent attacks.
- Add Abyssal Mask early if Ivern itemizes heavy AP; it amplifies your healing advantage.

drmundo__jax.notes:
- Jax Counter Strike dodges your Q and stuns you; his all-in after stunning you is lethal.
- Level 1–3 farm safely; space well to bully with Q poke, but respect his all-in if he closes.
- Max Q. Bait his E by walking forward, then cleaver and walk away; never trade into his stun window.
- Jax gains massive dueling power at rank 6; avoid extended fights unless you have ult advantage or he wastes E.
- Jax's first item (Triforce or Botrk) is a danger window; play safe and scale until you spike Heartsteel.
- Post-Heartsteel or when Jax ult is down, you win short trades; punish his E cooldown with Q spam.
- Hold wave near your tower; let it push into you so Jax cannot dive and you scale safely.
- Grasp to bully early if confident, Stormraider's Surge + Resolve if unconfident; Grasp rewards good spacing and early dominance.
- Build Jak'Sho early if he stacks AD; consider Abyssal Mask if he goes magic damage (rare) after boots.

drmundo__lissandra.notes:
- Threat: Frozen Tomb stuns you in place; Ring of Frost roots you before you can run her down.
- Early: Safe farm. She out-trades you levels 1-3; dodge Ice Shard, farm at max range, stack HP.
- Trading: Never trade into her. Bait Ring of Frost by standing at its edge, then all-in.
- Post6: Dangerous spike. Her Frozen Tomb locks you down; stay unpredictable, never let her land easy roots.
- Spike: First item is not a danger. You outscale her and get tankier; farm and scale.
- Window: Level 11+ with two items. You're unkillable and run her down; she cannot escape you.
- Wave: Shove it in. You need jungle proximity and pressure; freezing lets her kite and scale safely.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick through her slows and roots, breaking free of her kiting tools.
- Item: Mercury's Treads replace Boots of Swiftness to cleanse her root and stun duration threats early.

drmundo__leona.notes:
- threat: Zenith Blade immobilizes you and enables her team's burst; Solar Flare stuns, setting up kills on your ADC.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to dodge Zenith Blade; avoid extended trades when Shield of Daybreak is up.
- trading: Bait her Q Shield of Daybreak, then all-in with Blunt Force Trauma. Never walk into her E line.
- post6: Solar Flare creates kill windows on your backline. Play around cooldown; rotate to protect ADC when it's up.
- spike: Her first item (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) isn't a major threat. You scale harder; continue punishing her ADC.
- window: Mid-game when you've stacked Health. Your sustained damage and regeneration outpace her peel; dominate sidelanes and teamfights.
- wave: Push into her tower. Forces Leona to choose between defending tower or roaming; limits her ADC's safety and peel.
- rune: Conditioning variant. Extra armor and magic resist scale infinitely with your Health, hardening you against her repeated CC and burst.
- item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces her team's magic damage and her ADC's effectiveness; strengthens your tankiness against Leona's poke.

drmundo__lulu.notes:
- threat: Whimsy turns you into a critter; you can't fight back or use abilities while disabled.
- early: Safe farm. Stay at range, use Q poke. Avoid all-ins; she out-trades you levels 1–3.
- trading: Bait Whimsy by faking all-in; dodge her Q Glitterlance or it sticks you hard.
- post6: Maximum Dosage heal lets you survive Whimsy duration. Still vulnerable; play around cooldown timing carefully.
- spike: First item spike (Luden's or Chemtech) hurts but not terminal. You spike harder at Heartsteel.
- window: After Lulu burns Whimsy and you land Q; all-in before cooldown resets. Mid-game teamfights favor you.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Prevents her roaming bot and limits her gank setup range.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; you need the slow resist and movespeed to stick after Whimsy ends.
- item: Abyssal Mask first. Lulu scales AP; her damage becomes irrelevant and you heal more per trade.

drmundo__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Mordekaiser's E Death's Grasp pulls you into range for ult; avoid being hit by it.
- Early: Safe to farm levels 1-3; he has no kill pressure yet, just farm and scale.
- Trading: Bait his Q Obliterate by stepping in and out of range, then trade back freely.
- Post6: Mirror his Flash or he Flash-E-ults you at 6; your passive blocks first immobilize from ult.
- Spike: First item is not a danger window; you outscale him hard after level 11 anyway.
- Window: Level 11 onwards you tank 7 seconds in his Realm of Death; he cannot kill you.
- Wave: Shove the wave to deny him melee positioning and reduce his E Death's Grasp threat range.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge is easier and escapes even through Rylai's slow; pick this over Grasp here.
- Item: Unending Despair reduces his healing and stat-steal value; add it if he becomes a threat.

drmundo__morgana.notes:
- threat: Black Shield blocks your Q slow, denying your primary kiting tool against her chains.
- early: Safe farm. Respect Dark Binding range; stand behind minions and avoid predictable positioning.
- trading: Bait her Q with positioning; trade back only after she misses or shields ally.
- post6: Soul Shackles chains lock you down hard; play around cooldown and position carefully.
- spike: First Abyssal Mask spike weakens her damage; not a danger window, farm safely.
- window: Mid-game when you stack health; she can't shield entire team from your Q.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; forces her to choose between waveclear and roaming safety.
- rune: Conditioning variant; scaling health and resistances maximize your tankiness into her poke.
- item: Abyssal Mask first; magic damage reduction and health pool hard-counter her Tormented Shadow.

drmundo__olaf.notes:
- Olaf's true damage E and attack speed scaling mean he outdamages you in extended fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid all-ins since Olaf wins short trades with attack speed.
- Max Q for waveclear and kite. Bait his Q by positioning unpredictably, then trade back.
- Ragnarok makes Olaf unkiteable and disable-immune; respect his all-in potential massively post-6.
- Olaf's first item spike (Black Cleaver or similar) is dangerous; stay defensive and scale.
- You outscale hard mid-game with items and healing; abuse this window before he teamfights.
- Shove wave constantly; Stormraider's lets you kite away and deny his close-range advantage.
- Stormraider's Surge with slow resist shard lets you run from him permanently; use it.
- Randuin's Omen reduces his attack speed and crit threat; slot it into your build.

drmundo__nami.notes:
- Threat: Aqua Prison stun locks you; Tidal Wave knock-up chains CC and lets her team burst you.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay max range, avoid bubble range. Q her when she goes for CS.
- Trading: Bait Aqua Prison by positioning near minions; dodge it, then all-in with Q and E combo.
- Post6: Tidal Wave makes her exponentially stronger. Space wider, play safer. Your ult still lets you sustain through.
- Spike: First item around 10-12 minutes. Not a danger window; you outscale her damage with tankiness soon.
- Window: Mid-game levels 10-13 when you have 2-3 items. You tank burst; she has no kill threat.
- Wave: Freeze near your tower. Forces her to position forward for poke; makes her gankable and vulnerable.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. Scaling armor and MR lets you face-check her poke and ignore early harassment.
- Item: Mercury's Treads first if she chains stuns; swap from Boots of Swiftness for tenacity priority.

drmundo__riven.notes:
- Riven's Broken Wings Q and Ki Burst W stun combo locks you down for all-in burst damage.
- Levels 1-3 are dangerous; respect her damage and zone threat, farm safely at range with Q.
- Dodge her Ki Burst W stun by playing around minions; never chase or fight her directly.
- Post-6, her Blade of the Exile R and Wind Slash greatly increase her all-in damage threat.
- First item spike is moderate danger; she gets more AD and range but you still outscale.
- Outscale window opens mid-game; she falls off while your tankiness and healing make you unkillable.
- Hold wave near your tower; this denies her roam and keeps her stuck farming safely.
- Stormraider's Surge with Inspiration secondary; gives you mobility to kite her stick and survive all-ins.
- Add Jak'Sho, The Protean to reduce her burst damage and survive her early all-in attempts.

drmundo__rakan.notes:
- threat: His peel isn't enough against you; focus on his low durability and sustained damage output.
- early: Safely farm; Rakan has no kill threat early. Space from W Grand Entrance and avoid clumping.
- trading: Trade when his Q Gleaming Quill is down. Dodge nothing; all his damage matters. Press with Q Infected Bonesaw.
- post6: The Quickness charm is avoidable via W Heart Zapper's persistence. Your ult outscales his engage tools hard.
- spike: His first item doesn't threaten you. Punish by extending trades; your tankiness grows faster than his damage.
- window: Post-6 when Maximum Dosage fully heals you. Chase him down; he cannot kite or peel effectively enough.
- wave: Shove consistently; he cannot stop your push and you outtrade him in extended skirmishes near your lane.
- rune: Conditioning variant to maximize bulk; stacks with your health scaling and makes his poke irrelevant by mid-game.
- item: Thornmail early if he itemizes damage; reflects his auto-trades and forces him into less optimal builds.

drmundo__samira.notes:
- Threat: Inferno Trigger deals massive damage to your entire team; you lack CC to stop her ult.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Samira lacks waveclear and range advantage, so play passive and scale.
- Trading: Avoid trading into her melee combo; bait Wild Rush dashes and punish with Q after.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage timing becomes critical—use it before Inferno Trigger hits to survive and reengage.
- Spike: Samira's first item spike is dangerous; stay grouped and play defensive until you outscale her.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you once you stack resistances; she needs kills to refresh Wild Rush.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces Samira to overextend for kills and exposes her to ganks.
- Rune: Standard; you need tankiness and sustain against her constant melee damage and Daredevil Impulse procs.
- Item: Thornmail amplifies her pain when she dives; punishes her for committing into melee range.

drmundo__swain.notes:
- Swain's E roots you in place, then his ult drains your health faster than you heal.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q and W poke you down. Last-hit only, avoid his W.
- Bait his E root by walking unpredictably; dodge it and all-in before his cooldown resets.
- Post-6 Swain becomes extremely dangerous. Walk out immediately when his ult starts; don't trade into drain.
- Swain's first item spike (Liandry's or Rylai's) is your punish window if he lacks Rylai's.
- You spike harder once you finish Heartsteel or Hollow Radiance; his poke damage falls off hard.
- Shove the wave early to deny his poke damage and zone him from last-hitting safely.
- Take Conditioning variant; extra resistances scale perfectly into his mixed damage and sustained drain threat.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early if he rushes Rylai's; it cuts his drain effectiveness significantly.

drmundo__shen.notes:
- E Shadow Dash taunts you into bad positions; his ult abandons lane, forcing you to pressure towers.
- Play safe level 1-3; his Q poke outranges you early. Farm at distance, avoid extended trades.
- Bait his E dash with positioning, then trade back hard with Q max. Don't chase into W.
- Post-6, Shen ults away to help team; shove lane hard and deal massive tower damage with Demolish.
- First item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) doesn't spike him offensively; it's your window to abuse.
- Mid-game when you complete Heartsteel or Force of Nature; you outscale his early damage pressure significantly.
- Shove the wave hard every time he roams or ults; Demolish + tower pressure is your win condition.
- Stormraider's Surge with Resolve: Demolish punishes his ult roaming and guarantees tower damage when he leaves.
- Consider Unending Despair if he stacks shields (Stand United + Ki Barrier); it cuts his durability gains.

drmundo__urgot.notes:
- Threat: Fear Beyond Death execute threshold; if you fall below it, Urgot judges and kills you outright.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Urgot has no reliable all-in yet. Stay healthy, avoid his Q slow.
- Trading: Dodge his E charge—if he whiffs, he can't reel you in or hurl you. Bait it.
- Post6: Respect Fear Beyond Death execute window; never let health drop below threshold when Urgot has ult ready.
- Spike: Urgot first item (Manamune or Black Cleaver) is not a huge danger window for you yet.
- Window: After you hit level 6 Maximum Dosage, you out-sustain his poke and threaten all-ins; abuse it.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; forces Urgot to overextend for CS, sets up your E slam punish.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge with Resolve is better than Grasp to kite away from his Q slow and ult.
- Item: Rush Warden's Mail after Heartsteel and Warmog's to reduce his execute window and physical burst damage.

drmundo__xinzhao.notes:
- Three Talon Strike knock-up into all-in; get out of range before third auto lands.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his early all-in with Q is stronger than your trades.
- Don't trade into his autos before third hit procs; bait Q cooldown then retaliate.
- Post-6, space carefully; his ult extends fights where your sustain edges him out eventually.
- First item spike (Titanic or Bruiser item) is dangerous; play safe until you complete Heartsteel.
- Dr. Mundo dominates late-game teamfights; ignore him and run backline unless he's severely overextended.
- Shove wave consistently; denies him gank setup and lets you scale without jungle pressure.
- Conditioning variant for durability; his early spike is real and extended fights favor your healing.
- Buy Thornmail early if ahead; his Determination heals make pure tankiness less effective otherwise.

drmundo__vayne.notes:
- Threat: Silver Bolts true damage on third hit shreds your Health; Condemn stun traps you if you dash carelessly into terrain.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay back; her Attack Range dominates. Land Q Infected Bonesaw if she walks up aggressively to cs.
- Trading: Never trade into her Silver Bolts stacks. Bait her Condemn toward open space, then E Blunt Force Trauma and chase her down.
- Post6: Maximum Dosage healing lets you absorb her damage and chase. Your passive blocks her only escape tool—Condemn loses its peel power.
- Spike: Her first item (likely Kraken Slayer or Sheen) spikes her damage—punish window. You outscale her survivability with Heartsteel and tank itemization.
- Window: After landing Q Cleaver with ult and passive up, run her down relentlessly. She cannot kite or escape your raw tankiness.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower. Forces her to overextend for cs, triggering your passive block and letting you land free cleavers.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. Provides the Move Speed to stick and chase after cleaver lands; Resolve secondary guarantees you survive her burst.
- Item: Randuin's Omen. Reduces her Attack Speed and critical damage, gutting Silver Bolts and crits when she lands Condemn stuns on you.

drmundo__zaahen.notes:
- Threat: Zaahen's Determination stacks grant exponential damage; his revive makes him unkillable late-game threat.
- Early: Dangerous. His W pull plus Q knockup combo locks you down; stay max range, dodge W.
- Trading: Never trade into his stacked Determination. Bait his Q knockup recast, then all-in with W.
- Post6: Grim Deliverance healing plus revive window makes him unkillable in extended fights; play safer.
- Spike: First item is danger window. Zaahen gains survivability and damage simultaneously; don't force extended trades.
- Window: Mid-game before full Determination stacks when your tankiness peaks relative to his damage output.
- Wave: Hold near tower. His W pull punishes extended positioning; deny him pull opportunities on minions.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge. His W pull and sustained damage stick you; need the enhanced movespeed escape.
- Item: Unending Despair. Grievous wounds reduce his Grim Deliverance healing and burst healing from Q casts.

drmundo__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark amplifies all his damage into a burst that you cannot tank even with items.
- Play safe and farm. Zed's Razor Shuriken is a skillshot—dodge it by moving unpredictably.
- Never fight Zed in short trades. He will out-damage you. Wait for his Living Shadow cooldown.
- Death Mark makes Zed a kill threat. Play around cooldown timers and never stand isolated.
- Zed's first item spike is immediate danger. Stay alive, farm safely, and avoid 1v1 fights.
- Your punish window is when Zed wastes Living Shadow. All-in him if he can't escape.
- Shove the wave constantly. Force Zed to clear with abilities, draining his energy and mana.
- Use Conditioning variant. You need raw tankiness to survive marked burst, not rune damage output.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early. Reduces his magic damage and gives you time to heal between trades.

drmundo__zoe.notes:
- Threat: Sleepy Trouble Bubble's doubled damage breaks your tankiness; Portal Jump lets her kite and escape.
- Early: Safe farm. Stay behind minions to block Paddle Star!; dodge nothing recklessly since her poke scales poorly early.
- Trading: Don't chase after she casts spells—she gets bonus auto damage. Bait Paddle Star! by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post6: Portal Jump makes her untargetable; you can't catch her. Use Goes Where He Pleases to tank her burst.
- Spike: First item is danger. Her Paddle Star! and sleep combo spike hard; respect range and play safe then.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights favor you. She has no defensive items; Maximum Dosage healing outlasts her burst damage output.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. She's immobile without Portal Jump; jungle ganks punish her overextension harder here.
- Rune: Conditioning variant. You need armor and magic resist scaling to survive her poke and sleep combo consistently.
- Item: Abyssal Mask. Reduces her magic damage output; pairs well with your tankiness to negate Paddle Star! spam.

drmundo__ziggs.notes:
- threat: Ziggs' ranged poke and W Satchel Charge knockback prevent you from engaging; his R Mega Inferno Bomb zone-controls teamfights.
- early: Safely farm at range; dodge Q Bouncing Bomb and E Hexplosive Minefield mines by positioning away from wave clumps.
- trading: Never trade into his Short Fuse proc; bait his W knockback by standing near minions, then all-in when it's down.
- post6: Maximum Dosage heals you through his poke, but R Mega Inferno Bomb forces you to group or abandon sidelane pressure.
- spike: Ziggs' first item (Liandry's Torment or Luden's Tempest) doesn't spike hard; you outscale him in tankiness—punish overextension with Q.
- window: Post-Heartsteel or when Ziggs wastes W; engage only when his E mines are on cooldown and W is unavailable.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; his poke forces you to stay back, and grouping lets your tankiness outvalue his damage.
- rune: Conditioning variant—stacks resistances against his sustained poke and lets you scale into mid-game tankiness without additional action.
- item: Abyssal Mask—reduces his magic damage output and cuts healing effectiveness if he ever groups near you in teamfights.

olaf__akali.notes:
- Threat: Akali's W invisibility and mobility let her burst you down before you can retaliate or lock her.
- Early: Play safe; her Q-poke outranges your engage. Farm defensively and avoid pushing into river without vision.
- Trading: Bait her W shroud, then all-in when she's forced to attack and briefly reveals. Don't chase invisible Akali.
- Post6: Her R mobility and execute damage make her extremely slippery. Your disable immunity on Ragnarok doesn't help enough.
- Spike: First item spike (Protobelt or similar) lets her burst harder. Punish her before she completes it with aggression.
- Window: Levels 4-5 before her full combo is online. Force extended trades where her cooldowns matter more than burst.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard so she must choose between farming and roaming; limits her kill setup on you.
- Rune: Conqueror; you need sustain and true damage to match her elusiveness and reset her defensive plays.
- Item: Force of Nature against her magic damage and to reduce her burst window with magic resist.

olaf__akshan.notes:
- Threat: Akshan's mobility via Heroic Swing and Avengerang kiting makes him hard to lock down even with Ragnarok active.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Akshan's early Avengerang harass outranges your Q, so farm defensively and avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait Avengerang by faking aggression, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge the boomerang return or move behind minions.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables helps you stick, but Akshan still kites with Heroic Swing; don't chase blindly into terrain.
- Spike: Akshan's first item spike (Manamune or Kraken) is dangerous; respect his damage and poke from range during this window.
- Window: Mid-game when Ragnarok is up and Akshan lacks mobility cooldowns; force fights away from terrain where he can't swing.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Akshan safety and roaming; force him to choose between farm and backing.
- Rune: Conqueror for extended trading durability and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing in longer all-ins against him.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst and shields you against Comeuppance's missing health scaling damage.

olaf__aphelios.notes:
- Aphelios' long-range poke and kiting with Calibrum mark forces you to engage or take sustained damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q and avoid walking into Calibrum's effective range.
- Bait his weapon swaps with W to close distance; dodge Moonlight Vigil by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his disable attempts and gap-close for guaranteed extended trades.
- His first item spike (likely Collector or Manamune) increases burst; use it as your all-in window instead.
- After Ragnarok activates, you have a 5-second window to force him into melee range uncontested.
- Shove the wave into his tower; deny him space to kite and force closer positioning fights.
- Take Conqueror for sustained damage during extended trades your tankiness and engage enable.
- Buy Mercury's Treads early if Aphelios fetches weapon combinations with heavy crowd control effects available.

olaf__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Anivia's Q stun and W wall trap you; her E doubles damage on chilled targets.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; avoid her Q path and don't chase into tower range.
- Trading: Bait her Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E when she misses cooldown.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity breaks her disable lock; use it to walk through W and ignore stuns.
- Spike: First item spike (Luden's or Liandry's) hurts; farm safely and don't fight in her R.
- Window: Post-6 when Ragnarok active; dive through her abilities and force her to kite or die.
- Wave: Shove hard; force her into tower or chase you, breaking her wall and stun setup.
- Rune: Predator—gap close through her W wall and catch her immobile frame before she escapes.
- Item: Add Hollow Radiance; reduces her R damage and her ability haste, slowing her damage ramp.

olaf__aurelionsol.notes:
- Threat: Aurelion Sol kites with Astral Flight and Singularity pull while dealing unavoidable damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Breath of Light lacks cooldown only while flying, manageable.
- Trading: Dodge Falling Star stun, engage when Aurelion Sol lands from Astral Flight.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables counters Falling Star stun and Singularity pull effects.
- Spike: First item spike dangerous; Aurelion Sol gains sustained damage, you lack mobility escape.
- Window: Engage immediately after Aurelion Sol uses Astral Flight cooldown; chase with Undertow.
- Wave: Shove wave hard; force Aurelion Sol to choose between farming and positioning safely.
- Rune: Predator lets you chase Aurelion Sol across map when he attempts kiting.
- Item: Add Force of Nature for magic resist and movement speed against sustained magic.

olaf__cassiopeia.notes:
- Grounding from Miasma denies your engage tools; kite you while poisoning and healing off Twin Fang.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Cassiopeia outranges you heavily. Farm with Q from distance, avoid her Noxious Blast.
- Never chase through Miasma clouds; bait her into using W defensively, then all-in when cooldown expires.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Petrifying Gaze stun, but she still slows; engage carefully post-6.
- Her first item spike (Liandry's or Rylai's) around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect her sustained poison damage.
- Your window is when her W and E are down simultaneously; commit fully then or disengage.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her safety; force her to use abilities on minions instead of you.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true damage through her resistances and healing against her Twin Fang sustain.
- Buy Force of Nature early if she stacks magic damage; the move speed helps you reposition through Miasma.

olaf__ekko.notes:
- Threat: Ekko's Phase Dive teleport and Chronobreak rewind let him escape all-ins and reset fights repeatedly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko's poke with Timewinder outranges you, so farm passively near tower.
- Trading: Dodge Timewinder's return path by moving unpredictably; bait Phase Dive before committing to Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Chronobreak makes Ekko unkillable in extended fights; focus on burst windows before he rewinds.
- Spike: His first item spike (Lich Bane or Nashor's Tooth) increases his burst; punish him before completion.
- Window: You spike when Ekko's cooldowns are down; all-in immediately after he uses Phase Dive defensively.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Ekko safety for poking; force him to trade under tower.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage through his resistances and scaling into teamfights.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce his magic damage and lower Chronobreak's heal effectiveness.

olaf__gangplank.notes:
- Threat: Gangplank kites you with Powder Keg slow and Cannon Barrage; burst you before Ragnarok activates.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Parrrley outranges you. Stand behind minions, avoid predictable patterns for Q harass.
- Trading: Bait Powder Keg placement, then all-in when it's on cooldown. Dodge Cannon Barrage zones; close gaps post-dodge.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Cannon Barrage slow and dive. Activate before his ult lands for advantage.
- Spike: First item (Trinity Force or similar) spikes Gangplank's damage around minute 10-12. Play safer, farm under tower.
- Window: Post-Ragnarok activation and when Gangplank wastes Remove Scurvy; all-in immediately before cooldowns return online.
- Wave: Shove early to deny Gangplank safe Parrrley farming; reduces his gold income and forces risky plays.
- Rune: Conqueror; true damage stacking and healing sustain counters his poke and kite attempts effectively.
- Item: Purchase Force of Nature; magic resist blocks Cannon Barrage burst and Trial by Fire burn damage.

olaf__gragas.notes:
- Gragas Body Slam stuns you, then Explosive Cask knocks you away from safety or teammates.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Gragas out-ranges you. Farm at distance, avoid his Q path predictably.
- Bait Body Slam by moving unpredictably, then all-in while his E is down. Dodge Barrel Roll.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Explosive Cask knockback and Body Slam stun; activate before his combo.
- First item (Liandry's or Luden's around 10 minutes) doesn't spike hard; continue farming and scale up.
- Post-6, you outfight him if you dodge his E or activate Ragnarok before his burst lands.
- Hold wave near your tower; his E-R combo punishes overextended positioning more than your close range.
- Predator or Phase Rush—Predator closes gap post-dodge, Phase Rush kites his follow-up or escapes Body Slam.
- Mercury's Treads blocks Explosive Cask's knockback utility and Body Slam stun duration; prioritize early.

olaf__gnar.notes:
- Threat: Gnar's Wallop stun into GNAR! combo locks you down and deals massive damage before you respond.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Gnar's Hyper bonus damage out-trades you before Berserker Rage scales with missing health.
- Trading: Bait his Boomerang Throw, then all-in while it's returning; dodge Wallop by moving laterally before he lands.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore his stuns, but GNAR! displacement still threatens you near walls—position away from them.
- Spike: His first item-spike is dangerous; respect his damage and avoid extended trades until you stack missing health advantage.
- Window: Mid-game when Gnar sits small and you've taken poke damage; your Berserker Rage attack speed and lifesteal dominate his duels.
- Wave: Shove the wave into his tower to deny Mega Gnar transformation opportunities and prevent him from grouping effectively.
- Rune: Press the Attack for consistent trading damage and proc frequency throughout the lane phase against his poke.
- Item: Abyssal Mask reduces his burst and gives you tankiness; add it early if he snowballs hard on you.

olaf__heimerdinger.notes:
- Threat: Heimerdinger's turrets deal sustained damage; dodge E to avoid stun and kite setup.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; respect turret damage range and avoid extended trades near them.
- Trading: Bait E Electron Storm Grenade by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Q Undertow into E Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore stuns; activate R during E Reckless Swing to sustain through turret fire.
- Spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Rylai's) increases turret pressure; punish by forcing Heimerdinger away from turrets.
- Window: Post-6 when you activate Ragnarok—dive through turrets and E Reckless Swing; he cannot stop you cleanly.
- Wave: Shove constantly into turrets; force Heimerdinger to choose between defending towers or fighting you directly.
- Rune: Conqueror—sustained true damage from E Reckless Swing stacks against turrets and Heimerdinger's poke harassment.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius—reduces magic damage from turret beams and E grenade, increasing all-in survivability.

olaf__illaoi.notes:
- Threat: Illaoi's E rips your spirit, forcing you to take damage while separated from her tentacles.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid her W engage range and don't get caught by Q tentacle swings.
- Trading: Bait her E spirit pull, then disengage; dodge her W leap by moving unpredictably away from tentacles.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable attempts, but tentacles still deal damage during her ult.
- Spike: Illaoi's first item spike (Black Cleaver) is dangerous; she gains damage and armor shred simultaneously.
- Window: You spike harder mid-game when Berserker Rage procs from fights; use low health to sustain through her.
- Wave: Shove the wave into tower to deny her tentacle spawns from impassible terrain near lane brushes.
- Rune: Conqueror stacks true damage and healing, scaling better than hers as fights extend and you heal.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius shields you from her physical burst and provides early magic resist utility.

olaf__hwei.notes:
- Threat: Hwei's crowd control from E abilities locks you down; his Signature procs burst you before Ragnarok activates.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; his Q, W, E skillshots are dodgeable but spacing matters; farm with E sparingly.
- Trading: Dodge his E Subject: Torment abilities—Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw are his primary threat; trade after.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables counters his E crowd control; activate during Spiraling Despair to negate its slow and damage.
- Spike: First item powerspike (Luden's Tempest or similar) is his danger window; stay healthy and don't get caught by chain CC.
- Window: Level 6 onwards; your Ragnarok disables immunity turns his E abilities into dead weight; all-in when he wastes them.
- Wave: Shove waves into tower; forces Hwei to defend or lose CS, preventing him from roaming and setting up ganks.
- Rune: Kayle Keystone; sustain through poke, scale into teamfights where Ragnarok shines, and reduce reliance on potions early.
- Item: Hollow Radiance; reduces his ability power scaling and provides magic resist to survive his burst combo windows.

olaf__jayce.notes:
- Threat: Jayce's Shock Blast and poke force you to stay in lane with low health, weakening your tankiness.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Jayce out-ranges you heavily so avoid extended trades and farm defensively.
- Trading: Bait his Shock Blast skillshot, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when he's on cooldown.
- Post6: Ragnarok lets you ignore his crowd control; activate it during all-ins to lock down the kill.
- Spike: First item spike makes Jayce stronger; farm safely and avoid skirmishes until you complete core items.
- Window: Mid-game when you have Hollow Radiance; Ragnarok immunity lets you survive his burst and dominate.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; this lets you farm safely and forces Jayce to overextend.
- Rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustain in this poke-heavy matchup against ranged pressure.
- Item: Hollow Radiance negates Jayce's mixed damage and gives you tankiness to survive his burst.

olaf__jhin.notes:
- Jhin's W Deadly Flourish and R Curtain Call execute from range; dodge sideways or tank with Ragnarok immunity.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Jhin outranges you heavily. Farm with Q Undertow and retrieve axes to reset cooldown.
- Bait W Deadly Flourish by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown. Never trade into his fourth shot crit.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through W and R; activate before committing to all-ins to guarantee engage.
- First item spike (Manamune or Collector) hurts but isn't lethal. Use levels 6-8 to threaten all-ins while he scales.
- Spike at level 6 and again at two items when you have sustain. Force fights when Jhin lacks peel nearby.
- Shove wave into his tower when possible; forces him to farm close or lose cs, reducing his safe W poke angle.
- Press the Attack rewards your close-range auto-trading and synergizes with E Reckless Swing true damage burst pattern.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius early if Jhin secures kills; the shield blocks execute damage and amplifies your sustain.

olaf__leesin.notes:
- Lee Sin's Q-E combo chain and Dragon's Rage knockback control and burst threaten your survival.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lee's Sonic Wave range outmatches your Undertow early, avoid extended trades.
- Bait Sonic Wave by repositioning, then all-in when his Q is down and on cooldown.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Dragon's Rage knockback; activate before his ult lands.
- First item spike around 1000 gold is dangerous; respect his damage spike, scale safely.
- You outscale mid-game; force fights after your first major item when Berserker Rage dominates.
- Shove the wave to deny Lee Sin roam potential and force him to defend.
- Conqueror stacks during extended fights where your true damage and tankiness overwhelm his kiting.
- Buy Force of Nature to reduce his magic damage from Tempest and survive Dragon's Rage.

olaf__leblanc.notes:
- Threat: LeBlanc's E Ethereal Chains roots you, letting her burst with Q and W damage safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her W Distortion outranges your Q Undertow, so avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait her W Distortion by walking forward, then all-in when she returns to starting location.
- Post6: Mimic turns her into a two-chain threat; activate R Ragnarok when she chains to ignore CC.
- Spike: First Luden's Tempest spike hurts; stay healthy so P Berserker Rage scales Attack Speed and Life Steal.
- Window: Post-6 when R Ragnarok is active, you ignore her E root and run her down hard.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard; forces LeBlanc to choose between farming and roaming, limits her map pressure.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage through her defensive items and tankiness she'll eventually build.
- Item: Build Mercury's Treads early; reduces her E root duration and provides magic resist against her burst.

olaf__leona.notes:
- Leona stuns you repeatedly with Q, E, R—disables that block Ragnarok activation and guarantee her team kills you.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm at range, avoid her Q range, and don't fight near minions where E lands easily.
- Bait her E Zenith Blade by repositioning sideways, then all-in while her dash is down; dodge nothing, she has no skillshots.
- Post-6 Ragnarok lets you ignore her stuns during fights, but Solar Flare still lands—activate only when committed to all-in.
- First item spike around 1000 gold doesn't threaten you yet; your power window is levels 2-4 before her CC chains online.
- Your advantage window is early game before her cooldowns reset and before she builds tanky; abuse Q axe resets for pressure.
- Let the wave push toward you slightly so you can all-in her near your tower when she overextends for kills.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true damage through her armor; you'll out-damage her in extended fights she can't burst-lock.
- Add Force of Nature late if she stacks magic damage and keeps you CCed; the tenacity helps you slip chains.

olaf__lillia.notes:
- Lillia's Dream-Laden Bough deals max Health damage over time; kite and disengage her poke.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm at range, dodge Swirlseed, and avoid her Blooming Blows engage.
- Bait Swirlseed by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing when she misses.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore her Lilting Lullaby sleep; activate before she ults.
- Lillia's first item spike around 2-3 items hurts; play safer and scale into mid-game.
- Post-15 minutes you spike harder; your true damage and Life Steal outscale her sustained poke.
- Shove the wave to deny her roam and force her to choose farming or grouping.
- Take Conqueror for extended trades; it stacks through both true damage and her max Health damage.
- Add a Spirit Visage for extra healing against her percentage damage and Dream-Laden Bough pressure.

olaf__mordekaiser.notes:
- Threat: Realm of Death isolates you and steals your stats; you cannot escape or cleanse it.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Mordekaiser lacks gap close, so kite and avoid his Q center.
- Trading: Bait his Q, then trade with Undertow and autos; dodge his E pull with movement.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables does not prevent Realm of Death drag; play around cooldown timing.
- Spike: First item spike (Rylai's or Liandry's) increases his teamfight; punish him in side lane before.
- Window: After Realm of Death cooldown ends, you have 20+ seconds to abuse him in fights.
- Wave: Shove when Realm of Death is down; deny him the all-in setup near your tower.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true damage and healing to outduel him in extended fights.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature second to reduce his aura damage and gain magic resist stacking.

olaf__nocturne.notes:
- Threat: Unspeakable Horror fear chains you; Paranoia blinds and locks you into all-ins with no escape.
- Early: Safe farm; Nocturne outduels you pre-6, so respect his all-in range and avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Bait Shroud of Darkness with Undertow, then all-in; dodge Unspeakable Horror by moving away immediately when planted.
- Post6: Paranoia removes your vision and forces fights; use Ragnarok to stay immune to the fear during engages.
- Spike: First item spike makes Nocturne deadly; play safer and farm defensively until you complete your core items.
- Window: You outscale hard mid-game; when Nocturne falls behind, leverage your sustained damage and durability to dominate.
- Wave: Shove wave into his tower; limits his roam range and denies him vision control around river brush.
- Rune: Take Conqueror for extended trades where Berserker Rage and sustained damage let you win longer fights.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature if Nocturne ults repeatedly; the magic resist and move speed counter his engage.

olaf__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's Jubilant Veil dodges all your damage while speeding up; you cannot trade effectively against it.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nilah outtraces you early and Formless Blade poke forces you to concede CS.
- Never chase Nilah into fog; bait Jubilant Veil by walking forward, then disengage until cooldown expires.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her CC, but Apotheosis still pulls you in and deal damage regardless.
- Nilah's first item spike (likely Kaenic Rookern or Manamune) denies your burst; play patient farming, avoid all-ins.
- You spike when Nilah wastes Jubilant Veil cooldown; immediately all-in before it resets or she escapes.
- Shove the wave hard; Nilah struggles to farm under tower and her scaling requires roaming and teamfights.
- Take Conqueror for extended trade duration; Nilah's evasion forces long fights where true damage and AD scale better.
- Add Hollow Radiance to reduce her movement speed bonus from Jubilant Veil and block her heal amplification.

olaf__nunuwillump.notes:
- Absolute Zero roots you in place; avoid its blizzard or use Ragnarok's disable immunity to escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Biggest Snowball Ever! knock-up combos hurt. Farm ranged, respect Snowball Barrage root.
- Bait Biggest Snowball Ever! sideways, then all-in. Never face-check terrain where snowball gains speed unchecked.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Snowball Barrage root and Absolute Zero slow; activate aggressively.
- His first Liandry's Torment spike hurts; your window is before it completes around 10-12 minutes.
- Your power window: levels 2-5 before his ult, and post-Ragnarok when his CC means nothing.
- Hold wave near your tower; his roams with snowball are dangerous, deny him easy engage angles.
- Take Conqueror; true damage from Reckless Swing and sustained healing stack hard against his poke.
- Rush Force of Nature if behind; magic resist stacks with Ragnarok passive and blocks Liandry's burn.

olaf__poppy.notes:
- Poppy's E Heroic Charge stuns you into walls, removing your ability to kite or escape her.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q Hammer Shock zone and E threat limit your all-in potential early.
- Bait her E dash cooldown before trading; dodge Q Hammer Shock zone or fight outside it.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her W Steadfast Presence grounding, but E stun wall-lock still lands.
- Her first item spike (typically Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) increases her resistances; your true damage shines through.
- You outscale mid-game when Berserker Rage and Undertow resets let you kite; abuse this before she tanks up.
- Hold wave near your tower; her E engage range is shorter and wall-stuns are less likely near base.
- Take Conqueror; sustained damage and tenacity help you duel through her resistances and survive her burst.
- Add Maw of Malmortius if she deals heavy magic damage; its shield and tenacity aid survival.

olaf__rell.notes:
- Magnet Storm pulls you into her team while Shattering Strike stuns, leaving you vulnerable and disabled.
- Play safe early; her Shattering Strike stun is devastating. Farm from range with Q, avoid close trades.
- Dodge Shattering Strike by positioning behind minions. Don't trade when she's mounted; wait for Ferromancy crash.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable chain, but she still steals your resistances with Break the Mold.
- Her first item spike (likely Hollow Radiance or Kaenic Rookern) strengthens her tankiness; punish before completion.
- Post-Ragnarok activation, you win extended fights since immunity negates her stun and pull combo entirely.
- Hold wave near your tower; her engage tools reward forward positioning, and tower protection lets you scale safely.
- Take Conqueror for sustained tankiness and damage as Rell tries to kite and steal your resistances.
- Add Hollow Radiance to match her resistances and reduce the impact of Break the Mold stealing armor.

olaf__rengar.notes:
- Rengar's Bola Strike root locks you down; his empowered version guarantees root and follow-up burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect Rengar's all-in potential and farm at range using Undertow spam.
- Bait Bola Strike by moving unpredictably, then trade back with Undertow; avoid committing when low HP.
- Ragnarok immunity breaks Rengar's crowd control chain, allowing you to escape or turn fights post-6.
- Watch Rengar's first item spike around 10-12 minutes; punish him by forcing extended fights where Berserker Rage scales.
- You outscale Rengar in extended teamfights when Ragnarok active and Berserker Rage stacked from missing health.
- Push wave into Rengar's tower to deny him brush ganks and prevent roam pressure on teammates.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true-damage stacking and bonus AD, matching Rengar's fight persistence.
- Build Mercury's Treads early to reduce Bola Strike's root duration and improve Ragnarok's disable immunity uptime.

olaf__rumble.notes:
- Threat: Rumble's Danger Zone empowers all abilities; his AoE damage and slows kite and punish your melee range relentlessly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Rumble has no real threat yet, but respect his Q cone range and avoid grouping.
- Trading: Dodge his E Electro Harpoon skillshot; if he misses, all-in with Q Undertow and E Reckless Swing for true damage.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you walk through The Equalizer's slow and flame wall; activate during his ult to engage freely.
- Spike: First item (likely Liandry's) amplifies his Danger Zone damage spike; play safer, respect his zone control, wait for cooldowns.
- Window: You spike when Rumble wastes cooldowns or leaves Danger Zone; all-in immediately with R Ragnarok active to close distance.
- Wave: Shove the wave into his tower early; prevents him from grouping and forces him to farm under tower safely.
- Rune: Take Conqueror; true damage scaling from E Reckless Swing plus sustained fighting pressure rewards extended trades in his zone.
- Item: Buy Hollow Radiance second or third; magic resist and bonus health reduce Rumble's Danger Zone burst and Liandry's damage scaling.

olaf__shen.notes:
- Shadow Dash taunts you into bad positions; E cooldown is your window to trade back.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Shen's Q poke outranges you, so farm from distance and avoid fights.
- Bait Shadow Dash by positioning aggressively, then all-in while it's down; dodge nothing since it taunts.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his E taunt; use R to engage or commit to kills.
- Shen's first item spike (likely Hollow Radiance) reduces your burst; abuse him before he completes it.
- Your window opens when Shen wastes Shadow Dash or Stand United; all-in immediately with E.
- Shove the wave hard to deny Shen roam opportunities and force him to defend turret.
- Conqueror stacks from true damage E and repeated attacks, shredding Shen's armor and magic resist scaling.
- Add Maw of Malmortius if Shen's team has significant magic damage; otherwise stick to standard build.

olaf__skarner.notes:
- threat: Impale suppresses you instantly; Ixtal's Impact stuns into walls; you cannot escape with Ragnarok active.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Skarner lacks damage early; avoid walls and play around minions defensively.
- trading: Dodge Ixtal's Impact charge by moving perpendicular; bait his W shield, then trade with Undertow axe.
- post6: Impale suppresses you regardless of Ragnarok immunity; activate Ragnarok only after suppression ends to escape.
- spike: First item spike is minimal danger; punish Skarner's cooldowns when he misses Ixtal's Impact charge.
- window: You spike harder at two items; kite away from walls and use Undertow resets aggressively.
- wave: Shove constantly and hard; deny Skarner wall setups near your lane and force river presence.
- rune: Predator; chase Skarner into river and pivot teamfights away from walls before he engages.
- item: Hollow Radiance; reduces Skarner's Quaking damage and magic resist shred from his Threads of Vibration.

olaf__sivir.notes:
- Sivir kites you effortlessly with Fleet of Foot procs and On The Hunt; she avoids Undertow by dodging skillshots.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Sivir outranges you heavily, so farm with Q from distance and avoid walking into her range.
- Bait her Spell Shield with Undertow before committing trades; land true damage with Reckless Swing only when shield is down.
- Ragnarok makes you immune to her slows and lets you chase through On The Hunt; this is your win condition window.
- Her first item spike (likely Manamune or Navori) increases her DPS and cooldown reduction; respect her damage and don't all-in yet.
- You spike when Ragnarok is active and she wastes Spell Shield; immediately run her down and land Reckless Swing repeatedly.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her safe farming and force her to use abilities; this creates gank opportunities for your jungler.
- Take Conqueror for extended trading through her poke; you need true damage stacking to outduel her sustained damage output.
- Buy Force of Nature to reduce her magic damage and gain movement speed; this lets you stick to her better.

olaf__smolder.notes:
- Threat: Smolder's Q Super Scorcher Breath stacks Dragon Practice, scaling damage that burns you down over time.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Smolder's Q outranges your all-ins, so farm defensively and avoid prolonged trades.
- Trading: Bait out Smolder's W Achooo! before committing E Reckless Swing; dodge his Q by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Smolder's R MMOOOMMMM! slow, but respect the burst damage and reposition.
- Spike: First item spike (around 1100g) increases Smolder's Q damage significantly; play safer and scale into your items.
- Window: Once you land Undertow and pick up the axe, all-in hard before his stacks stack further.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; let Smolder push into you so Undertow hits multiple minions safely.
- Rune: Conqueror sustains you through poke and true damage trades, ramping into his high-damage mid-game phase.
- Item: Build Force of Nature to reduce his ability damage and gain movement speed against his kite.

olaf__sylas.notes:
- Threat: Sylas W Kingslayer heals him while damaging you; his chains lock you down repeatedly.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Sylas out-trades you before Berserker Rage scales with missing health.
- Trading: Bait his E Abscond dash, then Q Undertow him as he repositions away.
- Post6: Sylas R Hijack steals your Ragnarok; he becomes tankier and disables-immune like you.
- Spike: First Protobelt spike (items two to three) is dangerous; he gains burst and mobility.
- Window: Level two when W Tough It Out shields you; all-in before he scales chains.
- Wave: Shove early to deny him free poke; reset and repeat to control tempo.
- Rune: Take Conqueror; true damage from E Reckless Swing and extended fights favor you.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature into him; magic resist counters his Q Chain Lash damage.

olaf__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench's Devour locks you down for several seconds; build tankiness to survive the follow-up.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Tahm outdamages you early and Tongue Lash applies stacks toward Devour.
- Avoid trading into his Tongue Lash; dodge it with movement, then trade back with Undertow.
- Post-6, Devour becomes lethal; Ragnarok's disable immunity doesn't prevent being eaten, so position farther back.
- His first HP item spike (Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) strengthens his tankiness; abuse levels 4-5 before it.
- You spike harder at level 11 with R upgrade; farm safely and punish his roams.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Tahm has stronger all-in and roam potential than you do.
- Take Conqueror; stacking true damage from Reckless Swing and sustained fighting outvalues his burst.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern to amplify your Reckless Swing damage against his high health pool.

olaf__thresh.notes:
- Threat: Death Sentence chains and pulls you in, setting up gank or The Box trap.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Thresh outranges you. Farm from distance, avoid his Q hook.
- Trading: Bait Death Sentence by positioning unpredictably, then all-in with Reckless Swing when it misses.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through The Box and ignore his disable chain attempts.
- Spike: His Flay power spike hurts; respect his damage but you can out-duel him soon.
- Window: Mid-game when Ragnarok is active—activate it and run him down; he cannot escape.
- Wave: Shove the wave; it denies him safe lantern positioning and forces him to engage.
- Rune: Conqueror because sustained combat and true damage synergize against his armor stacking.
- Item: Mercury's Treads reduce Death Sentence chain duration and The Box slow impact meaningfully.

olaf__velkoz.notes:
- Vel'Koz's true damage from Organic Deconstruction stacks ignores your Berserker Rage durability and Life Steal.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Vel'Koz has no mobility. Farm freely, dodge Plasma Fission by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Never trade into his Tectonic Disruption knockup; bait it with fake engages, then all-in when it's down.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore his Tectonic Disruption knockup and walk through Life Form Disintegration Ray channel.
- First Liandry's Torment is dangerous; it compounds his true damage. Punish him before two items complete.
- Your power window is mid-game teamfights where you close distance fast and Ragnarok immunity negates his crowd control.
- Shove the wave constantly; Vel'Koz struggles to farm under tower and cannot safely waveclear without mana pressure.
- Take Conqueror; true damage stacking requires sustained fighting where Conqueror stacks and converts your damage to true.
- Add Hollow Radiance early if their team lacks burst; passive magic resist and active shield help versus poke.

olaf__wukong.notes:
- Cyclone's knock-up and Move Speed disable your engagement; stay mobile and respect range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Wukong's Crushing Blow outdamages early, farm at range with Q.
- Bait Warrior Trickster by positioning near walls; dodge Nimbus Strike's dash with unpredictable movement.
- Ragnarok immunity negates Cyclone's disable; activate ult before his Cyclone lands for control.
- Wukong spikes harder at first item; farm safely and scale into your late-game dueling.
- You spike when Wukong wastes Warrior Trickster; all-in immediately with Reckless Swing true damage.
- Shove wave into tower to deny his roam; Wukong needs side pressure to impact.
- Take Conqueror for sustained damage in extended fights and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing.
- Add Spirit Visage to reduce Cyclone burst and scale better into teamfights with healing.

olaf__xayah.notes:
- Xayah roots you with Bladecaller after she lands skillshots; respect her feather positioning always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Double Daggers poke is free damage—dodge sideways, avoid extended trades.
- Bait her Bladecaller by positioning near feathers, then all-in when it's on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her root—activate before she recalls feathers to force fights.
- Watch for Muramana or Kraken Slayer spike around 10-12 minutes; play defensive, scale safely.
- You spike harder mid-game with cooldown items; all-in when her E is down and warded.
- Hold wave near your tower; let her push so you can all-in with Ragnarok active.
- Conqueror stacks through true damage E and synergizes with your sustained dueling pressure here.
- Add Abyssal Mask after core to reduce her magic damage and amplify your tankiness further.

olaf__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo's Last Breath after Steel Tempest knockup chains into guaranteed damage you can't escape from.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Q knockup at 2 stacks wins early trades against you.
- Bait Steel Tempest knockups by positioning unpredictably, then all-in when his Gathering Storm stacks reset.
- Ragnarok immunity to airborne lets you ignore Last Breath knockup chains—activate before his ultimate lands.
- His first-item spike (likely Phantom Dancer or Manamune) increases burst; farm safely and scale harder.
- Post-15 minutes when you complete first item, your tankiness and true damage outscale his poke pressure.
- Shove the wave hard; Yasuo needs minion spacing for Sweeping Blade dashes to kite effectively.
- Conqueror stacks through his trades and converts your tankiness into damage for extended fights.
- Mercury's Treads reduce airborne duration slightly, making Last Breath chain less deadly before Ragnarok.

olaf__zed.notes:
- Zed's Death Mark burst and kite potential with shadows forces you into bad all-ins or lethal situations.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Zed outranges with Razor Shuriken—farm from distance, don't trade early.
- Bait Zed's Living Shadow dash forward, then all-in when his shadow is on cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Death Mark's untargetability window and dive him through his kite.
- First item spike (Serrated Dirk) is dangerous; respect his burst and avoid extended trades.
- Post-6 with Ragnarok active, you out-duel Zed in extended fights since he cannot kite forever.
- Shove the wave to deny Zed safe poke and pressure his tower; force him defensive.
- Take Conqueror for sustained dueling and true damage synergy against Zed's evasion and burst.
- Add Force of Nature to block his magic burst and spike defenses when Death Mark threatens.

olaf__zac.notes:
- Threat: Zac's Unstable Matter deals % max health magic damage; you lack magic resist scaling early.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Zac's Q grab range is long, so maintain distance from minions.
- Trading: Bait Elastic Slingshot by positioning near walls, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Let's Bounce knockups; use this to commit to fights fearlessly.
- Spike: Zac first item spike is moderate threat; your Tough It Out shield scales better with items.
- Window: You spike harder mid-game when Ragnarok passive armor stacks; abuse levels 9-11 for kills.
- Wave: Shove hard with Undertow to reset wave and force Zac to chase; prevents his gank setup.
- Rune: Conqueror gives you sustained true damage that Zac cannot mitigate with his percentage-based tankiness.
- Item: Add Abyssal Mask second to reduce Unstable Matter's magic damage and gain magic resist scaling.

olaf__zilean.notes:
- Zilean's Time Warp slows you hard; Chronoshift saves his allies from your all-ins.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid Time Bomb clusters and farm at range when possible.
- Dodge Time Bombs by moving unpredictably; don't chase into double bombs or stun setup.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore Time Warp slow and engage through Chronoshift windows.
- First item spike (Verdant Barrier or Kaenic) is dangerous; respect his poke and stall.
- You win post-15 minutes when Ragnarok cooldown shortens; look to force fights then.
- Hold wave near your tower; avoid extended trades that let Zilean land multiple bombs.
- Conqueror gives sustain against poke and true damage synergy with Reckless Swing trades.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern to reduce Time Warp effectiveness and gain magic resist cushion.

shen__bard.notes:
- Cosmic Binding stun into wall or double-hit stun locks you down for ganks.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Bard has no all-in but Cosmic Binding range is deceptive.
- Dodge Cosmic Binding by moving unpredictably; don't walk into walls when it's up.
- Stand United cannot save you from Tempered Fate stasis; play around ult timing.
- Bard first item spike is minor; punish his squishy early game before he scales.
- All-in after Bard wastes Cosmic Binding or when Spirit's Refuge is down; he lacks defensive tools.
- Hold wave near your tower; Magical Journey lets Bard set up ganks from anywhere.
- Use Grasp + Domination for early pressure; sustain through poke and burst healing.
- Add Mercury's Treads early to reduce Cosmic Binding stun impact and Tempered Fate lockdown.

shen__anivia.notes:
- Threat: Crystallize wall locks you down; Glacial Storm + Frostbite combo deals massive damage while you're trapped.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Anivia is vulnerable pre-6. Use Q to poke and position for all-ins.
- Trading: Bait Q Flash Frost by moving unpredictably, then all-in with E Shadow Dash + Q before her cooldowns reset.
- Post6: Glacial Storm creates a zone you cannot ignore; R Stand United becomes your only reliable escape tool now.
- Spike: First Liandry's or Archangel's around 10-12 minutes; this is when Anivia gets dangerous—play safer and hug tower.
- Window: Levels 2-5 are your best windows to kill; after 6 or first item spike, play for macro advantages.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Crystallize can trap you in bad positions, so proximity to tower keeps you safe.
- Rune: Aftershock; it gives you tankiness and CC reduction to survive Crystallize lock + Glacial Storm extended trades.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern; reduces magic damage and grievous wounds application, weakening her extended burst and poke pressure significantly.

shen__camille.notes:
- Her Q2 true damage and R cage lock you down—dodge her E before she cages you or lose all agency.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her short trades win. Farm ranged, avoid melee range, respect her all-in threat at level 2.
- Short trades only using Q poke; never commit to extended fights. Bait her E out, then E her before she recasts it.
- R becomes her teamfight tool while yours protects allies—you lose sidelane 1v1 pressure but gain team utility advantage post-6.
- First item (likely Sheen/Trinity into Q scaling) spikes her damage hard around 10-12 minutes; respect her and play passive then.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you if you prevent her cage; your E taunt and W block shut down her offense heavily.
- Hold the wave near your tower—she roams better and threatens all-ins. Deny her chase range and protect jungler ganks.
- Aftershock tanks her burst and cage damage better; Grasp sustain gets negated by her poke, and Precision wastes slots.
- Thornmail early (after first MR item) because her repeated AAs and Q procs shred you; reflect punishes her offense patterns.

shen__ekko.notes:
- Threat: Ekko's Phase Dive burst and Chronobreak reset let him all-in after poking you down safely.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Ekko out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, avoid extended trades.
- Trading: Dodge Timewinder's return path. Bait Phase Dive by positioning near your tower, then Shadow Dash + taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot save you from Chronobreak rewind damage. Play around his ult cooldown—trade when it's down.
- Spike: First item (Protobelt or similar) spikes Ekko's all-in around 9-11 minutes. Respect range, stay near minions for cover.
- Window: Your advantage comes mid-game when Stand United + Spirit's Refuge enable teamfights. Protect carries while Ekko struggles grouping.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Ekko has superior roam threat; letting it push risks ganks and his snowball.
- Rune: Aftershock; it mitigates Ekko's burst when Phase Dive triggers and reduces his all-in threat significantly.
- Item: Add Kaenic Rookern after core MR items; it cuts Ekko's magic damage and his poke pressure noticeably.

shen__hwei.notes:
- threat: Hwei's Subject abilities chain into Signature procs; dodge Q/W/E to prevent guaranteed follow-up damage
- early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Hwei has no instant CC yet, so stay at range and leverage Q poke
- trading: Bait Hwei's Subject casts before committing; E through his combo setup, then all-in while cooldowns reset
- post6: Stand United negates Spiraling Despair's burst if you time shield before center explosion; play around ult cooldown
- spike: Hwei's first item (usually Liandry's or Shadowflame) spikes his sustained damage; abuse him before he completes it
- window: Post-6 when Hwei wastes E Subject cooldown is your free all-in window; abuse the 12+ second gap relentlessly
- wave: Shove early to deny Hwei safety and force him toward your jungler; prevent him scaling freely mid-lane
- rune: Aftershock converts Hwei's poke into armor/MR; your E taunts proc it instantly, turning fights in your favor
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts Hwei's magic damage into healing for nearby allies and reduces his burst window significantly

shen__ivern.notes:
- Rootcaller locks you down hard; Ivern kite-chains you with Triggerseed shield while allies dash in and burst.
- Play safe levels 1–3; farm at range with Q, never walk into brush where Brushmaker bonus damage procs.
- Bait Rootcaller by moving unpredictably, then dash through with E before he roots you; dodge Q skillshot always.
- Stand United lets you bail teammates caught by Root or Daisy; use R proactively to negate Ivern's setup.
- Ivern first item spike (Liandry's or Demonic) hurts around minute 9–11; you're still vulnerable without MR stacking yet.
- After you stack two MR items (Abyssal Mask + Spirit Visage), Ivern's damage floor drops; all-in when he E is down.
- Hold wave near your tower; Ivern has zero kill pressure if you're safe, and his gank setup weakens without roam.
- Run Aftershock to tank Rootcaller and Daisy burst together; the armor and resistances matter more than Grasp sustain here.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern early to strip Ivern's Brushmaker bonus magic damage and apply grievous wounds if he builds healing.

shen__khazix.notes:
- Isolated Kha'Zix chunks you with evolved Q; avoid fighting alone without nearby minions or allies.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; farm defensively and stay near your wave to deny Isolation triggering.
- Never face-check bush or river alone; bait his Leap with E Shadow Dash to taunt and trade.
- Post-6, Kha'Zix gains kill pressure via Void Assault Invisibility; play safer and group with teammates sooner.
- First item spike (usually Serrated Dirk) is danger; reduce solo roaming and prioritize mid-lane TP presence.
- Spike at your Sunfire Aegis or Thornmail completion; duel him then with W blocking and sustained damage.
- Hold wave at tower; prevent him from isolating you and deny roam timings to collapse mid.
- Aftershock provides burst mitigation against his combo and shields from his isolated Q damage output.
- Add Kaenic Rookern to reduce his physical damage scaling and pen, strengthening survivability against evolved Q.

shen__leesin.notes:
- threat: Lee Sin's Sonic Wave into Resonating Strike gap-closes and combos into Dragon's Rage for a guaranteed knock-up and repositioning kill.
- early: Play safe levels 1–3. Lee Sin out-trades with Flurry attack speed; avoid extended fights near river where he can land Sonic Wave.
- trading: Dodge Sonic Wave by positioning unpredictably; if he misses, he loses combo access for 3 seconds—punish with Spirit's Refuge blocks and Q harass.
- post6: Dragon's Rage becomes lethal execution tool; Stand United must shield preemptively or block his kick mid-animation; play around your ult's cooldown only.
