- spike: Lee Sin's Sheen or Trinity Force first item is dangerous; he gains burst and kite pressure—minimize overextending and respect his all-in window.
- window: After Lee Sin wastes Sonic Wave and walks up, Shadow Dash taunt into Q auto-attack trades heavily in your favor before cooldowns reset.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Lee Sin excels at roaming and invading with mobility—deny him mid-priority and protect jungle pathing from ganks.
- rune: Aftershock. Tenacity and armor/magic resist proc on Shadow Dash taunt tank his follow-up burst and reduce Dragon's Rage knockup impact.
- item: Kaenic Rookern converts Lee Sin's physical damage from Dragon's Rage and Resonating Strike into healing for you during extended teamfights or all-ins.

shen__locke.notes:
- threat: Silver Stake procs on-hit magic damage scales with your missing health; gets exponentially worse as you fall low
- early: Play safe levels 1–3; Locke's attack speed steroid and mobility outrade you; farm ranged when possible, avoid all-ins
- trading: Never fight Locke head-on when he has W active; bait Soul Ignition cooldown before committing to E Shadow Dash trades
- post6: Stand United becomes your escape and teamfight tool; use it defensively when Locke positions aggressively or to enable plays elsewhere
- spike: First item (likely attack speed or damage item) is a danger window; Locke's on-hit scaling spikes hard; respect and scale
- window: You spike when you complete Spirit Visage or Kaenic Rookern; his magic damage threat drops and your survivability jumps significantly
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; Locke has chase potential with Ashen Pursuit; prevent him from forcing extended fights in river
- rune: Aftershock; reduces burst from Ritual Nails + Purgatory and provides armor/magic resist during his all-in windows
- item: Kaenic Rookern; converts his magic damage on-hit into healing reduction, directly countering Silver Stake scaling and reducing his threat

shen__milio.notes:
- Threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire healing and attack range boost enable his ADC to out-trade you indefinitely in lane.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Milio has no kill pressure. Use Q to farm safely from distance when possible.
- Trading: Avoid trading into Cozy Campfire zone. Bait Warm Hugs shield away before committing E Shadow Dash engage.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your primary tool; use it to negate Milio's backline pressure and shift fights favorably.
- Spike: Milio first item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) spikes around 10 minutes—respect his support's item timings.
- Window: Level 6+ provides your advantage; roam aggressively to other lanes while Milio lacks mobility to follow immediately.
- Wave: Shove hard when Milio rotates away; deny him time to reposition Cozy Campfire and control his ADC positioning.
- Rune: Standard Grasp + Precision; sustain and tankiness counter Campfire poke while Precision gives needed damage output for trades.
- Item: Add Kaenic Rookern to cleanse Milio's Fired Up! burn procs and reduce his team's magic damage amplification.

shen__masteryi.notes:
- threat: Master Yi's Highlander immunity to slows makes him gapclose and duel you despite Shadow Dash taunt.
- early: Safe farm. Master Yi has weak early all-in. Q poke from range, avoid extended trades near minions.
- trading: Bait Alpha Strike with Shadow Dash positioning, then E-taunt as he lands; follow with Q collisions.
- post6: Stand United becomes crucial—shield allies Master Yi dives or use it to escape his Highlander duels.
- spike: First Dagger spike is moderate threat. Delay his power by denying extended trades and farming safely.
- window: After Master Yi ults end and before it resets. All-in when Highlander is down and he's slowed.
- wave: Shove it in. Master Yi needs extended duels; denying him time near your tower starves his duel windows.
- rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Grasp sustain lets you trade safely without committing, and Precision gives dueling stats.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Its magic damage reduction and slow-apply passive cut his effective DPS in Highlander duels.

shen__pyke.notes:
- Phantom Undertow stun into Death From Below execution combo kills you; Pyke hunts isolated targets relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Pyke's early all-in with Bone Skewer pull plus auto-damage threatens your health pool.
- Bait Phantom Undertow by positioning near minions; dodge the dash itself or use Shadow Dash to taunt him mid-combo.
- Stand United ult becomes defensive necessity post-6; Pyke gains all-in kill pressure and roam threat across map.
- First Lethality item (around 1100 gold) spikes Pyke's execute threshold; respect his all-in window and play under tower.
- After your first tank item complete, you outduel Pyke if he commits; abuse this 10-15 minute power window.
- Shove wave into tower early; Pyke thrives on side-lane isolation, so deny his hunting ground and reduce gank setup.
- Take Aftershock for guaranteed damage reduction during Bone Skewer trades and Phantom Undertow engage chains.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern early third item; reduces his lethality scaling and gives you magic resist against potential AP allies.

shen__qiyana.notes:
- threat: Audacity dash into Royal Privilege bonus damage chunk; avoid being isolated when her weapon is enchanted.
- early: Relatively safe—Qiyana lacks early waveclear. Farm at range with Q; back off if she dashes close.
- trading: Bait Audacity by positioning near minions, then E taunt her as she commits; dodge nothing, she has no skillshots.
- post6: Supreme Display stuns in a line—stay spread from allies and minions she could detonate. Stand United becomes reactive shield tool.
- spike: First item (likely Riftmaker or penetration)—respect her burst window. Your Jak'Sho or Kaenic Rookern spike harder; play patient.
- window: Mid-game teamfights where E taunts lock her down; she cannot kite or escape once caught. Abuse cooldown windows.
- wave: Hold wave near tower—forces her to overextend for trades or all-ins; limits her roam pressure and Audacity engagement range.
- rune: Aftershock—procs on E taunt, mitigates her Elemental Wrath damage and Royal Privilege burst immediately after dash-in.
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her ability damage and gives grievous wounds if you anticipate heavy Qiyana team threat.

shen__quinn.notes:
- threat: Vault's dash interrupts you mid-ability; Harrier bonus damage and kiting make extended trades lethal.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to block Blinding Assault. Do not fight her level 2 all-in.
- trading: Avoid extended fights where she stacks Harrier procs. Bait Vault with Spirit Dash timing, then punish.
- post6: Behind Enemy Lines lets her kite infinitely and reset Harrier. You cannot chase her down anymore.
- spike: First item (likely Manamune) sharpens her burst and attack speed. Play safe; do not extend trades.
- window: After her Vault goes on cooldown (18s early), dash in hard before she resets Harrier.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Letting it push out lets her Vault trade freely and roam.
- rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision). Grasp sustains poke; Precision's Tenacity and Last Stand help you survive Vault kite.
- item: Kaenic Rookern. Reduces her burst physical damage and gives you an active to cleanse Blinding Assault slow.

shen__reksai.notes:
- Void Rush marks and one-shots you from fog; her max-Fury Bite true damage chunk forces defensive play.
- Play safe near tower; Rek'Sai's early Burrow mobility and knockup combo threaten all-ins—don't get isolated.
- Bait Unburrow by backing away, then trade hard when she surfaces; dodge Prey Seeker with positioning.
- Stand United cannot save you from Void Rush's burst since she marks you—play around cooldown timers.
- Her first Sheen/Manamune spike (mid-game) drastically increases Fury Bite damage; you need early defensive items then.
- Post-15 minutes when Shen has two items, out-duel her in extended trades using W blocking and shields.
- Hold the wave slightly closer to your tower; Rek'Sai hunts isolated targets, so deny roam opportunities.
- Take Aftershock to reduce Unburrow and all-in burst damage; it also helps all-in back when you need.
- Build Kaenic Rookern early if Rek'Sai goes AP items, otherwise Jak'Sho for sustained tankiness against repeated Fury Bites.

shen__renataglasc.notes:
- threat: Hostile Takeover forces you to fight or die; Berserk enemies deal massive damage to your team.
- early: Safe farm; Renata lacks engage. Play for cs and scale. Stay near minions to block Handshake.
- trading: Dodge Handshake to prevent root and recast throw. Trade after she misses Q; use Shadow Dash when she commits.
- post6: Stand United cannot save teammates from Berserk. Play around cooldown; force fights when it's down or coordinate defensively.
- spike: First item makes her tankier and Loyalty Program shields stronger. Delay fighting; scale into your items faster.
- window: Mid-game when Abyssal Mask and Spirit Visage stack; you out-trade her and win extended fights decisively.
- wave: Hold wave near tower; Renata roams to enable allies. Denies her roam window and keeps you safe from ganks.
- rune: Aftershock; absorbs Loyalty Program damage and protects against Hostile Takeover burst.
- item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her E shields and W buff effectiveness while giving you needed tankiness.

shen__rumble.notes:
- Threat: The Equalizer wall zones you hard; Danger Zone Electro Harpoon slows and shreds your magic resist severely.
- Early: Farm safely at range with Q; avoid walking into Flamespitter cone. Stay near minions to block Electro Harpoon.
- Trading: Bait his W cooldown before all-ining; dodge Electro Harpoon by positioning behind minions, then E-taunt and Q him.
- Post6: Stand United lets you bail allies from The Equalizer's wall; use ult to negate his zone control strategically.
- Spike: His first item (likely Zhonyas or Protobelt) is not a danger spike; stay aggressive and punish his positioning.
- Window: Before Danger Zone (under 50% Heat) and right after he wastes E harpoons; press your advantage immediately then.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; let him push in, then E-taunt through minions and punish his overextension hard.
- Rune: Aftershock because his combo (Q+E+R) is mixed damage and you need the burst mitigation and armor bonus.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage and counters his magic resist shred from Electro Harpoon significantly.

shen__shaco.notes:
- threat: Shaco's Q Deceive + Backstab combo one-shots you from fog of war; you cannot see or react to it coming.
- early: Extremely dangerous. Stay near minions, never extend alone. Ward river immediately. Play for safe farming; avoid isolated positions.
- trading: Never chase Shaco away from minions. Bait his Q Deceive by staying grouped; when he Teleports in, E Shadow Dash to taunt and trade back.
- post6: Stand United cannot save you from Shaco's burst since he appears behind you. Play around your team; avoid splitpush entirely.
- spike: Shaco's first Lethality item is a lethal danger window. You gain no defensive stats yet; stay grouped and under tower.
- window: After your first magic resist item completes, Shaco cannot one-shot you. Abuse this by trading aggressively and grouping for fights.
- wave: Shove the wave hard to deny Shaco roam opportunities and create vision pressure. Shove denies him flanking angles from fog of war.
- rune: Aftershock provides immediate burst mitigation when Shaco lands Q near you and lets you E taunt into survivability.
- item: Buy Kaenic Rookern early; it blocks Shaco's Two-Shiv Poison slow and gives magic resist against his burst threat.

shen__syndra.notes:
- Threat: Scatter the Weak stun chains into Unleashed Power burst; avoid clumping with Dark Spheres near you.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3; Dark Sphere has long cooldown, so Q when she overextends for CS.
- Trading: Bait Scatter the Weak by positioning near her Dark Spheres, then Shadow Dash through her for taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot block Unleashed Power damage; use it reactively only after she commits her spheres.
- Spike: First Liandry's spike around 10–12 minutes hurts; respect her zone but farm safely with Spirit Blade range.
- Window: Post-6 when her cooldowns are down; Shadow Dash in, taunt, and all-in before Scatter resets.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; let her push, then Shadow Dash through minions to taunt and punish.
- Rune: Aftershock; her combo lacks a single hard CC, so aftershock procs on taunt and reduces burst.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern after first tank item; converts her magic damage into healing reduction and armor.

shen__taliyah.notes:
- Threat: Unraveled Earth stuns you if you dash through it; Seismic Shove knocks you away from objectives.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Taliyah's Q damage is low. Stay near minions, dodge Threaded Volley, avoid unnecessary dashes.
- Trading: Bait her W cooldown, then trade with Q+auto. Never dash into Unraveled Earth; walk around it instead.
- Post6: Stand United becomes your escape from Weaver's Wall engages. Use it preemptively if she ults toward your team.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) is a danger window. Respect her damage spike; play safer, focus wave control.
- Window: Mid-game when your tankiness peaks and her cooldowns are up. Force trades when her E is down.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Taliyah outranges you early. Freeze to deny her roam pressure and E usage angles.
- Rune: Aftershock; it shields you against her W burst and reduces her follow-up combo damage significantly.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her magic damage and provides the grievous wounds to limit her sustain through poke.

shen__taric.notes:
- Threat: Taric's Cosmic Radiance invulnerability negates your ult shield and turn potential in teamfights.
- Early: Play safe levels 1–3; Taric's Bravado empowered attacks hurt. Farm at range with Q.
- Trading: Avoid walking into Dazzle stun range. Bait his W Bastion cast, then trade back hard.
- Post6: Your Stand United becomes less impactful when he has Cosmic Radiance; coordinate with team.
- Spike: Taric's first item (usually armor) is not a major threat window; farm safely and scale.
- Window: Mid-game before his ult cooldown resets; split-push and force favorable 1v1s away from his team.
- Wave: Shove and roam; Taric needs allies nearby to maximize Bastion synergy, so push lane pressure.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision) lets you sustain and duel his empowered attacks consistently.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces his magic damage and his team's healing from any source.

shen__vayne.notes:
- Threat: Silver Bolts true damage on third hit shreds your max health regardless of resistances built.
- Early: Dangerous levels 1–3; stay behind minions and avoid repeated trades; Vayne out-damages early.
- Trading: Never trade repeatedly in short windows; bait Condemn into terrain to create openings safely.
- Post6: Stand United lets you shield an ally and escape Vayne's kite; use it proactively.
- Spike: First item is dangerous; Vayne gains sustained damage threat; farm safely and scale resistances.
- Window: Mid-game when you stack resistances and cooldown; Vayne struggles if she cannot kite endlessly.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; Vayne excels in extended trades on open terrain, punish overextension.
- Rune: Aftershock; grants burst tankiness and resistances when you engage with Shadow Dash and E.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern converts her true damage proc into reduced damage, negating Silver Bolts threat.

shen__udyr.notes:
- threat: Udyr's sustained attack speed and healing from Iron Mantle W make him duel you indefinitely; kite or die.
- early: Dangerous. Stay behind minions to avoid Blazing Stampede E stun; Q Twilight Assault costs too much mana early.
- trading: Never trade auto-attacks; Udyr gains attack speed after abilities. Bait his E stun into empty space, then disengage immediately.
- post6: Stand United R lets you escape ganks but doesn't prevent Udyr from running you down with movement speed.
- spike: First item (likely Kaenic Rookern or Hollow Radiance) favors Udyr. His sustained damage outpaces your shield regen; avoid fights.
- window: Mid-game, after you complete two tank items. His damage falls off relative to your resistances; force teamfights then.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Udyr wins extended sidelane duels; group for objectives where your ult shields teammates.
- rune: Aftershock. E Shadow Dash triggers it reliably, and the armor burst counters his heavy attack speed physical damage.
- item: Thornmail. Reflects his sustained auto-attacks back and reduces his healing from Iron Mantle W significantly.

shen__zilean.notes:
- threat: Chronoshift negates your burst and Stand United follow-up; Time Bomb stun chain locks you down hard
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid bunching near minions where Time Bombs stick and chain-detonate into stuns
- trading: Never chase Zilean; bait Time Warp slow before committing Shadow Dash; dodge his Q spacing by staying spread
- post6: Chronoshift makes him unkillable in all-ins; prioritize using Stand United to save allies he bombs instead
- spike: His first item (usually CDR utility) accelerates his bomb spam and cooldown resets; farm safely behind minions
- window: You dominate at level 2-3 before his Q harass stacks; all-in only when his Q is on cooldown
- wave: Freeze near your tower; his Q punishes shoved waves and you need minion cover for safety
- rune: Aftershock; reduces Time Bomb burst damage and shields you from his CC-heavy trading patterns consistently
- item: Add Abyssal Mask early; its magic resist and mana sustain counter repeated bomb spam and poke

sivir__caitlyn.notes:
- Threat: Caitlyn's 100-range advantage lets her trap and Q-poke you without risk of retaliation from your Q.
- Early: Dangerous—stay back and farm under tower; her Headshot and traps punish any forward positioning hard.
- Trading: Dodge her E with Spell Shield to block the net and gain health plus movespeed back.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you match her waveclear and teamfight impact; her Ace in the Hole is long-range threat.
- Spike: First item (Infinity Edge) is her danger window; you cannot duel her yet, keep farming safely.
- Window: Mid-game when you complete two items—your On The Hunt push and teamfight vastly outscale her mediocre teamfight presence.
- Wave: Hold the wave near your tower; forcing her to approach resets the lane and limits her trap placements.
- Rune: Press the Attack gives you scaling and dueling power once items come online to eventually beat her.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar lets you cleanse her trap immobilize and escape her close-range Headshot empowered follow-up.

sivir__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals and sustained damage output exceed Sivir's defensive tools; avoid extended trades.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q and avoid Fiora's all-in range.
- Use E Spell Shield to block Fiora's W Riposte stun, then kite backward with Q.
- Grand Challenge forces Sivir to move constantly; use R On The Hunt to escape and team fight.
- Fiora's first item spike (around 10-12 minutes) is dangerous; stay grouped and avoid sidelane fights.
- Sivir spikes harder mid-game with R and attack speed; group for team fights where mobility wins.
- Shove the wave quickly with W Ricochet to deny Fiora freeze opportunities near your tower.
- Fleet Footwork sustains against poke and enables kiting; Precision tree synergizes with your attack-speed build.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse Fiora's W Riposte slow and maintain kiting distance safely.

sivir__chogath.notes:
- Rupture catches you immobile; it's his primary threat. Spell Shield blocks it; use E reactively.
- Play safe levels 1-3. Stay mobile, don't let him walk into Rupture range easily.
- Bait Rupture with movement, then trade with Q and W. Never face-check bushes or stand still.
- Post-6 On The Hunt gives you speed to kite. Feast range is huge—respect it and maintain distance.
- His first item spike (typically HP/AP) isn't a major danger window. You still kite him effectively.
- Your window is mid-game teamfights where On The Hunt lets you reposition and W bounces onto grouped enemies.
- Push the wave when safe. Sivir clears fast with Q and W; deny him minion kills for Carnivore stacks.
- Run standard ADC runes; Precision or Lethal Tempo suit your need to attack and kite constantly.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar or Maw early if he stacks magic damage. Use active to cleanse Feral Scream silence threat.

sivir__garen.notes:
- Garen's Q silences you, stopping your kiting and ability rotations; his E Judgment shreds you at close range.
- Play safe near tower; Garen dominates short trades. Use Q Boomerang Blade from distance; never let him close gap.
- Bait his Q Decisive Strike by backing away, then trade with Q while he's on cooldown and silenced.
- His R Demacian Justice executes regardless of shields; play around map vision and never fight low-health near him.
- His first item spike (usually Plated Steelcaps or Magic Resist) reduces your damage; this is a farming window for you.
- When you finish Infinity Edge and have R On The Hunt active, you outduel and kite him reliably.
- Hold wave near your tower; Garen's all-in threat means you need safety. Let him push into your defensive position.
- Take Fleet Footwork for sustained healing and movespeed to kite his engage and survive his all-in trades.
- Add Maw of Malmortius early if Garen gets ahead; the magic resist and spellshield synergizes with your E.

sivir__gragas.notes:
- Threat: Body Slam stun into Explosive Cask knockback combo locks you down and enables all-in kill.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; stay max range with Q poke, avoid letting him close distance.
- Trading: Bait his E with positioning, then kite backward while trading with Q and W bounces.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite his engages better, but Explosive Cask knockback still threatens.
- Spike: His first item spike (typically Liandry's or Protobelt) is dangerous; respect all-in threat window.
- Window: Once you complete Navori Flickerblade, your cooldown reduction lets you Q spam and kite him.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; his E engage is weaker when you're near turret safety.
- Rune: Hail of Blades for early aggression and attack speed to trade and reset faster.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early if Gragas lands Body Slam stuns frequently; cleanse the stun effect.

sivir__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's E Flawless Duet stun locks you instantly; dodge it or Spell Shield it every time.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q Boomerang Blade from distance, never trade short with her.
- Bait her E Flawless Duet before committing to trades; use Spell Shield reactively to block her combo.
- Her R Vanguard's Edge marks and damages your entire team; respect the teamfight pressure post-6 heavily.
- First item spike around level 9 is dangerous; play back and use range advantage to kite.
- You spike when Irelia has no Marks on you; chase her down with W Ricochet bounces.
- Shove the wave hard; denies her dashing reset opportunities on minions and forces her to overextend.
- Fleet Footwork for sustained safety and lane poke; kiting is your survival tool against her dash.
- Buy Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse the Mark debuff and reduce her damage amplification window.

sivir__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan's Q Dragon Strike knockup locks you down; dodge it or E Spell Shield to block and gain MS.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his Martial Cadence bonus damage hurts. Farm at range with Q; avoid short trades.
- Bait his Q with positioning, then E Spell Shield the knockup. Trade back with W Ricochet bounces when he commits.
- On The Hunt ult at level 6 lets Jarvan dive with his team. Play further back; use E defensively.
- His first item spike (usually Stride Breaker or Black Cleaver) threatens all-ins. Farm safely until you complete Infinity Edge.
- Your power window comes post-three items with attack speed and lifesteal; kite backward while On The Hunt speeds you.
- Shove the wave hard to deny him roam opportunities and force him to farm under tower where you control range.
- Precision primary (attack speed and crit synergies) or Lethal Tempo for extended kiting and dueling him safely throughout laning.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early if Jarvan lands frequent Q knockups; cleanse the CC and escape with the active MS.

sivir__kayle.notes:
- threat: Kayle's Divine Judgment makes her untargetable and unkillable; use Spell Shield to block Radiant Blast resist shred.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Kayle outranges you early, so respect her poke and farm with Q from distance.
- trading: Avoid trading into her passive empowerment; bait Radiant Blast with Spell Shield, then all-in with Ricochet and On The Hunt.
- post6: Divine Judgment blocks burst and enables her teamfight; you must kite and respect invulnerability timing on engages.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; Kayle gains range and attack speed, outranging your Q; stay safe and farm.
- window: Post-three items you outscale; your sustained damage and On The Hunt mobility overwhelm her without full build advantage.
- wave: Shove waves hard; Kayle struggles to clear under tower early, and you roam faster with Fleet of Foot.
- rune: Fleet Footwork page for sustained safety, poke recovery, and synergy with your attack-based mobility and Bloodthirster healing.
- item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse Radiant Blast's resistances reduction before extended teamfight trades occur.

sivir__ksante.notes:
- Threat: K'Sante's R All Out launches you through walls after knocking you back, trapping you with transformed high-damage abilities.
- Early: Relatively safe—K'Sante has no gap close yet. Farm with Q Boomerang Blade; stay beyond Ntofo Strikes range.
- Trading: Bait Q Ntofo Strikes with positioning, then trade back with your Q. Never let him stack twice for shockwave pull.
- Post6: Extremely dangerous—R All Out chains into W Path Maker's dash, trapping you. Respect wall positioning; play safer near terrain.
- Spike: First item spike (typically Kaenic Rookern or Black Cleaver) moderately threatens you. Pressure with ult speed boost while he builds.
- Window: Early game before level 6 and when K'Sante's R is on cooldown. Use R On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- Wave: Shove the wave hard with W Ricochet bounces—prevents K'Sante from setting up wall traps and forces him to chase extended.
- Rune: Precision with Fleet of Foot synergy; your P already procs it, amplifying kite potential against all-in threats.
- Item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse potential CC from W Path Maker or Q Ntofo Strikes shockwave pull.

sivir__malphite.notes:
- Threat: Unstoppable Force engages you; you cannot dodge it, so Spell Shield or kite after knockup.
- Early: Safe farm. Malphite has no early kill threat; farm Q bounces and respect his all-in range.
- Trading: Avoid trading into his melee range; he wins short fights. Kite backward and use Q from distance.
- Post6: Unstoppable Force is a game changer. Play further back, position near escape routes, save Spell Shield for it.
- Spike: His first armor item (Plated Steelcaps or Kaenic Rookern) strengthens Ground Slam damage and defense; respect the spike.
- Window: After his ult is down, you have 60+ seconds to pressure and kite. Force fights on your terms then.
- Wave: Shove wave hard. Malphite needs close range; pushing forces him to choose between following or losing farm.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo; you need attack speed and range advantage to kite his melee engages and win extended trades.
- Item: Navori Flickerblade; reduced cooldowns on Q let you kite and reposition more while pressuring from distance safely.

sivir__nami.notes:
- Threat: Aqua Prison stun chains into Ebb and Flow damage; block Q with Spell Shield to negate setup.
- Early: Safe to farm—Nami lacks early damage. Use W to push wave and maintain spacing from bubble range.
- Trading: Bait her Q with positioning, block it with E, then trade back with Boomerang Blade immediately.
- Post6: Tidal Wave knocks up from range, but she has no mobility to chase. Play around cooldown windows.
- Spike: First item isn't a danger spike for Nami. Sivir's W push and poke outpace her early scaling.
- Window: Sivir dominates when W is active—push wave, extend trades, and force Nami to use resources defensively.
- Wave: Shove the wave with W to deny Nami safe positioning near minions and force her back.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo—stacks quickly with W bounces and synergizes with On The Hunt for extended trades.
- Item: Mercurial Scimitar—cleanses Tidecaller's Blessing slow and provides magic resist against her ability spam.

sivir__nasus.notes:
- Wither slows your attack speed and move speed, letting Nasus kite and duel you effectively.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades. Last-hit with Q Boomerang Blade from distance.
- Bait Wither with E Spell Shield, then all-in. Never trade autos into his W upfront.
- Post-6, Nasus gains tankiness and AoE damage. Use R On The Hunt to kite and escape.
- His first item spike (Trinity Force or similar) makes him dangerous; avoid fights, farm safely.
- Sivir dominates levels 1-2 and after completing two items with attack speed and lifesteal advantage.
- Shove the wave quickly; deny Nasus safe stacking and force him to choose between farming and roaming.
- Press Attack or Lethal Tempo; you need attack speed to out-duel and kite his slows.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early to cleanse Wither and maintain your mobility and dueling potential.

sivir__olaf.notes:
- Threat: Olaf's Q Undertow slows and reduces your armor; kite away from him constantly.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3. Stay outside Q range; let wave come to you.
- Trading: Bait his Q by moving unpredictably, then trade with W Ricochet bounces.
- Post6: On The Hunt lets you kite faster; use R to escape Ragnarok engages.
- Spike: His first item is dangerous. Maintain distance; don't let him close the gap.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where your R speed advantage lets you kite and deal sustained damage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Olaf needs to run you down; deny that angle.
- Rune: Lethal Tempo. Extends your autoattack range and attack speed to kite him harder.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius. Blocks burst and provides survivability if he catches you out.

sivir__pantheon.notes:
- Threat: Shield Vault stun locks you; dodge it or die to follow-up burst damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Pantheon's all-in potential outduels you; farm with Q only.
- Trading: Bait Shield Vault with positioning, then trade back; never face-check brush where he hides.
- Post6: Grand Starfall threatens your whole team; respect map pressure and position near escape routes.
- Spike: First item spike (likely Manamune or Eclipse) increases his burst; play extra safe then.
- Window: After he wastes Shield Vault, you have 10+ seconds to trade or shove wave.
- Wave: Shove it hard; prevents Pantheon from all-ining you under tower and denies his gank setup.
- Rune: Precision with Fleet of Foot and Overheal; sustain laning phase and kite his dives.
- Item: Buy Mercurial Scimitar early; cleanses stun and keeps you mobile for kiting and escaping.

sivir__renataglasc.notes:
- threat: Her W delays your kills and restarts fights; her R charm is wide but shieldable with E
- early: Safe farm; she has mediocre damage. Farm freely and outpush her with Q and W bounces
- trading: Bait her Q root with E Spell Shield to gain health and movespeed; she cannot trade back
- post6: Her R Hostile Takeover forces berserks on hit targets but you block it with E—use this to engage
- spike: First item is not a danger window; her damage remains mediocre and you outscale hard with items
- window: Mid-game when you complete Infinity Edge; your sustained damage and team utility gap widens significantly
- wave: Shove constantly; your Q and W outpush her waveclear and deny her engage angles near your tower
- rune: Lethal Tempo—attack speed lets W Ricochet cover more bounces and synergizes with R On The Hunt
- item: Mercurial Scimitar removes slows from E Loyalty Program and provides lifesteal; slot it after Bloodthirster if needed

sivir__shaco.notes:
- Threat: Shaco's Deceive invisibility and Backstab burst from fog of war delete you before counterplay exists.
- Early: Play safe. Stay near tower, cs conservatively. Ward river. Don't face-check bushes ever.
- Trading: Never trade into Shaco when he has Deceive up. Bait it with positioning, then punish.
- Post6: Hallucinate forces you to waste cooldowns and Spell Shield. On The Hunt doesn't save you from burst.
- Spike: First item (likely Serrated Dirk path) is lethal. Play further back. Expect all-in attempts immediately.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you have Infinity Edge and On The Hunt active give you range safety and damage.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Shaco uses fog of war; pushing draws ganks. Safety trumps tempo here.
- Rune: Fleet of Foot keystones (sustain + speed) let you kite Shaco's approach angles and duel pressure better.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks his burst and Backstab scaling; buy it early if he snowballs.

sivir__viego.notes:
- Viego's W stun and R execute delete you before you can react or kite away.
- Play safe early; his W dash-stun has deceptive range. Farm with Q from distance only.
- Bait his W with movement, then trade back with Q and W bounces immediately after.
- On The Hunt lets Viego chase you down and execute with Heartbreaker; play back line.
- First item spike (Blade of the Ruined King) makes him duel-proof; avoid 1v1s entirely.
- Post-first-item you outrange him with Q and kite with Fleet of Foot and On The Hunt.
- Shove wave hard to deny him wraith spawns; deny dead minions near your tower always.
- Lethal Tempo lets you out-DPS his healing and kite his all-in attempts with attack speed.
- Build Mercurial Scimitar to cleanse his W stun and escape Heartbreaker execution range safely.

sivir__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's E Nimbus Strike and R Cyclone combo gap-closes and knocks you up, preventing kiting and escape.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q Boomerang Blade and avoid close trades near Wukong.
- Bait W Warrior Trickster with positioning, then trade back; use E Spell Shield to block E or R.
- Post-6, R Cyclone becomes lethal all-in tool; respect the range and stay near tower or grouped allies.
- Wukong's first item spike (Trinity Force or Black Cleaver) is dangerous; play safer and group with team.
- Your window arrives when Wukong wastes W or E; punish with Q poke and R mobility for kiting.
- Shove the wave hard; prevents Wukong from roaming freely and forces him to fight in your push.
- Precision Lethal Tempo lets you kite and duel; Attack Speed counters his tanking and lets you escape.
- Add Mercurial Scimitar early; cleanses Wukong's R Cyclone knockup and lets you reposition immediately to escape.

kogmaw__rengar.notes:
- Rengar's Unseen Predator leap from brush closes gap instantly; you cannot kite or react in time.
- Levels 1-3 are safe if you respect brush proximity; farm at max W range, never face-check.
- Never trade when Rengar has Ferocity stacked; bait his E Bola Strike, then reposition away immediately.
- At level 6, Thrill of the Hunt reveals you across the map; play deeper in lane.
- Rengar's first item spike (Blade of the Ruined King or similar) is severe; respect all-in threat window.
- Kog'Maw spikes harder with two items (attack speed + on-hit); kite and abuse W range advantage then.
- Hold wave near your tower; pushing gives Rengar brush access and gank setup for roaming threats.
- Use Scaling rune page; Kog'Maw outscales Rengar's one-shot window and needs survivability in extended fights.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass into build; it blocks Rengar's burst window and converts all-in attempts into survival.

kogmaw__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's E Nimbus Strike and R Cyclone dash in and knock you up, preventing kiting.
- Levels 1-3 are safe; Wukong has no gap close yet. Farm freely and poke with Q.
- Never let Wukong walk up freely. Trade with Q Caustic Spittle; dodge E Nimbus Strike dash.
- Post-6, R Cyclone is lethal if it lands. Play further back and use R Living Artillery to kite.
- Wukong's first item spike (usually Black Cleaver or Trinity) is dangerous. Respect his all-in window.
- Your window opens mid-game when W Bio-Arcane Barrage range lets you kite his dashes safely from distance.
- Hold the wave near your tower; Wukong excels at all-ins in open space. Deny him engage angles.
- Use Scaling; you outscale and need survival tools and mana to spam R Living Artillery safely.
- Add Zhonya's Hourglass to survive E into R combo; active breaks his knockup chain and extends fight.

drmundo__jinx.notes:
- threat: Super Mega Death Rocket instakills you if you're low; Zap! + Fishbones kite you forever.
- early: Dangerous—stay behind minions, avoid Zap! poke, let wave push to you naturally.
- trading: Never chase her down lane; bait Zap! behind minions, then all-in with Q + E.
- post6: Her ultimate deletes you from range; respect it, hug walls, never face-check without vision.
- spike: First Manamune hurts; she kites harder—don't extend past river; farm safely under tower.
- window: Post-6 when her cooldowns are down; run her down with Maximum Dosage movement speed.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower; she outranges you and kills you if you overextend forward.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge—she kites you endlessly; you need the slow resistance and extra stickiness here.
- item: Plated Steelcaps early if Fishbones damage stacks too hard; Randuin's Omen if she gets AD.

drmundo__poppy.notes:
- threat: Heroic Charge stuns you into wall; Keeper's Verdict knocks you away from fights.
- early: Dangerous—Poppy Q and autos hurt hard. Play safe, farm ranged, dodge her Hammer Shock zones.
- trading: Avoid her Hammer Shock explosion zone. Bait E dash, then trade back with Q slow.
- post6: Keeper's Verdict removes you from teamfights. Play around walls carefully; ulti when she channels ult.
- spike: First item (Hollow Radiance) is minor spike. You still outscale; farm safely through it.
- window: Mid-game onwards you dominate. Once you're tanky enough, her damage tickles; run her down.
- wave: Hold wave near tower. She'll overextend chasing you; let jungler punish or scale safely.
- rune: Grasp—sustain through her Q spam and proc tank scaling for late-game bulk advantage.
- item: Jak'Sho, The Protean—reduces her physical Q damage and strengthens your tankiness against her kit.

drmundo__mel.notes:
- threat: Golden Eclipse deals massive damage stacked through Overwhelm; Mel applies it constantly via abilities and autos.
- early: Dangerous. Mel out-ranges and out-damages you early; farm safely at range, avoid extended trades, respect her Q poke.
- trading: Never chase Mel into her team. Dodge Solar Snare root; if she misses, all-in immediately before cooldown resets.
- post6: Maximum Dosage healing lets you survive Eclipse burst, but Mel's range advantage persists; don't expect ult to swing fights.
- spike: First item spike (likely Shadowflame or Liandry's) hurts; farm safely, don't force fights; your Heartsteel spike comes later.
- window: After Mel wastes Rebuttal or Solar Snare, close distance instantly with Boots of Swiftness and all-in before she repositions.
- wave: Hold wave near your tower. Mel punishes overextension; safety lets you outscale and wait for teamfight; avoid shoving solo.
- rune: Stormraider's Surge to stick after gap-close and stick through her kiting; her slows and root demand the movespeed counter.
- item: Abyssal Mask reduces her magic damage and amplifies your healing back against her poke and burst patterns.

drmundo__xayah.notes:
- Threat: Xayah's E Bladecaller roots you in place, allowing her team to collapse and burst you down.
- Early: Play safely; Xayah outranges your Q and farms safely with W. Farm defensively and avoid her daggers.
- Trading: Don't chase her feathers or walk into E range. Bait her W, then trade with Q when she repositions.
- Post6: Xayah gains untargetability and kiting tools via R Featherstorm. Play around cooldown; don't all-in without ultimate ready.
- Spike: First item (Infinity Edge or Kraken Slayer) is dangerous. Respect her damage spike; focus on scaling and sustain.
- Window: Post-6 and when her E is on cooldown, all-in with R Maximum Dosage and chase her down relentlessly.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. Xayah wants to kite and root; denying her spacing limits her pressure.
- Rune: Fleet Footwork; sustain and mobility help you survive her poke and stick to her when she kites.
- Item: Plated Steelcaps reduce her attack damage and provide armor; build early if she's ahead or scaling fast.

olaf__annie.notes:
- threat: Annie's Pyromania stun locks you down; Summon Tibbers' passive burn melts your Health
- early: Farm safely at range with Undertow; avoid close trades before level 3
- trading: Bait Pyromania stun on minions, then trade when her stun is down
- post6: Summon Tibbers forces you to engage or disengage; activate Ragnarok to stay immune
- spike: Annie's first item (typically Luden's Tempest) accelerates her burst; farm safely during this window
- window: After Annie uses Summon Tibbers, wait for cooldown before committing; your Ragnarok immunity counters her disable chains
- wave: Shove the wave hard with Undertow to deny Annie safe positioning near minions
- rune: Adaptive Carapace reduces her burst damage and scales with your tankiness perfectly
- item: Hollow Radiance blocks her burn damage from Tibbers and boosts your resistances

olaf__ashe.notes:
- Threat: Enchanted Crystal Arrow stun locks you; use Ragnarok's disable immunity to counter engage or escape.
- Early: Safely farm; Ashe out-ranges you early. Stay behind minions to dodge Volley and bait Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
- Trading: Trade only after Ashe uses Volley or Enchanted Crystal Arrow. Avoid walking predictably into Volley cones.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity negates her stun lock; activate before Enchanted Crystal Arrow lands to all-in or disengage freely.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune or Immortal Shieldbow) is dangerous; dodge her abilities and farm safely until your power grows.
- Window: After landing Undertow and resetting cooldown, chase and all-in; her slows cannot stop Ragnarok-activated aggression and disable immunity.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; ganking is risky due to Enchanted Crystal Arrow range and Hawkshot vision.
- Rune: Conqueror; sustained true damage from Reckless Swing and attack scaling synergizes against her tanky builds and kiting.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius; blocks her magic burst and provides lifeline, protecting you during long Ragnarok engagements against poke.

olaf__briar.notes:
- threat: Briar's Head Rush stun chains into Blood Frenzy relentless pursuit—you cannot kite or escape her lockdown
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Q dash-stun beats your short range, so farm at max distance with Q
- trading: Bait her Head Rush by positioning near minions, then Undertow her as she commits to the leap
- post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her Certain Death fear, but activate it only after she marks you
- spike: Her first item spike (likely Black Cleaver or Eclipse) is dangerous—she gains AD and chase tools you cannot match
- window: You spike harder mid-game with Hollow Radiance and Spirit Visage; press this window before she scales into teamfights
- wave: Hold the wave near your tower; she wants to all-in you in open space, so deny her roaming room
- rune: Grasp of the Undying for sustained lane pressure and bulk scaling without committing to all-in trading patterns
- item: Force of Nature blocks her healing and magic damage while giving you movement speed to kite Blood Frenzy

olaf__darius.notes:
- threat: Darius stacks Hemorrhage and executes with Noxian Guillotine; avoid max stacks at all costs.
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; Darius outdamages you early, so farm from range with Q Undertow.
- trading: Bait Apprehend by positioning near minions; trade when his Q cooldown is down.
- post6: Ragnarok makes you immune to his Crippling Strike slow; activate before his Noxian Guillotine.
- spike: First item spike is dangerous; stay healthy and kite with Q Undertow axe resets.
- window: You outscale hard mid-game; when you get tankier, all-in before his Hemorrhage stacks max.
- wave: Shove wave constantly; denies Darius close-range engagement and lets you reset health safely.
- rune: Fleet Footwork sustains you through his poke and lets you kite his close range.
- item: Build Force of Nature early if he stacks Magic Resist; otherwise add Kaenic Rookern.

olaf__diana.notes:
- Threat: Diana's Lunar Rush resets on Moonlight targets, enabling relentless all-in combos you cannot escape.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her Crescent Strike range outmatches your engage, farm defensively under tower.
- Trading: Dodge her Crescent Strike skillshot; if she misses, trade back immediately before Lunar Rush resets.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Moonfall's slow and chain her down during ult.
- Spike: First item around 10 minutes is her powerspike; avoid extended fights, kite and reset waves.
- Window: After her Lunar Rush misses or she wastes Crescent Strike, instantly all-in before cooldowns refresh.
- Wave: Shove waves into tower hard; denies her roam potential and forces her to contest tower.
- Rune: Conqueror stacks true damage from Reckless Swing and converts healing against her magic damage poke.
- Item: Build Hollow Radiance to reduce her magic damage and block her Moonsilver Blade cleave threat.

olaf__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Threat: Terrify fear chains you; Crowstorm damage and silence from Reap lock you down helpless.
- Early: Safe farm—Fiddlesticks scales into a teamfight monster; avoid unnecessary trades before level 6.
- Trading: Bait Reap's center silence, then Undertow to close distance; dodge Terrify by staying visible.
- Post6: Crowstorm creates unkitable zone damage; position away from walls where it can trap you.
- Spike: Liandry's Torment first spike—watch for jungle pressure; you outfarm him early if unmolested.
- Window: Levels 1-5 before Crowstorm unlock; all-in with Reckless Swing when Fiddlesticks channels Bountiful Harvest.
- Wave: Shove hard early to deny Fiddlesticks safe drain angles; reset when his jungler appears nearby.
- Rune: Unflinching—reduces fear duration and Reap slow, letting you escape Crowstorm zones faster.
- Item: Force of Nature—magic resist scales against repeated Crowstorm and Bountiful Harvest drain attempts.

olaf__graves.notes:
- Graves' four-bullet shotgun and kiting destroy Olaf in extended trades; respect his range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Graves out-trades you at range—farm with Q from distance.
- Dodge Smoke Screen's initial impact to avoid the Move Speed slow crippling your engage.
- Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore Smoke Screen slow and all-in; abuse this.
- First item spike (likely Black Cleaver or Eclipse) is dangerous; play around minions and terrain.
- Level 6 onwards Ragnarok makes you the threat; look to force all-ins when active.
- Hold wave near your tower to minimize Graves' range advantage and set up ganks.
- Conqueror stacks during fights and converts your true damage into true healing for sustain.
- Pick up Force of Nature to block Collateral Damage and reduce his poke damage significantly.

olaf__hecarim.notes:
- Threat: Hecarim's Devastating Charge knockback denies your engagement and Ragnarok immunity uptime.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Hecarim outtraces you—avoid extended trades near river.
- Trading: Bait Devastating Charge by positioning near walls, then Undertow + Reckless Swing.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you tank Onslaught of Shadows; activate before his charge.
- Spike: His first item spike (Stride Breaker) is dangerous—respect his kite potential.
- Window: Post-6 when Ragnarok is active and Hecarim wastes Devastating Charge on terrain.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; Hecarim roams better than you, deny his roam impact.
- Rune: Phase Rush lets you stick through his knockbacks and escape his rotations.
- Item: Spirit Visage for magic resist and healing synergy against Spirit of Dread.

olaf__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's E stun and consistent kite pressure with Q resets force you into bad fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q is point-and-click so you cannot dodge it.
- Bait her E Flawless Duet by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her E stun but not her sustained kite damage.
- Her first Sheen/Trinity spike is dangerous; respect her burst and don't overextend early.
- You spike harder mid-game when Ragnarok active duration matters most; abuse low-cooldown windows.
- Shove the wave to deny her Mark stacking and force her into tower trades.
- Take Conqueror for extended fight sustain against her repeated spell procs and healing pressure.
- Buy Force of Nature if she snowballs; magic resist reduces her R burst and spike damage.

olaf__khazix.notes:
- Isolated Taste Their Fear burst kills you; avoid being alone away from teammates and minions.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Kha'Zix out-damages you early. Farm with Q from range, respect all-ins.
- Never chase isolated into fog of war. Trade when minions are near you; bait his E cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity to his W slow and E fear is huge; activate before his burst window.
- First item spike (Manamune or Black Cleaver) is dangerous; respect his damage and play safer.
- Level 11+ when Ragnarok evolves or you complete Hollow Radiance; use it to run him down.
- Shove the wave hard; denies isolation and forces him to teamfight near allies, not duel you.
- Press the Attack for extended dueling and true damage synergy; Conqueror works if you expect longer fights.
- Hollow Radiance blocks his burst combo and shields you; buy it third or fourth item.

olaf__kogmaw.notes:
- Threat: Kog'Maw's percent health magic damage from Bio-Arcane Barrage shreds your health pool relentlessly.
- Early: Safe farm—avoid close trades before level 3; Kog'Maw out-ranges you and pokes freely.
- Trading: Bait his Q Caustic Spittle, then all-in with E Reckless Swing while he's on cooldown.
- Post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Living Artillery's slow; close distance aggressively when it's down.
- Spike: First item spike (Liandry's or Manamune) hurts; use level 6 to force fights before he scales.
- Window: Levels 6-9 before his second item; force skirmishes when Ragnarok is active and he's isolated.
- Wave: Push wave hard into tower; force him to choose between farm and safety under turret pressure.
- Rune: Conqueror sustain through percent damage; stacks faster on his immobile body in extended fights.
- Item: Hollow Radiance reduces magic damage and armor-shreds his defenses; slots after core for survivability.

olaf__lucian.notes:
- Lucian kites and pokes relentlessly with Lightslinger procs, preventing you from closing and engaging safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Lucian out-ranges you early. Farm under tower, avoid trading into his ability chains.
- Bait his E Relentless Pursuit by faking Q engagement, then all-in when he dashes away defensively.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you walk through his kite and CC, but he still out-damages you raw.
- His first item spike (Manamune or Axiom Arc) around 10-12 minutes increases his burst; play safer then.
- Post-9 minutes when you finish core, you out-duel him if he wastes E; hunt him down.
- Shove the wave hard; Lucian must use mana to clear, and you need river control to engage.
- Conqueror stacks during his sustained poke and true damage from E, converting fight length into your win.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius to survive his burst windows and gain sustain against his repeated magic damage.

olaf__maokai.notes:
- Threat: Maokai roots you with W Twisted Advance, leaving you vulnerable and unable to escape or fight back effectively.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades since Maokai's Sap Magic heals him repeatedly while you lack sustain early.
- Trading: Bait his Q Bramble Smash by positioning unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge W Twisted Advance.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore his roots and disables, turning Maokai's ult counterplay into your window to dominate.
- Spike: Maokai's first item is dangerous; his sustained healing and tankiness spike hard—avoid extended fights until you gain items.
- Window: You dominate mid-game once Ragnarok is active; activate it proactively when Maokai tries to root or disable you.
- Wave: Push the wave into his tower early to deny him brush control for E Sapling Toss and W engages.
- Rune: Take Conqueror to sustain through poke and stack true damage against his high resistances from Ragnarok passive.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature to reduce his magic damage and cooldown reduction, weakening Sap Magic healing frequency.

olaf__milio.notes:
- Threat: Milio's Cozy Campfire and Warm Hugs keep enemies alive and mobile; you cannot stick targets.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Milio has no damage threat, only sustain and poke with Q.
- Trading: Dodge Ultra Mega Fire Kick's knockback by positioning behind minions; all-in when he wastes E charges.
- Post6: Ragnarok lets you ignore Breath of Life's crowd control removal; still gap-close and commit hard.
- Spike: Milio's first support item spike (Ionian Boots, Mikael's Blessing) weakens your all-in; abuse before completion.
- Window: You win when Milio burns E charges or ult on others; hunt him immediately after.
- Wave: Shove the wave constantly; Milio must follow, and you control teamfights with Undertow axe resets.
- Rune: Take Conqueror because true damage from Reckless Swing and extended trades suit his kit perfectly.
- Item: Buy Force of Nature if Milio builds Liandry's; reflects damage amplification and blocks burn stacking.

olaf__pyke.notes:
- Pyke's Phantom Undertow stun chains with his allies' crowd control, making you vulnerable to execution.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing lane and stay near your tower to minimize gank setup.
- Bait Pyke's Bone Skewer pull, then trade back hard with Reckless Swing while he recovers.
- Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you ignore Phantom Undertow stun and dive for Pyke under tower.
- Watch for Pyke's first item spike around 8-10 minutes; use it to farm safely and scale.
- Your power window arrives at level 6 when Ragnarok active immunity counters his setup and execution.
- Shove the wave into Pyke's tower so he cannot roam freely to assist other lanes.
- Take Conqueror for sustained true damage trading that ignores Pyke's low armor and health scaling.
- Build Force of Nature if Pyke secures kills; its magic resist and move speed help kite.

olaf__samira.notes:
- Samira's melee damage and mobility with Wild Rush let her kite and burst you down repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from range and avoid all-ins near her.
- Bait Blade Whirl with Undertow, then all-in; dodge Wild Rush dashes by repositioning unpredictably.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore her disable attempts; use it to run her down relentlessly.
- First item spike is dangerous; respect her damage and kite backwards until you complete items.
- Level 6 onwards you win extended fights; force teamfights where she cannot kite your Ragnarok.
- Shove the wave hard to deny her roam and create side lane pressure for yourself.
- Conqueror stacks through true damage and tank her attempts to burst; sustain through trading.
- Maw of Malmortius blocks her burst magic damage and gives you a safety shield buffer.

olaf__seraphine.notes:
- threat: Beat Drop stuns and slows you; Encore charm chains if it hits multiple targets repeatedly
- early: Safe farm; avoid her Q poke range; wait for Undertow cooldown before committing trades
- trading: Bait Beat Drop by moving sideways; all-in when her E is down; dodge nothing, she has no skillshots to dodge
- post6: Ragnarok immunity to disables lets you ignore her E stun and R charm; this is your power spike window
- spike: First item around 10 minutes is dangerous; respect her damage but your tankiness mitigates it heavily
- window: Level 6 onwards; activate Ragnarok to run through her disable chains and close distance for Reckless Swing
- wave: Push wave into her tower; forces her to choose between defending tower or poking; limits her roam threat
- rune: Conqueror; stacking true damage from Reckless Swing synergizes better than raw tankiness into her sustained poke
- item: Spirit Visage; grants magic resist, healing amplification for Berserker Rage lifesteal, and shields from her Surround Sound

olaf__shyvana.notes:
- threat: Shyvana's Dragon Form empowers all abilities and her sustained damage output overwhelms your defenses.
- early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Shyvana outtraces you in extended fights, so avoid trades and focus CS.
- trading: Bait her W Inferno Aegis shield delay, then engage with Q Undertow into E Reckless Swing.
- post6: Dragon's Descent lets her engage and chase; activate R Ragnarok to ignore her crowd control threat.
- spike: First item spike (Hollow Radiance or Liandry's) empowers her sustained damage; play around cooldowns instead.
- window: Olaf dominates before her first back and when her R is down; punish aggressively then.
- wave: Shove the wave hard to deny her roam potential and force her to match push.
- rune: Take Conqueror to stack true damage and sustain through her poke and teamfight pressure.
- item: Buy Hollow Radiance to reduce her area damage and shield her healing amplification from allies.

olaf__sona.notes:
- threat: Crescendo stuns you, stopping your engage and leaving you vulnerable to kite attempts.
- early: Safe farm. Sona has no early kill pressure; abuse range with Undertow pokes.
- trading: Bait Crescendo cooldown before all-ins; dodge Song of Celerity speed with Undertow axe pickup.
- post6: Ragnarok immunity negates Crescendo stun duration; activate it reactively when she ults.
- spike: First item is a danger window; Sona gains scaling. Punish before she completes it.
- window: Level 6-9 is your window; Ragnarok counters her lockdown more than her damage.
- wave: Shove it; force her to choose between waveclear and poking you with Hymn.
- rune: Conqueror; you stack it faster than her damage scales and it sustains you.
- item: Mercury's Treads reduce Crescendo stun duration, letting you stay mobile and threaten engage.

olaf__tristana.notes:
- threat: Tristana's Rocket Jump and Buster Shot knock you away, preventing you from engaging or chasing effectively
- early: Play safe levels 1-3; her attack range scales up and she outranges you—focus on farming under tower
- trading: Dodge her Rocket Jump landing zone to avoid the slow, then all-in with Undertow and Reckless Swing
- post6: Ragnarok's disable immunity lets you tank Buster Shot knockback and dive her, but watch her bomb range
- spike: Her first item spike (Kraken Slayer or Trinity Force) increases her damage significantly—play safer during this window
- window: You spike hardest mid-game when Ragnarok is up; all-in her before she kites you with multiple Rocket Jumps
- wave: Shove the wave hard to deny her CS under tower and create roaming opportunities away from her range
- rune: Take Conqueror for sustained true-damage trading through her poke and to scale into the mid-game all-in
- item: Add Force of Nature to block her magic damage from Buster Shot and Explosive Charge detonations

olaf__veigar.notes:
- Threat: Event Horizon stuns you when crossing; Primordial Burst scales off your missing health.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Veigar outranges you—don't force extended trades yet.
- Trading: Bait Event Horizon by faking engages; dodge Baleful Strike and Dark Matter skillshots.
- Post6: Ragnarok immunity lets you ignore stuns during Primordial Burst windows; activate before her ult.
- Spike: Veigar's first item spike is dangerous; avoid extended fights when his cooldowns reset.
- Window: You outfight Veigar when low health and Berserker Rage active; all-in aggressively then.
- Wave: Shove waves into her tower; denies her safe positioning for Event Horizon setups.
- Rune: Conqueror sustains through her poke and true damage from Reckless Swing self-damage.
- Item: Hollow Radiance blocks her burst and gives armor scaling to counter magic damage.

olaf__ziggs.notes:
- Ziggs kites you with Bouncing Bomb and Satchel Charge while dealing poke damage you cannot return safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge Bouncing Bomb by moving unpredictably and farm at range with Q Undertow.
- Never chase Ziggs into his mines; bait Satchel Charge knockback then all-in him during its cooldown.
- Ragnarok immunity lets you tank his burst and close distance; engage only when you have ult up.
- His first item spike (Liandry's Torment or Luden's Tempest) is dangerous; respect poke and scale instead.
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items; Ziggs struggles against all-in if you gap-close with Undertow.
- Shove the wave into his tower to deny safety; force him to farm under pressure or lose CS.
- Conqueror for sustained damage and healing during extended trades; you outscale him in teamfights if ahead.
- Mercury's Treads help you resist his burst magic damage and reduce crowd control from mines' slows.

shen__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's Cannon Barrage slows and damages your team from range; kite into it or dodge.
- Farm safely at range with Q; avoid melee trades into Trial by Fire procs early.
- Bait his Remove Scurvy with Shadow Dash taunt; he wastes healing on CC cleanse, not damage.
- Stand United punishes Gangplank's immobility; teleport to allies when he ults to negate zone control.
- Gangplank first item spike (Essense Reaver or Trinity) is moderate; you scale better into mid-game.
- Post-first-item, Shen outduels Gangplank in side lanes; force 1v1s before he groups for Barrage.
- Hold wave near your tower; Gangplank's Cannon Barrage punishes extended positioning, so deny his ult value.
- Pick Aftershock to survive Barrage spam and trade safely into his poke without fearing all-ins.
- Buy Kaenic Rookern if Gangplank builds lethality or damage; it cuts his burst and gives MR.

shen__lissandra.notes:
- Threat: Lissandra's Ring of Frost roots you in place, then Frozen Tomb stuns you for guaranteed follow-up damage.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; her Ice Shard is a skillshot you can dodge by moving sideways unpredictably.
- Trading: Bait her Ring of Frost by walking close, then Shadow Dash away before it triggers; don't trade into it.
- Post6: Stand United becomes critical—use it proactively when she positions to all-in, negating her Frozen Tomb stun burst value.
- Spike: Her first Luden's Tempest spike (around 10 minutes) increases burst; farm safely and respect all-in range during this window.
- Window: Post-level 9 with Abyssal Mask and Mercury's Treads, her burst and root duration diminish; trade aggressively then.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower; her skillshots are easier to dodge with wall proximity, and ganks favor you defensively.
- Rune: Aftershock—the armor and magic resist proc instantly counters her Ring of Frost root-into-burst combo before Frozen Tomb lands.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern adds magic resist and tenacity—directly reduces Ring of Frost root duration and Frozen Tomb stun impact.

shen__swain.notes:
- Threat: Nevermove roots you in place; Demonic Ascension drains and locks you down despite shields.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1–3. Stay outside Vision of Empire range; abuse Q to poke and kite.
- Trading: Bait Nevermove by walking forward unpredictably, then all-in. Never let him root you near minions.
- Post6: Demonic Ascension makes extended fights unwinnable. Use Shadow Dash to escape or Stand United to leave.
- Spike: First item (Liandry's or similar) around 10–12 minutes. Punish him: he lacks healing items early.
- Window: Levels 4–5 before he maxes E. Trade hard, then reset. Post-15 minutes you outscale if ahead.
- Wave: Hold wave near your tower. If pushed, Shadow Dash out safely; never get caught mid-wave.
- Rune: Grasp + Domination. Sustain his poke and access Cheap Shot to trade damage back reliably.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern to reduce his drain healing and cut his slow effectiveness on Demonflare.

shen__soraka.notes:
- Threat: Soraka's Wish heals entire team instantly; silences you with Equinox, blocking Shadow Dash taunt.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; Soraka lacks damage. Stack Grasp procs on minions, avoid her Starcall.
- Trading: Bait Equinox before engaging. Dodge Starcall skillshot, then Shadow Dash through her for guaranteed taunt.
- Post6: Stand United cannot be stopped; she scales into teamfights. Mirror her utility with defensive Stand United plays.
- Spike: Her first item (usually Redemption) weakens Shen's all-in potential; farm safely, wait for cooldown windows.
- Window: Shen spikes harder mid-game with items like Jak'Sho and Kaenic Rookern; abuse this before she stacks healing.
- Wave: Hold wave near tower; forces Soraka closer, letting you Shadow Dash through minions to taunt safely.
- Rune: Standard (Grasp + Precision); sustain matches her healing and provides consistent lane pressure damage.
- Item: Kaenic Rookern reduces her healing output on teammates you protect with Stand United; rush before Warmog's.

sivir__pyke.notes:
- Threat: His R Death From Below executes at low health; stay full HP and avoid grouping near vulnerable allies.
- Early: Safe farming levels 1-3; his Q Bone Skewer is a skillshot you can dodge by moving unpredictably.
- Trading: Bait his Q by repositioning, then trade back with W Ricochet bounces; use E Spell Shield when he commits.
- Post6: Death From Below execution threat means never duel him alone at low HP; group with teammates for safety.
- Spike: Pyke's first item spike is moderate; you outscale him with Infinity Edge and attack speed builds.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights are your advantage; use R On The Hunt to kite and avoid his E Phantom Undertow dash.
- Wave: Push him into tower aggressively so he cannot roam mid; ping immediately when he leaves lane.
- Rune: Precision primary with Fleet of Foot synergy; sustain and mobility help you survive and kite his engage.
- Item: Build Mercurial Scimitar early against his hook threat; the active cleanse helps escape Q Bone Skewer pulls.
